paras.zh: 这些主题共同反映了行业在适应变化的同时寻求长期增长。

paras.en: Looking ahead: The future of construction
paras.zh: 展望未来：建筑业的未来

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG shines a bold spotlight on the companies and innovations redefining what’s next in the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Our team’s conversations and key learnings will help shape our strategies for the coming year, and we’re committed to driving progress!
paras.zh: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 大胆聚焦于重新定义建筑、采矿和骨料行业未来发展的公司和创新。我们团队的对话和重要经验将有助于制定我们来年的战略，我们致力于推动进步！

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India
paras.zh: 新工厂将非公路湿摩擦生产带至印度

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司 (Carlisle Brake & Friction) 已破土动工，以扩大其位于印度钦奈的制造业务，该工厂位于世界上增长最快的工业地区之一。 Carlisle CBF 在该地区生产机电一体化产品已超过 15 年，将搬迁至更大的工厂，增加非公路用纸湿式摩擦片和钢制隔板的生产。新设施计划于 2027 年开业。

paras.en: The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.
paras.zh: 扩大空间的目的是为了满足印度和东南亚农业、建筑业、特别是采矿业不断增长的需求所需的制造能力。本地生产将提高供应链响应能力，同时支持成本敏感市场的原始设备和售后市场要求。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 正在钦奈新工厂建立最先进的湿式摩擦制造设施，与成熟的全球制造工艺相媲美，以打造更具弹性的区域平台。此次扩张增强了我们提供耐用湿式摩擦产品的能力，有助于保持关键非公路设备的生产力。

articles.title: Jacobus CARSTAR Celebrates 50-Year Anniversary
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: CARSTAR is celebrating the 50th anniversary of Jacobus CARSTAR, a family-owned collision repair business serving Vancouver, Wash., and Clark County since Oct. 1, 1976.
paras.zh: CARSTAR 正在庆祝 Jacobus CARSTAR 成立 50 周年，这是一家家族企业，自 1976 年 10 月 1 日起为华盛顿州温哥华和克拉克县提供服务。

paras.en: Owned by Dave Jacobus, the shop cites five decades of quality craftsmanship, customer service and a commitment to doing the job right. Since opening, the business has evolved alongside the collision repair industry while remaining grounded in longstanding family values.
paras.zh: 该商店由戴夫·雅各布斯 (Dave Jacobus) 拥有，拥有五年来的优质工艺、客户服务和正确做好工作的承诺。自开业以来，该业务与碰撞修复行业一起发展，同时仍然立足于长期的家庭价值观。

paras.en: Over the past five decades, Jacobus CARSTAR has seen the transformation of the automotive industry. From repairing largely mechanical vehicles in the 1970s to servicing sophisticated vehicles equipped with advanced safety systems, cameras, sensors and onboard technology, the shop has invested in training, technology and equipment to meet the needs of modern drivers.
paras.zh: 在过去的五年里，Jacobus CARSTAR 见证了汽车行业的变革。从 20 世纪 70 年代主要维修机械车辆到维修配备先进安全系统、摄像头、传感器和车载技术的复杂车辆，该商店在培训、技术和设备方面进行了投资，以满足现代驾驶员的需求。

paras.en: “Fifty years ago, my father, Jerry Jacobus, opened a small auto body shop with a commitment to hard work, honesty and craftsmanship,” said Jacobus. “While the vehicles, technology and repair process have changed dramatically over the years, what has never changed is the pride we take in our work and the relationships we’ve built with our customers and community. We are incredibly grateful to everyone who has trusted us over the past five decades and allowed our family to be part of their lives.”
paras.zh: “五十年前，我的父亲杰里·雅各布斯 (Jerry Jacobus) 开了一家小型汽车车身修理厂，致力于努力工作、诚实和工艺，”雅各布斯说。 “多年来，虽然车辆、技术和维修流程发生了巨大变化，但从未改变的是我们对工作的自豪感以及我们与客户和社区建立的关系。我们非常感谢过去五年来信任我们并让我们的家庭成为他们生活一部分的每个人。”

paras.en: For Jacobus, the milestone is about more than longevity. It is about the people who helped make the journey possible.
paras.zh: 对于雅各布斯来说，这一里程碑不仅仅意味着长寿。这是关于那些帮助使这段旅程成为可能的人。

paras.en: “We’ve had the privilege of serving generations of families throughout Vancouver and Clark County,” Jacobus said. “We’re proud of the thousands of customers we’ve served, the dedicated employees who have been part of our story and the community that has supported us every step of the way. This anniversary belongs to all of them.”
paras.zh: “我们有幸为温哥华和克拉克县的几代家庭提供服务，”雅各布斯说。 “我们为我们服务过的数千名客户、参与我们故事的敬业员工以及一路支持我们的社区感到自豪。这个周年纪念日属于他们所有人。”

paras.en: “Reaching 50 years in business is an incredible accomplishment and a testament to the trust that Dave, his family, and the entire Jacobus CARSTAR team have earned within their community,” said Damien Reyna, COO, Driven Brands Collision Group. “For five decades, Jacobus CARSTAR has exemplified the highest standards of craftsmanship, customer care and professionalism. We are proud to celebrate this remarkable milestone and congratulate the Jacobus family on their lasting impact in Southwest Washington.”
paras.zh: Driven Brands Collision Group 首席运营官 Damien Reyna 表示：“从业 50 年是一项令人难以置信的成就，也证明了 Dave、他的家人以及整个 Jacobus CARSTAR 团队在社区中赢得的信任。” “五年来，Jacobus CARSTAR 体现了最高标准的工艺、客户服务和专业精神。我们很自豪能够庆祝这一非凡的里程碑，并祝贺 Jacobus 家族在华盛顿西南部产生的持久影响。”

paras.en: For more information, visit CARSTAR.com.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 CARSTAR.com。

articles.title: Experience: The Missing Ingredient in ADAS Calibrations
articles.author: Mitch Becker

paras.en: You hear this phrase in a lot of environments and jobs or careers. It’s a basic truth that the automotive repair industry has learned along with every other industry. Experience matters. Technicians coming out of college still need experience in automotive repair. I know there are exceptions, but in the majority of people coming into collision, mechanical, glass or any other facet of the automotive industry, there is a lack of experience.
paras.zh: 您在很多环境、工作或职业中都会听到这句话。这是汽车维修行业和其他行业一样都学到的基本事实。经验很重要。大学毕业的技术人员仍然需要汽车维修经验。我知道也有例外，但大多数接触碰撞、机械、玻璃或汽车行业任何其他方面的人都缺乏经验。

paras.en: Where do they get that experience? The basic answer is, “By doing the work.” The technician shortage and the low numbers of entry-level people coming into the industry have all of us looking at what can be done. With the rapid growth of electronics repair in all vehicles on the roadway and also that the transportation industry (gross vehicle weight over 10,000 lbs.) is competing for the same technicians whether experienced or entry-level, the repair industry will need more people to fulfill the need to repair these vehicles. The experienced technician is becoming more important to the industry than ever before. Mentors with experience, in my eyes, are priceless to any shop and the industry as a whole. I have to admit, I’m anxious to see how this all plays out throughout the industry in the very near future.
paras.zh: 他们从哪里获得这种经验？基本的答案是“通过工作”。技术人员短缺和进入该行业的入门级人员数量较少，让我们所有人都在考虑可以做些什么。随着道路上所有车辆电子维修的快速增长，以及运输行业（车辆总重超过 10,000 磅）正在争夺相同的技术人员，无论是经验丰富的还是入门级的，维修行业将需要更多的人员来满足维修这些车辆的需求。经验丰富的技术人员对行业来说比以往任何时候都变得更加重要。在我看来，有经验的导师对于任何商店和整个行业来说都是无价的。我不得不承认，我很想知道这一切在不久的将来会如何在整个行业中发挥作用。

paras.en: I can state in many ways how experience affects collision shops, and there are many people who are looking into ways to improve the situation. The same situation goes for dealerships and all other mechanical shops. When we discuss vehicle electronics, there are points to discuss that are still very new to many in the industry. The first point is that we all know each vehicle manufacturer has their own design and software for their vehicles. It can be different for each year, model and platform manufactured. Differences can be found even in same year, make and model of vehicles as vehicle manufacturers are updating or improving sensor performance everyday. This creates the need for a problem solver and a person who has the ability and tenacity to track down what needs to be done to work on these vehicles. I hear about more people doing and getting into doing calibrations. We do need more people getting into the industry as the number of vehicles on roadways that have ADAS and require calibrations for services climbs daily. Over the past years, I’ve learned that people and equipment are only part of what you need.
paras.zh: 我可以通过多种方式说明经验如何影响碰撞店，并且有很多人正在寻找改善这种情况的方法。同样的情况也适用于经销商和所有其他机械商店。当我们讨论汽车电子产品时，有一些要点对于业内许多人来说仍然是非常新鲜的。第一点是，我们都知道每个汽车制造商都有自己的车辆设计和软件。它可能因制造年份、型号和平台而异。由于汽车制造商每天都在更新或改进传感器性能，因此即使是同一年份、同一品牌和型号的车辆也可能存在差异。这就需要一个问题解决者和一个有能力和毅力来追踪这些车辆需要做什么的人。我听说越来越多的人正在做校准。随着道路上配备 ADAS 并需要校准服务的车辆数量每天都在增加，我们确实需要更多的人进入这个行业。在过去的几年里，我了解到人员和设备只是您所需要的一部分。

paras.en: You may have heard of the 80/20 rule: If it works 80% of the time, that’s great. The problem is a shop or technician will spend 90% of their time trying to fix that 20%. This is where experience counts on any level of vehicle repair.
paras.zh: 您可能听说过 80/20 规则：如果 80% 的时间有效，那就太好了。问题是商店或技术人员会花费 90% 的时间来尝试修复那 20% 的问题。这就是任何级别的车辆维修都需要经验的地方。

paras.en: I’ve seen new equipment come out that answers so many concerns that have been plaguing the industry on vehicles and issues of suspension alignment and vehicle structure alignment. We know the issue of a level datum plane in the shop to perform calibrations can be alleviated to an extent with new equipment available. Kudos to Autel and other equipment manufacturers on new equipment that can not only identify but document all these concerns. Stew Peregrine has put together great articles (see: Closing the OEM Procedure Gap in ADAS Calibration, August 2006 issue of BodyShop Business) addressing vehicle alignment issues on vehicles equipped with ADAS features that really need to be read by all. Any alignment, tire, mechanical or collision shop needs to be versed on these issues to be sure all the vehicle’s functions work after any service is performed that requires a calibration.
paras.zh: 我看到新设备的问世，解决了困扰业界的许多关于车辆以及悬架对准和车辆结构对准问题的担忧。我们知道，使用新设备可以在一定程度上缓解车间中用于执行校准的水平基准面的问题。感谢 Autel 和其他设备制造商的新设备，它们不仅可以识别而且可以记录所有这些问题。 Stew Peregrine 整理了一些很棒的文章（请参阅：《缩小 ADAS 校准中的 OEM 程序差距》，BodyShop Business 2006 年 8 月号），解决了配备 ADAS 功能的车辆的车辆对准问题，确实需要所有人阅读。任何定位、轮胎、机械或碰撞车间都需要熟悉这些问题，以确保在执行任何需要校准的服务后车辆的所有功能都能正常工作。

paras.en: The new calibration equipment available today is also adding target measuring and target alignment built into the equipment, reducing the need for the technician to find the centerline and target distance through measuring. This built-in feature not only saves time but reduces the problem of incorrect measuring or target placement experienced every day in the industry. These measuring errors cause calibration failures that confound technicians and require time to rectify. The new equipment with these measuring features also addresses the concern of calibrations that are passing but are incorrect due to target placement, affecting vehicle safety.
paras.zh: 今天推出的新校准设备还增加了设备内置的目标测量和目标对准功能，减少了技术人员通过测量找到中心线和目标距离的需要。这一内置功能不仅节省了时间，还减少了行业中每天遇到的错误测量或目标放置问题。这些测量误差会导致校准失败，使技术人员感到困惑并需要时间来纠正。具有这些测量功能的新设备还解决了校准通过但由于目标放置不正确而影响车辆安全的问题。

paras.en: The other phenomenal feature of the new calibration equipment is the documentation built in to protect shops and provide proof of correct calibration service to customers. All facets of the repair industry can appreciate all of the improved equipment available for shops that are doing calibrations in-house. With pedestrian protection becoming integrated into vehicles’ ADAS integrated software, calibrations will need to be performed exactly as electronics manufacturers designed them to work with their algorithm. The learning curve with the new equipment being offered to the industry by ADAS calibration equipment manufacturers will produce better results and require less manual labor for technicians, saving a shop time and money as well as controlling their cycle time and delivery dates. The goal of achieving the 80% is definitely within reach for any shop.
paras.zh: 新校准设备的另一个显着特点是内置文档，用于保护商店并向客户提供正确校准服务的证明。维修行业的各个方面都可以欣赏到内部校准商店可用的所有改进设备。随着行人保护功能被集成到车辆的 ADAS 集成软件中，校准将需要完全按照电子制造商设计的方式进行，以便与他们的算法配合使用。 ADAS 校准设备制造商向行业提供的新设备的学习曲线将产生更好的结果，并且需要更少的技术人员体力劳动，从而节省车间时间和金钱，并控制周期时间和交货日期。达到80%的目标对于任何一家店来说都是可以实现的。

paras.en: Now let’s talk 20%. Technician error is still one of the biggest reasons for failed calibrations and vehicles returning with lights on the dash or DTCs. Mismounted sensors and misaligned vehicle structure are all part of the shop and technician errors the industry sees. There is also process error that creates failures in calibrations where a technician does not follow each step in a process or does the steps required in an incorrect order.
paras.zh: 现在我们来谈谈20%。技术人员的错误仍然是校准失败和车辆返回时仪表板或故障码上有灯的最大原因之一。传感器安装错误和车辆结构错位都是行业中常见的车间和技术人员错误的一部分。还有一种过程错误会导致校准失败，即技术人员没有遵循过程中的每个步骤或以错误的顺序执行所需的步骤。

paras.en: Experience tells a service technician that when the forward-facing camera is removed from a windshield to lower the headliner on a vehicle with a gel sensor for the camera on the windshield, you should replace the pad versus reusing the gel pad. The calibration may be successful after the work is completed, but the air bubbles that are now in the pad between the glass and camera will be issues months down the road when heat expands them. The dealer will say the camera needs to be replaced versus the $18 gel sensor pad. And if the windshield was replaced before using a non-dealer glass, the cost goes up because many dealers will not work on any forward-facing camera without the dealer logo glass. And from what I’ve experienced, the dealers are always right in the customers’ eyes. It’s a great way to spend a couple thousand dollars on warranty. Unless the technician looked up the instructions for camera replacement or clicked on the hyperlink located in the windshield replacement instructions, he or she may not see this in the procedures. Diagnostic technicians and many shops have learned this through experience.
paras.zh: 经验告诉维修技术人员，当挡风玻璃上装有用于摄像头的凝胶传感器的车辆上的前向摄像头从挡风玻璃上拆下以降低车顶内衬时，您应该更换该垫，而不是重复使用凝胶垫。工作完成后校准可能会成功，但玻璃和相机之间的垫子中的气泡在几个月后会因热量膨胀而出现问题。经销商会说相机需要更换，而不是 18 美元的凝胶传感器垫。如果在使用非经销商玻璃之前更换挡风玻璃，则成本会上升，因为许多经销商不会在没有经销商标志玻璃的情况下使用任何前置摄像头。根据我的经验，经销商在顾客眼中永远是对的。这是花几千美元购买保修的好方法。除非技术人员查找摄像头更换说明或单击挡风玻璃更换说明中的超链接，否则他或她可能在程序中看不到这一点。诊断技术人员和许多商店都通过经验了解到了这一点。

paras.en: The experience I speak of comes from the failures you experience and learn from while working on cars over time and the trial and error of finding the resolutions to certain issues. Many of these vehicles that have been on the road for a minute have started developing internal issues from heat and use, or smashed electronics and wiring, or modules experiencing shock damage during the collision. Experienced technicians see the issue and diagnose the issues and variables occurring during the repair process.
paras.zh: 我所说的经验来自于你在汽车工作过程中经历的失败和从中学到的教训，以及寻找解决某些问题的解决方案的反复试验。许多车辆在行驶了一分钟后就开始出现由于发热和使用而产生的内部问题，或者电子设备和线路被砸碎，或者模块在碰撞过程中受到冲击损坏。经验丰富的技术人员会发现问题并诊断维修过程中发生的问题和变量。

paras.en: The other part of the 20% is the process of diagnostics, coding and programming. The tips and tricks a diagnostic technician must use to work within the vehicle software are sometimes unbelievable – like knowing to leave a hood unlatched to access specific modules, or moving away from the vehicle with the key FOB during specific processes, or even the time required before cycling a key to clear DTC codes. The one I love the most is specific to some forward-facing cameras: if the calibration is not completing, the technician must know to stop and disconnect camera to let the internal circuits cool down because the camera is overheating. An indication of this is that the camera is very hot to the touch. Many technicians will place the camera in a freezer to avoid setting a “camera overheated DTC” that requires a camera replacement.
paras.zh: 20%的另一部分是诊断、编码和编程的过程。诊断技术人员在车辆软件中工作时必须使用的提示和技巧有时令人难以置信，例如知道要打开引擎盖以访问特定模块，或者在特定过程中带着钥匙 FOB 离开车辆，甚至在循环钥匙之前需要时间来清除 DTC 代码。我最喜欢的是一些前置摄像头：如果校准没有完成，技术人员必须知道停止并断开摄像头，让内部电路冷却，因为摄像头过热。一个迹象是相机摸起来很热。许多技术人员会将相​​机放入冰箱中，以避免出现需要更换相机的“相机过热故障码”。

paras.en: Technicians must learn which module in a vehicle has to be updated to program another module. Vehicle manufacturers are also controlling access to vehicles, as security in the vehicle is becoming more of a necessity as integration inside the vehicle and outside in V2V interface becomes the norm.
paras.zh: 技术人员必须了解必须更新车辆中的哪个模块才能对另一个模块进行编程。汽车制造商也在控制对车辆的访问，因为随着车辆内部和外部 V2V 接口的集成成为常态，车辆的安全性变得越来越重要。

paras.en: And these are just minor diagnostics that a technician needs to know.
paras.zh: 这些只是技术人员需要了解的小诊断。

paras.en: The ability to know which module needs to be accessed to complete a calibration that keeps failing. Knowing what parts will need to be programmed, and understanding internet speeds and latency needed to complete that programming. Using a digital angle finder to be sure the sensor is at the correct angle to be calibrated.
paras.zh: 能够知道需要访问哪个模块才能完成不断失败的校准。了解需要对哪些部分进行编程，并了解完成该编程所需的互联网速度和延迟。使用数字测角器确保传感器处于要校准的正确角度。

paras.en: These are all factors in a diagnostic technician’s everyday life. The amount of time and research to resolve the 20% is extensive. A shop just entering into the calibration arena will learn that there’s more to know and learn than just calibrations. I do believe that to control cycle time and delivery status, many shops do need to look at buying the equipment to do calibrations. But that 20% can be a red flag in the back of your mind as those issues will become a part of your life.
paras.zh: 这些都是诊断技术人员日常生活中的所有因素。解决这 20% 问题需要大量的时间和研究。刚刚进入校准领域的商店将会了解到，除了校准之外，还有更多需要了解和学习的东西。我确实相信，为了控制周期时间和交货状态，许多商店确实需要考虑购买设备来进行校准。但这 20% 可能会成为您心中的危险信号，因为这些问题将成为您生活的一部分。

paras.en: With all this being said, finding experienced technicians can be a difficult task. There are definitely different levels of experience. You have a technician that can do calibrations, and then a technician that can do diagnostics. Add on to this wire repair and the ability to navigate multiple software platforms. Then there’s the need to understand all the battery-electric vehicle (BEV) information and/or servicing BEV/HEV platforms. You have to have a lot of knowledge and/or the ability to learn and follow processes diligently. This creates a unique and valuable asset to any shop. Having these skills in-house can result in a very good revenue stream for any shop as it gives the shop the ability to control cycle time, delivery and costs associated with vehicle electronics.
paras.zh: 话虽如此，寻找经验丰富的技术人员可能是一项艰巨的任务。肯定有不同级别的经验。您有一名可以进行校准的技术人员，然后还有一名可以进行诊断的技术人员。添加此线路修复和导航多个软件平台的能力。然后需要了解所有电池电动汽车 (BEV) 信息和/或维修 BEV/HEV 平台。您必须拥有大量知识和/或勤奋学习和遵循流程的能力。这为任何商店创造了独特且有价值的资产。拥有这些内部技能可以为任何商店带来非常好的收入来源，因为它使商店能够控制与车辆电子设备相关的周期时间、交付和成本。

paras.en: This experienced technician is also being sought after by everyone in the industry. Finding a technician with the skills your shop needs will take some time and effort. We as an industry need to be offering careers for our technicians, not jobs. Helping someone see a future with your shop might help you find that special technician. As to my understanding today — and I could be wrong — I have not seen a school or training program that can provide all these required skills. I see many programs that can introduce enough skills to someone to enter the industry, but not advanced skills. There are training series a technician can take, but I’ve yet to see a complete program that offers hands-on experience. I’d love to be proven wrong here and would love to see these programs if they’re out there, and I would absolutely promote these programs. But most experience and learning comes from apprenticeships or mentorship by companies trying to grow their technician base. I totally applaud those companies that are investing in entry-level technicians In all of the trades for any industry, this time and cost is building the next generation of technicians these industries need.
paras.zh: 这位经验丰富的技术人员也受到业内人士的追捧。寻找具有您商店所需技能的技术人员需要一些时间和精力。作为一个行业，我们需要为技术人员提供职业生涯，而不是工作岗位。帮助某人看到您商店的未来可能会帮助您找到特殊的技术人员。就我今天的理解而言——我可能是错的——我还没有见过能够提供所有这些所需技能的学校或培训项目。我看到许多项目可以向某人介绍足够的技能以进入该行业，但不能介绍高级技能。技术人员可以参加一些培训系列，但我还没有看到一个提供实践经验的完整计划。我很乐意在这里被证明是错误的，并且很乐意看到这些项目（如果它们存在），而且我绝对会推广这些项目。但大多数经验和学习都来自于试图扩大技术人员基础的公司的学徒或指导。我完全赞赏那些投资于入门级技术人员的公司。在任何行业的所有行业中，这些时间和成本都在培养这些行业所需的下一代技术人员。

paras.en: A number of companies have stepped up to help shops needing guidance for calibrations and the diagnostic needs. Protech Automotive Solutions and AirPro Diagnostics’ acquisition of REVV with their ADAS support are some of the companies offering the technical help that shops need. Whether it be remote help or car side, shops may find these technical services invaluable. Having experienced people who know what you’re experiencing on the line being able to access your equipment to be live with you right there can be a cost savings to any business — along with the ability to provide car side support with OE software is coverage you can’t deny would be a necessity.
paras.zh: 许多公司已加紧帮助需要校准和诊断需求指导的商店。 Protech Automotive Solutions 和 AirPro Diagnostics 收购 REVV 及其 ADAS 支持是为商店提供所需技术帮助的公司之一。无论是远程帮助还是汽车方面，商店可能会发现这些技术服务非常宝贵。拥有经验丰富的人员，他们知道您在生产线上遇到的情况，能够访问您的设备并与您一起生活，这对任何企业来说都可以节省成本，而且使用 OE 软件提供汽车端支持的能力是您不可否认的必要条件。

paras.en: I also truly appreciate what ASE is doing on levels of certification for technicians performing all levels of calibrations. These ASE certifications will be valuable to any part of the repair industry including collision, auto glass, mechanical and transportation. The levels and what they cover is very well thought out and will set the bar for certifications to meet possible new state laws that will be affecting calibrations. This is very evident what may be coming to the auto repair industry as more states are enacting new laws on windshield replacement and calibrations. The Auto Glass Safety Council is also doing certifications for auto glass technicians to meet what the future is going to be possibly requiring for performing work and or licensing.
paras.zh: 我也非常欣赏 ASE 在为执行各级校准的技术人员提供级别认证方面所做的工作。这些 ASE 认证对于维修行业的任何部分都具有价值，包括碰撞、汽车玻璃、机械和运输。这些级别及其涵盖的内容经过深思熟虑，将为认证设定标准，以满足可能影响校准的新州法律。随着越来越多的州颁布有关挡风玻璃更换和校准的新法律，汽车维修行业可能面临的情况非常明显。汽车玻璃安全委员会还正在对汽车玻璃技术人员进行认证，以满足未来执行工作和/或许可的可能要求。

paras.en: Experience is not just doing the work on repairing vehicles. Experience is also knowing what you as a technician or shop will need for support and to be prepared for what is coming. Trust me, there is more coming and fast. Choosing the right equipment is only part of what you need. Choosing the right technical support with the experience you need is just as critical.
paras.zh: 经验不仅仅是修理车辆的工作。经验还意味着知道您作为技术人员或商店需要什么支持并为即将发生的事情做好准备。相信我，更多的事情即将到来，而且速度很快。选择正确的设备只是您需要的一部分。选择具有您所需经验的正确技术支持同样重要。

articles.title: CCC Intelligent Solutions Signs Definitive Agreement to Be Acquired by GTCR and Elliott
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. announced that it entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by a consortium of private investment firms led by GTCR, including Elliott Investment Management L.P., in an all-cash transaction with an enterprise value of approximately $6.1 billion.
paras.zh: CCC Intelligence Solutions Holdings Inc. 宣布签订最终协议，由 GTCR 牵头的私人投资公司财团（包括 Elliott Investment Management L.P.）以全现金交易方式收购，企业价值约为 61 亿美元。

paras.en: Under the terms, CCC stockholders will receive $7.75 in cash for each share of common stock. The price represents a premium of approximately 44% to CCC’s unaffected closing stock price on July 9, 2026, and approximately 59% to the 30-day average price as of July 9, 2026.
paras.zh: 根据条款，CCC 股东每股普通股将获得 7.75 美元现金。该价格较 CCC 2026 年 7 月 9 日未受影响的收盘价溢价约 44%，较截至 2026 年 7 月 9 日的 30 天平均价溢价约 59%。

paras.en: Based in Chicago, CCC connects more than 35,000 businesses across the insurance economy. The company draws on 40 years of industry data and over a decade of AI embedded into mission-critical workflows to help customers improve decision-making, efficiency and outcomes across the claims and repair lifecycle.
paras.zh: CCC 总部位于芝加哥，连接保险经济领域的 35,000 多家企业。该公司利用 40 年的行业数据以及十多年来嵌入关键任务工作流程的人工智能技术，帮助客户在整个索赔和维修生命周期中改进决策、提高效率和结果。

paras.en: “Throughout CCC’s history, we have helped customers navigate growing complexity and achieve better outcomes through technology and innovation,” said Githesh Ramamurthy, chairman and CEO of CCC. “With GTCR and Elliott’s experience and resources, we will continue to build on our momentum and extend our leadership. Together, we will accelerate the AI and agentic capabilities our customers want from us, expand the network at the center of our platform, and continue to develop and build our world class team. I am deeply grateful to our employees for their dedication and commitment to our customers, and I am excited for all that we will accomplish together in this next chapter.
paras.zh: CCC 董事长兼首席执行官 Githesh Ramamurthy 表示：“纵观 CCC 的历史，我们帮助客户应对日益增长的复杂性，并通过技术和创新取得更好的成果。” “凭借 GTCR 和 Elliott 的经验和资源，我们将继续巩固我们的势头并扩大我们的领导地位。我们将共同加速客户希望我们提供的人工智能和代理能力，扩大我们平台中心的网络，并继续发展和建设我们的世界一流团队。我非常感谢我们的员工对客户的奉献和承诺，我对我们在下一章中共同完成的一切感到兴奋。

paras.en: “Today’s announcement follows a thorough review of strategic options with assistance from our financial and legal advisors. Our board of directors is confident this transaction recognizes the strength of the business our team has built while delivering immediate and premium cash value to our stockholders.”
paras.zh: “今天的公告是在我们的财务和法律顾问的协助下对战略选择进行了彻底审查之后发布的。我们的董事会相信，这项交易认可了我们团队所建立的业务实力，同时为我们的股东提供了即时和优质的现金价值。”

paras.en: “We have followed CCC for years and believe the company is uniquely positioned to support their customers as they increasingly adopt AI solutions to improve decision making and efficiency across the claims and repair lifecycle,” said Mark Anderson, managing director, head of technology, Media & Telecommunications at GTCR. “We look forward to partnering with Githesh and the talented CCC team to support continued investment in product innovation and AI capabilities, expand the company’s offerings and build long-term value. Our focus will be on helping CCC deliver better outcomes for its customers while supporting CCC’s next phase of growth.”
paras.zh: GTCR 董事总经理兼技术、媒体和电信主管 Mark Anderson 表示：“我们多年来一直关注 CCC，并相信该公司具有独特的优势，可以为客户提供支持，因为他们越来越多地采用人工智能解决方案来提高整个索赔和维修生命周期的决策和效率。” “我们期待与 Githesh 和才华横溢的 CCC 团队合作，支持对产品创新和人工智能能力的持续投资，扩大公司的产品范围并建立长期价值。我们的重点将是帮助 CCC 为客户提供更好的成果，同时支持 CCC 下一阶段的增长。”

paras.en: “We have strong belief in CCC’s position as the trusted third party at the center of the automotive insurance and repair industry,” said David Kerko, head of Global Private Equity at Elliott. “CCC’s role within the large ecosystem of insurers, repair facilities, automakers and parts suppliers creates strong data advantages and network benefits for their more than 35,000 customers. We believe these advantages make CCC a highly durable franchise in vertical software — which AI will only make more valuable as CCC delivers the next generation of capabilities to its customers.”
paras.zh: Elliott 全球私募股权主管 David Kerko 表示：“我们坚信 CCC 作为汽车保险和维修行业中心值得信赖的第三方的地位。” “CCC 在由保险公司、维修机构、汽车制造商和零部件供应商组成的大型生态系统中发挥的作用，为其超过 35,000 名客户创造了强大的数据优势和网络优势。我们相信，这些优势使 CCC 成为垂直软件领域高度持久的特许经营权——随着 CCC 向客户提供下一代功能，人工智能只会让这种优势变得更有价值。”

paras.en: The transaction was approved by CCC’s board of directors and is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including required regulatory approvals and approval of CCC stockholders.
paras.zh: 该交易已获得 CCC 董事会批准，预计将于 2027 年第一季度完成，但须满足惯例成交条件，包括所需的监管批准和 CCC 股东的批准。

paras.en: Until the transaction closes, CCC remains publicly traded and will continue operating as an independent company. The transaction is not subject to a financing condition.
paras.zh: 在交易完成之前，CCC 仍保持公开交易并将继续作为一家独立公司运营。该交易不受融资条件限制。

paras.en: Upon completion, CCC will become a privately held company, and its common stock will no longer be listed on the Nasdaq.
paras.zh: 完成后，CCC将成为一家私人控股公司，其普通股将不再在纳斯达克上市。

articles.title: Penske enters merger agreement to be taken private
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Penske Automotive Group, an automotive and commercial truck retailer, has entered a merger agreement to be taken private by Motown Acquisition Group (Owned by Penske Corporation) and Mitsui & Company, according to a press release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，汽车和商用卡车零售商潘世奇汽车集团 (Penske Automotive Group) 已签订合并协议，将由摩城收购集团 (Motown Acquisition Group，由潘世奇公司所有) 和三井物产公司 (Mitsui & Company) 私有化。

paras.en: The proposed transaction was unanimously recommended by a special committee of independent and disinterested directors of the board of directors, the release states. It was formed to evaluate and consider the proposal and was advised by independent legal and financial advisors. The transaction was approved by the board per the recommendation of the special committee.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，拟议的交易是由董事会独立且无利害关系的董事组成的特别委员会一致推荐的。该委员会的成立是为了评估和考虑该提案，并由独立法律和财务顾问提供建议。该交易已根据特别委员会的建议获得董事会批准。

paras.en: “We are pleased to have reached this agreement with Penske and Mitsui, our largest shareholders,” said David Hoogendoorn, Penske Automotive Group board member and the special committee Chair. “The Special Committee thoroughly reviewed the proposal and considered the benefits of the transaction as compared to continuing as a public company, and determined that this transaction provided the greatest value for the Company’s minority shareholders.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴与我们最大的股东潘世奇和三井物产达成这项协议，”潘世奇汽车集团董事会成员兼特别委员会主席 David Hoogendoorn 表示。 “特别委员会彻底审查了该提案，并考虑了该交易与继续作为上市公司相比的好处，并确定该交易为公司的少数股东提供了最大的价值。”

paras.en: Under the terms of the merger agreement, holders of Penske Automotive Group common stock will receive $212 per share in cash, valuing the company at an enterprise value of approximately $16.3 billion. Penske Corporation, Mitsui and other investment group members were excluded from receiving cash for shares.
paras.zh: 根据合并协议的条款，潘世奇汽车集团普通股持有人将获得每股 212 美元的现金，使该公司的企业价值约为 163 亿美元。潘世奇公司、三井物产和其他投资集团成员被排除在收到股票现金之外。

paras.en: About 64% of Penske Automotive Group’s ownership will be held by Penske and 36% to be held by Mitsui.
paras.zh: 潘世奇汽车集团约 64% 的股权将由潘世奇持有，36% 将由三井持有。

paras.en: The purchase price represents a premium of about 8.6% to the closing price of the company’s common stock on July 21 and a premium of about 20.09% and 26.17% to the 60-day and 90-day volume weighted average prices for the period ending July 21. It was an 8.84% premium to the closing price of the Company’s common stock on Oct. 14.
paras.zh: 此次收购价格较该公司普通股7月21日收盘价溢价约8.6%，较截至7月21日期间60天和90天成交量加权平均价格溢价约20.09%和26.17%。较该公司普通股10月14日收盘价溢价约8.84%。

paras.en: Regular quarterly cash dividends will continue to be paid through the closing of the transaction, not to exceed $0.02 per share above the per share amount of the last quarterly dividend declared and paid by the company.
paras.zh: 交易结束前，将继续支付定期季度现金股息，每股股息不超过公司宣布并支付的上一季度股息每股金额的 0.02 美元。

paras.en: “I want to thank the special committee for its thoughtful and diligent evaluation of the transaction,” said Roger Penske, chair and CEO of the company. “This transaction marks an important next chapter for PAG. Mitsui has been a shareholder for 25 years, and we have had a productive relationship over the past quarter-century. Together with Mitsui, we will build on PAG’s operational excellence and draw on our combined capabilities and networks to drive innovation and expand PAG’s business through new opportunities and collaborative projects.”
paras.zh: 该公司董事长兼首席执行官罗杰·彭斯克(Roger Penske)表示：“我要感谢特别委员会对本次交易进行深思熟虑和勤勉的评估。” “这项交易标志着 PAG 翻开了重要的新篇章。三井物产作为股东已有 25 年，在过去 25 年里我们一直保持着富有成效的关系。我们将与三井物产一起，以 PAG 的卓越运营为基础，​​利用我们的综合能力和网络来推动创新，并通过新的机会和合作项目拓展 PAG 的业务。”

paras.en: The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027. The closing will require a receipt of regulatory approvals and the affirmative vote of the holders of a majority of outstanding shares of the company’s common stock, and approval by holders of a majority of the votes cast by unaffiliated stockholders.
paras.zh: 该交易预计将于 2027 年第一季度完成。完成交易需要获得监管部门的批准、公司普通股多数已发行股股东的赞成票，以及非关联股东多数票的持有者的批准。

paras.en: The stocks will no longer be traded or listed on the New York Stock Exchange, following closing of the transaction.
paras.zh: 交易结束后，这些股票将不再在纽约证券交易所交易或上市。

articles.title: Autel software update gains access to Nissan’s restricted CONSULT 4 vehicle line
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Nissan’s CONSULT 4 vehicle line secures access to critical vehicle systems, but Autel says it has gained access for ADAS calibrations and other services.
paras.zh: Nissan 的 CONSULT 4 车辆系列可确保对关键车辆系统的访问，但 Autel 表示，它已获得 ADAS 校准和其他服务的访问权限。

paras.en: A news release from Autel says that available functions include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, active tests and ADAS calibration procedures, depending on the vehicle.
paras.zh: Autel 的新闻稿称，可用功能包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序，具体取决于车辆。

paras.en: The software gives access to protected vehicle functions through AutoAuth, the release adds.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿补充说，该软件可以通过 AutoAuth 访问受保护的车辆功能。

paras.en: “Our current licensing covers data and all current secure gateway access,” Paul A. Marshall, Autel director of product development, told Repairer Driven News (RDN). “This includes AutoAuth and the MAC Keys Auth licensing process to access secured Body Control Modules.”
paras.zh: “我们目前的许可涵盖数据和所有当前的安全网关访问，”Autel 产品开发总监 Paul A. Marshall 告诉 Repairer Driven News (RDN)。 “这包括 AutoAuth 和 MAC Keys Auth 许可流程，以访问安全的车身控制模块。”

paras.en: Marshall said this access is necessary to calibrate some 2025 and 2026 Nissan vehicles.
paras.zh: 马歇尔表示，此访问权限对于校准部分 2025 年和 2026 年日产汽车是必要的。

paras.en: “We worked with Nissan U.S. and Japan to validate our process,” Marshall said.
paras.zh: “我们与日产美国和日本合作验证我们的流程，”马歇尔说。

paras.en: The Equipment and Tool Institute (ETI) manages Autel’s Nissan licensing, Marshall further explained. He said ETI worked directly with Nissan during the process.
paras.zh: 马歇尔进一步解释说，设备和工具研究所 (ETI) 管理 Autel 的 Nissan 许可。他表示，在此过程中，ETI 直接与 Nissan 合作。

paras.en: Allison A. Whitney, Autel’s director of corporate communications, told RDN that Nissan provided security-access information and reviewed diagnostic logs supplied by Autel. She adds that the automaker also provided guidance on accessing protected vehicle control modules and that in specific logs, Nissan confirmed successful security access and command transmission.
paras.zh: Autel 的企业传播总监 Allison A. Whitney 告诉 RDN，日产提供了安全访问信息并审查了 Autel 提供的诊断日志。她补充说，该汽车制造商还提供了有关访问受保护的车辆控制模块的指南，并且在特定日志中，日产确认了成功的安全访问和命令传输。

paras.en: Whitney noted that “technical assistance is distinct from Nissan’s endorsement or certification of Autel products.”
paras.zh: 惠特尼指出，“技术援助不同于日产对 Autel 产品的认可或认证。”

paras.en: Nissan’s technical review of particular access sequences and diagnostic logs should not be interpreted as product-wide validation, Whitney said.
paras.zh: 惠特尼表示，日产对特定访问序列和诊断日志的技术审查不应被解释为整个产品范围的验证。

paras.en: “Approval for a dealer equipment program is also a separate matter,” Whitney said.
paras.zh: “经销商设备计划的批准也是另一回事，”惠特尼说。

paras.en: She adds that Autel is pursuing approval for its IA1000 through that process and approval is pending.
paras.zh: 她补充说，Autel 正在通过该流程寻求其 IA1000 的批准，目前正在等待批准。

paras.en: Autel’s diagnostic software for Nissan is available on MaxiSYS Ultra and Ultra S2 tablets, Autel’s release states. The ADAS calibration capabilities are available on Ultra and Ultra S2 series tablets with ADAS calibration software.
paras.zh: Autel 的发布声明称，Autel 的 Nissan 诊断软件可在 MaxiSYS Ultra 和 Ultra S2 平板电脑上使用。配备 ADAS 校准软件的 Ultra 和 Ultra S2 系列平板电脑提供 ADAS 校准功能。

paras.en: “On newer Nissan platforms, security-gateway restrictions previously prevented aftermarket diagnostic tools from accessing certain protected functions, including code clearing, Active Tests, and ADAS calibration procedures,” said Vinie Putrino, Autel senior testing specialist, during a live demonstration at Auto Glass Week 2026, according to the release. “This expanded access gives Autel users the ability to perform supported diagnostic and calibration functions through the established AutoAuth authorization process.”
paras.zh: 根据新闻稿，Autel 高级测试专家 Vinie Putrino 在 2026 年汽车玻璃周现场演示中表示：“在较新的 Nissan 平台上，安全网关限制此前阻止售后诊断工具访问某些受保护的功能，包括代码清除、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。” “这种扩展的访问权限使 Autel 用户能够通过既定的 AutoAuth 授权流程执行受支持的诊断和校准功能。”

paras.en: The release notes that Nissan began incorporating security-gateway protections into select North American vehicles with the 2020 model year. The protections restrict access to designated bidirectional functions unless the technician, shop, and diagnostic tool are properly authenticated.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿指出，日产开始将安全网关保护纳入 2020 年款的精选北美车辆中。除非技术人员、车间和诊断工具经过正确的身份验证，否则保护措施会限制对指定双向功能的访问。

paras.en: Autel has offered AutoAuth-based Nissan security-gateway access for several years on applicable vehicles supported by Nissan’s CONSULT-III plus diagnostic platform, according to the release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，Autel 多年来一直在日产 CONSULT-III plus 诊断平台支持的适用车辆上提供基于 AutoAuth 的日产安全网关访问。

paras.en: CONSULT 4, Nissan’s newer web-based diagnostic software, was introduced for the 2023 Nissan Ariya and is now on a growing number of newer Nissan vehicle platforms, the release states. It adds that supporting functions on these vehicles required Autel to develop and validate a reliable authorization process compatible with newer electronic architectures.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，CONSULT 4 是 Nissan 较新的基于网络的诊断软件，专为 2023 款 Nissan Ariya 推出，目前已安装在越来越多的较新 Nissan 车辆平台上。它还补充说，这些车辆上的支持功能需要 Autel 开发和验证与更新的电子架构兼容的可靠授权流程。

paras.en: Whitney says that AutoAuth provided the authentication and authorization process used to obtain secure access to protected Nissan vehicle functions with compatible aftermarket tools. She adds that it connects eligible shops, users, and tools with Nissan’s security access process.
paras.zh: 惠特尼表示，AutoAuth 提供了身份验证和授权流程，用于通过兼容的售后工具安全访问受保护的日产汽车功能。她补充说，它将符合条件的商店、用户和工具与日产的安全访问流程连接起来。

paras.en: “Gateway access and access to a particular protected control module can involve separate requirements,” Whitney said. “Successful authentication does not, by itself, establish that every function is supported or that a calibration has been completed successfully.”
paras.zh: “网关访问和对特定受保护控制模块的访问可能涉及不同的要求，”惠特尼说。 “成功的身份验证本身并不表明所有功能均受支持或校准已成功完成。”

paras.en: Autel-developed software communicates with the vehicle’s control modules to request supported diagnostic and service functions, Whitney explained. She said that the announced functionality does not run Nissan’s CONSULT 4.
paras.zh: 惠特尼解释说，Autel 开发的软件与车辆的控制模块进行通信，以请求支持的诊断和服务功能。她表示，所公布的功能并不运行 Nissan 的 CONSULT 4。

paras.en: Autel describes the new capability as “comprehensive diagnostic and ADAS calibration access across supported Nissan vehicles using the CONSULT 4 platform.”
paras.zh: Autel 将这项新功能描述为“使用 CONSULT 4 平台对受支持的 Nissan 车辆进行全面的诊断和 ADAS 校准访问”。

paras.en: Whitney describes the access as the breadth of supported bidirectional functions beyond reading fault codes and live data.
paras.zh: 惠特尼将访问描述为除读取故障代码和实时数据之外支持的双向功能的广度。

paras.en: “Bidirectional capability allows the tool to send commands to the vehicle — for example, to activate a component for testing or initiate a supported ADAS calibration routine,” Whitney said. “Coverage varies by vehicle, control module, and procedure. The term should not be read as a guarantee of every CONSULT 4 function on every Nissan vehicle. Shops should verify coverage for the specific vehicle and procedure and use the required software, equipment, targets, and accessories.”
paras.zh: “双向功能允许该工具向车辆发送命令，例如，激活组件进行测试或启动支持的 ADAS 校准程序，”Whitney 说。 “覆盖范围因车辆、控制模块和程序而异。该术语不应被理解为对每辆 Nissan 车辆上的每项 CONSULT 4 功能的保证。商店应验证特定车辆和程序的覆盖范围，并使用所需的软件、设备、目标和配件。”

paras.en: The release states that North American Nissan vehicles using CONSULT 4 include:
paras.zh: 该新闻稿指出，使用 CONSULT 4 的北美 Nissan 车辆包括：

paras.en: - 2025 and newer Nissan Kicks, Murano, Pathfinder, and Armada; and
paras.zh: - 2025 款及更新款 Nissan Kicks、Murano、Pathfinder 和 Armada；和

paras.en: - 2026 and newer Nissan Sentra and Leaf.
paras.zh: - 2026 年及更新的 Nissan Sentra 和 Leaf。

paras.en: Autel says that its expanded Nissan coverage is included in its new MA800 mobile ADAS calibration system. It is built on the MA600 platform and combines dual-laser positioning, mirror alignment, and independent pitch, roll, and yaw adjustment.
paras.zh: Autel 表示，其扩大的 Nissan 覆盖范围已包含在其新的 MA800 移动 ADAS 校准系统中。它基于MA600平台构建，结合了双激光定位、镜像对准以及独立的俯仰、横滚和偏航调整。

paras.en: “Integrated validation features allow technicians to check target height, target distance, and vehicle-to-frame distance against applicable specifications before beginning a calibration,” the release states. “These checks are designed to support accurate, repeatable target placement under appropriate shop conditions.”
paras.zh: “集成的验证功能允许技术人员在开始校准之前根据适用的规范检查目标高度、目标距离和车辆到框架的距离，”该新闻稿称。 “这些检查旨在支持在适当的车间条件下准确、可重复的目标放置。”

paras.en: When RDN asked what determines successful calibration, Whitney said the vehicle’s control module executes the routine and evaluates completion using manufacturer-defined criteria.
paras.zh: 当 RDN 询问什么决定校准成功时，惠特尼表示，车辆的控制模块执行例程并使用制造商定义的标准评估完成情况。

paras.en: “Autel’s software initiates the supported routine and reports the result returned by the vehicle; Autel does not substitute its own acceptance thresholds for those programmed by Nissan,” Whitney said. “A proper calibration also depends on meeting the applicable service procedure’s requirements, including vehicle condition, equipment and target setup, environmental conditions, and any required verification steps. A successful routine result must be interpreted within that complete procedure.
paras.zh: “Autel 的软件启动支持的例程并报告车辆返回的结果；Autel 不会用自己的接受阈值替换 Nissan 编程的阈值，”惠特尼说。 “正确的校准还取决于满足适用的服务程序的要求，包括车辆状况、设备和目标设置、环境条件以及任何所需的验证步骤。成功的例行结果必须在整个程序中进行解释。

paras.en: “The benefit of this release is that appropriately equipped independent shops can perform additional supported Nissan diagnostic and calibration work in-house, subject to the stated coverage and procedural requirements.”
paras.zh: “此版本的好处是，配备适当的独立商店可以根据规定的覆盖范围和程序要求在内部执行额外的支持日产诊断和校准工作。”

paras.en: Late-model Nissan and Infiniti vehicles may incorporate forward and rear-facing radar, cameras, around view monitor systems, and other ADAS capabilities, the release states. These systems may require calibration following windshield replacement, collision repair, suspension or alignment work, component replacement, or other service events as specified by the automaker.
paras.zh: 最新型号的日产和英菲尼迪汽车可能会配备前向和后向雷达、摄像头、环视监控系统和其他 ADAS 功能。这些系统可能需要在更换挡风玻璃、碰撞修复、悬架或对准工作、部件更换或汽车制造商指定的其他服务事件后进行校准。

paras.en: Autel’s expanded capabilities are available through Autel Nissan V7.40 diagnostic software and Nissan ADAS V5.20 software release.
paras.zh: Autel 的扩展功能可通过 Autel Nissan V7.40 诊断软件和 Nissan ADAS V5.20 软件版本获得。

paras.en: Access requires an active Autel software subscription and AutoAuth account for Nissan access and applicable Autel ADAS calibration software, equipment, targets, and accessories when performing a calibration.
paras.zh: 执行校准时，访问需要有效的 Autel 软件订阅和 AutoAuth 帐户才能访问 Nissan 以及适用的 Autel ADAS 校准软件、设备、目标和配件。

articles.title: ADAS Showcase expanded and made interactive for this year’s SEMA Show goers
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Through its newly launched ADAS Council, the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) is working with SEMA Show organizers to significantly expand this year’s ADAS Showcase, according to a press release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，通过新成立的 ADAS 委员会，碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 正在与 SEMA 展会组织者合作，大幅扩大今年的 ADAS 展示范围。

paras.en: SCRS and SEMA say the showcase will be newly interactive, bringing vehicle manufacturers, technical experts, working technicians, and calibration technology together on the show floor.
paras.zh: SCRS 和 SEMA 表示，此次展示将采用全新的互动方式，将车辆制造商、技术专家、工作技术人员和校准技术聚集在展厅中。

paras.en: Located in Upper South Hall, booth 31200, adjacent to the Collision Repair & Refinish section, the expanded ADAS Showcase will feature two fully equipped calibration bays, late-model ADAS-equipped vehicles, diagnostic and calibration equipment, and a rotating schedule of technical discussions and hands-on demonstrations.
paras.zh: 扩大后的 ADAS 展示柜位于上南厅 31200 号展位，毗邻碰撞修复和修补部分，将配备两个设备齐全的校准台、配备最新型 ADAS 的车辆、诊断和校准设备，以及轮流安排的技术讨论和实践演示。

paras.en: SCRS programming will be held daily, Nov. 3–6, from 9:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. SEMA will contribute to programming on designated afternoons.
paras.zh: SCRS 节目将于 11 月 3 日至 6 日每天上午 9:30 至下午 1:30 进行。 SEMA 将在指定下午为节目做出贡献。

paras.en: “Unlike traditional classroom presentations or equipment demonstrations, the showcase is being developed as an interactive workshop environment where attendees can engage directly with the engineers who develop vehicle safety technologies and translate engineering requirements into service and repair procedures,” the SCRS release states.
paras.zh: SCRS 新闻稿称：“与传统的课堂演示或设备演示不同，该展示正在开发为交互式研讨会环境，与会者可以直接与开发车辆安全技术并将工程要求转化为服务和维修程序的工程师互动。”

paras.en: Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director, added: “One of the most important things we can do for collision repair professionals is create opportunities to understand better not just what a manufacturer requires, but why those requirements exist.”
paras.zh: SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 补充道：“我们能为碰撞修复专业人员做的最重要的事情之一就是创造机会，让他们更好地了解制造商的要求，以及这些要求存在的原因。”

paras.en: “ADAS technology has introduced an entirely new level of precision and responsibility into the collision repair process,” he said. “Through this collaboration with the SEMA Show, we’re creating an environment where repairers can stand alongside the engineers and technical representatives developing these systems, developing the procedures and requirements for system restoration, and we are able to look at the vehicles and equipment together, and have conversations that connect the repair process directly to vehicle safety performance.”
paras.zh: “ADAS 技术将碰撞修复过程的精度和责任提升到了一个全新的水平，”他说。 “通过与 SEMA 展会的合作，我们正在创造一个环境，让维修人员可以与工程师和技术代表一起开发这些系统，制定系统恢复的程序和要求，我们能够一起查看车辆和设备，并进行将维修过程直接与车辆安全性能联系起来的对话。”

paras.en: Throughout SEMA Week, technical representatives and engineering experts from General Motors, Ford, and Rivian will participate in focused discussions and demonstrations that SCRS says will address “the increasingly interconnected relationship between collision repair, vehicle geometry, sensing technologies, calibration, and safety-system performance.”
paras.zh: 在整个 SEMA 周期间，来自通用汽车、福特和 Rivian 的技术代表和工程专家将参与集中讨论和演示，SCRS 表示这些讨论和演示将解决“碰撞修复、车辆几何形状、传感技术、校准和安全系统性能之间日益相互关联的关系”。

paras.en: Each day will feature manufacturer-specific technical expertise and a series of discussions centered on practical questions collision repair facilities encounter.
paras.zh: 每天都会以制造商特定的技术专业知识和一系列围绕碰撞修复设施遇到的实际问题的讨论为主题。

paras.en: SCRS says the showcase will use short, focused conversations about vehicles, components, and repair scenarios.
paras.zh: SCRS 表示，展示将使用有关车辆、零部件和维修场景的简短而集中的对话。

paras.en: Each programmed discussion will be followed by dedicated open engagement time during which attendees can ask questions, examine equipment, and continue conversations with the participating experts.
paras.zh: 每次计划好的讨论之后都会有专门的公开参与时间，在此期间，与会者可以提出问题、检查设备并继续与参与专家对话。

paras.en: The release states that any buyer or exhibitor participating in the SEMA Show is invited and encouraged to take part in the discussions.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿指出，邀请并鼓励任何参加 SEMA 展会的买家或参展商参与讨论。

paras.en: Each day will start with an open house and end with a discussion about building out an ADAS space.
paras.zh: 每天都会以开放日开始，并以关于构建 ADAS 空间的讨论结束。

paras.en: According to the release, other topics planned throughout the week include:
paras.zh: 根据新闻稿，本周计划的其他主题包括：

paras.en: - “Small Changes, Big Consequences: How sensor alignment, mounting, positioning, and vehicle modifications can influence ADAS performance.
paras.zh: - “小变化，大后果：传感器对准、安装、定位和车辆修改如何影响 ADAS 性能。

paras.en: - “Would You Calibrate It? Real-world repair scenarios examining when calibration is required and the engineering rationale behind manufacturer requirements.
paras.zh: - “你会校准它吗？现实世界的维修场景检查何时需要校准以及制造商要求背后的工程原理。

paras.en: - “Calibration Failed. Now What? Interactive troubleshooting of calibration failures, including diagnostics and hardware/software integration.
paras.zh: - “校准失败。现在怎么办？校准失败的交互式故障排除，包括诊断和硬件/软件集成。

paras.en: - “Find It, Fix It, Recalibrate: Following calibration challenges through diagnosis, correction, recalibration, and additional verification.
paras.zh: - “查找、修复、重新校准：通过诊断、校正、重新校准和额外验证来应对校准挑战。

paras.en: - “Repair, Geometry & ADAS: Why the Repair Matters: Exploring how collision repair, vehicle geometry, components, and controllers influence ADAS operation.
paras.zh: - “修复、几何形状和 ADAS：修复为何重要：探索碰撞修复、车辆几何形状、组件和控制器如何影响 ADAS 操作。

paras.en: - “Successful Calibration ≠ Complete Repair: Understanding what a successful calibration confirms and what additional considerations may remain.
paras.zh: - “成功校准≠完整修复：了解成功校准所确认的内容以及可能需要考虑的其他注意事项。

paras.en: - “Active Safety: What Does ‘Restored’ Actually Mean? Connecting calibration and verification requirements to the intended performance of vehicle safety systems.”
paras.zh: - “主动安全：‘恢复’实际上意味着什么？将校准和验证要求与车辆安全系统的预期性能联系起来。”

paras.en: Additional hands-on programming will explore calibration and measurement processes, equipment and facility considerations, and how shops can evaluate the resources necessary to service different vehicle makes and technologies.
paras.zh: 其他实践编程将探索校准和测量过程、设备和设施注意事项，以及商店如何评估服务不同车辆品牌和技术所需的资源。

paras.en: The release notes that the expanded experience development involves SCRS ADAS Council members who have firsthand experience in collision repair, diagnostics, calibration, facility operations, and technical training.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿指出，扩大的经验开发涉及 SCRS ADAS 委员会成员，他们在碰撞修复、诊断、校准、设施运营和技术培训方面拥有第一手经验。

paras.en: “These individuals have designed, developed, and grown ADAS calibration businesses and operate successful businesses that navigate real-world challenges,” the release states. “Working with SEMA Show organizers, the council is helping develop an environment that combines technical education with practical demonstrations and opportunities for direct engagement.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“这些人设计、开发和发展了 ADAS 校准业务，并经营成功的业务来应对现实世界的挑战。” “该委员会与 SEMA 展会组织者合作，帮助建立一个将技术教育与实际演示和直接参与机会相结合的环境。”

paras.en: AirPro Diagnostics, Alldata, Autel, John Bean, CarADAS, Hunter Engineering, OEC, OPUS IVS, Repairify, Revv, and others have all committed to providing equipment, software, or solutions to support the hands-on learning space.
paras.zh: AirPro Diagnostics、Alldata、Autel、John Bean、CarADAS、Hunter Engineering、OEC、OPUS IVS、Repairify、Revv 等都致力于提供设备、软件或解决方案来支持实践学习空间。

paras.en: Enterprise, Rivian, and others have provided support through vehicle availability.
paras.zh: Enterprise、Rivian 和其他公司通过车辆可用性提供了支持。

paras.en: - Brian Perkins, body and damageability commodity manager of design for service
paras.zh: - Brian Perkins，服务设计的车身和易损性商品经理

paras.en: - Gerry Bonanni, senior paint and body repair engineer
paras.zh: - Gerry Bonanni，高级喷漆和车身修复工程师

paras.en: - Ron Richards, paint and body commodity specialist
paras.zh: - Ron Richards，油漆和车身商品专家

paras.en: - Michael Carpenter, global vehicle performance owner, active safety
paras.zh: - Michael Carpenter，全球车辆性能负责人，主动安全

paras.en: - Jameson Collins, staff product manager, active safety
paras.zh: - Jameson Collins，主动安全部门产品经理

paras.en: - Steven Vance, principal hardware engineer, engineering technical leader, ADAS sensors and sensing systems
paras.zh: - Steven Vance，ADAS 传感器和传感系统首席硬件工程师、工程技术负责人

paras.en: - Chad Zagorski, principal systems engineer, advanced driver assistance systems
paras.zh: - Chad Zagorski，高级驾驶员辅助系统首席系统工程师

paras.en: - Ryan Davenport, senior manager, service engineering, propulsion and electronics
paras.zh: - Ryan Davenport，服务工程、推进和电子部门高级经理

paras.en: - James Rodis, industry relations manager at OEM Calibration
paras.zh: - James Rodis，OEM Calibration 行业关系经理

paras.en: - Michael Ambrosino, director of operations at ADAS Diagnostic Solutions
paras.zh: - ADAS 诊断解决方案运营总监 Michael Ambrosino

paras.en: - Joe Brookhart, managing partner of Summit Auto Calibration
paras.zh: - Joe Brookhart，Summit Auto Calibration 执行合伙人

paras.en: - Andy Dingman, owner of Dingman’s Collision Center
paras.zh: - 安迪·丁曼 (Andy Dingman)，丁曼碰撞中心所有者

paras.en: - Jason Zeise, regional director at Minnesota ADAS Solutions
paras.zh: - Jason Zeise，明尼苏达 ADAS 解决方案区域总监

paras.en: AirPro and K&M Collision have also provided technical support and will participate in the programming.
paras.zh: AirPro 和 K&M Collision 也提供了技术支持并将参与节目制作。

paras.en: “The value of this experience is bringing together perspectives that don’t always have the opportunity to interact in the same environment,” said James Rodis, industry relations for OEM Calibrations, in the release. “We have engineers who understand how these systems are designed to perform, technicians who encounter the challenges of servicing them, and technology providers developing the tools that support that work. When those groups are working together around an actual vehicle, the opportunity for meaningful dialog is tremendous.”
paras.zh: OEM 校准行业关系 James Rodis 在新闻稿中表示：“这种体验的价值在于将并不总是有机会在同一环境中互动的观点汇集在一起​​。” “我们的工程师了解这些系统的设计原理，技术人员在维护这些系统时遇到挑战，而技术提供商则开发支持该工作的工具。当这些团队围绕实际车辆一起工作时，进行有意义对话的机会是巨大的。”

paras.en: Andy Tompkins, SEMA trade show director, added: “The SEMA Show is uniquely positioned to bring together the people, technologies and expertise shaping the automotive aftermarket. Working with SCRS and its ADAS Council has really allowed us to build an experience that goes beyond just displaying technology, and beyond what you would expect from exhibit space. We’re giving attendees an opportunity to interact with industry experts, explore real-world applications, and better understand the technologies influencing the future of vehicle service and repair.”
paras.zh: SEMA 贸易展总监 Andy Tompkins 补充道：“SEMA 展具有独特的优势，能够汇集塑造汽车售后市场的人员、技术和专业知识。与 SCRS 及其 ADAS 委员会的合作确实让我们能够打造一种超越仅仅展示技术的体验，也超出了您对展览空间的期望。我们为与会者提供了与行业专家互动、探索实际应用并更好地了解影响车辆服务和维修未来的技术的机会。”

paras.en: Cameras, radar, and other sensing technologies depend on precise relationships between vehicle components, mounting locations, structural dimensions, and vehicle geometry. Changes introduced by damage or repair can influence what those systems perceive and how they perform.
paras.zh: 摄像头、雷达和其他传感技术取决于车辆部件、安装位置、结构尺寸和车辆几何形状之间的精确关系。损坏或修复引起的变化可能会影响这些系统的感知及其执行方式。

paras.en: The release states that the showcase will explore those relationships while examining:
paras.zh: 该新闻稿指出，展示将在检查时探索这些关系：

paras.en: - “What successful calibrations confirm, and
paras.zh: - “成功的校准确认了什么，以及

paras.en: - “What additional considerations may be necessary before determining that a vehicle’s safety capabilities have been properly restored.”
paras.zh: - “在确定车辆的安全能力已得到适当恢复之前，可能还需要考虑哪些额外因素。”

paras.en: “The objective is not to promote a particular calibration solution, but to help repair professionals better understand the entire process, from the underlying engineering and repair requirements to the safety performance those requirements are intended to preserve,” the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“目标不是推广特定的校准解决方案，而是帮助维修专业人员更好地了解整个过程，从基础工程和维修要求到这些要求旨在保持的安全性能。”

paras.en: A SEMA press release states the showcase, along with the return of the FutureTech Studio, will dive into the emerging technologies that are “reshaping” the automotive aftermarket, from advanced powertrains and artificial intelligence to ADAS.
paras.zh: SEMA 新闻稿称，此次展示以及 FutureTech Studio 的回归，将深入探讨正在“重塑”汽车售后市场的新兴技术，从先进的动力总成和人工智能到 ADAS。

paras.en: “The rise of ADAS is among the most impactful developments for the automotive aftermarket, and SEMA has led the industry’s response through its substantial investment in its SEMA Garage program, impactful federal advocacy, and, now, a highly visible presence among SEMA Show programming,” the release states.
paras.zh: “ADAS 的兴起是对汽车售后市场最具影响力的发展之一，SEMA 通过对其 SEMA Garage 计划的大量投资、有影响力的联邦宣传以及现在在 SEMA Show 节目中的高度可见的存在，引领了行业的反应，”该新闻稿称。

paras.en: SEMA Garage and Government Affairs will provide additional ADAS Showcase programming on Nov. 3, according to the release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，SEMA Garage 和政府事务部将于 11 月 3 日提供额外的 ADAS 展示节目。

paras.en: “Advanced vehicle technologies are creating questions across the automotive aftermarket, and businesses need access to credible technical information they can apply to their work today,” said Tom Gattuso, SEMA vice president of events, in the release. “The SEMA Show brings vehicle engineers and aftermarket professionals together to examine these technologies in a practical setting, improve understanding and support more informed business decisions.”
paras.zh: SEMA 活动副总裁 Tom Gattuso 在新闻稿中表示：“先进的汽车技术正在给整个汽车售后市场带来问题，企业需要获得可应用于当前工作的可靠技术信息。” “SEMA 展会将车辆工程师和售后市场专业人士聚集在一起，在实际环境中检验这些技术，增进理解并支持更明智的业务决策。”

paras.en: The FutureTech Studio (located in Central Hall, Booth #24401) will feature more than 20 vehicles powered by alternative fuels and EV powertrains, plus a three-day education program that SEMA says will highlight technologies that are changing how automotive aftermarket products are designed, developed, and brought to market.
paras.zh: FutureTech Studio（位于中央大厅，展位#24401）将展出 20 多辆由替代燃料和电动汽车动力系统驱动的车辆，以及为期三天的教育计划，SEMA 表示将重点介绍那些正在改变汽车售后市场产品设计、开发和推向市场方式的技术。

paras.en: For more information about the ADAS Showcase activities at the SEMA Show, visit semashow.com/ADAS-showcase.
paras.zh: 有关 SEMA 展会上 ADAS 展示活动的更多信息，请访问 semashow.com/ADAS-showcase。

paras.en: Prior year SEMA ADAS Showcase and FutureTech Studio photos provided by SEMA
paras.zh: 上一年 SEMA ADAS 展示和 FutureTech Studio 照片由 SEMA 提供

articles.title: Can Your Class Design a Better Way to Get Work Done?
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Your class has been assigned an innovation project.
paras.zh: 你们班被分配了一个创新项目。

paras.en: Nobody has to invent a new vehicle, build a robot or promise to revolutionize transportation by Friday. The challenge is closer to home: improve one routine that makes your school’s shop harder to use.
paras.zh: 没有人必须在周五之前发明一辆新车、制造一个机器人或承诺彻底改变交通运输。挑战就在我们身边：改进一种使学校商店更难使用的惯例。

paras.en: The idea follows a point Jeremy White made during his keynote at the 2026 Schaeffler Automotive Symposium. The WIRED Senior Innovation Editor argued that the most interesting uses of technology come from reconsidering how work is organized, rather than simply fitting a new tool into an existing routine.
paras.zh: 这一想法遵循了杰里米·怀特 (Jeremy White) 在 2026 年舍弗勒汽车研讨会上发表的主题演讲中提出的观点。 《连线》高级创新编辑认为，技术最有趣的用途来自于重新考虑工作的组织方式，而不是简单地将新工具融入现有的日常工作中。

paras.en: Students can test that thinking on something they understand. Tool checkout, parts requests, inspection documentation or project handoffs could all provide manageable subjects. Instructors should select processes students are authorized to examine and keep safety procedures outside the scope of unsupervised changes.
paras.zh: 学生可以用他们理解的东西来测试这种想法。工具检查、零件请求、检查文档或项目移交都可以提供易于管理的主题。教师应选择学生有权检查的流程并将安全程序保留在无人监督的变更范围之外。

paras.en: Begin with observation. Have teams watch how the current process works and talk with the people using it. Where does someone wait? What information is frequently missing? Which step causes confusion? Require a specific problem statement before students propose a solution.
paras.zh: 从观察开始。让团队观察当前流程的运作方式并与使用该流程的人员进行交谈。有人在哪里等？哪些信息经常缺失？哪一步会造成混乱？在学生提出解决方案之前需要先陈述具体的问题。

paras.en: Next, establish a starting measurement. A team examining tool checkout might record how long the process takes or how often a tool’s location is unknown. Students should collect only appropriate information and avoid identifying classmates unnecessarily.
paras.zh: 接下来，建立起始测量。检查工具检查的团队可能会记录该过程需要多长时间或工具位置未知的频率。学生应仅收集适当的信息，并避免不必要地识别同学的身份。

paras.en: Then design a small improvement. Computing might help through a simple form, shared inventory record or spreadsheet. Students could also discover that clearer instructions or a better physical arrangement solves much of the problem. Their job is to justify the choice, including who will maintain it.
paras.zh: 然后设计一个小的改进。计算可能会通过简单的表格、共享库存记录或电子表格来提供帮助。学生们还可能发现，更清晰的指示或更好的物理安排可以解决大部分问题。他们的工作是证明选择的合理性，包括由谁来维持它。

paras.en: An instructor-approved trial provides the next lesson. Does the proposal work when people are busy? Can a new user understand it? What happens when someone enters incomplete information? Teams should document those exceptions and revise their approach.
paras.zh: 教师批准的试验提供了下一课。当人们忙碌时，该提案是否有效？新用户能看懂吗？当有人输入不完整的信息时会发生什么？团队应该记录这些例外情况并修改他们的方法。

paras.en: Finish with a presentation comparing the result with the original measurement. An unsuccessful trial can still earn a strong evaluation if students explain the evidence and what they would change.
paras.zh: 最后进行演示，将结果与原始测量结果进行比较。如果学生解释证据以及他们将改变什么，那么不成功的试验仍然可以获得强有力的评价。

paras.en: This project brings together communication, observation and practical use of information. It also introduces a business reality: an improvement has to work for the people expected to use it.
paras.zh: 该项目汇集了信息的交流、观察和实际使用。它还引入了一个商业现实：改进必须对预期使用它的人有效。

paras.en: This concept invites industries to rethink familiar practices. Your classroom can begin with a process small enough to change and important enough that somebody notices when it gets better.
paras.zh: 这一概念促使行业重新思考熟悉的做法。你的课堂可以从一个小到足以改变、足够重要到当它变得更好时有人注意到的过程开始。

paras.en: And we’d love to hear about it! Share your ideas with me at [email protected]. I’d love to share them with the rest of the Tomorrow’s Technician audience.
paras.zh: 我们很想听听！通过 [email protected] 与我分享您的想法。我很乐意与《明天的技术人员》的其他观众分享它们。

articles.title: Cartridge or Spin-On? Choosing the Right Oil Filter
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: Some vehicles may use either a spin-on or cartridge-style oil filter. Identifying the correct filter requires a visual inspection, often from underneath the vehicle.
paras.zh: 有些车辆可能使用旋装式或筒式机油滤清器。识别正确的过滤器需要进行目视检查，通常是从车辆下方进行。

paras.en: Counter professionals should alert customers to this possibility and recommend checking the existing filter before purchasing a replacement to avoid ordering the wrong part.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人员应提醒顾客这种可能性，并建议在购买替换件之前检查现有的过滤器，以避免订购错误的部件。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: Shop Profile: Loveland’s A-OK Transmission
articles.author: Bobby Mace

paras.en: “I’m a guy that started from ground zero. I mean, even though dad was running the place, I came in just like any other grunt, and I was expected to work, like any other grunt,” explains Loveland’s A-OK Transmission shop owner John Haines. “And my son is the same way. He’s starting at the bottom, working his way up.”
paras.zh: “我是一个从零开始的人。我的意思是，尽管爸爸在经营这个地方，但我就像其他人一样进来，并且我被期望像其他人一样工作，”拉夫兰的 A-OK Transmission 商店老板约翰·海恩斯 (John Haines) 解释道。 “我的儿子也是这样。他从底层做起，一步步向上。”

paras.en: John’s son, Macen, represents the third generation of his family involved in the shop. But Loveland’s history goes back still further. This business has been in Springfield, Missouri, for more than 50 years.
paras.zh: 约翰的儿子 Macen 是经营这家商店的家族第三代。但拉夫兰的历史可以追溯到更远的地方。这家企业在密苏里州斯普林菲尔德已有 50 多年的历史。

paras.en: “It was started by Don Loveland who retired in the mid-’70s when he sold the business to Amos Alsup, but retained ownership of the building,” John explains. “Dad [Vern Haines] came in in 1989. He started running the business side of things, taking over ownership in 2004. Then, I ran the day-to-day business for the last eight to ten years and took over the ownership role in January of 2025.”
paras.zh: “它是由唐·洛夫兰 (Don Loveland) 创办的，他于 70 年代中期退休，将公司卖给了阿莫斯·阿尔苏普 (Amos Alsup)，但保留了该建筑的所有权，”约翰解释道。 “父亲 [Vern Haines] 于 1989 年上任。他开始负责业务方面的事务，并于 2004 年接管了所有权。然后，我在过去八到十年里负责日常业务，并于 2025 年 1 月接管了所有权角色。”

paras.en: John says some of their favorite work is on classic vehicles that owners entrust to his shop. “We’d had a little bit of a following with some of the car clubs, and I guess word of mouth just kind of took off from there. We do a lot of work for VL Classics in nearby Strafford, Missouri. And of course, anytime they sell a car, if it’s local, they recommend that those customers come here, and we’ve had the opportunity to work on a lot of those cars.
paras.zh: 约翰说，他们最喜欢的一些作品是车主委托给他的商店的经典车辆。 “我们在一些汽车俱乐部中拥有了一些追随者，我想口口相传就是从那里开始的。我们在密苏里州斯特拉福德附近为 VL Classics 做了很多工作。当然，每当他们出售汽车时，如果是本地的，他们会推荐这些客户来这里，我们有机会为很多这样的汽车工作。

paras.en: “These classic cars are their owners’ babies. They want to make sure they’re treated like their baby, and we make sure that everything is righteous with them. We cover the fenders and the doors anytime we’re doing any repair to keep anything from getting scratched or marked up. We do everything we can to keep them protected. When they get returned, they’re as clean or cleaner as when they got here.”
paras.zh: “这些老爷车是车主的孩子。他们希望确保自己像自己的孩子一样受到对待，而我们确保一切都对他们公平。在进行任何维修时，我们都会遮盖挡泥板和车门，以防止任何东西被刮伤或留下痕迹。我们尽一切努力保护它们。当它们被归还时，它们会像到达时一样干净或更干净。”

paras.en: Beyond the classics, Loveland’s is a busy repair shop. “I enjoy the work,” John says. “I would say we just don’t have a typical customer. We’ve got everybody from schoolteachers and soccer moms to a plumber who’s trying to make a living using their van or truck to get to the next jobsite. Many customers are that blue collar crowd, people who have to make a living too.
paras.zh: 除了经典之外，Loveland’s 也是一家繁忙的维修店。 “我喜欢这份工作，”约翰说。 “我想说的是，我们只是没有典型的客户。我们的客户包括从学校老师、足球妈妈到水管工，他们都试图用面包车或卡车前往下一个工作地点谋生。许多客户都是蓝领人群，他们也必须谋生。

paras.en: “We’ve garnered a reputation of being fair on price. I’m not going be the cheapest guy in town by any means, and I’m going to try not to be the most expensive. I’m making sure my work is comparable for the price I’m asking.”
paras.zh: “我们赢得了价格公平的声誉。无论如何，我不会成为城里最便宜的人，而且我会尽量不成为最贵的人。我会确保我的作品与我要的价格相当。”

paras.en: He achieves this in part by taking another step beyond the initial repair.
paras.zh: 他实现这一目标的部分原因是在最初的修复之外采取了另一步骤。

paras.en: “Anytime we have a customer that has a repair, especially a transmission repair, I remind them that after 500-600 miles, I want to see the car back. They don’t have to have an appointment. It doesn’t cost them anything. I just want to check everything over. That tells the customer, we’re not here just to take their money. We want to make sure that the job’s good when they’ve driven a few hundred miles. If there’s a problem, it usually will show up then. It just gives that perceived notion of, ‘well, hey, they’re not just here to take my money and run.’
paras.zh: “每当我们有客户需要维修，尤其是变速箱维修时，我都会提醒他们，在行驶了 500-600 英里后，我想把车送回来。他们不必预约。这不会花费他们任何费用。我只是想检查一下一切。这告诉客户，我们来这里不仅仅是为了拿他们的钱。我们希望确保他们开了几百英里后工作顺利。如果有问题，通常会出现然后它只是给人一种这样的感觉：“好吧，嘿，他们不仅仅是为了拿走我的钱然后逃跑。”

paras.en: “Another thing I do is remind them about service intervals. Let’s face it, the biggest reason why a lot of transmissions fail nowadays is because somebody bought into the myth of you don’t ever have to change the transmission fluid. That’s not the case! A lot of times I’ll tell the customer I’d like to see it back for a fluid change at 25,000 miles just to keep that relationship going because most customers, if they’ve put a transmission in a car, are going to come back to the same shop, especially if it’s going to be for maintenance work on that transmission.
paras.zh: “我做的另一件事是提醒他们注意保养间隔。让我们面对现实吧，现在很多变速箱出现故障的最大原因是因为有人相信你永远不需要更换变速箱油。事实并非如此！很多时候我会告诉客户我希望在行驶 25,000 英里时再次更换变速箱油，只是为了保持这种关系，因为大多数客户，如果他们在汽车中安装了变速箱，他们会回到原来的状态商店，特别是如果要对变速箱进行维护工作。

paras.en: “I’ve done more R&R work as of lately. It’s been a cost-to-benefit analysis thing. Like if someone wants a 700 R4 in a classic Camaro or something like that, I’ll build it for them. TH350s and 400s or C4s and C6s are units that you can’t really get reman anymore. A lot of the later model stuff, the six-, eight- or 10-speeds, we get from reman. By the time I buy the parts and spend the time and labor to build it, I’m money ahead to buy the reman and just put it in. At the end of the day, I come out a little cheaper on the on the build side, plus if something goes wrong with that unit, I’m being paid to fix it.”
paras.zh: “我最近做了更多的 R&R 工作。这是一个成本效益分析的事情。就像如果有人想要一辆 700 R4 的经典科迈罗或类似的东西，我会为他们制造它。TH350 和 400 或 C4 和 C6 是你不能真正再制造的单位。很多后来的模型，六速、八速或 10 速，我们从当我购买零件并花费时间和劳力来建造它时，我已经预付了钱来购买再制造并将其安装起来。最终，我在建造方面会便宜一些，而且如果该装置出现问题，我会得到报酬来修复它。

paras.en: “As for the CVTs, I don’t build those at all. Mainly, I just don’t have the space to keep all the stuff I need to build them properly. I’d go reman on them anytime I can. About the only CVT that I ever put in as a used unit would be a Subaru. I don’t know why, but they just seem to work.”
paras.zh: “至于 CVT，我根本不制造这些。主要是，我没有足够的空间来保存正确制造它们所需的所有东西。只要有可能，我就会对它们进行重新制造。我唯一使用过的 CVT 是斯巴鲁。我不知道为什么，但它们似乎很管用。”

paras.en: Haines goes on to say that about half the jobs going through his bays are general repair work. “I let customers know that we do more than transmissions,” he elaborates. “If your car needs a tune-up, if you just need a headlight put in, we’ll take care of it. We’ll make sure you’re good and going down the road.”
paras.zh: 海恩斯接着说，他的海湾中约有一半的工作是一般维修工作。 “我让客户知道我们所做的不仅仅是传输，”他解释道。 “如果您的汽车需要调整，如果您只需要装上车头灯，我们都会帮您处理。我们会确保您一切顺利，顺利上路。”

paras.en: Finally, John recognizes that training for the six-member staff at the shop is important. He says the shop pays for the classes, room and board for seminars that are within a day’s drive. He adds that anytime one of the local parts houses puts on a training class, the Loveland’s team will be there.
paras.zh: 最后，约翰认识到对商店六名员工的培训非常重要。他说，商店支付一天车程内研讨会的课程、食宿费用。他补充说，每当当地零件公司举办培训班时，拉夫兰的团队都会在那里。

articles.title: DRiV Adds Wagner Brake Caliper Parts
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: DRiV announced the expansion of its Wagner brake caliper portfolio with the addition of 547 new SKUs, bringing the lineup to approximately 1,100 SKUs.
paras.zh: DRiV 宣布扩大其瓦格纳制动卡钳产品组合，新增 547 个 SKU，使产品阵容达到约 1,100 个 SKU。

paras.en: According to DRiV, the expanded coverage includes the 2015 Nissan Altima and 2013 Hyundai Sonata. Wagner says its calipers are 100% new units, and the program requires no core charge or core return.
paras.zh: 据 DRiV 称，扩大的覆盖范围包括 2015 款 Nissan Altima 和 2013 款现代 Sonata。瓦格纳表示，其卡钳是 100% 全新的，并且该计划不需要核心充电或核心返回。

paras.en: “Wagner continues to invest in the categories and coverage areas that matter most to aftermarket customers,” said Joseph Saoud, vice president and general manager for the U.S. and Canada at DRiV. “With 547 new caliper SKUs, we are expanding availability across high-volume vehicle applications while giving customers a 100% new caliper option that helps simplify the repair and replacement process.”
paras.zh: DRiV 美国和加拿大副总裁兼总经理 Joseph Saoud 表示：“瓦格纳继续投资于对售后客户最重要的类别和覆盖领域。” “凭借 547 个新卡钳 SKU，我们正在扩大大批量车辆应用的可用性，同时为客户提供 100% 全新卡钳选项，有助于简化维修和更换流程。”

articles.title: Imitations Have Limitations. Your Reputation Shouldn’t.
articles.author: Litens Aftermarket

paras.en: You’ve been in the bay long enough to know how this plays out. A customer comes back three weeks after a belt job — cabin full of noise, belt shredded, tensioner shot. They’re not thinking about where the parts came from. They’re thinking about who put them in. That’s you.
paras.zh: 你在海湾待了足够长的时间，知道事情会如何发展。一位客户在完成皮带工作三周后回来——机舱里充满了噪音、皮带碎裂、张紧器射击。他们没有考虑零件来自哪里。他们在想是谁把他们放进去的。那就是你。

paras.en: This scenario is playing out more often as imitation overrunning alternator decouplers (OADs) flood the aftermarket. These knockoffs might look the part on the shelf, but under the hood is a completely different story — and the difference shows up fast, in the worst possible way.
paras.zh: 随着仿制超越交流发电机解耦器 (OAD) 充斥售后市场，这种情况越来越频繁地发生。这些仿制品在货架上看起来可能是一样的，但在幕后却是完全不同的故事——而且差异很快就会以最糟糕的方式显现出来。

paras.en: Here’s the bottom line: Litens invented the OAD and holds the original patent on the torsion spring decoupler design — the specific engineering that makes a genuine OAD function the way it’s supposed to.
paras.zh: 底线是这样的：Litens 发明了 OAD，并拥有扭力弹簧解耦器设计的原始专利——使真正的 OAD 发挥应有功能的特定工程。

paras.en: When imitation manufacturers copy a Litens OAD, they’re working from the outside in. They can match the shape, nail the dimensions, and price it to move — but they cannot replicate the patented internal design. The result is a component that might pass a visual inspection but fails the only test that actually counts: in the field, on a customer’s car.
paras.zh: 当仿制品制造商复制 Litens OAD 时，他们是从外到内进行工作的。他们可以匹配形状、确定尺寸并为其移动定价，但他们无法复制获得专利的内部设计。结果是一个组件可能通过了目视检查，但未能通过唯一真正重要的测试：在现场，在客户的汽车上。

paras.en: Every time an engine accelerates, decelerates and even at idle, it generates torsional pulses — constant vibrations that ripple through the serpentine belt and into every component connected to it. Left unchecked, those pulses create NVH complaints and chew through belts, tensioners, and entire alternators ahead of schedule.
paras.zh: 每当发动机加速、减速，甚至怠速时，它都会产生扭转脉冲——持续的振动，通过蛇形皮带传递到与之相连的每个部件。如果不加以控制，这些脉冲会导致 NVH 投诉，并提前磨损皮带、张紧器和整个交流发电机。

paras.en: The patented Litens torsion spring design absorbs those pulses before they become a problem. By decoupling the alternator rotor from the pulley during decel and cushioning the transition to acceleration, it smooths the load on the belt and tensioner at every revolution. The results are straightforward: quieter operation from the first cold start, and belt and tensioner life that can last up to twice as long as systems without a properly functioning decoupler.
paras.zh: 获得专利的莱顿扭转弹簧设计可以在这些脉冲成为问题之前吸收它们。通过在减速期间将交流发电机转子与皮带轮分离并缓冲加速过渡，它可以在每次旋转时平滑皮带和张紧器上的负载。结果很简单：第一次冷启动时运行更安静，皮带和张紧器的使用寿命比没有正常工作的解耦器的系统长两倍。

paras.en: That’s a repair that holds up long after the customer stops thinking about it.
paras.zh: 这种修复在客户不再考虑它之后仍能持续很长时间。

paras.en: A cheap OAD might save a few bucks at the counter. But when it fails — and imitation units do fail — the math turns ugly fast. You’re looking at a comeback repair, a lost afternoon, and a customer telling everyone at their workplace to go somewhere else next time.
paras.zh: 在柜台购买便宜的 OAD 可能会节省几美元。但当它失败时——而且仿制品确实失败了——数学很快就会变得丑陋。你看到的是一次修复、一个失落的下午，以及一位顾客告诉工作场所的每个人下次去其他地方。

paras.en: In a trade built on word-of-mouth, your name is your most valuable tool. Every part you install either backs that up or puts it on the line.
paras.zh: 在建立在口碑之上的行业中，您的名字是您最有价值的工具。您安装的每个部件要么支持该功能，要么将其投入使用。

paras.en: Drop-In Fit. Original Design. Original Manufacturer.
paras.zh: 插入式贴合。原创设计。原始制造商。

paras.en: Litens OADs install as direct replacements for the standard alternator pulley — no modifications, no adapter, no guesswork. You’re bolting in the component the system was engineered around, built by the same company that holds the patent on it.
paras.zh: Litens OAD 安装后可直接替代标准交流发电机皮带轮 — 无需修改、无需适配器、无需猜测。你用螺栓固定系统设计的组件，该组件是由拥有该系统专利的同一家公司制造的。

paras.en: Knockoffs will keep showing up at the counter, priced to move. But they’re not built to the same spec, and when they fail, it’s your name that takes the hit — not theirs.
paras.zh: 仿冒品将不断出现在柜台上，价格也会变动。但它们并不是按照相同的规格构建的，当它们失败时，受到打击的是您的名字，而不是他们的名字。

paras.en: The comeback is never worth it. The genuine part always is.
paras.zh: 卷土重来永远不值得。真正的部分总是如此。

paras.en: Learn more about Litens OADs and find the right part for your application at
paras.zh: 了解有关 Litens OAD 的更多信息并找到适合您的应用的部件：

articles.title: Can R-444A Help Your Shop Lower AC Costs?
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Every refrigerant change brings another round of questions for shop owners. What equipment do we need? What will it cost? How much training is involved? And how does the investment translate into better service for customers?
paras.zh: 每次制冷剂的更换都会给店主带来新一轮的问题。我们需要什么设备？费用是多少？涉及多少培训？投资如何转化为为客户提供更好的服务？

paras.en: In this episode of Shop Owner Solutions, presented by Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials, we discuss another option: Klea Edge R-444A, which Orbia has positioned as an aftermarket alternative to R-1234yf.
paras.zh: 在 Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials 推出的本期店主解决方案中，我们讨论了另一种选择：Klea Edge R-444A，Orbia 将其定位为 R-1234yf 的售后替代品。

paras.en: Joining the conversation are Chuck Abbott, Orbia’s global marketing manager, and Wade Pugh, owner of Wade’s Fixit Shop. Chuck explains the product’s reported performance and cost advantages, while Wade brings the discussion into the bay with firsthand experience retrofitting vehicles at his shop.
paras.zh: 加入对话的还有 Orbia 全球营销经理 Chuck Abbott 和 Wade’s Fixit Shop 老板 Wade Pugh。查克解释了该产品所报告的性能和成本优势，而韦德则通过在他的商店改装车辆的第一手经验将讨论带入海湾。

paras.en: The conversation moves beyond refrigerant chemistry to the details that affect daily operations: equipment requirements, service time, technician preparation and the potential impact on the shop’s bottom line. They also address retrofit procedures, service fittings, labeling, cross-contamination prevention and safety considerations.
paras.zh: 讨论超越了制冷剂化学，涉及到影响日常运营的细节：设备要求、服务时间、技术人员准备以及对车间利润的潜在影响。它们还涉及改造程序、维修配件、标签、交叉污染预防和安全注意事项。

paras.en: For owners evaluating their next AC equipment purchase, or looking for additional ways to serve customers, those details are important. Understanding an alternative starts with knowing what the work actually involves.
paras.zh: 对于评估下一次购买空调设备或寻找其他方式为客户提供服务的业主来说，这些细节非常重要。了解替代方案首先要了解工作实际涉及的内容。

paras.en: Watch the episode above for a practical conversation about R-444A and what shop owners should consider before bringing it into their AC service business.
paras.zh: 观看上面的剧集，了解有关 R-444A 的实用对话，以及店主在将其引入空调服务业务之前应考虑的事项。

articles.title: NAPA Apprentice Program Builds a New Path Into the Service Bay
articles.author: NAPA

paras.en: As repair shops across the country struggle to recruit qualified technicians, the NAPA Auto Care Apprentice Program offers participating businesses a structured way to develop new talent inside their own service bays.
paras.zh: 由于全国各地的维修店都在努力招募合格的技术人员，NAPA 汽车护理学徒计划为参与的企业提供了一种结构化的方法，以在自己的维修站内培养新人才。

paras.en: More than 700 NAPA Auto Care centers nationwide participate in the program, which combines technical education, hands-on experience and mentorship. Its mission is to educate and cultivate the next generation of automotive repair professionals by providing a broad learning experience that combines online and classroom training.
paras.zh: 全国 700 多个 NAPA 汽车护理中心参与了该计划，该计划结合了技术教育、实践经验和指导。其使命是通过提供结合在线和课堂培训的广泛学习经验来教育和培养下一代汽车维修专业人员。

paras.en: For shop owners, the program offers an alternative to waiting for experienced technicians to appear in an increasingly competitive labor market. A participating shop can identify someone with the right attitude and work ethic, then help that person build technical skills through a defined training path.
paras.zh: 对于店主来说，该计划提供了一种替代方案，让他们无需等待经验丰富的技术人员出现在竞争日益激烈的劳动力市场中。参与的商店可以识别具有正确态度和职业道德的人员，然后通过明确的培训路径帮助该人员培养技术技能。

paras.en: “NAPA is committed to finding solutions that address the national shortage of skilled automotive technicians,” said Jason Rainey, vice president of Auto Care. “Our apprenticeship program is one of several key NAPA initiatives that help pave the way for young people to launch long and fruitful careers in our industry.”
paras.zh: Auto Care 副总裁 Jason Rainey 表示：“NAPA 致力于寻找解决方案，解决全国熟练汽车技术人员短缺的问题。” “我们的学徒计划是 NAPA 的几项关键举措之一，有助于为年轻人在我们行业开展长期且富有成果的职业生涯铺平道路。”

paras.en: The NAPA Apprentice Program uses a nine-stage curriculum designed to give participants a broad understanding of the systems and components found on modern vehicles. Most apprentices can complete the program in two years or less.
paras.zh: NAPA 学徒计划采用九阶段课程，旨在让参与者广泛了解现代车辆上的系统和组件。大多数学徒可以在两年或更短的时间内完成该计划。

paras.en: However, the curriculum is competency-based rather than tied strictly to a calendar. Apprentices can progress through each stage at a pace that matches their learning style and demonstrated abilities. A participant who quickly masters a subject can move forward, while someone who needs additional practice can spend more time developing that competency.
paras.zh: 然而，课程是基于能力的，而不是严格与日历挂钩。学徒可以按照与他们的学习风格和能力相匹配的速度完成每个阶段。快速掌握某一主题的参与者可以继续前进，而需要额外练习的参与者可以花更多的时间来发展该能力。

paras.en: Training is 100% technical and is delivered through several formats:
paras.zh: 培训 100% 是技术性的，并通过多种形式提供：

paras.en: - Classroom training videos exclusive to the Apprentice Program provide in-depth instruction from experienced master technicians.
paras.zh: - 学徒计划独有的课堂培训视频提供经验丰富的技术大师的深入指导。
