paras.en: The affected areas form a telltale pattern with four quadrants, somewhat resembling a four-leaf clover, per Scientific American. “This is a very strange pattern that is not caused by other Earth processes,” Domeier tells New Scientist’s James Woodford.
paras.zh: 据《科学美国人》报道，受影响的区域形成了一个有四个象限的明显图案，有点像四叶草。 “这是一种非常奇怪的模式，不是由其他地球过程引起的，”多梅尔告诉《新科学家》杂志的詹姆斯·伍德福德。

paras.en: The researchers searched for this signature when running computer simulations of flooding dynamics on Earth over the past 320 million years. Four time points stood out: the Oligocene to Miocene about 20 million to 30 million years ago, the mid-Cretaceous about 90 million to 100 million years ago, the Late Jurassic to Early Cretaceous about 140 million to 150 million years ago, and the Early Jurassic about 190 million to 200 million years ago.
paras.zh: 研究人员在对过去 3.2 亿年地球上的洪水动态进行计算机模拟时寻找了这一特征。有四个时间点比较突出：渐新世至中新世，距今约2000万至3000万年；中白垩世，距今约9000万至1亿年；晚侏罗世至早白垩世，距今约1.4亿至1.5亿年；早侏罗世，距今约1.9亿至2亿年。

paras.en: “These findings refute the view of [true polar wander] as negligible or persistently slow,” the authors write in the paper. They also “highlight the need to consider [true polar wander] as an episodic control on sea level change and likely other global environmental and biological dynamics.”
paras.zh: 作者在论文中写道：“这些发现驳斥了[真正的极地漂移]可以忽略不计或持续缓慢的观点。”他们还“强调需要考虑[真正的极地漂移]作为对海平面变化以及可能的其他全球环境和生物动态的间歇性控制。”

paras.en: These short, intense periods of moving crust and mantle could alter ocean currents and affect the climate, drastically changing ecosystems.
paras.zh: 这些短暂而剧烈的地壳和地幔运动可能会改变洋流并影响气候，从而彻底改变生态系统。

paras.en: “This is a very exciting development that helps us link very deep Earth processes to changes in long-term climate and sea level on the planet,” says Sabin Zahirovic, a geoscientist at the University of Sydney in Australia who was not involved in the study, to New Scientist.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的澳大利亚悉尼大学地球科学家萨宾·扎希罗维奇 (Sabin Zahirovic) 向《新科学家》杂志表示：“这是一项非常令人兴奋的进展，有助于我们将地球深层过程与地球长期气候和海平面的变化联系起来。”

paras.en: Still, researchers aren’t sure what triggers true polar wander events and the geographic poles’ extent of travel during each. “Trying to understand why these events happened at these times would be the next logical step,” Domeier tells Scientific American.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究人员仍不确定是什么触发了真正的极地漂移事件，以及每次事件期间地理极点的移动范围。多梅尔告诉《科学美国人》：“尝试了解为什么这些事件在这些时间发生将是下一个合乎逻辑的步骤。”

articles.title: All-Clad Factory Seconds Sale: Cookware Deals for Fall Cooking
articles.author: Kat Merck

paras.en: All-Clad cookware is a buy-it-for-life staple, according to the WIRED Reviews team and, well, everyone else. My parents have owned an 8-inch All-Clad frying pan as long as I can remember—and I grew up in the ’80s—and I've owned an All-Clad sauté pan that's almost 25 years old and still looks like I bought it last year.
paras.zh: 根据《连线》评论团队和其他所有人的说法，All-Clad 炊具是一种终身购买的必需品。从我记事起，我的父母就拥有一个 8 英寸的 All-Clad 煎锅，而我是在 80 年代长大的，而我拥有一个 All-Clad 炒锅，它已经有近 25 年的历史了，看起来仍然像是我去年买的。

paras.en: Note that you will need to enter your email address to access the sale (though when I did this, I got a coupon for free shipping over $60); all sales are final; and items you see are of limited quantity and may not be restocked, so if you see something you like, don't wait until later.
paras.zh: 请注意，您需要输入您的电子邮件地址才能参与促销活动（尽管当我这样做时，我得到了一张 60 美元以上免运费的优惠券）；所有销售均为最终销售；而且您看到的商品数量有限，可能不会补货，所以如果您看到喜欢的商品，请不要等到稍后再购买。

paras.en: This is the sauté pan I have, and it really is $180 right now at Williams Sonoma. It's super versatile with its straight sides that allow you to cook one-pot meals, and it's oven-safe up to 600 degrees Fahrenheit, so you can even use it under the broiler.
paras.zh: 这是我买的炒锅，现在在 Williams Sonoma 卖 180 美元。它的用途非常广泛，其直边可让您烹饪一锅饭菜，烤箱温度可达 600 华氏度，因此您甚至可以在烤炉下使用它。

paras.en: If I were going to buy one thing from this sale, it would be these kitchen shears. Kitchen shears are one of the most useful things you can have as a home cook, whether for cutting herbs and trimming fat or slicing through small bones. I haven't tried All-Clad's, but I imagine they're legit.
paras.zh: 如果我要从这次促销中买一件东西，那就是这些厨房剪刀。厨房剪刀是家庭厨师最有用的东西之一，无论是用来切香草、修剪脂肪还是切小骨头。我没有尝试过 All-Clad，但我想它们是合法的。

paras.en: Home and Cook Sales says this is the lowest price this roaster has ever been, but note that it does not include the rack. Worry not, however—searching Amazon for “All-Clad roasting pan rack replacement” brings up multiple options for less than $30.
paras.zh: 家庭和烹饪销售人员表示，这是该烘焙机有史以来的最低价格，但请注意，它不包括机架。不过，不用担心，在亚马逊搜索“All-Clad 烤盘架更换件”会出现多种价格不到 30 美元的选择。

paras.en: This set includes a versatile 12-inch frying pan, a 2-quart saucepan, and a 4-quart sauté pan—all with lids. They're all around the right size for one or two people, so this set would make a great wedding gift.
paras.zh: 该套装包括一个多功能 12 英寸煎锅、一个 2 夸脱平底锅和一个 4 夸脱炒锅 - 全部带盖。它们的尺寸适合一两个人使用，因此这套套装将是一份很棒的结婚礼物。

paras.en: I have a Calphalon version of this pot, but I wish I had All-Clad. It's ideal for making stock with leftover turkey bones, cooking long pasta like spaghetti or fettuccine, or just whipping up large quantities of soup.
paras.zh: 我有这个锅的 Calphalon 版本，但我希望我有 All-Clad。它非常适合用剩下的火鸡骨头做高汤，烹饪长意大利面，如意大利面条或宽面条，或者只是搅拌大量汤。

paras.en: I have had the regular-size version of these measuring cups for more than 20 years, and they still look brand-new. I love that they look like little pots, and if you're looking for a gift for the cook who has everything, these odd-size measuring cups are perfect—the set includes ⅔ cup, ¾ cup, and 1.5 cups.
paras.zh: 我使用这些量杯的常规尺寸版本已经有 20 多年了，而且它们看起来仍然是全新的。我喜欢它们看起来像小锅，如果您正在为拥有一切的厨师寻找一份礼物，这些奇特尺寸的量杯是完美的选择 - 套装包括 ⅔ 杯、3/4 杯和 1.5 杯。

paras.en: A 1-quart saucepan only holds 4 cups, but it's pretty useful to have for melting butter and making small quantities of sauces and gravies, or cooking a single-serving meal.
paras.zh: 1 夸脱的平底锅只能容纳 4 杯，但它对于融化黄油、制作少量酱汁和肉汁或烹饪单份餐食非常有用。

paras.en: Imagine serving Thanksgiving sides or even a small roast in this attractive oven-to-table pot that even comes with matching oven mitts! You also can't beat this giftable price.
paras.zh: 想象一下，在这款迷人的从烤箱到餐桌的锅中供应感恩节配菜，甚至是小烤肉，甚至还配有配套的烤箱手套！这个优惠的价格也是您无法比拟的。

articles.title: Japan’s MMX Mission Wants to Bring Martian Moon Samples Back to Earth
articles.author: Jenna Ahart

paras.en: It’s difficult to imagine a more daunting journey than one to an alien moon named after the Greek god of fear—especially when three other attempts to make that journey have failed.
paras.zh: 很难想象还有什么比前往一颗以希腊恐惧之神命名的外星卫星更令人畏惧的旅程了——尤其是当其他三次尝试都失败了的时候。

paras.en: And yet, as Japan’s space agency, JAXA, and its collaborators gear up to send a spacecraft to Mars’ formidably named moon, “all the members are filled with a quiet sense of excitement,” says Kiyoshi Kuramoto, who leads the mission’s slew of international scientists.
paras.zh: 然而，当日本航天局 JAXA 及其合作者准备向火星这颗令人敬畏的卫星发射一艘宇宙飞船时，“所有成员都充满了一种安静的兴奋感，”领导该任务的众多国际科学家的仓本清 (Kiyoshi Kuramoto) 说。

paras.en: This mission, called the Martian Moons eXploration (MMX), is set to launch from Japan’s Tanegashima Space Center in the wee hours of Tuesday in Japan (Monday afternoon in the US). After almost a year of travel, the spacecraft will reach Mars and its two moons: Phobos, meaning fear in Greek, and Deimos, meaning dread. MMX will observe the pair from afar and collect samples from Phobos in a bid to answer a looming scientific question: How, exactly, did the moons come to be?
paras.zh: 这项名为“火星卫星探索”（MMX）的任务定于周二凌晨在日本（美国周一下午）从日本种子岛航天中心发射。经过近一年的旅行，飞船将到达火星及其两颗卫星：火卫一（Phobos），希腊语中的意思是恐惧，火卫二（Deimos），意思是恐惧。 MMX 将从远处观察这对卫星，并从火卫一收集样本，以回答一个迫在眉睫的科学问题：这两颗卫星究竟是如何形成的？

paras.en: Researchers have been attempting similar gambits for decades. Since the 1980s, Russia has sent three probes to Phobos, all of which failed. Still, researchers are anxious to achieve this mission impossible because the origin of Phobos and its sibling remains a mystery. Some of their attributes, such as the pattern of visible light they reflect, suggest they are asteroids captured into Mars’ orbit by its gravity. But the moons’ circular orbits in line with the Martian equator indicate that they could have formed from debris left over from a collision between a nascent Mars and a gigantic asteroid, Tom Statler, MMX program executive at NASA, said at a press briefing.
paras.zh: 几十年来，研究人员一直在尝试类似的策略。自20世纪80年代以来，俄罗斯已向火卫一发射了三个探测器，但均以失败告终。尽管如此，研究人员仍然渴望完成这项不可能完成的任务，因为火卫一及其兄弟姐妹的起源仍然是个谜。它们的一些属性，例如它们反射的可见光的模式，表明它们是被火星引力捕获到火星轨道的小行星。但美国宇航局 MMX 项目主管汤姆·斯塔特勒 (Tom Statler) 在新闻发布会上表示，这些卫星的圆形轨道与火星赤道一致，表明它们可能是由新生火星和巨大小行星碰撞留下的碎片形成的。

paras.en: The new mission is designed to help settle the debate by surveying Mars and the moons in detail using a suite of scientific instruments. With MMX’s MEGANE instrument, for instance, researchers will determine the elemental makeup of Phobos by measuring the neutrino particles and gamma rays it emits. If Phobos ends up having more volatile elements such as hydrogen or potassium, it could lean closer to the captured-asteroid hypothesis, while fewer volatiles could support the impact idea.
paras.zh: 新任务旨在通过使用一套科学仪器详细测量火星和卫星来帮助解决争论。例如，利用 MMX 的 MEGANE 仪器，研究人员将通过测量火卫一发射的中微子粒子和伽马射线来确定火卫一的元素组成。如果火卫一最终拥有更多的挥发性元素，例如氢或钾，它可能更接近捕获小行星假说，而更少的挥发性元素可以支持撞击的想法。

paras.en: “We know nothing about Phobos' elemental composition,” says David Lawrence, who leads the MEGANE team from Johns Hopkins University. “For me, that’s what’s exciting—making a measurement nobody’s done before.”
paras.zh: “我们对火卫一的元素组成一无所知，”约翰·霍普金斯大学 MEGANE 团队负责人戴维·劳伦斯 (David Lawrence) 说道。 “对我来说，这就是令人兴奋的地方——进行前所未有的测量。”

paras.en: These observations are “going to give us a hint at some of the answers to the really big questions we have about Phobos,” says Abigail Fraeman, an MMX team member at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory. “But really, the return samples are going to nail those questions.” After scoping out Phobos with its onboard instruments and a rover—which will land ahead of the spacecraft to explore the new terrain—the spacecraft will land on the moon to collect at least 10 grams of material using two different sampling methods. The goal is to bring them to Earth by 2031, which would make them the first ever samples returned from a moon other than our own.
paras.zh: NASA 喷气推进实验室的 MMX 团队成员阿比盖尔·弗雷曼 (Abigail Fraeman) 表示，这些观察结果“将为我们提供有关火卫一的重大问题的一些答案”。 “但实际上，返回的样本将解决这些问题。”在利用其机载仪器和漫游车对火卫一进行探测后（它将在航天器之前着陆以探索新地形），航天器将降落在月球上，使用两种不同的采样方法收集至少 10 克的材料。我们的目标是在 2031 年之前将它们带回地球，这将使它们成为有史以来第一个从月球以外的月球带回的样本。

paras.en: Researchers suspect Phobos’ surface soil contains Martian material, and analyzing it could paint a better picture of how the planet evolved over billions of years. But MMX will also provide insight into our solar system at large. Laboratory analysis of the samples will help determine the origin of leftover material from the early solar system and how it was transported, Statler said during the briefing.
paras.zh: 研究人员怀疑火卫一的表层土壤含有火星物质，对其进行分析可以更好地描绘火星在数十亿年中如何演化的图景。但 MMX 也将提供对整个太阳系的深入了解。斯塔特勒在简报中说，对样本的实验室分析将有助于确定早期太阳系剩余物质的来源及其运输方式。

paras.en: Undertaking this research will require overcoming daunting obstacles. Because scientists currently know little of Phobos’ surface, they can’t pick a landing spot until taking up-close observations of the moon, Kuramoto says. The mission also uses two sampling methods as a safeguard in case one fails, he adds. “Returning samples from a Martian moon is a world-first challenge that is not easy.”
paras.zh: 进行这项研究需要克服令人畏惧的障碍。仓本说，由于科学家目前对火卫一的表面知之甚少，因此在对火卫一进行近距离观察之前，他们无法选择着陆点。他补充说，该任务还使用两种采样方法作为保障措施，以防其中一种失败。 “从火星卫星带回样本是一项世界首创的挑战，这并不容易。”

paras.en: Still, the number of researchers involved and their depth of expertise give the team confidence that it can succeed where others have failed. MMX is a feat of international collaboration with scientists from NASA, the European Space Agency, and Germany’s and France’s space agencies. “That kind of compounded set of expertise and contributions really helps make the mission objectives very achievable,” says Elliot Sefton-Nash, MMX project scientist at ESA.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，参与研究的研究人员数量和他们的专业知识深度让团队有信心在其他人失败的地方取得成功。 MMX 是美国宇航局、欧洲航天局、德国和法国航天局科学家国际合作的一项壮举。欧空局 MMX 项目科学家埃利奥特·塞夫顿-纳什 (Elliot Sefton-Nash) 表示：“这种复合型的专业知识和贡献确实有助于使任务目标非常容易实现。”

paras.en: JAXA also has a proven track record of successful sample-return missions. Despite some setbacks, its Hayabusa mission became the first mission to return a sample from the surface of a near-Earth object when it brought back material from asteroid Itokawa in 2010. Its successor, Hayabusa2, delivered samples from the primitive asteroid Ryugu in 2020. Many Hayabusa2 members have helped design the MMX mission, but sampling Phobos will be different—its orbit and gravity are different from Ryugu’s, for instance, Kuramoto says.
paras.zh: JAXA 还拥有成功的样本返回任务记录。尽管遇到了一些挫折，隼鸟号任务还是成为第一个从近地天体表面返回样本的任务，它于 2010 年从小行星糸川带回了物质。它的后继者隼鸟 2 号于 2020 年从原始小行星龙宫传送了样本。许多隼鸟 2 号成员帮助设计了 MMX 任务，但对火卫一的采样会有所不同——它的轨道和重力与龙宫的不同，例如仓本号。说。

paras.en: Still, “JAXA's learned and achieved so much with their sample-return missions that they are really well positioned to be able to do this,” Fraeman says.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，“JAXA 在样本返回任务中学到了很多东西，并取得了很多成就，因此他们确实有能力做到这一点，”弗雷曼说。

articles.title: Election Offices in at Least 32 States Have Received Suspicious Letters
articles.author: David Gilbert

paras.en: At 12:20 pm last Tuesday, an official in the Louisiana secretary of state’s office opened a mailed letter and white powder fell out. The office was immediately evacuated and the employee was rushed to the emergency room. The employee was not injured and subsequent tests showed that the substance was not harmful. By Wednesday, the office was back open.
paras.zh: 上周二中午12点20分，路易斯安那州国务卿办公室的一名官员打开一封邮寄的信件，白色粉末掉了出来。办公室立即被疏散，该员工被送往急诊室。该员工没有受伤，随后的测试表明该物质无害。到周三，办公室重新开放。

paras.en: “Tuesday’s event did not impact any election operations in preparation for the upcoming election,” Trey Williams, a spokesperson for Louisiana’s secretary of state, tells WIRED.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州国务卿发言人特雷·威廉姆斯 (Trey Williams) 告诉《连线》杂志：“周二的事件没有影响任何为即将到来的选举做准备的选举活动。”

paras.en: But the incident was not isolated. A WIRED investigation has found that over the course of the following days, election offices in at least 31 other states were targeted with similar letters as they prepared for the midterms that are now just two weeks away. Many of the states have made public statements acknowledging the receipt of these letters, but WIRED’s accounting of all the incidents shows the full scale of this campaign for the first time.
paras.zh: 但该事件并非孤立事件。 A WIRED investigation has found that over the course of the following days, election offices in at least 31 other states were targeted with similar letters as they prepared for the midterms that are now just two weeks away. Many of the states have made public statements acknowledging the receipt of these letters, but WIRED’s accounting of all the incidents shows the full scale of this campaign for the first time.

paras.en: The vast majority of letters were intercepted by the United States Postal Service before they reached their intended targets, state officials tell WIRED, but in Arizona, Delaware, Oklahoma, South Carolina, and Louisiana the letters were not intercepted, leading to election offices being evacuated when white powder was discovered.
paras.zh: 州官员告诉《连线》杂志，绝大多数信件在到达预定目标之前就被美国邮政局截获，但在亚利桑那州、特拉华州、俄克拉荷马州、南卡罗来纳州和路易斯安那州，这些信件没有被截获，导致选举办公室在发现白色粉末后被疏散。

paras.en: The states that confirmed receipt of a letter are: Alaska, Arizona, California, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, and Wyoming.
paras.zh: 确认收到信件的州包括：阿拉斯加州、亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州、康涅狄格州、特拉华州、佛罗里达州、佐治亚州、爱达荷州、伊利诺伊州、堪萨斯州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、马里兰州、马萨诸塞州、明尼苏达州、密西西比州、内布拉斯加州、新罕布什尔州、新墨西哥州、北达科他州、俄亥俄州、俄克拉荷马州、俄勒冈州、宾夕法尼亚州、南卡罗来纳州、南达科他州、田纳西州、犹他州、弗吉尼亚州、华盛顿州、威斯康星州、和怀俄明州。

paras.en: Election officials in 10 states—Vermont, Michigan, New York, Rhode Island, Texas, West Virginia, Colorado, Kentucky, Indiana, North Carolina—and DC tell WIRED they have not received any suspicious packages. The eight remaining state election offices did not respond.
paras.zh: 佛蒙特州、密歇根州、纽约州、罗德岛州、德克萨斯州、西弗吉尼亚州、科罗拉多州、肯塔基州、印第安纳州、北卡罗来纳州等 10 个州和华盛顿特区的选举官员告诉《连线》杂志，他们没有收到任何可疑包裹。其余八个州选举办公室没有回应。

paras.en: The white powder contained in the letters that have been opened so far has been reported as not harmful, but election offices remain on high alert.
paras.zh: 据报道，迄今为止已打开的信件中含有的白色粉末无害，但选举办公室仍保持高度戒备。

paras.en: “We are deeply concerned by these incidents,” the National Association of Secretaries of State and the National Association of State Election Directors wrote in a joint statement. “As we have each stated in the past, threats against election officials and workers have no place in our democracy. Those who administer our elections should never fear for their safety while carrying out their essential duties.”
paras.zh: 全国国务卿协会和全国州选举主任协会在一份联合声明中写道：“我们对这些事件深感担忧。” “正如我们过去所说的那样，针对选举官员和工作人员的威胁在我们的民主制度中没有立足之地。那些管理我们选举的人在履行基本职责时永远不应该担心自己的安全。”

paras.en: As news of the letters being sent emerged last week, federal agencies alerted other election offices in some states that a potentially dangerous package was on the way. The FBI notified authorities in Alaska on Friday that an envelope was expected to arrive the following day. At about 9 am Saturday morning, the USPS identified the suspicious package, the Juneau Independent reported.
paras.zh: 随着上周发送信件的消息传出，联邦机构向一些州的其他选举办公室发出警报，称一个潜在危险的包裹即将寄出。联邦调查局周五通知阿拉斯加当局，预计第二天将收到一个信封。据《朱诺独立报》报道，周六上午 9 点左右，美国邮政局发现了这个可疑包裹。

paras.en: In Utah, officials told WIRED on Friday that they were preparing for a threatening letter to be sent. “We have been in contact with postal service employees who are actively monitoring our mail for a similar letter so they can intercept it before it reaches our office,” a spokesperson for Utah lieutenant governor Deidre Henderson told WIRED. On Sunday, Henderson posted an image of the suspicious letter that had been intercepted to Threads. The letter was sent in a white envelope with a handwritten address on the front.
paras.zh: 犹他州官员周五告诉《连线》杂志，他们正在准备发送一封威胁信。犹他州副州长戴德丽·亨德森 (Deidre Henderson) 的发言人告诉《连线》杂志：“我们一直在与邮政服务员工保持联系，他们正在积极监控我们的邮件是否有类似的信件，以便在邮件到达我们办公室之前将其截获。”周日，亨德森在 Threads 上发布了一张被截获的可疑信件的图片。这封信装在一个白色信封里寄出，正面写着手写的地址。

paras.en: The top left hand corner of the letter lists the sender as DSA, seemingly standing for the Democratic Socialists of America organization, with the New York ZIP code associated with the group. The DSA has denied any involvement in the campaign.
paras.zh: 信函的左上角将发件人列为 DSA，似乎代表美国民主社会主义者组织，并附有与该组织相关的纽约邮政编码。 DSA 否认参与了该活动。

paras.en: Like many election officials responding to this apparent intimidation, Henderson was defiant. “Nothing is going to disrupt the midterm election,” she said. “We won’t let it happen.”
paras.zh: 与许多选举官员对这种明显的恐吓做出反应一样，亨德森表现得目中无人。 “没有什么会扰乱中期选举，”她说。 “我们不会让这种事发生。”

paras.en: The US Postal Service directed WIRED to the FBI when reached for comment, and the FBI refused to say how many letters it had identified as part of this campaign or whether it had any leads on who was behind the campaign.
paras.zh: 当美国邮政局联系《连线》杂志寻求评论时，联邦调查局拒绝透露有多少封信是该活动的一部分，也拒绝透露是否掌握了该活动幕后黑手的任何线索。

paras.en: “The FBI and US Postal Inspection Service are investigating a series of suspicious mailings sent to various addresses nationwide, including Secretary of State offices and their related election offices,” the FBI tells WIRED in a statement. “Some of the letters contained an unknown substance and we are working closely with our law enforcement partners to respond to each incident.”
paras.zh: 联邦调查局在一份声明中告诉《连线》杂志：“联邦调查局和美国邮政检查局正在调查一系列发送到全国各个地址的可疑邮件，其中包括国务卿办公室及其相关选举办公室。” “其中一些信件含有未知物质，我们正在与执法合作伙伴密切合作，对每一起事件做出回应。”

paras.en: “Based on the events in other states, we were notified to expect a suspicious letter, but it was intercepted by the USPS and [Homeland Security Investigations] before it got to our office,” Elizabeth Jonson, a spokesperson for the Mississippi secretary of state, tells WIRED. “It has now been turned over to the FBI, and we were informed the contents were non-hazardous.”
paras.zh: 密西西比州国务卿发言人伊丽莎白·琼森 (Elizabeth Jonson) 告诉《连线》杂志：“根据其他州发生的事件，我们接到通知预计会收到一封可疑信件，但该信件在到达我们办公室之前就被美国邮政总局和国土安全调查局截获。” “它现已移交给联邦调查局，我们被告知里面的东西没有危险。”

paras.en: A Department of Homeland Security spokesperson says that its “Federal Protective Service has responded to a series of suspicious-letter incidents affecting congressional offices in federal facilities over the past week,” though they did not comment on the letters sent to election offices.
paras.zh: 国土安全部发言人表示，“联邦保护局已经对过去一周影响联邦设施国会办公室的一系列可疑信件事件做出了回应”，但他们没有对发送给选举办公室的信件发表评论。

paras.en: The letters targeting election offices coincided with similar letters being sent to congressional offices across the country, targeting both Democratic and some Republican lawmakers including senators Ted Cruz, Chris Murphy, and Alex Padilla. One letter was sent to Michigan representative Hillary Scholten, a Democrat, who said in a statement that it warned of an impending “civil war” beginning after the midterms.
paras.zh: 这些针对选举办公室的信件与发送给全国各地国会办公室的类似信件同时发出，这些信件针对的是民主党和一些共和党议员，包括参议员特德·克鲁兹、克里斯·墨菲和亚历克斯·帕迪拉。其中一封信寄给了密歇根州民主党众议员希拉里·肖尔滕(Hillary Scholten)，她在一份声明中表示，这封信警告中期选举后即将爆发的“内战”。

paras.en: “Threats and intimidation have no place in our elections,” Michel Moore, the co-chair of the Committee for Safe and Secure Elections, tells WIRED. “Professionals responsible for administering and protecting our elections have established plans, practiced their responses, and are working together to keep election workers and voters safe.”
paras.zh: “我们的选举中没有威胁和恐吓的余地，”安全选举委员会联合主席米歇尔摩尔告诉《连线》杂志。 “负责管理和保护我们选举的专业人士已经制定了计划，实践了他们的应对措施，并正在共同努力确保选举工作人员和选民的安全。”

articles.title: Supreme Court denies appeal from alleged Sept. 11 planners

paras.en: Oct. 19 (UPI) -- The U.S. Supreme Court said Monday that it will not review a 2024 Pentagon decision to revoke plea deals for Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and two other men accused of planning the Sept. 11, 2001, terrorism attacks.
paras.zh: 10 月 19 日（UPI）——美国最高法院周一表示，不会审查五角大楼 2024 年撤销对哈立德·谢赫·穆罕默德和另外两名被控策划 2001 年 9 月 11 日恐怖袭击的男子认罪协议的决定。

paras.en: The court left in place an appeals court decision that said former Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin, a member of the Biden administration, had the authority to cancel the plea deals, which removed the death penalty from the possible punishments for the three, CNN reported.
paras.zh: 据美国有线电视新闻网报道，法院维持了上诉法院的一项裁决，称拜登政府成员、前国防部长劳埃德·奥斯汀有权取消认罪协议，从而取消了对三人的可能惩罚中的死刑。

paras.en: Military prosecutors had reached the deals with the alleged conspirators earlier in 2024, and a military commission judge signed off on them.
paras.zh: 军事检察官于 2024 年初与被指控的共谋者达成了这些协议，并由军事委员会法官签署了这些协议。

paras.en: They were to receive life sentences in agreement for guilty pleas to all charges and a public sentencing in which they would face survivors of the Sept. 11 attacks and family members of those killed.
paras.zh: 他们将因对所有指控认罪而被判处无期徒刑，并在公开宣判中面对 9 月 11 日袭击的幸存者和遇难者家属。

paras.en: Austin revoked the agreements days later. Military courts said that he did not have the authority to do so, but in August, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit backed his decision.
paras.zh: 几天后，奥斯汀撤销了这些协议。军事法庭称他无权这样做，但八月，美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院支持了他的决定。

paras.en: The United States has held Mohammad at the U.S. base in Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, since 2006. Accused co-conspirators Mustafa Ahmed al-Hawsawi and Walid bin Attash, who also appealed, are also held at the base.
paras.zh: 自2006年以来，美国一直将穆罕默德关押在古巴关塔那摩湾的美国基地。被指控的同谋穆斯塔法·艾哈迈德·豪萨维和瓦利德·本·阿塔什也提出上诉，也被关押在该基地。

paras.en: The high court's announcement Monday is one step toward clearing the way for the three to face a military commission, which could happen in 2028 at the soonest.
paras.zh: 高等法院周一的宣布是为三人接受军事委员会扫清道路的一步，军事委员会最快可能在 2028 年进行。

paras.en: "The practical effect of today's denials of certiorari is to clear the way for the inexorable pre-trial proceedings in these cases to continue," said Steve Vladeck, a professor at Georgetown University Law Center and legal analyst, told CNN. "It would be one thing if a trial were reasonably likely in the near future, but even the current summer 2028 trial date is entirely unrealistic given how many issues remain to be resolved."
paras.zh: 乔治城大学法律中心教授兼法律分析师史蒂夫·弗拉德克 (Steve Vladeck) 告诉 CNN，“今天拒绝调卷的实际效果是为这些案件中不可阻挡的预审程序的继续扫清道路。” “如果在不久的将来有可能进行审判，那是一回事，但考虑到还有多少问题有待解决，即使目前的 2028 年夏季审判日期也是完全不现实的。”

paras.en: Vladeck had filed a friend-of-the-court brief asking the justices to take up the appeals.
paras.zh: 弗拉德克提交了一份法庭之友陈述，要求法官审理上诉。

paras.en: The trials have been delayed in part as leaders and legal authorities determine how to deal with questions and concerns about using evidence obtained by CIA torture.
paras.zh: 审判被推迟的部分原因是领导人和法律当局决定如何处理有关使用中央情报局酷刑获得的证据的问题和担忧。

articles.title: Cuba opens oil sector further to private investment under new law

paras.en: Oct. 19 (UPI) -- Cuba's new oil and gas law took effect Monday, allowing more private businesses and foreign investors to participate in the country's energy industry as the island struggles with fuel shortages and widespread power outages.
paras.zh: 10月19日（UPI）——古巴新石油和天然气法周一生效，允许更多私营企业和外国投资者参与该国能源行业，因为该岛正面临燃料短缺和大范围停电的困境。

paras.en: The law, published in Cuba's Official Gazette on Oct. 12, allows private companies to take part in oil exploration, production, refining, transportation and fuel distribution.
paras.zh: 该法律于10月12日在古巴官方公报上公布，允许私营公司参与石油勘探、生产、炼油、运输和燃料分销。

paras.en: However, the Cuban government will continue to own the country's oil and gas reserves and control which companies can operate in the industry.
paras.zh: 然而，古巴政府将继续拥有该国的石油和天然气储备，并控制哪些公司可以从事该行业。

paras.en: Jorge Piñón, an energy expert at the University of Texas at Austin, told UPI on Monday that changing the law may do little to attract investors because Cuba has not demonstrated commercially viable oil reserves sufficient to justify major new exploration projects.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校能源专家豪尔赫·皮尼翁 (Jorge Piñón) 周一告诉合众国际社，改变法律可能对吸引投资者无济于事，因为古巴尚未证明商业上可行的石油储量足以证明重大新勘探项目的合理性。

paras.en: "Geology, geology, geology, not contractual rules, is what matters," Piñón said.
paras.zh: “重要的是地质、地质、地质，而不是合同规则，”皮尼翁说。

paras.en: He pointed to unsuccessful offshore exploration efforts between 2010 and 2012, when major international oil companies drilled four exploratory wells without finding commercially viable reserves.
paras.zh: 他指出，2010年至2012年间，海上勘探工作并​​不成功，当时主要国际石油公司钻探了四口探井，但没有找到商业上可行的储量。

paras.en: Piñón said a single deepwater exploratory well could cost approximately $100 million, with no guarantee that oil or gas would be discovered.
paras.zh: 皮尼翁表示，一口深水探井可能耗资约 1 亿美元，而且不能保证一定会发现石油或天然气。

paras.en: He also raised concerns about political uncertainty and whether investors could recover their money if Cuba undergoes a political transition.
paras.zh: 他还对政治不确定性以及如果古巴经历政治过渡投资者能否收回资金表示担忧。

paras.en: Under the new rules, companies can enter into different types of agreements with the government to explore for oil, produce it or provide services to the industry. The government also retains the right to buy oil and gas needed to meet the country's energy demands.
paras.zh: 根据新规定，公司可以与政府签订不同类型的协议，以勘探、生产石油或为该行业提供服务。政府还保留购买满足国家能源需求所需的石油和天然气的权利。

paras.en: Cuba has allowed foreign investment in oil production since the 1990s. However, efforts to develop new reserves have faced setbacks. Several offshore wells drilled by international companies in 2012 failed to produce commercially viable quantities of oil, according to a report by Martí Noticias.
paras.zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，古巴允许外国投资石油生产。然而，开发新储备的努力遇到了挫折。根据 Martí Noticias 的一份报告，国际公司在 2012 年钻探的几口海上油井未能生产出商业上可行的石油量。

paras.en: In an Oct. 12 statement, Cuba's Attorney General's Office said the legislation aims to gradually increase domestic oil and natural gas production, meet the country's fuel needs and reduce dependence on imported energy.
paras.zh: 古巴总检察长办公室在10月12日的一份声明中表示，该立法旨在逐步增加国内石油和天然气产量，满足该国的燃料需求并减少对进口能源的依赖。

paras.en: The agency said the changes also would allow new businesses and management arrangements throughout the industry, from oil exploration and extraction to refining, storage, transportation and sales.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，这些变化还将允许整个行业出现新的业务和管理安排，从石油勘探和开采到炼油、储存、运输和销售。

paras.en: The changes come as Cuba faces a severe energy crisis. Fuel shortages, aging power plants and limited electricity generation have led to frequent blackouts, disrupting daily life and economic activity across the island.
paras.zh: 这些变化发生之际，古巴正面临严重的能源危机。燃料短缺、发电厂老化和发电量有限导致频繁停电，扰乱了全岛的日常生活和经济活动。

paras.en: Cuba produces about 40,000 barrels of oil per day, compared with an estimated daily demand of 100,000 to 125,000 barrels, Piñón told UPI. The shortfall has left the island heavily dependent on imported fuel.
paras.zh: 皮尼翁告诉合众国际社，古巴每天生产约 40,000 桶石油，而每日需求量预计为 100,000 至 125,000 桶。短缺导致该岛严重依赖进口燃料。

paras.en: But attracting investors could prove difficult. Cuba faces financial problems, outdated infrastructure and U.S. sanctions that restrict many international business transactions.
paras.zh: 但吸引投资者可能会很困难。古巴面临金融问题、过时的基础设施以及限制许多国际商业交易的美国制裁。

paras.en: Piñón has argued that attracting investment will require greater transparency, legal certainty and changes to Cuba's state-controlled fuel distribution system.
paras.zh: 皮尼翁认为，吸引投资需要更大的透明度、法律确定性以及古巴国家控制的燃料分配系统的改变。

paras.en: In an analysis published by Diario de Cuba in April, Piñón warned that U.S. sanctions limit access to the financing and technology needed to increase production.
paras.zh: 皮尼翁在《古巴日报》四月发表的一份分析中警告称，美国的制裁限制了获得增产所需的融资和技术的机会。

paras.en: Washington has also criticized the Cuban government's management of its financial and energy resources.
paras.zh: 华盛顿还批评古巴政府对其金融和能源资源的管理。

paras.en: In a post on X, Juan Pablo Segura, a U.S. State Department official, accused Cuba's ruling elite of controlling illicit assets through GAESA, a military-linked business conglomerate.
paras.zh: 美国国务院官员胡安·巴勃罗·塞古拉 (Juan Pablo Segura) 在 X 上发帖，指责古巴统治精英通过与军方有联系的商业集团 GAESA 控制非法资产。

paras.en: Segura claimed the conglomerate holds $20 billion in illicit assets and diverts cash to overseas accounts while ordinary Cubans face electricity shortages and food insecurity.
paras.zh: 塞古拉声称，该集团持有 200 亿美元的非法资产，并将现金转移到海外账户，而普通古巴人则面临电力短缺和粮食不安全的问题。

paras.en: He also accused the Cuban government of selling subsidized Venezuelan oil on international markets for cash rather than using it to supply the island's electricity system. The allegations have not been independently verified.
paras.zh: 他还指责古巴政府在国际市场上出售受补贴的委内瑞拉石油以换取现金，而不是用它来供应该岛的电力系统。这些指控尚未得到独立核实。

paras.en: Smaller private businesses may find opportunities in fuel transportation, storage and distribution, although questions remain about the permits they will need.
paras.zh: 较小的私营企业可能会在燃料运输、储存和分配方面找到机会，尽管他们所需的许可证仍存在疑问。

paras.en: According to an analysis published Monday by independent Cuban outlet Cubatags, the regulations do not clearly explain how smaller fuel businesses would obtain necessary licenses.
paras.zh: 根据古巴独立媒体 Cubatags 周一发布的分析，该法规没有明确解释小型燃料企业如何获得必要的许可证。

paras.en: The government has not announced any new investment deals that resulted from the law, and it remains unclear how quickly the changes could increase oil production or ease Cuba's fuel shortages.
paras.zh: 政府尚未宣布该法律带来的任何新投资协议，目前尚不清楚这些变化能以多快的速度增加石油产量或缓解古巴的燃料短缺。

articles.title: Mindy Kaling to join Kate Hudson in 'Running Point' Season 3

paras.en: Oct. 19 (UPI) -- Mindy Kaling is joining the cast of Running Point Season 3.
paras.zh: 10 月 19 日（UPI）——Mindy Kaling 加入《跑点》第三季的演员阵容。

paras.en: The actress, writer and producer, who co-created the series with Elaine Ko, Ike Barinholtz and David Stassen, and serves as a writer and executive producer, will have a recurring role in the upcoming season.
paras.zh: 这位女演员、编剧和制片人与伊莱恩·柯、艾克·巴里霍尔茨和大卫·斯塔森共同创作了该剧，并担任编剧和执行制片人，她将在下一季中担任反复角色。

paras.en: Running Point is a sports comedy series starring Kate Hudson as Isla Gordon, a woman who unexpectedly finds herself in charge of her family's pro basketball team, the Los Angeles Waves.
paras.zh: 《奔跑点》是一部体育喜剧剧集，由凯特·哈德森 (Kate Hudson) 饰演艾拉·戈登 (Isla Gordon)，她是一位出人意料地负责家族职业篮球队洛杉矶波浪队 (Los Angeles Waves) 的女性。

paras.en: Other cast members include Drew Tarver, Scott MacArthur, Brenda Song, Fabrizio Guido, Chet Hanks and Toby Sandeman.
paras.zh: 其他演员包括德鲁·塔弗、斯科特·麦克阿瑟、布伦达·宋、法布里奇奥·吉多、切特·汉克斯和托比·桑德曼。

paras.en: Netflix announced Kaling's casting in a video Monday on Instagram. The actress will play the character Divya.
paras.zh: Netflix 周一在 Instagram 上发布了一段视频，宣布了 Kaling 的选角。这位女演员将扮演角色迪维亚（Divya）。

paras.en: Running Point Season 3 is in production in Los Angeles, with a premiere date yet to be announced.
paras.zh: 《跑点》第三季正在洛杉矶制作，首播日期尚未公布。

articles.title: D4vd Murder Case: A Timeline of the Investigation & Charges Over Celeste Rivas Hernandez’s Death
articles.author: Rachel Scharf

paras.en: D4vd, the 21-year-old pop singer made famous by his 2022 hit “Romantic Homicide,” is facing first-degree murder charges for allegedly killing and dismembering the body of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. Prosecutors claim the musician, born David Anthony Burke, was having an illegal sexual relationship with the teenager and murdered her after she “threatened to expose his criminal conduct and devastate his musical career.”
paras.zh: 21 岁的流行歌手 D4vd 因 2022 年的热门歌曲《浪漫杀人》而出名，因涉嫌杀害并肢解 14 岁的塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯 (Celeste Rivas Hernandez) 的尸体而面临一级谋杀指控。检察官称，这位原名大卫·安东尼·伯克的音乐家与这名青少年发生了非法性关系，并在她“威胁揭露他的犯罪行为并摧毁他的音乐生涯”后谋杀了她。

paras.en: The Los Angeles District Attorney’s Office alleges the murder occurred on April 23, 2025 — just two days before the release of D4vd’s debut album, Withered, which opened at No. 13 on the Billboard 200. Months later, police discovered Rivas’ decomposed and dismembered body in an impounded Tesla registered to D4vd.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶地方检察官办公室声称，这起谋杀案发生在 2025 年 4 月 23 日，就在 D4vd 的首张专辑《Withered》发行前两天，该专辑在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第 13 位。几个月后，警方在一辆注册为 D4vd 的被扣押的特斯拉汽车中发现了 Rivas 已腐烂和肢解的尸体。

paras.en: D4vd has pleaded not guilty to all charges, and his attorneys say they will “vigorously defend” him in court. “Let us be clear,” said the singer’s lawyers in a statement following his arrest, “the actual evidence in this case will show that David Burke did not murder Celeste Rivas Hernandez and he was not the cause of her death.”
paras.zh: D4vd has pleaded not guilty to all charges, and his attorneys say they will “vigorously defend” him in court. “让我们明确一点，”这位歌手被捕后的一份声明中说，“本案的实际证据将表明大卫·伯克没有谋杀塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯，他也不是导致她死亡的原因。”

paras.en: The case has already had swift consequences for D4vd’s career. After Rivas’ body was discovered, his headlining Withered tour was cut short, and a deluxe version of the album got shelved. He was then dropped by Darkroom/Interscope Records, Sony Music Publishing and The·Team (formerly Wasserman).
paras.zh: 此案已经对 D4vd 的职业生涯产生了迅速的影响。里瓦斯的尸体被发现后，他的主打《Withered》巡演被缩短，专辑的豪华版也被搁置。随后他被 Darkroom/Interscope Records、Sony Music Publishing 和 The·Team（前身为 Wasserman）抛弃。

paras.en: Billboard has put together a timeline of D4vd’s legal case, and we’ll keep you up to date with new developments as it moves forward. (For more details about D4vd’s music career, check out our separate story on his trajectory in the industry.)
paras.zh: Billboard 整理了 D4vd 法律案件的时间表，我们将随时向您通报案件进展的最新进展。 （有关 D4vd 音乐生涯的更多详细信息，请查看我们关于他在行业轨迹的单独故事。）

paras.en: - Sept. 8, 2025: Rivas’ Body is Discovered in D4vd’s Tesla On Sept. 8, 2025, the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) responded to reports of a “foul odor” coming from a car registered to D4vd in a Hollywood tow lot. When they opened the Tesla’s front trunk, officers found two black bags containing a severed head, torso and limbs. A week later on Sept. 17, authorities said they’d identified the remains as belonging to Celeste Rivas Hernandez, a reported runaway who’d gone missing from her home in Lake Elsinore, Calif., at the age of 13 in 2024. At the time, police weren’t sure how old she’d been at the time of death.
paras.zh: - 2025 年 9 月 8 日：里瓦斯的尸体在 D4vd 的特斯拉汽车中被发现 2025 年 9 月 8 日，洛杉矶警察局 (LAPD) 接到报告称，在好莱坞一处停车场，一辆注册为 D4vd 的汽车发出“恶臭”气味。当他们打开特斯拉的前行李箱时，警察发现了两个黑色袋子，里面装有被切断的头颅、躯干和四肢。一周后的 9 月 17 日，当局表示，他们确认这些遗体属于塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯 (Celeste Rivas Hernandez)，据报道，她是一名离家出走者，于 2024 年在加利福尼亚州埃尔西诺湖的家中失踪，时年 13 岁。当时，警方并不确定她死亡时的年龄。

paras.en: - Nov. 26, 2025: Reports Emerge of D4vd as Subject of Criminal Probe Two months after Rivas’ body was found, reports began to trickle out that D4vd was a suspect in the LAPD’s investigation. On Nov. 26, 2025, the Los Angeles Times reported that the city’s district attorney had empaneled an investigative grand jury, a secret process in which laypeople hear evidence and decide whether to recommend criminal charges.
paras.zh: - 2025 年 11 月 26 日：有报道称 D4vd 成为刑事调查对象 在 Rivas 的尸体被发现两个月后，有报道称 D4vd 是洛杉矶警察局调查中的嫌疑人。 2025 年 11 月 26 日，《洛杉矶时报》报道称，该市地方检察官已组建了一个调查大陪审团，这是一个秘密程序，外行人将在该程序中听取证据并决定是否提出刑事指控。

paras.en: - Feb. 25, 2026: D4vd Confirmed as Target of Murder Investigation A series of public court documents filed in late February 2026 showed that D4vd was officially the target of an investigation for potential murder charges. D4vd’s parents and younger brother filed petitions in Texas, where they live, seeking to avoid testifying before the grand jury in Los Angeles. In these documents, D4vd’s family members attached subpoenas from the Los Angeles District Attorney’s Office that said prosecutors believed the singer “may be involved” in “foul play” tied to Rivas’ death.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 2 月 25 日：D4vd 被确认为谋杀调查目标 2026 年 2 月下旬提交的一系列公开法庭文件显示，D4vd 正式成为潜在谋杀指控的调查目标。 D4vd 的父母和弟弟在他们居住的德克萨斯州提交了请愿书，试图避免在洛杉矶大陪审团面前作证。在这些文件中，D4vd 的家人附上了洛杉矶地方检察官办公室的传票，传票称检察官认为这位歌手“可能参与”与里瓦斯之死有关的“谋杀”。

paras.en: - April 16, 2026: D4vd Arrested on Suspicion of Murder D4vd was arrested in Los Angeles on April 16, 2026. Charges had not yet been officially filed, but the LAPD said he was suspected of murdering Rivas. He was held in custody without bail while police presented the case to prosecutors for filing consideration.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 4 月 16 日：D4vd 因涉嫌谋杀被捕 D4vd 于 2026 年 4 月 16 日在洛杉矶被捕。指控尚未正式提出，但洛杉矶警察局表示他涉嫌谋杀里瓦斯。他被拘留，不得保释，警方将案件提交检察官审理。

paras.en: - April 20, 2026: D4vd Charged with Rivas’ Murder Four days after D4vd’s arrest, on April 20, DA Nathan Hochman formally charged him with first-degree murder, continuous sexual abuse of a child under age 14 and mutilating a body. Hochman’s office alleged that D4vd, an adult, had an illegal underage sexual relationship with Rivas beginning when she was 13. Prosecutors claimed that on April 23, 2025, D4vd killed the then-14-year-old Rivas with a “sharp instrument” and disposed of the body because she had threatened to reveal his sexual crimes and derail his burgeoning music career. The charges carry up to life in prison without parole, or death, if he’s convicted, though prosecutors have not yet decided whether to seek the death penalty. D4vd pleaded not guilty to all counts at his arraignment the same day.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 4 月 20 日：D4vd 被指控谋杀 Rivas 在 D4vd 被捕四天后，即 4 月 20 日，地方检察官 Nathan Hochman 正式指控他犯有一级谋杀罪、持续性虐待 14 岁以下儿童以及残害尸体罪。霍赫曼办公室指控，成年人 D4vd 从 Rivas 13 岁时开始与她发生非法未成年性关系。检察官声称，2025 年 4 月 23 日，D4vd 用“锋利的乐器”杀死了当时 14 岁的 Rivas，并处理了尸体，因为她威胁要揭露他的性犯罪行为并破坏他蓬勃发展的音乐事业。如果罪名成立，这些指控最高可判处终身监禁，不得假释；如果罪名成立，最高可判处死刑，不过检察官尚未决定是否寻求死刑。 D4vd 在同一天受审时对所有罪名均表示不认罪。

paras.en: - April 22, 2026: Medical Examiner Report Reveals Cause of Death The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner released its report on Rivas’ autopsy on April 22, 2026. The report concluded that Rivas died by homicide, from “two penetrating wounds of the torso with smooth edges that may represent sharp forced injuries.”
paras.zh: - 2026 年 4 月 22 日：法医报告揭示死因洛杉矶县法医于 2026 年 4 月 22 日发布了里瓦斯的尸检报告。该报告得出的结论是，里瓦斯死于他杀，“躯干上有两处边缘光滑的穿透伤，可能是锐利的强迫伤害”。

paras.en: - April 23, 2026: Evidence Discussed at First Court Hearing D4vd appeared in Los Angeles court on April 23, 2026 for his first substantive hearing following the charges. There, prosecutors revealed that they collected more than 40 terabytes of digital data from D4vd’s devices during the monthslong investigation, including “a significant amount of child pornography” from his iPhone. Judge Charlaine F. Olmedo scheduled preliminary evidentiary hearing to begin on May 1, though this date could get pushed if the lawyers need more time to prepare. At this proceeding, prosecutors will present their evidence against D4vd for the judge to evaluate whether there’s a sufficient basis for criminal charges.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 4 月 23 日：第一次法庭听证会上讨论的证据 D4vd 于 2026 年 4 月 23 日出现在洛杉矶法院，参加指控后的第一次实质性听证会。检察官透露，在长达数月的调查期间，他们从 D4vd 的设备中收集了超过 40 TB 的数字数据，其中包括来自他的 iPhone 的“大量儿童色情内容”。法官 Charlaine F. Olmedo 计划于 5 月 1 日开始初步证据听证会，但如果律师需要更多时间准备，这一日期可能会推迟。在此诉讼中，检察官将出示针对 D4vd 的证据，供法官评估是否有充分的刑事指控依据。

paras.en: - April 29, 2026: More Evidence Comes Out After Another Hearing At another court hearing on April 29, 2026, a judge allowed prosecutors to publicly file a document revealing more grisly details of their investigation. According to the Associated Press, this document says D4vd purchased two chainsaws online and used them to dismember Rivas’ body in an inflatable pool. Prosecutors claim the dismemberment occurred in D4vd’s garage, where they found Rivas’ DNA. The document also reveals that investigators obtained text messages between D4vd and Rivas from the night she was allegedly killed, in which she “became extremely upset and threatened to disclose damaging information about her relationship with defendant to end his career and destroy his life.” Also during this hearing, the judge delayed D4vd’s preliminary evidentiary hearing to May 26 from its original May 1 date, CBS News reports.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 4 月 29 日：另一次听证会后出现更多证据 在 2026 年 4 月 29 日的另一场法庭听证会上，法官允许检察官公开提交一份文件，披露其调查的更多可怕细节。据美联社报道，这份文件称，D4vd 在网上购买了两把电锯，并用它们在充气泳池中肢解了里瓦斯的尸体。检察官声称肢解发生在 D4vd 的车库，他们在那里发现了里瓦斯的 DNA。该文件还显示，调查人员从她据称被杀当晚获得了 D4vd 和 Rivas 之间的短信，其中她“变得非常沮丧，并威胁要披露有关她与被告关系的破坏性信息，以结束他的职业生涯并毁掉他的生活。”据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，在这次听证会上，法官将 D4vd 的初步证据听证会从原定的 5 月 1 日推迟到 5 月 26 日。

paras.en: - May 12, 2026: Preliminary Hearing Delayed a Month During a court status conference on May 12, the judge pushed D4vd’s preliminary hearing to June 29 after the singer’s lawyers said they needed more time to review the voluminous evidence. According to KTLA, D4vd replied, “Yes, your honor” when asked whether he consented to the delay. A follow-up status conference is set for June 17.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 5 月 12 日：初步听证会推迟一个月在 5 月 12 日举行的法庭状况会议上，法官将 D4vd 的初步听证会推迟到 6 月 29 日，因为歌手的律师表示他们需要更多时间来审查大量证据。据 KTLA 报道，当被问及是否同意推迟时，D4vd 回答说：“是的，法官大人”。后续状态会议定于 6 月 17 日举行。

paras.en: - June 17, 2026: Another Hearing Delay On June 17, the judge once again pushed D4vd’s preliminary evidence hearing from June 29 to July 21. The reasoning was not immediately clear; according to Rolling Stone, Judge Olmedo granted the delay based on a sealed declaration submitted by D4vd’s lawyer. The singer is set to return to court for another status conference on July 7.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 6 月 17 日：听证会再次延迟 6 月 17 日，法官再次将 D4vd 的初步证据听证会从 6 月 29 日推迟到 7 月 21 日。原因尚不清楚；据《滚石》杂志报道，奥尔梅多法官根据 D4vd 律师提交的密封声明批准了延期。这位歌手将于 7 月 7 日返回法庭参加另一场状态发布会。

paras.en: - July 21, 2026: Preliminary Hearing Begins D4vd’s preliminary hearing finally began on July 21 in Los Angeles. Prosecutors were set to present their evidence during a week-long hearing before a judge, who will then determine if there’s probable cause for the singer to go to trial for charges of first-degree murder, child sexual abuse and mutilating a body. According to Rolling Stone, prosecutors began the hearing Tuesday by showing photos of Rivas’ torso in one black plastic bag and her arms and legs in another. An LAPD detective who discovered the body parts in the front trunk of D4vd’s Tesla testified that he was not able to discern any of Rivas’ facial features. “There was quite a bit of decomposition,” explained Det. Joshua Byers, per Rolling Stone. “The skin slippage made it unrecognizable.” Rivas’ family members were in the courtroom, as was D4vd. District Attorney Nathan Hochman said in a press conference, “We believe we will more than accomplish the evidentiary burden of probable cause at this point.” On Wednesday (July 22), an Interscope staffer testified that D4vd made more than $7 million from his record deal before being dropped by the label in the early days of the murder investigation. Prosecutors were trying to establish that D4vd had a motive for allegedly killing Rivas: he earned significant money from his music career, which Rivas threatened to derail by exposing their illegal sexual relationship.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 7 月 21 日：预审听证会开始 D4vd 的预审听证会最终于 7 月 21 日在洛杉矶开始。检察官将在为期一周的听证会上向法官提交证据，法官随后将确定这位歌手是否有可能因一级谋杀、儿童性虐待和残害尸体的指控而受审。据《滚石》报道，检察官周二在听证会开始时展示了里瓦斯躯干放在一个黑色塑料袋中、她的手臂和腿放在另一个黑色塑料袋中的照片。一名在 D4vd 特斯拉前备箱中发现身体部位的洛杉矶警察局侦探作证说，他无法辨别里瓦斯的任何面部特征。 “有相当多的分解，”探长解释道。约书亚拜尔斯，滚石杂志。 “皮肤滑脱使其无法辨认。” Rivas 的家人和 D4vd 都在法庭上。地区检察官内森·霍奇曼在新闻发布会上表示：“我们相信，此时我们将不仅仅完成可能原因的证据负担。”周三（7 月 22 日），Interscope 的一名工作人员作证称，D4vd 从唱片合约中赚取了超过 700 万美元，之后在唱片公司成立初期就被放弃了。 谋杀案调查。检察官试图确定 D4vd 涉嫌杀害里瓦斯的动机：他从音乐事业中赚了大钱，里瓦斯威胁要通过揭露他们的非法性关系来破坏他的事业。

paras.en: - July 27, 2026: Judge Orders D4vd to Stand Trial Following a five-day preliminary hearing, Judge Charlaine F. Olmedo ruled on July 27 that prosecutors have met their burden of showing “probable cause” for the charges against D4vd. The judge thus sustained the case and allowed it to move forward toward trial. In order to actually convict D4vd of the alleged murder, prosecutors will have to meet a higher standard of convincing a jury that the singer killed Rivas “beyond a reasonable doubt.” A trial date was not immediately set. The court scheduled D4vd to next appear in court for an arraignment on Aug. 31. “What was presented by our office over the course of the last week is a small but illustrative fraction of the evidence investigators have accumulated that proves defendant Burke is guilty beyond a reasonable doubt of the brutal murder of Celeste Rivas Hernandez,” said Los Angeles County District Attorney Nathan Hochman in a statement following the judge’s ruling. “This has been a parent’s worst nightmare, hearing the ghoulish details of how their child was killed, dismembered and left as trash.”
paras.zh: - 2026 年 7 月 27 日：法官命令 D4vd 受审 经过为期五天的初步听证会，法官 Charlaine F. Olmedo 于 7 月 27 日裁定，检察官已履行了为 D4vd 指控提供“合理理由”的责任。法官因此维持了该案并允许其进入审判阶段。为了真正判定 D4vd 犯有谋杀罪，检察官必须达到更高的标准，让陪审团相信歌手“排除合理怀疑”杀害了里瓦斯。审判日期尚未立即确定。法院安排 D4vd 于 8 月 31 日出庭接受提审。洛杉矶县地方检察官内森·霍赫曼 (Nathan Hochman) 在法官裁决后的一份声明中表示，“我们办公室在上周提供的只是调查人员积累的证据的一小部分，但具有说明性，这些证据证明被告伯克对残酷谋杀塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯毫无疑问有罪。” “这是父母最可怕的噩梦，听到他们的孩子被杀害、肢解并被当作垃圾的残忍细节。”

paras.en: - Aug. 31, 2026: D4vd Replaces Lawyers On Aug. 31, D4vd replaced his high-powered private attorneys with a public defender. His previous lawyers — Blair Berk, Marilyn Bednarski and Regina Peter — did not give a reason for the change but said D4vd “qualified for appointed counsel.” “We continue to support David and his defense against these serious charges,” said Berk, Bednarski and Peter. “We are grateful that the Los Angeles County Public Defender’s Office has taken over the representation and that David has a highly capable and committed team of attorneys and investigators behind him.” Public defender Walid Kandeel was named D4vd’s new lawyer. The Public Defender’s Office said they are “committed to providing” D4vd with his constitutional right to a defense. “We recognize the loss of life underlying the allegations and extend our sympathies to those who are grieving,” said the office. “At the same time, David Burke is entitled to a defense that takes his circumstances seriously and carefully examines the evidence.”
paras.zh: - 2026 年 8 月 31 日：D4vd 取代律师 8 月 31 日，D4vd 用一名公设辩护律师取代了他的高级私人律师。他之前的律师——布莱尔·伯克(Blair Berk)、玛丽莲·贝德纳尔斯基(Marilyn Bednarski)和雷吉娜·彼得(Regina Peter)——没有给出这一变化的理由，但表示D4vd“有资格担任指定律师”。伯克、贝德纳尔斯基和彼得说：“我们继续支持大卫和他对这些严重指控的辩护。” “我们很感激洛杉矶县公设辩护人办公室接管了代理权，并且大卫背后有一支能力很强、忠诚的律师和调查人员团队。”公共辩护律师 Walid Kandeel 被任命为 D4vd 的新律师。公设辩护人办公室表示，他们“致力于为”D4vd 提供宪法赋予的辩护权。该办公室表示：“我们认识到这些指控造成的生命损失，并向那些悲伤的人表示同情。” “与此同时，大卫·伯克有权获得认真对待他的情况并仔细审查证据的辩护。”

paras.en: - Oct. 19, 2026: Status Conference D4vd appeared in court on Oct. 19 for a brief status conference that lasted just a few minutes, per LA Magazine. The singer’s new public defenders said they’re working on collecting evidence from the prosecution, and a follow-up status conference was set for Jan. 11, 2027.
paras.zh: - 2026 年 10 月 19 日：据《洛杉矶杂志》报道，状态会议 D4vd 于 10 月 19 日出庭，参加了一场简短的状态会议，持续了几分钟。这位歌手的新公设辩护人表示，他们正在努力从检方收集证据，后续情况会议定于 2027 年 1 月 11 日举行。

articles.title: Cyndi Lauper Says the Fashion & Music Industries ‘Squeeze’ Creatives: ‘How Much Money Do You Goddamn Need?’
articles.author: Joe Lynch

paras.en: For Cyndi Lauper, her Suitcase of Memories auction/exhibition currently open at Bonhams in her native New York City isn’t just a trip down memory lane – it’s a wake-up call.
paras.zh: 对于辛迪·劳珀 (Cyndi Lauper) 来说，她的“回忆手提箱”拍卖/展览目前在她的家乡纽约市的邦瀚斯 (Bonhams) 举办，这不仅仅是一次回忆之旅，更是一记警钟。

paras.en: “The fashion stuff is very important to share because it’s inspirational. We spray-painted this, we put that together with safety pins,” Lauper tells Billboard after giving us and a few other outlets a personal tour of her auction block. “This is a great time to do this. Now that we’ve become so corporatized it’s good to look back at what we were. If you look back at rock n’ roll fashion in the ‘80s, it was a time of individual expression. In a time when we’re being forced into a square peg, it’s time to either remember or inspire.”
paras.zh: “分享时尚的东西非常重要，因为它能鼓舞人心。我们把它喷漆了，我们把它和安全别针放在一起，”劳珀在带我们和其他一些媒体参观了她的拍卖区后告诉《公告牌》。 “现在是这样做的好时机。现在我们已经变得如此企业化，回顾一下我们的过去是件好事。如果你回顾 80 年代的摇滚时尚，那是一个个人表达的时代。在我们被迫陷入困境的时代，是时候记住或激发灵感了。”

paras.en: The Suitcase of Memories lot — named after a lyric from her 1984 Billboard Hot 100-topper “Time After Time,” one of four top five hits off her blockbuster debut She’s So Unusual — is colorful, screaming proof of Lauper’s point. There’s DIY (the iconic True Colors skirt Lauper and Screaming Mimi’s owner Laura Wills made from ripped newspapers and magazines); couture (stage-worn Vivienne Westwood outfits); pieces of music history (the plaid dress she wore to the inaugural VMAs); and even hand-me-downs (those leopard-print PJs she wore in the “Girls Just Want to Have Fun” video were her grandmother’s). Plus, there are Gold records, mixing boards, shoes, furniture, dolls, handwritten lyrics and an explosion of accessories.
paras.zh: “手提箱回忆”拍品以她 1984 年公告牌百强单曲《Time After Time》中的一句歌词命名，这是她轰动一时的处女作《She’s So Unusual》中的四首前五名单曲之一。色彩缤纷、令人尖叫的证明了劳珀的观点。还有 DIY（Lauper 和 Screaming Mimi 的主人 Laura Wills 用撕碎的报纸和杂志制作的标志性 True Colors 裙子）；高级定制时装（Vivienne Westwood 舞台服装）；音乐史上的片段（她在首届 VMA 上穿的格子连衣裙）；甚至还有旧衣服（她在“女孩只想玩得开心”视频中穿的那些豹纹睡衣是她祖母的）。此外，还有金唱片、混音板、鞋子、家具、玩偶、手写歌词和大量配件。

paras.en: Suitcase of Memories is open to the public through the live auction date on Thursday (Oct. 22); the online auction stays open through Friday (Oct. 23). For Lauper, whose outrageous, eye-popping looks helped define the ‘80s, fashion isn’t just part of her life — it’s family history. “[When] my family came over, the first relative was a seamstress. That’s how she made her money,” Lauper says of her Italian family. “Everybody sewed and could take a pattern and add to it. They could get hand-me-downs, look at you and measure and it would look like it was made for you. My mom, I can’t even get over how talented she was like that. My uncle was a cutter in the Garment District and became a sought-after pattern maker and then he became a women’s coat designer. I had to go to Fashion Industries [High School in New York] because they felt that was my lot in life. But I wanted to sing. I wanted to go to [High School of] Music & Art so bad.”
paras.zh: 《回忆的手提箱》在周四（10 月 22 日）现场拍卖期间向公众开放；在线拍卖将持续至周五（10 月 23 日）。 Lauper 的夸张、令人瞠目结舌的造型定义了 80 年代，对于她来说，时尚不仅是她生活的一部分，也是她的家族历史。 “当我的家人过来时，第一个亲戚是一名裁缝。这就是她赚钱的方式，”劳珀谈到她的意大利家庭时说道。 “每个人都可以缝制图案，然后添加到它上面。他们可以得到旧衣服，看看你，然后测量一下，它看起来就像是为你量身定做的。我的妈妈，我什至无法想象她是多么有才华。我的叔叔是服装区的一名裁剪师，后来成为一名受欢迎的制版师，然后他成为一名女装设计师。我不得不去时装工业公司（纽约的高中），因为他们觉得这就是我的人生。但我想唱歌。我非常想去音乐与艺术[高中]。”

paras.en: Obviously, the whole music thing worked out for the Hot 100-topping, Grammy- and Tony-winning singer-songwriter who was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2025. And though a teenaged Lauper flunked out of Fashion Industries, her substantial impact on fashion since then nearly rivals her enormous influence on music. So when she rings an alarm about the state of the fashion industry, it carries some weight.
paras.zh: 显然，这位跻身热门 100 强、格莱美奖和托尼奖得主的创作型歌手在 2025 年入选摇滚名人堂，整个音乐事业都取得了成功。虽然十几岁的劳珀未能通过时尚行业，但从那时起她对时尚的巨大影响几乎可以与她对音乐的巨大影响相媲美。因此，当她对时尚业的现状敲响警钟时，它是有一定分量的。

paras.en: “It’s big, gigantic corporations buying up little companies that are creative and the creatives are squeezed out. Or you take a guy like Alexander McQueen and then you make him do 12 shows a year,” she says, referencing the game-changing couturier who died by suicide in 2010. “Do you know [how much work] that entails? When they do that, they squeeze these people dry. They either lose their minds like [John] Galliano or they turn to drugs and alcohol, because after a while, coffee ain’t doing it. And that is where the problem is. Why do you have to be that greedy?” she ponders. “Once you homogenize everything there is no more creative. That’s the danger of all of this. How much money do you goddamn need? You’re already a billionaire.”
paras.zh: “大公司收购了一些有创意的小公司，创意就被挤出了。或者你让像 Alexander McQueen 这样的人，然后你让他每年做 12 场时装秀，”她说，指的是 2010 年自杀身亡的改变游戏规则的时装设计师。“你知道这需要做多少工作吗？当他们这样做时，他们会榨干这些人。他们要么像 [John] Galliano 一样失去理智，要么转向毒品。还有酒精，因为过了一段时间，咖啡就不起作用了，这就是问题所在。”她沉思着。 “一旦你把一切都同质化，就不再有创造力了。这就是所有这一切的危险。你到底需要多少钱？你已经是亿万富翁了。”

paras.en: She also sees the deleterious efforts of that corporate mentality — and the idea that every quarter must outperform the previous one — on the music industry. “The shareholders are not any of the creatives,” she states, though she adds that banking can be a creative field, too. “If you squeeze people dry, you wreck it. When Michael [Jackson] sold 35 million copies [of Thriller] they didn’t view it as a phenomenon. They brought a chart in and said, ‘Well, next year….’ What?! You’re not making a car. It happened; it doesn’t mean it’s going to happen every year. Grow up and don’t be so greedy and shortsighted.”
paras.zh: 她还看到了这种企业心态——以及每个季度都必须超越前一个季度的想法——对音乐行业的有害影响。 “股东并不是任何有创意的人，”她表示，不过她补充说，银行业也可以是一个创意领域。 “如果你把人们榨干，你就会毁掉它。当迈克尔（杰克逊）售出 3500 万张（《Thriller》）时，他们并不认为这是一种现象。他们带来了一张图表并说，‘好吧，明年……’什么？！你不是在制造汽车。它发生了；但这并不意味着它每年都会发生。长大吧，不要那么贪婪和短视。”

paras.en: Over the last few decades, she’s also seen how billionaires and corporations have quashed creative life in Manhattan. “When things become too expensive, you don’t have those young neighborhoods anymore in your city,” she says. “What happens is the city becomes dull. This used to be the city that never slept. Not anymore, pallie. This island that was so fantastic has become Work Island and that’s sad. I remember when Greenwich Village wasn’t just a college dorm.”
paras.zh: 在过去的几十年里，她还看到亿万富翁和企业如何压制曼哈顿的创意生活。 “当东西变得太贵时，你的城市就不再有那些年轻的社区了，”她说。 “发生的事情是，这座城市变得沉闷。这曾经是一座不眠之城。现在不再了，帕利。这个曾经如此美妙的岛屿变成了工作岛，这很悲伤。我记得格林威治村不仅仅是一个大学宿舍。”

paras.en: Still, there are plenty of creatives who continue to inspire Lauper in the fashion world. “Obviously, I still love Vivienne and I love Jean-Paul,” she says. “I still have the coat I bought from him in 1985, which I will never, ever part with.” Another personal item she held back from the auction block was a piece of furniture from the “Girls Just Want to Have Fun” video. “I painted it, so I kept that.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，时尚界仍有许多创意人士继续为 Lauper 带来灵感。 “显然，我仍然爱薇薇安，也爱让-保罗，”她说。 “我还保留着 1985 年从他那里买的那件外套，我永远不会放弃它。”她从拍卖区扣留的另一件个人物品是“女孩只想玩得开心”视频中的一件家具。 “我画了它，所以我保留了它。”

paras.en: For better or worse, the closet-cleaning Bonhams auction also led to her inadvertently parting with a few beloved items. “I didn’t go through everything. I had other people help me and there were a few things that slipped right through that I didn’t mean to have go. But what are you gonna do?” she muses. “After a while, you can’t be tied down and hold onto the past. You should share it.”
paras.zh: 无论好坏，邦瀚斯拍卖行的衣柜清理工作也导致她无意中放弃了一些心爱的物品。 “我并没有经历所有事情。我有其他人帮助我，有一些事情我本来不想经历的，但是你会怎么做呢？”她沉思道。 “过了一段时间，你就不能被过去束缚住了。你应该分享它。”

articles.title: Ariana Grande Mourns Coco, Her Beloved Dog of 17 Years: ‘I Will Miss You Every Day’
articles.author: Anna Chan

paras.en: There’s more than a single teardrop falling from her eyes. Ariana Grande revealed on Monday (Oct. 19) that Coco, her beloved dog of more than 17 years, has died.
paras.zh: 不止一滴泪珠从她的眼角滑落。爱莉安娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 周一（10 月 19 日）透露，她心爱超过 17 年的狗可可（Coco）去世了。

paras.en: “sweetest, most amazing and most beautiful coco … i am so proud of you. thank you for your love, and for blessing this planet with your physical presence for over seventeen wonderful years,” she began her Instagram post, in which she shared numerous photos of herself and her beloved pup from over the years. “you make everywhere you go a more beautiful place.”
paras.zh: “最可爱、最神奇、最美丽的可可……我为你感到骄傲。感谢你的爱，感谢你在十七年的美好岁月里用你的存在来祝福这个星球，”她在 Instagram 上发帖，分享了多年来她和她心爱的小狗的许多照片。 “你让你所到之处都变得更加美丽。”

paras.en: She concluded her emotional tribute: “i will miss you every day and hold you in my heart always. i love you so, sweet girl.”
paras.zh: 她总结道：“我会每天想念你，永远把你放在心里。我非常爱你，可爱的女孩。”

paras.en: Among the snaps of Coco were several of Ari snuggling with her furry pal, one of the pup celebrating her 17th birthday with a bone-shaped cake, the pooch as a little baby, a video of her contemplating a “morning leap” from one step to the patio, and finally ending with a black-and-white image of Coco’s paws with a white rose.
paras.zh: 在《可可》的几张照片中，有几张阿里和她毛茸茸的朋友依偎在一起的照片、其中一只小狗用骨头形状的蛋糕庆祝她 17 岁生日的照片、这只小狗还是个小婴儿的照片、一段她考虑从一个台阶“晨跃”到露台的视频，最后以一张可可的爪子拿着一朵白玫瑰的黑白照片结束。

paras.en: Some of the three-time Grammy-winning artist’s friends shared their heartfelt condolences in the comments section of the post.
paras.zh: 这位三届格莱美奖得主的一些朋友在帖子的评论部分表达了他们衷心的哀悼。

paras.en: “Oh my love. What a gift you were to one another. 17 years. And I love that you said how proud you were of her,” TV host Ross Matthews wrote. “I so get it. I’m sending you every ounce of my love.”
paras.zh: “哦，我的爱人。你是彼此的一份礼物。17 年。我喜欢你说你为她感到骄傲，”电视主持人罗斯·马修斯写道。 “我明白了。我正在向你表达我每一分的爱。”

paras.en: “I’m sorry for your loss,” singer Leon Thomas penned. “Coco was the best.”
paras.zh: “我对你的损失感到抱歉，”歌手莱昂·托马斯写道。 “可可是最棒的。”

paras.en: “sweet sweet coco,” wrote Ilya Salmanzadeh, a producer and songwriter who has worked with Grande on multiple songs over the years, including “Petal,” which reached No. 4 on the Billboard Hot 100 in August.
paras.zh: “sweet sweet coco，”制作人兼作曲家 Ilya Salmanzadeh 写道，多年来，他与 Grande 合作创作了多首歌曲，其中包括 8 月份在 Billboard Hot 100 上排名第四的《Petal》。

paras.en: The singer, who boasts 10 Hot 100 No. 1 hits to date, has been open about her love for pups for a long time. “Dogs are the most harmless, sweetest babes in the world,” the pop star told Billboard in 2015. “They show nothing but unconditional love, so they deserve that in return.”
paras.zh: 这位歌手迄今为止拥有 10 首热门 100 首热门歌曲，长期以来一直公开表达她对小狗的热爱。 “狗是世界上最无害、最可爱的宝贝，”这位流行歌星在 2015 年告诉《告示牌》。“它们只表现出无条件的爱，所以它们值得得到回报。”

paras.en: Grande is currently taking a break from her public-facing work after wrapping her Eternal Sunshine Tour in early September. However, Billboard confirmed in September that she would still be doing press for her upcoming movie, Focker-in-Law, in which she stars alongside Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. The film arrives in theaters Nov. 25.
paras.zh: 格兰德在九月初结束了她的“永恒阳光”巡演后，目前正在暂停她面向公众的工作。然而，《告示牌》在 9 月份证实，她仍将为即将上映的电影《福克》做新闻报道，在这部电影中，她与本·斯蒂勒和罗伯特·德尼罗一起主演。该片将于 11 月 25 日上映。

articles.title: ‘Elsbeth’ Production Assistants File For Union Election (Exclusive)
articles.author: Caitlin Huston

paras.en: Production assistants on Elsbeth are embarking on a union push.
paras.zh: 埃尔斯贝斯的制作助理正在发起工会推动活动。

paras.en: On Oct. 15, the production assistants filed for a union election with the National Labor Relations Board. The petition covers 28 workers on the CBS series. The goal is to join LiUNA Local 724, which has partnered with grassroots organization Production Assistants United as part of a broader push to unionize film and television production assistants.
paras.zh: 10月15日，生产助理向国家劳工关系委员会申请工会选举。请愿书涵盖了 CBS 系列节目的 28 名工作人员。我们的目标是加入 LiUNA Local 724，该组织与草根组织 Production Assistants United 合作，作为更广泛推动电影和电视制作助理成立工会的一部分。

paras.en: The New York-based show stars Carrie Preston as the titular star in the police procedural, which is now entering into its fourth season. The series was created by Robert and Michelle King as a spinoff of The Good Wife and The Good Fight.
paras.zh: 这部以纽约为背景的剧集由凯莉·普雷斯顿 (Carrie Preston) 饰演警察程序剧中的主角，该剧现已进入第四季。该剧由罗伯特·金和米歇尔·金创作，是《傲骨贤妻》和《傲骨之战》的衍生剧。

paras.en: “The production assistants on ‘Elsbeth’ are so excited about taking this important step into unionizing,” the PAs said in a statement. “For too long in this industry nonunion labor has been seen as simply an entry level position when in reality these workers are people with years of experience who work some of the longest hours on set while being in precarious positions with their finances, healthcare, and their children’s wellbeing.”
paras.zh: 制片人在一份声明中表示：“《埃尔斯贝斯》的制作助理对于加入工会这一重要步骤感到非常兴奋。” “长期以来，在这个行业中，非工会劳工被视为只是初级职位，而实际上，这些工人都是拥有多年经验的人，他们在片场工作的时间最长，但他们的财务、医疗保健和孩子的福祉却处于不稳定的境地。”

paras.en: “We are artists who love what we do and want to continue working with the amazing cast and crew of our show. We hope to inspire other PA teams to follow our lead in an effort to protect ourselves as a community against the consolidation of media companies and the inevitable effects that will have on our industry,” the statement continued.
paras.zh: “我们是热爱我们所做的事情的艺术家，并希望继续与我们节目中出色的演员和工作人员合作。我们希望激励其他 PA 团队效仿我们的领导，努力保护我们自己作为一个社区免受媒体公司的整合以及这对我们行业造成的不可避免的影响，”声明继续说道。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Elsbeth did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 埃尔斯贝斯的发言人没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: As part of the organizing push, production assistants have voted to unionize on The Pitt, Abbott Elementary, All American, Georgie & Mandy’s First Marriage, Chicago Fire, Chicago Med, The Four Seasons, Cupertino and Dexter’s Resurrection.
paras.zh: 作为组织推动的一部分，制作助理们投票决定在《皮特》、《雅培小学》、《全美美国人》、《乔吉和曼迪的第一次婚姻》、《芝加哥火焰》、《芝加哥医学》、《四个季节》、《库比蒂诺》和《德克斯特的复活》等节目中加入工会。

paras.en: “Production in New York is booming right now, and so is this movement. PAs across the city are deciding that the people who keep these sets running deserve a union too,” said Ethan Ravens, director of organizing for Production Assistants United and LiUNA 724.
paras.zh: “纽约的制作现在正在蓬勃发展，这场运动也在蓬勃发展。全市的 PA 都决定让这些设备保持运转的人也应该成立工会，”制作助理联合组织和 LiUNA 724 的组织总监伊森·雷文斯 (Ethan Ravens) 说。

articles.title: Jon Stewart Extends His ‘Daily Show’ Run Through 2028
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: The Daily Show and Jon Stewart are staying together for a couple more years.
paras.zh: 《每日秀》和乔恩·斯图尔特还要再在一起几年。

paras.en: Stewart has signed a two-year deal to continue as the once-a-week host of Comedy Central‘s late night show through 2028. He also remains an executive producer of the show every day of the week.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特已签署了一份为期两年的协议，将继续担任喜剧中心深夜节目每周一次的主持人，直至 2028 年。他还仍然担任该节目每周每一天的执行制片人。

paras.en: “Jon Stewart is a generational talent, and The Daily Show continues to be one of the most influential franchises on television and a cornerstone of Comedy Central,” said George Cheeks, co-chair and chief content officer of Skydance TV. “We are excited to continue our partnership with Jon and his award-winning news team.”
paras.zh: Skydance TV 联合主席兼首席内容官乔治·奇克斯 (George Cheeks) 表示：“乔恩·斯图尔特是一代天才，《每日秀》仍然是电视界最具影响力的系列剧之一，也是喜剧中心的基石。” “我们很高兴继续与乔恩及其屡获殊荣的新闻团队合作。”

paras.en: Stewart most recently signed a one-year deal to continue his duties on The Daily Show through 2026. With the end of that agreement approaching, he re-upped. The two-year deal, notably, extends Stewart’s run on the show through the 2028 presidential election cycle.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特最近签署了一份为期一年的协议，将在《每日秀》中继续履行职责直至 2026 年。随着协议到期的临近，他重新崛起。值得注意的是，这份为期两年的协议将斯图尔特在节目中的竞选时间延长到 2028 年总统选举周期。

paras.en: Stewart rejoined The Daily Show in 2024, anchoring the show once a week (usually on Mondays) and serving as an executive producer. He also hosts the related Weekly Show podcast. Daily Show correspondents Ronny Chieng, Josh Johnson, Jordan Klepper, Michael Kosta and Desi Lydic rotate hosting the Tuesday-Thursday shows; Troy Iwata and Grace Kuhlenschmidt are also correspondents.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特于 2024 年重新加入《每日秀》，每周主持一次节目（通常在周一）并担任执行制片人。他还主持相关的每周秀播客。 《每日秀》记者 Ronny Chieng、Josh Johnson、Jordan Klepper、Michael Kosta 和 Desi Lydic 轮流主持周二至周四的节目； Troy Iwata 和 Grace Kuhlenschmidt 也是记者。

paras.en: The long-time host’s return has helped The Daily Show’s ratings improve. The show’s third quarter audience of a little more than 1 million viewers was its largest for that quarter since 2018.
paras.zh: 这位长期主持人的回归帮助《每日秀》的收视率有所提高。该剧第三季度的观众人数略高于 100 万，这是自 2018 年以来该季度观众人数最多的一次。

paras.en: Jen Flanz is the showrunner for The Daily Show. She executive produces with Stewart and his long-time manager, James “Baby Doll” Dixon.
paras.zh: 珍·弗兰茨 (Jen Flanz) 是《每日秀》的节目主持人。她与斯图尔特和他的长期经理詹姆斯“娃娃”迪克森一起担任执行制片人。

articles.title: New RingConn Gen 3 Smart Ring Makes Awards Show Debut at Emmys Gifting Suite
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Following its Sept. 4 unveiling at IFA Berlin, RingConn Gen 3 was featured in the Official Emmys Giving Suite at the 78th annual awards show, bringing the new piece of wellness tech into the hands of TV’s most familiar faces. Jaclyn Smith, Angela Bassett, Dale Dickey, Jeff Hiller and Joy Sunday were among the stars who stopped by the backstage gifting station to test it out.
paras.zh: 继 9 月 4 日在柏林 IFA 展会上亮相后，RingConn Gen 3 出现在第 78 届年度颁奖典礼的官方艾美奖颁奖套件中，将这项全新的健康技术带到了电视界最熟悉的面孔的手中。 Jaclyn Smith、Angela Bassett、Dale Dickey、Jeff Hiller 和 Joy Sunday 等明星都来到后台礼品站进行了测试。

paras.en: The Emmys represent some of the brightest spotlight moments in television, celebrating the outstanding work and performances that take center stage. But behind every spotlight is countless hours of creating, preparing and recovering that make those moments possible. That is the idea RingConn hopes to bring to life through its presence in the Official Emmys Giving Suite. The brand believes that every meaningful moment is shaped by the days that come before it.
paras.zh: 艾美奖代表了电视界一些最耀眼的焦点时刻，庆祝占据舞台中心的杰出作品和表演。但每一次聚光灯的背后，都是无数个小时的创作、准备和恢复，才使得这些时刻成为可能。这就是 RingConn 希望通过其在艾美奖官方捐赠套件中实现的想法。该品牌相信每一个有意义的时刻都是由之前的日子塑造的。

paras.en: With RingConn’s around-the-clock companionship, users can gain a better understanding of their everyday patterns, from sleep and activity to stress and recovery, and develop a deeper awareness of their well-being along the way.
paras.zh: 借助 RingConn 的全天候陪伴，用户可以更好地了解自己的日常模式，从睡眠和活动到压力和恢复，并在此过程中更深入地了解自己的健康状况。

paras.en: Established in 2021, RingConn’s aim is equal parts physical and mental wellbeing. In such a competitive category, RingConn Gen 3 provides Vascular Trends insights for everyday wellness, up to 14 days of battery life with vibration off, plus Vibration Alerts for subtle, timely notifications when attention is needed.
paras.zh: RingConn 成立于 2021 年，其目标是身心健康。在竞争如此激烈的类别中，RingConn Gen 3 提供了日常健康的血管趋势洞察、振动关闭时长达 14 天的电池续航时间以及振动警报，可在需要注意时提供微妙、及时的通知。

paras.en: Notifications go beyond raw data, providing context around everyday wellness trends. Instead of presenting isolated numbers, RingConn Gen 3 combines individual data points to offer a broader view of wellness, with insights into patterns such as stress and recovery.
paras.zh: 通知超越原始数据，提供有关日常健康趋势的背景信息。 RingConn Gen 3 不是提供孤立的数字，而是结合各个数据点，提供更广泛的健康视角，并深入了解压力和恢复等模式。

paras.en: Simplicity translates into the product’s physical design too. RingConn’s signature round-inside, square-outside structure follows the natural curve of the finger. And its ultra-light design is built to stay comfortable day and night.
paras.zh: 简单性也体现在产品的物理设计中。 RingConn 标志性的内圆外方结构遵循手指的自然曲线。其超轻设计旨在让您日夜保持舒适。

paras.en: *RingConn Gen 3 is designed for general wellness and everyday health management purposes only and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition.
paras.zh: *RingConn Gen 3 专为一般健康和日常健康管理目的而设计，并非旨在诊断、治疗、治愈或预防任何疾病或医疗状况。

articles.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop

paras.en: Apple announced a product launch event on Oct. 28, sending invitations on Monday to media and analysts for an "Apple Experience in Los Angeles".
paras.zh: 苹果公司宣布将于 10 月 28 日举行产品发布会，并于周一向媒体和分析师发出“洛杉矶苹果体验”邀请。

paras.en: The email says "Pro and tell," suggesting the launch will focus on high-end "Pro" devices with powerful homegrown chips.
paras.zh: 该电子邮件称“Pro and Tell”，暗示此次发布将专注于配备强大国产芯片的高端“Pro”设备。

paras.en: Ben Reitzes, an analyst at Melius Research, wrote in a note on Monday that he expects new Macs to be introduced, "including a touchscreen notebook," this fall. He said that for CEO John Ternus, who succeeded Tim Cook last month, the launch cadence marks a "meaningful shift" from what has been two events a year.
paras.zh: Melius Research 分析师 Ben Reitzes 在周一的一份报告中写道，他预计今年秋季将推出新款 Mac，“包括触摸屏笔记本电脑”。他表示，对于上个月接替蒂姆·库克的首席执行官约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）来说，此次发布节奏标志着一年两次活动的“有意义的转变”。

paras.en: It will be Apple's third launch in Ternus' brief tenure, following an event at company headquarters for new iPhones, including the foldable Duo, and a gathering in New York centered around smart home hubs and a new speaker with a screen called HomeView.
paras.zh: 这将是苹果在 Ternus 短暂任期内的第三次发布会，此前在公司总部举行了包括可折叠 Duo 在内的新款 iPhone 的活动，并在纽约举行了一场以智能家居中心和名为 HomeView 的屏幕的新型扬声器为中心的聚会。

paras.en: Apple updated its Mac Mini and Mac Studio desktops with new chips in August, and refreshed its MacBook Pro in the spring, along with a new low-cost MacBook Neo. But Apple's iMac desktop hasn't been updated since October 2024.
paras.zh: 苹果在 8 月份更新了 Mac Mini 和 Mac Studio 台式机，配备了新芯片，并在春季更新了 MacBook Pro，以及新款低成本 MacBook Neo。但苹果的 iMac 桌面自 2024 年 10 月以来就没有更新过。

paras.en: In the most recent quarter, Apple's Mac sales accounted for about 10% of overall revenue, as the company remains heavily reliant on iPhones.
paras.zh: 最近一个季度，苹果的 Mac 销量约占总收入的 10%，因为该公司仍然严重依赖 iPhone。

paras.en: Still, Macs have become one of the strongest parts of Apple's artificial intelligence story, thanks to its chips that can access more memory at higher speeds than other consumer processors. Apple shares are up 26% so far this year, outperforming the S&P 500.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，Mac 仍成为苹果人工智能故事中最强大的部分之一，这要归功于其芯片能够以比其他消费处理器更高的速度访问更多内存。今年迄今为止，苹果股价已上涨 26%，跑赢标准普尔 500 指数。

paras.en: Last week, Apple and Meta teamed up to bring a large open-weight model, developed by Meta, to multiple high-end Mac Studios.
paras.zh: 上周，Apple 和 Meta 联手将 Meta 开发的大型开放重量模型引入多个高端 Mac 工作室。

paras.en: Apple has historically been dismissive of touchscreen laptops, with software chief Craig Federighi explaining in 2018 that the ergonomics would fatigue users.
paras.zh: 苹果历来对触摸屏笔记本电脑不屑一顾，软件主管克雷格·费德里吉 (Craig Federighi) 在 2018 年解释说，人体工学会让用户感到疲劳。

articles.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why

paras.en: Decades before Siri or Alexa or ChatGPT, there was a real person, almost always a woman, at the center of the information world. She was so vital, most long-distance communication could not happen without her.
paras.zh: 在 Siri、Alexa 或 ChatGPT 之前几十年，信息世界的中心有一个真实的人，几乎总是女性。她是如此重要，没有她，大多数长途通信都无法进行。

paras.en: She was the telephone switch operator, and at one time she was part of the single largest occupation for white, U.S.-born women under age 20.
paras.zh: 她是电话接线员，一度是美国出生的 20 岁以下白人女性最大的单一职业之一。

paras.en: The world is struggling to figure out what the dawn of artificial intelligence means for society, culture and the economy. A lot of ordinary Americans are just wondering what it means for their jobs.
paras.zh: 世界正在努力弄清楚人工智能的曙光对社会、文化和经济意味着什么。许多普通美国人只是想知道这对他们的工作意味着什么。

paras.en: The history of technological progress — from automated telephone switches to the introduction of the washing machine and the personal computer — can offer some guidance. And that guidance suggests women are likely to be among the most affected by AI.
paras.zh: 技术进步的历史——从自动电话交换机到洗衣机和个人电脑的引入——可以提供一些指导。该指南表明，女性可能是受人工智能影响最严重的群体之一。

paras.en: "AI is focused on routine tasks and numbers and finding patterns, and those types of jobs are the clerical, administrative jobs that a lot of women hold,'' said Ariane Hegewisch, a senior research fellow at the Institute for Women's Policy Research. "It's still 90% of secretaries and clerical workers who are women."
paras.zh: 妇女政策研究所高级研究员 Ariane Hegewisch 表示：“人工智能专注于日常任务、数字和发现模式，而这些类型的工作是许多女性担任的文书、行政工作。”“90% 的秘书和文书工作人员仍然是女性。”

paras.en: New research backs this up. The International Labour Organization in March concluded that nearly 1 in 10 women in high-income countries work in occupations at the highest risk from AI.
paras.zh: 新的研究支持了这一点。国际劳工组织三月份的结论是，高收入国家中有近十分之一的女性从事人工智能风险最高的职业。

paras.en: In the 1940s, nearly 95% of America's telephone operators were female. It was a relatively well-paying job for women at the time, and a complicated one: It took months of training to be able to handle the several hundred calls an hour that could come in at peak times. Operators were expected to be speedy, precise — and polite.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 40 年代，美国近 95% 的电话接线员都是女性。对于当时的女性来说，这是一份薪酬相对较高的工作，但也是一项复杂的工作：需要经过数月的培训才能处理高峰时段每小时可能打来的数百个电话。操作员被要求快速、精确且有礼貌。

paras.en: These women were hit hard when AT&T introduced the automated telephone switch. It was one of the largest automation investments in history — a close analog to the massive AI investment now underway — and created one of the biggest technological shocks the nation had ever seen.
paras.zh: 当 AT&T 推出自动电话交换机时，这些女性受到了沉重打击。这是历史上最大的自动化投资之一——与目前正在进行的大规模人工智能投资非常相似——并造成了美国有史以来最大的技术冲击之一。

paras.en: In the decades after the automated switch was popularized, an estimated 75,000 operator jobs vanished.
paras.zh: 在自动开关普及后的几十年里，估计有 75,000 个操作员工作岗位消失。

paras.en: Economists James Feigenbaum at Boston University and Daniel P. Gross at Duke University's Fuqua School of Business studied census and paycheck data from the time and followed local employment trends along the path of AT&T's rolling investment in switches across the nation.
paras.zh: 波士顿大学的经济学家 James Feigenbaum 和杜克大学 Fuqua 商学院的 Daniel P. Gross 研究了当时的人口普查和薪资数据，并沿着 AT&T 在全国范围内滚动投资交换机的路径跟踪了当地的就业趋势。

paras.en: "The effect of this shock on incumbent operators was to dispossess many of their jobs and careers," they wrote in 2020. Many switchboard operators wound up in lower-paying jobs — or dropped out of the workforce entirely, they found.
paras.zh: 他们在 2020 年写道：“这种冲击对现有运营商的影响是剥夺了他们的许多工作和职业生涯。”他们发现，许多总机运营商最终只能从事低薪工作，或者完全退出劳动力市场。

paras.en: Economist David Autor said this outcome reflects the reality that many workers are already in their highest and best-paying occupation. When the job goes away, the next step is often down.
paras.zh: 经济学家戴维·奥托尔表示，这一结果反映了一个现实，即许多工人已经处于最高、收入最高的职业。当工作消失时，下一步往往会被取消。

paras.en: "Most people are not changing careers very often. They make their career decisions early, and they stick with those careers," he said. "If those careers, if the value of that work ... suddenly goes out of fashion, becomes technologically obsolete, they're going to, in general, do something not as good."
paras.zh: “大多数人不会经常改变职业。他们很早就做出了职业决定，并且坚持这些职业，”他说。 “如果这些职业，如果这项工作的价值……突然过时，在技术上变得过时，那么总的来说，他们会做一些不太好的事情。”

paras.en: But Feigenbaum and Gross also discovered that the next generation of women fared better.
paras.zh: 但费根鲍姆和格罗斯还发现，下一代女性的表现更好。

paras.en: "Future workers found work in other fields, often taking up similar-quality jobs," they wrote, as the younger workers were "more adaptive to an evolving labor market ... Anxiety over the opportunities available to future generations proved to be somewhat misplaced."
paras.zh: 他们写道：“未来的工人在其他领域找到了工作，通常从事类似质量的工作。”因为年轻的工人“更能适应不断变化的劳动力市场……事实证明，对子孙后代可获得的机会的焦虑有些错误。”

paras.en: In other words: One type of job went away, but other work emerged over time that was just as good.
paras.zh: 换句话说：一种工作消失了，但随着时间的推移，其他同样好的工作出现了。

paras.en: By the 1950s, another technological innovation would come along and have a profound effect on women: the washing machine.
paras.zh: 到了 20 世纪 50 年代，另一项技术创新出现，并对女性产生了深远的影响：洗衣机。

paras.en: Dubbed "engines of liberation" in a seminal paper on the topic by University of Pennsylvania economist Jeremy Greenwood and others, washing machines and other appliances dramatically reduced the time women spent on unpaid housework. That meant time could be reallocated to a paycheck outside the home, even as women's responsibility for the home remained.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学经济学家杰里米·格林伍德等人在一篇关于该主题的开创性论文中将洗衣机和其他电器称为“解放引擎”，洗衣机和其他电器大大减少了女性花在无酬家务上的时间。这意味着即使女性仍然承担家庭责任，时间也可以重新分配到家庭之外的薪水上。

paras.en: From 1950 to 1980, as gender norms changed, the number of employed women in the U.S. grew by more than 25 million. Their participation rate, or share of the female population in the labor force, grew to 52% from 34%. At the same time, 16 million more men found work, though the male participation rate dropped by 5 percentage points.
paras.zh: 从 1950 年到 1980 年，随着性别规范的变化，美国就业女性人数增加了超过 2500 万。她们的参与率，即女性劳动力中的比例，从 34% 增长到 52%。与此同时，新增 1600 万男性找到工作，但男性参与率下降了 5 个百分点。

paras.en: The relevant question for the AI boom today: How did the economy suddenly find jobs for these women? If AI creates a vast new pool of available workers, can the economy put them to work?
paras.zh: 当今人工智能热潮的相关问题是：经济是如何突然为这些女性找到工作的？如果人工智能创造了大量新的可用工人，经济能否让他们工作？

paras.en: First, the very entry of women into the workforce meant demand for tasks once done at home moved into the paid economy, services such as childcare and food preparation. Second, as the nation grew wealthier, other employment opportunities for women emerged in the service economy — in retail, restaurants, leisure and hospitality, and even some professional services. And third, as American businesses grew, they needed more people to handle the paperwork — everything from payroll to customer accounts.
paras.zh: 首先，女性进入劳动力市场意味着对曾经在家完成的任务的需求转移到付费经济、儿童保育和食品准备等服务中。其次，随着国家变得更加富裕，服务经济中出现了女性的其他就业机会——零售、餐饮、休闲和酒店业，甚至一些专业服务业。第三，随着美国企业的发展，他们需要更多的人来处理文书工作——从工资单到客户账户的一切事务。

paras.en: Changes to the economy and businesses were partly related to the entry of women into the workforce, but it was also partly random luck that the U.S. was booming and businesses were changing to need more office workers.
paras.zh: 经济和企业的变化部分与女性进入劳动力市场有关，但也有部分是随机的运气，因为美国正在蓬勃发展，企业正在发生变化，需要更多的办公室职员。

paras.en: "Between 1940 and 1980, there was a ton of new work created in the U.S. economy, and it was in office and clerical work that was accessible to people with a high school education,'' Autor said.
paras.zh: 奥托尔说：“1940 年至 1980 年间，美国经济创造了大量新工作，其中办公室和文书工作是受过高中教育的人可以从事的。”

paras.en: The next big revolution affecting women in the workplace was the personal computer.
paras.zh: 影响职场女性的下一场重大革命是个人电脑。

paras.en: Before PCs arrived on the scene, women were the backbone of office infrastructure. According to the 1980 U.S. census, nearly 4.7 million Americans worked as secretaries, stenographers and typists. More than 98% were women.
paras.zh: 在个人电脑出现之前，女性是办公室基础设施的支柱。根据 1980 年美国人口普查，近 470 万美国人担任秘书、速记员和打字员。 98%以上是女性。

paras.en: When IBM introduced the personal computer in 1981, followed by the advent of Microsoft Word just two years later, some of the middlemen, or in this case, middlewomen, became obsolete. It didn't eliminate writing, filing or editing. It simply shifted a big chunk of those tasks from dedicated clerical workers to others in the office — executives could type their own reports, book their own travel and print their own papers.
paras.zh: 当 IBM 于 1981 年推出个人计算机时，两年后 Microsoft Word 又出现了，一些中间商（或者在本例中为中间女）已经过时了。它并没有消除写作、归档或编辑。它只是将大部分任务从专门的文员转移到了办公室的其他人身上——高管们可以自己打印报告、预订旅行并打印自己的文件。
