paras.en: Fifty-three people were killed and 200 were injured in an attack on Monday by the Iran-aligned Houthis on a government security forces training camp in Yemen's Shabwa province, according to the local authority, as fighting in the country intensifies.
paras.zh: 据当地政府称，随着也门战斗加剧，周一，与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装对也门沙布瓦省的一个政府安全部队训练营发动袭击，造成 53 人死亡、200 人受伤。

paras.en: Video verified by Reuters from Shabwa province showed injured people and bloodied bodies scattered across the ground.
paras.zh: 路透社证实，来自沙布瓦省的视频显示，伤者和血迹斑斑的尸体散落在地上。

paras.en: The Houthis and the internationally recognized government, which is backed by a Saudi-led coalition, have been trading attacks since the group advanced in September toward territory near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a shipping chokepoint at the mouth of the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装和得到沙特领导的联军支持的国际公认政府自去年 9 月向红海口航运要道曼德海峡附近的领土挺进以来，一直在相互攻击。

paras.en: Local authority sources who spoke on condition of anonymity said the Houthis had launched three ballistic missiles at security forces during a training exercise.
paras.zh: 不愿透露姓名的地方当局消息人士称，胡塞武装在一次训练演习中向安全部队发射了三枚弹道导弹。

paras.en: Shabwa, an energy-rich province in southcentral coastal Yemen overlooking the Gulf of Aden, is home to the Balhaf liquefied natural gas facility, Yemen's largest industrial investment.
paras.zh: 沙布瓦是也门中南部沿海能源丰富的省份，俯瞰亚丁湾，是也门最大的工业投资巴尔哈夫液化天然气设施的所在地。

paras.en: Government forces this month began a campaign aimed at recapturing areas controlled by the Houthis, recovering ground near the strait, while the group besieges Taiz, the last major urban stronghold of anti-Houthi forces in the southern highland area of Yemen.
paras.zh: 政府军本月开始了一场旨在夺回胡塞武装控制地区的战役，收复海峡附近的土地，同时胡塞武装围攻也门南部高地地区反胡塞武装最后一个主要城市据点塔伊兹。

paras.en: The conflict in Yemen has become another frontline in the wider U.S.-Israeli war on Iran as the Houthis have escalated their attacks on Saudi Arabia, the world's largest crude exporter, targeting Riyadh's international airport and the state oil company Saudi Aramco.
paras.zh: 也门冲突已成为更广泛的美以对伊朗战争的另一个前线，胡塞武装升级了对世界最大原油出口国沙特阿拉伯的袭击，目标是利雅得国际机场和国有石油公司沙特阿美公司。

paras.en: Amid the Houthi attacks, the organizers of Saudi Arabia's flagship investment conference announced on Monday that they were postponing the event until next year.
paras.zh: 在胡塞武装袭击期间，沙特阿拉伯旗舰投资会议的组织者周一宣布，他们将把该活动推迟到明年。

paras.en: The four-day Future Investment Initiative Conference, dubbed "Davos in the Desert," was set to take place in the capital, Riyadh, from Oct. 26 to 29. "We will announce the new 2027 dates very soon," the organizers said in a written statement.
paras.zh: 为期四天的未来投资倡议会议被称为“沙漠中的达沃斯”，定于 10 月 26 日至 29 日在首都利雅得举行。组织者在一份书面声明中表示，“我们将很快宣布 2027 年的新日期”。

paras.en: - Canadians cautioned against travel to Saudi Arabia after attacks on airports
paras.zh: - 机场袭击后加拿大人警告不要前往沙特阿拉伯

paras.en: - Yemenis live in fear as Houthi rebels tighten siege of Taiz
paras.zh: - 胡塞武装加强对塔伊兹的围困，也门人生活在恐惧之中

paras.en: War broke out in Yemen in 2014 when the Houthis seized the capital Sanaa, driving the government south. A Saudi-led military intervention the following year led to a bloody stalemate until the sides agreed a 2022 truce that held until this year.
paras.zh: 2014年，也门爆发战争，胡塞武装占领首都萨那，迫使政府南下。次年沙特领导的军事干预导致了血腥僵局，直到双方同意 2022 年停战，并一直维持到今年。

paras.en: Yemen is already one of the world's worst humanitarian crises, with aid agencies warning of rapidly deteriorating conditions there.
paras.zh: 也门已经是世界上人道主义危机最严重的国家之一，援助机构警告那里的局势正在迅速恶化。

articles.title: Russian oil exports by Arctic route jump amid world freight crisis, data shows
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: Russian oil exports by Arctic route jump amid world freight crisis, data shows
paras.zh: 数据显示，在世界货运危机中，俄罗斯通过北极航线的石油出口量猛增

paras.en: Disruptions in Suez Canal, Strait of Hormuz and Black Sea make icy route more attractive
paras.zh: 苏伊士运河、霍尔木兹海峡和黑海的中断使冰冷的航线更具吸引力

paras.en: Russia's oil exports through its Northern Sea Route (NSR) in 2026 have already exceeded last year's by nearly 50 per cent, with some 20 million barrels shipped to Asia from the start of navigation in July to mid-October, traders said and data showed.
paras.zh: 交易商表示，数据显示，2026年俄罗斯通过北海航线(NSR)的石油出口量已超过去年的近50%，从7月开始航行到10月中旬，约有2000万桶运往亚洲。

paras.en: The NSR links Russia's western ports with Asian markets through icy Arctic waters and is considered a more dangerous and expensive route. This year, however, it became more attractive as a result of disruptions to routes in the Suez Canal, the Strait of Hormuz and the Black Sea area, traders said.
paras.zh: 北方航道通过冰冷的北极水域将俄罗斯西部港口与亚洲市场连接起来，被认为是一条更危险、更昂贵的路线。然而，贸易商表示，由于苏伊士运河、霍尔木兹海峡和黑海地区航线中断，今年它变得更具吸引力。

paras.en: Tanker freight rates have soared to record highs as wars with Iran and in Ukraine have stoked inflation and put U.S. crude oil out of reach for Asian refiners, driving them to seek alternatives from the Middle East and Latin America.
paras.zh: 由于与伊朗和乌克兰的战争加剧了通货膨胀，并使亚洲炼油商无法购买美国原油，迫使他们从中东和拉丁美洲寻求替代品，油轮运费飙升至历史新高。

paras.en: This made high tariffs for ships using the NSR, which requires assistance from an icebreaker, less costly compared with the usual route to Asia through the Red Sea, traders said.
paras.zh: 贸易商表示，这使得使用北方航道的船舶需要缴纳高额关税，而该航线需要破冰船的协助，与通常通过红海前往亚洲的航线相比，成本更低。

paras.en: For Russia, which controls the NSR, it represents a secure alternative to European waters, where tankers with its oil have been regularly arrested this year.
paras.zh: 对于控制北海航线的俄罗斯来说，它代表了欧洲水域的一个安全替代方案，今年载有其石油的油轮在欧洲水域经常被扣押。

paras.en: The volume of Russian oil exported through the Arctic route is expected to rise by another five to 10 million barrels by the end of the navigation period, traders' preliminary estimates show.
paras.zh: 贸易商初步估计，到航行期结束时，俄罗斯通过北极航线出口的石油量预计将再增加5至1000万桶。

paras.en: Russia shipped 13 million barrels during the last navigation season. Gazprom Neft, one of Russia's major oil companies, will increase its shipments via the NSR by some 35 per cent this year compared with 2025, its CEO Alexander Dyukov told journalists on Friday in Moscow.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯在上一个航行季节运输了 1300 万桶。俄罗斯主要石油公司之一的俄罗斯天然气工业石油公司首席执行官亚历山大·久科夫周五在莫斯科对记者表示，与 2025 年相比，今年通过北海航线的发货量将增加约 35%。

paras.en: Russia also supplies significant volumes of liquid natural gas (LNG) to Asia via the NSR as well as other goods. LNG supply via the NSR is also expected to rise this year after the launch of Arctic LNG shipments.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯还通过北方航道向亚洲供应大量液化天然气（LNG）以及其他商品。在北极液化天然气运输启动后，预计今年通过北海航线的液化天然气供应量也会增加。

paras.en: President Vladimir Putin told an economic forum in Vladivostok in September that Russia expects cargo turnover via the NSR to double to 70 million tonnes annually by the end of the decade.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 9 月在符拉迪沃斯托克 (Vladivostok) 举行的经济论坛上表示，俄罗斯预计到本世纪末，北海航线的货运量将翻一番，达到每年 7000 万吨。

paras.en: Rosneft's giant new oil project in the north of Russia, Vostok Oil, which opened last month, is already contributing to the rising volumes using the NSR.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯石油公司在俄罗斯北部的大型新石油项目“东方石油”于上个月开业，已经为北海航线的产量增加做出了贡献。

articles.title: Police issue curfew in Paris after weekend rioting over cost of living, school conditions

paras.en: Police issue curfew in Paris after weekend rioting over cost of living, school conditions
paras.zh: 周末因生活成本和学校条件引发骚乱后，巴黎警方实施宵禁

paras.en: About 3,000 businesses along with other public buildings were damaged or looted across France, police said
paras.zh: 警方称，法国各地约 3,000 家企业和其他公共建筑遭到破坏或抢劫

paras.en: Paris police issued an overnight curfew on Monday in two areas of the French capital in efforts to prevent further violence, after a weekend marred by France's worst rioting in years that targeted city halls, other public buildings and thousands of businesses across the country.
paras.zh: 巴黎警方周一在法国首都的两个地区实施夜间宵禁，以防止进一步的暴力事件。周末发生了法国多年来最严重的骚乱，针对市政厅、其他公共建筑和全国数千家企业的骚乱造成了影响。

paras.en: The order aims to protect "people and property from the violence and looting," the Paris police statement said.
paras.zh: 巴黎警方声明称，该命令旨在保护“人民和财产免受暴力和抢劫”。

paras.en: The curfew prohibits anyone from entering or remaining on the Place de la République, where rioting took place Saturday, and the shopping neighbourhood of Les Halles, which has been subject to looting.
paras.zh: 宵禁禁止任何人进入或停留在周六发生骚乱的共和广场，以及遭受抢劫的莱斯哈里斯购物区。

paras.en: The curfew will be in effect from 11 p.m. local time Monday until 6 a.m. Tuesday. In addition, gatherings and demonstrations are banned from 8 p.m., the Paris police said.
paras.zh: 宵禁将从晚上 11 点开始生效。当地时间周一至周二早上 6 点。此外，巴黎警方表示，从晚上8点开始禁止集会和示威。

paras.en: Earlier Monday, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu had called for "very limited" and "localized" curfews.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努呼吁实施“非常有限”和“局部”的宵禁。

paras.en: Protesters burn trash during clashes with police on Sunday. (Emma Da Silva/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周日，抗议者在与警察的冲突中焚烧垃圾。 （艾玛·达席尔瓦/美联社）

paras.en: In northern France, local authorities imposed a curfew for children and teenagers under age 18 in several cities, including Lille, starting from Monday and for the next two days from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nice, on the French Riviera, also imposed an overnight curfew for minors from 9 p.m.
paras.zh: 在法国北部，地方当局从周一开始，在接下来的两天晚上 8 点开始，在包括里尔在内的多个城市对 18 岁以下的儿童和青少年实施宵禁。法国里维埃拉的尼斯也从晚上 9 点到早上 6 点对未成年人实行宵禁。

paras.en: Lecornu defended police handling of the unrest, saying that "despite scenes of severe violence and extensive property damage, no one was killed, and that is a miracle."
paras.zh: 莱科尔努为警方处理骚乱的方式进行了辩护，称“尽管发生了严重的暴力事件和广泛的财产损失，但没有人死亡，这是一个奇迹。”

paras.en: He said that details of the curfews would be announced later Monday after consultations with mayors.
paras.zh: 他表示，宵禁的细节将在与市长协商后于周一晚些时候公布。

paras.en: - French 'lycée' protests spread to Quebec as Montreal students take to streets in solidarity
paras.zh: - 蒙特利尔学生走上街头声援法国“中学”抗议活动蔓延至魁北克

paras.en: - Student-led protesters clash with riot police in France
paras.zh: - 法国学生领导的抗议者与防暴警察发生冲突

paras.en: Mass protests in France are often tainted by violence on the fringes of otherwise peaceful marches, leading to clashes with police.
paras.zh: 法国的大规模抗议活动经常在原本和平的游行边缘爆发暴力事件，导致与警察的冲突。

paras.en: Saturday's unrest recalled the riots that followed the fatal police shooting of a teenager in 2023, when authorities imposed local curfews, and violence during the yellow vest movement that began in 2018 over fuel prices and broader economic grievances.
paras.zh: 周六的骚乱让人想起2023年警察枪杀一名青少年后发生的骚乱，当时当局实施了当地宵禁，以及2018年因燃油价格和更广泛的经济不满而开始的黄背心运动期间的暴力事件。

paras.en: A worker repairs a window of a looted shop following the riots. (Christophe Ena/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 骚乱后，一名工人正在修复一家被洗劫商店的窗户。 （克里斯托夫·埃纳/美联社）

paras.en: The prime minister's instructions come after France's interior minister Laurent Nuñez offered his resignation Sunday. But President Emmanuel Macron refused it "given the need for continued command of law enforcement in the current context," Macron's office said in a statement Monday.
paras.zh: 法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯周日提出辞职后，总理发出了这一指示。但马克龙总统办公室周一在一份声明中表示，“鉴于在当前情况下需要继续指挥执法”，总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙拒绝了这一要求。

paras.en: He instructed Nuñez "to take all necessary steps to ensure full transparency about the failures in planning and intelligence-gathering that led to the violence," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称，他指示努涅斯“采取一切必要措施，确保导致暴力事件的规划和情报收集失败的情况完全透明”。

paras.en: Macron also asked for the introduction of "new policing tactics on the ground as quickly as possible" to put an end to the violence.
paras.zh: 马克龙还要求“尽快在当地采取新的警务策略”以结束暴力。

paras.en: On Sunday evening, groups set fire to trash bins, bicycles and other objects in the streets and looted businesses in Paris, Lyon, Marseille and other cities. That followed the violence during nationwide protests Saturday against rising living costs and poor conditions in schools. At least 2,400 people were arrested across the country.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，一些团体纵火焚烧街道上的垃圾桶、自行车和其他物品，并抢劫巴黎、里昂、马赛和其他城市的商店。此前，周六全国范围内针对生活成本上涨和学校条件恶劣的抗议活动发生了暴力事件。全国至少有2,400人被捕。

paras.en: Authorities estimated Monday that at least 3,000 businesses were damaged or looted in several cities.
paras.zh: 当局周一估计，多个城市至少有 3,000 家企业遭到破坏或抢劫。

paras.en: In Marseille, the prefect banned any protest or other gatherings from noon to 8 p.m. Monday.
paras.zh: 在马赛，省长禁止从中午到晚上 8 点进行任何抗议或其他集会。周一。

paras.en: "I submitted my resignation because I am responsible for everything that is happening," Nuñez said on France Inter radio. "Now the real issue is ensuring that this doesn't happen again. … We obviously need to be better at anticipating the kind of mobilization that is unfolding."
paras.zh: 努涅斯在法国国际广播电台上表示：“我提交了辞呈，因为我对所发生的一切负责。” “现在真正的问题是确保这种情况不再发生……我们显然需要更好地预测正在展开的动员活动。”

paras.en: Nuñez blamed the violence on "hordes of troublemakers and looters" and "far-left activists," and said that police strategy needs to be adapted "in the face of extremely mobile groups."
paras.zh: 努涅斯将暴力事件归咎于“成群结队的麻烦制造者和抢劫者”和“极左活动分子”，并表示“面对流动性极强的群体”，警方的策略需要调整。

paras.en: Authorities said that groups of hundreds of people sought confrontations with police and targeted public buildings, including city halls and other public offices.
paras.zh: 当局表示，数百人的团体寻求与警方对抗，并袭击了公共建筑，包括市政厅和其他公共办公室。

paras.en: A man throws a plastic traffic cone through a burning barricade amid clashes Saturday in Paris. (Abdul Saboor/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六，巴黎发生冲突，一名男子将塑料交通锥扔进燃烧的路障。 （阿卜杜勒·萨布尔/路透社）

paras.en: Authorities 'lost control,' says minister
paras.zh: 部长表示当局“失去了控制”

paras.en: Nuñez acknowledged that authorities had "lost control" in some major cities on Saturday.
paras.zh: 努涅斯承认，周六，当局在一些主要城市“失去了控制”。

paras.en: "You can't look shopkeepers in the eye when hundreds of businesses have been looted and say we haven't lost control in some of these major cities," Nuñez said.
paras.zh: 努涅斯说：“当数百家企业被抢劫时，你不能直视店主的眼睛，并说我们在其中一些主要城市没有失去控制。”

paras.en: Flames engulfed the 19th-century City Hall in Limoges, in central France, causing its roof to collapse and nearly destroying the building.
paras.zh: 火焰吞没了法国中部利摩日 19 世纪的市政厅，导致其屋顶倒塌，几乎摧毁了这座建筑。

paras.en: On Monday, clean-up crews and firefighters cleared shattered glass and other debris from the streets of Paris.
paras.zh: 周一，清洁人员和消防员清理了巴黎街道上的碎玻璃和其他碎片。

paras.en: Ouri Zagoury, owner of a video game shop near Paris' Place de la République, said that he closed the store Saturday afternoon, but then saw looters forcing their way in on surveillance cameras.
paras.zh: 巴黎共和广场附近一家电子游戏店的老板乌里·扎古里 (Ouri Zagoury) 表示，他周六下午关闭了商店，但随后在监控摄像头中看到抢劫者强行闯入。

paras.en: "There were so many people coming in and out. And even though I called the police, they said not to intervene, that they would come, but they never did, which is another problem," Zagoury said.
paras.zh: “有很多人进进出出。尽管我报警了，他们说不要干预，他们会来，但他们从来没有这样做，这是另一个问题，”扎古里说。

paras.en: Jordan Bardella, president of the far-right National Rally party, pointed to the government's failure to prevent violence.
paras.zh: 极右翼国家集会党主席乔丹·巴尔德拉(Jordan Bardella)指出政府未能防止暴力。

paras.en: "The government has failed, the head of state has failed in his essential duty of protecting the French people," he told reporters at the party's headquarters.
paras.zh: 他在党总部对记者说：“政府失败了，国家元首未能履行保护法国人民的基本职责。”

paras.en: "I call on the people of France now, beyond their right to protest, to use their voting power," Bardella said. He is campaigning alongside far-right leader Marine Le Pen, whose polling numbers have suggested for months that she's the front-runner in next spring's presidential election.
paras.zh: 巴尔德拉说：“我现在呼吁法国人民，除了抗议权之外，还要使用他们的投票权。”他与极右翼领导人马琳·勒庞一起竞选，几个月来，她的民意调查数据表明她是明年春季总统选举的领跑者。

articles.title: Rubio visits India with a trip to the world's largest oil refinery topping the agenda

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio kicks off a three-day visit to India on Monday in the finance hub of Mumbai, before heading to Jamnagar, home to a major oil refinery owned by industrial titan Reliance Industries.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一在金融中心孟买开始对印度进行为期三天的访问，然后前往工业巨头信实工业旗下的一家大型炼油厂所在地贾姆讷格尔。

paras.en: Rubio's business-oriented visit comes as trade talks remain stalled amid continued ambiguity on punitive measures from the US over India's purchases of Russian oil.
paras.zh: 卢比奥此次以商业为导向的访问正值贸易谈判陷入僵局之际，美国对印度购买俄罗斯石油的惩罚措施仍然含糊不清。

paras.en: Reliance is a top buyer of Venezuelan oil. The refinery can process 1.4 million barrels of crude oil a day, so it's a valuable exporter of diesel fuel for global markets. The refinery has also been a major buyer of Russian Urals crude, making it a significant part of India's energy relationship with Russia.
paras.zh: 信实集团是委内瑞拉石油的最大买家。该炼油厂每天可加工 140 万桶原油，因此是全球市场有价值的柴油出口商。该炼油厂也是俄罗斯乌拉尔原油的主要买家，使其成为印度与俄罗斯能源关系的重要组成部分。

paras.en: In March, Washington unveiled plans for a new oil refinery in Texas, backed by Reliance.
paras.zh: 今年三月，华盛顿公布了在信实集团的支持下在德克萨斯州建造一座新炼油厂的计划。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has put the value of the project at $300 billion (€258 billion) and presented it as a way to help reduce the US trade deficit with India. Whether the project moves forward, and on what terms, will be closely watched.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将该项目的价值定为 3000 亿美元（2580 亿欧元），并将其视为帮助减少美国对印度贸易逆差的一种方式。该项目是否进展以及进展如何，将受到密切关注。

paras.en: Since taking office for a second time in 2025, Trump has gone back and forth on tariff threats with India over what he considers to be unfair trade practices, along with India's continued purchases of Russian oil amid the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年第二次上任以来，特朗普一直在对印度进行关税威胁，原因是他认为印度的不公平贸易行为，以及印度在乌克兰战争期间继续购买俄罗斯石油。

paras.en: In February 2026, Trump announced a "trade deal" that slashed US tariffs on Indian goods, in exchange for India lowering trade barriers and halting purchases of Russian oil. Trump had claimed that Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi promised to stop buying Russian oil. However, this has never been confirmed by New Delhi.
paras.zh: 2026年2月，特朗普宣布一项“贸易协议”，大幅削减美国对印度商品的关税，以换取印度降低贸易壁垒并停止购买俄罗斯石油。特朗普曾声称印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪承诺停止购买俄罗斯石油。不过，这一消息从未得到新德里方面的证实。

paras.en: While maritime data from Kpler, a commodities and energy-market intelligence company, showed Indian refiners briefly diversified supply away from Russia to avoid tightening sanctions, India's deep reliance on discounted Russian crude continues to be a cornerstone of its energy strategy. Russia remains India's top supplier of crude oil.
paras.zh: 尽管大宗商品和能源市场情报公司 Kpler 的海事数据显示，印度炼油商短暂将供应从俄罗斯转向多元化，以避免收紧制裁，但印度对打折的俄罗斯原油的深度依赖仍然是其能源战略的基石。俄罗斯仍然是印度最大的原油供应国。

paras.en: In mid-September, Trump signed the "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act," imposing 100% tariffs on top buyers of Russian oil and gas, which includes India.
paras.zh: 9月中旬，特朗普签署了《林赛·格雷厄姆制裁俄罗斯和伊朗法案》，对俄罗斯石油和天然气的主要买家征收100%的关税，其中包括印度。

paras.en: However, last week, just days before the legislation was due to go into effect, Trump signed an executive order pausing the sanctions.
paras.zh: 然而，上周，就在该立法生效前几天，特朗普签署了一项暂停制裁的行政命令。

paras.en: Before traveling to India, Rubio was in Uzbekistan for a meeting of the "C5+1" diplomatic platform comprising the US and five Central Asian countries. In remarks on the sidelines, Rubio said trade talks with India are taking place with the sanctions waivers in mind.
paras.zh: 在前往印度之前，卢比奥正在乌兹别克斯坦参加由美国和中亚五国组成的“C5+1”外交平台会议。卢比奥在场外发表讲话时表示，与印度进行贸易谈判时考虑到了制裁豁免。

paras.en: "We have had to waive sanctions over the past few months, looking at the global supplies, looking at global prices, and the impact it was having on other countries," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“过去几个月我们不得不放弃制裁，审视全球供应、全球价格及其对其他国家的影响。”

paras.en: "We're trying to finalize a trade deal with India right now. We're very close to doing that," Rubio added.
paras.zh: “我们现在正在努力与印度敲定贸易协议。我们非常接近这样做，”卢比奥补充道。

paras.en: In an interview with Indian broadcaster NDTV, US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor said that Jamnagar could be a valuable source of diesel for the US.
paras.zh: 美国驻印度大使塞尔吉奥·戈尔在接受印度NDTV电视台采访时表示，贾姆讷格尔可能是美国宝贵的柴油来源。

paras.en: Foreign policy analyst C Raja Mohan of Jindal Global University in India told DW that Rubio skipping a visit to the Indian capital in favor of Mumbai and Jamnagar should not be considered a diplomatic snub, as the refinery has international importance amid the global energy crunch brought on by the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East.
paras.zh: 印度金达尔全球大学外交政策分析师拉贾·莫汉 (C Raja Mohan) 告诉德国之声，卢比奥没有访问印度首都而转而访问孟买和贾姆讷格尔不应被视为外交冷落，因为在乌克兰和中东战争引发的全球能源危机中，该炼油厂具有国际重要性。

paras.en: He said Jamnagar is an "important node in global trade" because it processes Russian oil and serves as a conduit for refined Russian petroleum products reaching Western markets.
paras.zh: 他说贾姆讷格尔是“全球贸易的重要节点”，因为它加工俄罗斯石油，并充当俄罗斯精炼石油产品进入西方市场的渠道。

paras.en: Although Trump's sanctions reprieve offers New Delhi temporary relief, the underlying threat remains. Washington retains the option of imposing punitive tariffs, leaving Russian oil as a potential source of leverage in wider trade negotiations.
paras.zh: 尽管特朗普的制裁缓期让新德里暂时得到缓解，但潜在的威胁依然存在。华盛顿保留征收惩罚性关税的选择，使俄罗斯石油成为更广泛贸易谈判的潜在杠杆来源。

paras.en: Former Indian ambassador to the US, Meera Shankar, cautioned against reading too much into Rubio's decision to skip Delhi amid political criticism in India.
paras.zh: 印度前驻美国大使梅拉·香卡 (Meera Shankar) 警告，不要对卢比奥在印度政治批评之际跳过德里的决定过度解读。

paras.en: "The focus of his current trip is on energy, and he is visiting the Reliance refinery in Jamnagar," she told DW. "The high price of fuel, particularly diesel, has become a political liability for the Trump administration, which wants to be seen taking action on this issue."
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声：“他此次访问的重点是能源，他正在参观位于贾姆讷格尔的信实炼油厂。” “燃料价格高企，尤其是柴油价格，已成为特朗普政府的政治负担，特朗普政府希望看到在这个问题上采取行动。”

paras.en: Diesel prices have skyrocketed around the world following the Iran war and the ensuing disruption of supply from the Middle East. In waiving Russia sanctions, Trump has tried to blame Ukrainian attacks on Russian oil facilities as being the cause of high prices.
paras.zh: 伊朗战争和随之而来的中东供应中断后，全球柴油价格飙升。在放弃对俄罗斯的制裁时，特朗普试图将高油价归咎于乌克兰对俄罗斯石油设施的袭击。

paras.en: Shankar pointed to Reliance's proposed Texas refinery, noting that the state is "one of the states in play" in the upcoming midterm elections in the US.
paras.zh: 尚卡提到了信实集团拟建的德克萨斯州炼油厂，并指出该州是即将到来的美国中期选举中“参与其中的州之一”。

paras.en: "Some forward movement on the investment would be welcome," she said.
paras.zh: “投资方面的一些进展将受到欢迎，”她说。

paras.en: The two governments continue to describe their ties as a comprehensive global strategic partnership spanning defence, trade, technology and energy.
paras.zh: 两国政府继续将两国关系描述为涵盖国防、贸易、技术和能源的全面全球战略伙伴关系。

paras.en: Analyst Mohan argued that describing the US-India relationship as uniquely transactional was misleading.
paras.zh: 分析师莫汉认为，将美印关系描述为独特的交易性关系具有误导性。

paras.en: "Every nation ultimately acts out of national self-interest, rather than pure altruism or shared values," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“每个国家的行为最终都是出于国家自身利益，而不是纯粹的利他主义或共同价值观。”

paras.en: The current friction, in his view, is part of a normal negotiation between two sovereign powers, not proof that the partnership was failing.
paras.zh: 他认为，当前的摩擦是两个主权国家之间正常谈判的一部分，而不是伙伴关系失败的证据。

paras.en: Besides Russian oil, another potential area of complication is the Trump administration suspending a scheme allowing US companies to sponsor skilled foreign workers.
paras.zh: 除了俄罗斯石油之外，另一个潜在的复杂领域是特朗普政府暂停了一项允许美国公司赞助熟练外国工人的计划。

paras.en: On October 8, the Trump administration suspended new and pending applications under the US Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) program at several technology companies amid investigations into alleged visa fraud and the displacement of US workers.
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日，在对涉嫌签证欺诈和美国工人流离失所的调查中，特朗普政府暂停了多家科技公司根据美国永久劳工认证 (PERM) 计划提出的新申请和待处理申请。

paras.en: The process is a key step for employers seeking permanent residency for foreign staff, including Indian professionals.
paras.zh: 对于雇主为包括印度专业人士在内的外国员工寻求永久居留权的雇主来说，这一过程是关键一步。

paras.en: Harsh Pant, vice president for studies and foreign policy at the Delhi-based Observer Research Foundation (ORF), said Trump's own words and actions had damaged ties despite regular high-level engagement.
paras.zh: 总部位于德里的观察家研究基金会（ORF）负责研究和外交政策的副总裁哈什·潘特表示，尽管高层定期接触，但特朗普自己的言行损害了两国关系。

paras.en: "Even as he calls Prime Minister Modi a good friend, he has damaged the relationship by targeting India, and his supporters have been targeting Indians," Pant told DW.
paras.zh: 潘特对德国之声表示：“尽管他称莫迪总理为好朋友，但他针对印度的行为损害了两国关系，而他的支持者也一直针对印度人。”

paras.en: Pant said inconsistent messaging from Washington was eroding trust and could have consequences well beyond Trump's presidency.
paras.zh: 潘特表示，华盛顿发出的不一致的信息正在侵蚀信任，其后果可能远远超出特朗普的总统任期。

paras.en: "The sense that America is unreliable, that America can't be trusted, is beginning to come back into policy discourse," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“美国不可靠、不可信任的感觉正开始重新回到政策讨论中。”

paras.en: The damage, he warned, could reach beyond government-to-government relations to Indian students, professionals and the middle class, whose goodwill has helped sustain ties through earlier disagreements.
paras.zh: 他警告说，这种损害可能不仅限于政府间关系，还波及印度学生、专业人士和中产阶级，他们的善意有助于维持两国关系，度过了早期的分歧。

paras.en: "If public sentiment goes against a country, then it becomes very difficult for the policy-makers to craft an alternative policy,” Pant said, adding that US actions affecting Indian students and professionals "will have consequences."
paras.zh: 潘特说：“如果公众情绪不利于一个国家，那么政策制定者就很难制定替代政策。”他补充说，美国影响印度学生和专业人士的行动“将会产生后果”。

articles.title: Can diplomacy stop another Ethiopia-Eritrea war?

paras.en: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has announced an interim government in the country's northern Tigray region, giving it six months to prepare for regional elections and restore stability.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德宣布在该国北部提格雷地区组建临时政府，给予其六个月的时间准备地区选举并恢复稳定。

paras.en: Abiy's announcement on Friday followed a military offensive launched in September by the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) and six other armed groups. They were ultimately forced to retreat and lost control of the region.
paras.zh: 阿比周五宣布这一消息之前，提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）和其他六个武装团体于 9 月发起了军事攻势。他们最终被迫撤退并失去了对该地区的控制。

paras.en: "To attain the peace that has long eluded them, to secure their right to self-administration, and to finally enjoy the fruits of development — which have been out of reach for many years — the people of Tigray must break free from this cycle of conflict," Abiy said in a statement posted on X.
paras.zh: 阿比在 X 上发布的一份声明中表示：“为了实现长期以来一直未能实现的和平，确保自治权，并最终享受多年来一直遥不可及的发展成果，提格雷人民必须摆脱这种冲突循环。”

paras.en: Shishay Amare, the new mayor of the regional capital Mekelle, said they would "create the right conditions for elections by ensuring peace and stability across Tigray," as reported by French news agency Agence France-Presse.
paras.zh: 据法国通讯社法新社报道，地区首府梅克莱新任市长希谢·阿玛雷表示，他们将“确保提格雷各地的和平与稳定，为选举创造合适的条件”。

paras.en: "I am confident that this will be done within six months, according to our plan," Amare said, adding that their priorities included restoring peace, helping displaced residents return home, reopening markets and ensuring humanitarian assistance reached those in need.
paras.zh: 阿玛雷说：“我相信，根据我们的计划，这将在六个月内完成。”他补充说，他们的优先事项包括恢复和平、帮助流离失所的居民返回家园、重新开放市场以及确保人道主义援助送达有需要的人手中。

paras.en: The fighting has revived concerns about a return to the devastating 2020–2022 Tigray war. Around 1 million people remain displaced from that conflict. The African Union has estimated that the war resulted in around 600,000 deaths from combat, famine and the collapse of healthcare.
paras.zh: 这场战斗再次引发了人们对 2020 年至 2022 年毁灭性提格雷战争重演的担忧。约有 100 万人因这场冲突而流离失所。非洲联盟估计，这场战争导致约 60 万人因战斗、饥荒和医疗保健崩溃而死亡。

paras.en: The new administration faces unresolved disputes over political authority and territory, including western Tigray, which is claimed by both Tigray and neighboring Amhara state.
paras.zh: 新政府面临着政治权力和领土方面悬而未决的争端，其中包括西提格雷州，提格雷州和邻近的阿姆哈拉州都声称对该地区拥有主权。

paras.en: Ethiopia and Eritrea were once bitter enemies but signed a peace agreement in 2018. Eritrean forces later fought alongside Ethiopian federal troops during the Tigray war. But the countries' relationship has since deteriorated.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚曾经是死敌，但在2018年签署了和平协议。厄立特里亚军队后来在提格雷战争中与埃塞俄比亚联邦军队并肩作战。但此后两国关系恶化。

paras.en: Addis Ababa has accused Asmara of supporting Tigrayan forces and violating Ethiopian territory. Eritrea has denied the accusations.
paras.zh: 亚的斯亚贝巴指责阿斯马拉支持提格雷武装并侵犯埃塞俄比亚领土。厄立特里亚否认了这些指控。

paras.en: Reports of Eritrean troop movements near the border have heightened concern, although the extent of any current deployment remains disputed.
paras.zh: 有关厄立特里亚军队在边境附近调动的报道引起了人们的高度关注，尽管目前的部署规模仍存在争议。

paras.en: Tsedale Lemma, journalist and publisher of the prominent Addis Standard magazine, told DW earlier this month that the danger reflects years of unresolved tensions and failures to implement the November 2022 Pretoria Agreement, which ended the Tigray war.
paras.zh: 知名杂志《亚的斯标准》的记者兼出版人 Tsedale Lemma 本月早些时候告诉德国之声，这种危险反映出多年来紧张局势未得到解决，以及未能执行 2022 年 11 月结束提格雷战争的《比勒陀利亚协议》。

paras.en: Lemma said the international community was "absolutely underestimating" the threat of conflict. She argued that international actors had failed to ensure effective monitoring of the agreement and respond adequately as the peace process weakened.
paras.zh: 莱玛表示，国际社会“绝对低估”了冲突的威胁。她认为，随着和平进程的削弱，国际行为者未能确保对该协议进行有效监督并做出充分反应。

paras.en: The confrontation comes amid instability across the Horn of Africa, including Sudan's war and tensions between Ethiopia and Egypt over the Nile mega-dam project.
paras.zh: 此次对抗发生在非洲之角局势不稳定的背景下，包括苏丹战争以及埃塞俄比亚和埃及因尼罗河大坝项目而紧张的局势。

paras.en: Ethiopia inaugurated the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD) in September 2025, a move that was not well received by neighboring Egypt and Sudan, both downstream countries.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚于 2025 年 9 月启用了埃塞俄比亚复兴大坝 (GERD)，此举并未受到下游邻国埃及和苏丹的欢迎。

paras.en: Competition over access to the Red Sea has added another strategic dimension: Ethiopia became landlocked when Eritrea gained independence in 1993.
paras.zh: 对红海出入权的争夺增加了另一个战略层面：1993 年厄立特里亚获得独立后，埃塞俄比亚成为内陆国家。

paras.en: Journalist Martin Plaut, who specializes in the Horn of Africa, has warned that the region is at a crossroads. He has raised the possibility of Ethiopian forces entering Eritrea, but an invasion remains a scenario, not a confirmed decision by the Ethiopian government.
paras.zh: 专门研究非洲之角的记者马丁·普劳特警告说，该地区正处于十字路口。他提出了埃塞俄比亚军队进入厄立特里亚的可能性，但入侵仍然是一种假设，而不是埃塞俄比亚政府确认的决定。

paras.en: Any wider conflict could threaten regional trade and maritime security. The Red Sea and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait connect shipping routes between Europe and Asia, making the region strategically important well beyond Africa.
paras.zh: 任何更广泛的冲突都可能威胁区域贸易和海上安全。红海和曼德海峡连接了欧洲和亚洲之间的航线，使该地区的战略重要性远远超出非洲。

paras.en: Can diplomacy avert war between Ethiopia and Eritrea?
paras.zh: 外交能否避免埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚之间的战争？

paras.en: The United States and the United Kingdom have called on Ethiopia and Eritrea to exercise restraint and return to dialogue under their 2018 peace framework.
paras.zh: 美国和英国呼吁埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚保持克制，并在2018年和平框架下恢复对话。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland on Saturday, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned that the military buildup on the Ethiopia-Eritrea border could escalate into a wider conflict.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥周六在马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地向记者发表讲话警告说，埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚边境的军事集结可能会升级为更广泛的冲突。

paras.en: Rubio said Washington hoped lifting some sanctions would improve communication with both sides and stressed the need for a "wise and measured" response to avoid a broader regional war.
paras.zh: 卢比奥表示，华盛顿希望解除一些制裁将改善与双方的沟通，并强调需要采取“明智和慎重”的应对措施，以避免更广泛的地区战争。

paras.en: The United Kingdom has also called for renewed talks between both sides. "We urgently call for de-escalation and a return to dialogue. We reiterate our support for the African Union's role in facilitating this," said a UK government spokesperson in a statement on October 15.
paras.zh: 英国也呼吁双方重启谈判。英国政府发言人在 10 月 15 日的一份声明中表示：“我们紧急呼吁缓和局势并恢复对话。我们重申支持非洲联盟在促进这一进程中发挥的作用。”

paras.en: For now, the recapture of towns in Tigray has changed the military balance but has not resolved tensions in the region.
paras.zh: 目前，提格雷城镇的收复改变了军事平衡，但尚未解决该地区的紧张局势。

paras.en: Whether international pressure can prevent a wider war will depend on whether the governments involved choose dialogue over further escalation.
paras.zh: 国际压力能否阻止更广泛的战争将取决于相关政府是否选择对话而不是进一步升级。

paras.en: Negash Mohammed, Tamirat Geleta and Christine Mhundwa contributed to this report.
paras.zh: Negash Mohammed、Tamirat Geleta 和 Christine Mhundwa 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Canada: Alberta votes on holding independence referendum

paras.en: Residents of Alberta in Canada are voting in a referendum on whether the province should begin a process that could ultimately lead to independence.
paras.zh: 加拿大阿尔伯塔省的居民正在就该省是否应该启动最终可能导致独立的进程进行全民公投。

paras.en: The motion does not appear likely to succeed but the vote taking place at all signifies economic and political grievances gaining some sway in the vast oil-rich region.
paras.zh: 该动议似乎不太可能成功，但投票的进行完全表明经济和政治不满情绪在这个广阔的石油资源丰富的地区获得了一定的影响力。

paras.en: Separatist leaders hope that a comparatively strong showing for their cause could nevertheless pressure Prime Minister Mark Carney's government in Ottawa to pay them more heed in future.
paras.zh: 分离主义领导人希望，他们的事业取得相对强劲的表现，能够迫使渥太华总理马克·卡尼的政府在未来更加关注他们。

paras.en: Polls opened at 9 a.m. local time in the provincial capital Edmonton (1500 GMT/UTC) on Monday.
paras.zh: 投票于周一当地时间上午 9 点在省会埃德蒙顿（1500 GMT/UTC）开始。

paras.en: They are scheduled to close at 8 p.m. that evening (Tuesday, 0200 GMT/UTC).
paras.zh: 他们预计晚上 8 点关门。那天晚上（星期二，0200 GMT/UTC）。

paras.en: Results will then be published as they come in.
paras.zh: 结果将在收到后立即发布。

paras.en: At least based on opinion polls, the yes/no result is in no real doubt, but as many as 1 in 3 voters might support the proposal.
paras.zh: 至少根据民意调查，是/否的结果毫无疑问，但多达三分之一的选民可能支持该提案。

paras.en: Monday's referendum is the first on the notion of breaking away from Canada in a province other than majority French-speaking Quebec, which has a better-known separatist movement founded in language and cultural differences.
paras.zh: 周一的公投是法语区魁北克省以外省份第一次关于脱离加拿大的公投，魁北克省的分裂主义运动以语言和文化差异为基础。

paras.en: The vast oil-rich state is almost double the size of Germany in terms of land mass, but is much more sparsely populated with around 5 million residents. Almost half of them live in its two main cities, Edmonton and Calgary.
paras.zh: 这个石油资源丰富的广阔国家的土地面积几乎是德国的两倍，但人口稀少，约有 500 万居民。其中近一半居住在两个主要城市：埃德蒙顿和卡尔加里。

paras.en: Alberta's provincial government is led by Danielle Smith of the United Conservative Party while Mark Carney's Liberal Party lead the national government.
paras.zh: 艾伯塔省政府由联合保守党的丹妮尔·史密斯领导，而马克·卡尼的自由党领导国家政府。

paras.en: Smith herself does not advocate independence and has urged voters to oppose the motion. But she has nevertheless authorized the vote, seemingly in a bid to assuage an increasingly vocal flank within her own ranks.
paras.zh: 史密斯本人并不主张独立，并敦促选民反对这项动议。但她还是授权了这次投票，似乎是为了安抚自己队伍中日益发声的一方。

paras.en: Independence advocates accuse the government of stifling Alberta's oil industry, for instance through environmental regulations, and also say they contribute disproportionately to the national public purse.
paras.zh: 独立倡导者指责政府通过环境法规等方式扼杀阿尔伯塔省的石油工业，并表示政府为国家公共财政做出了不成比例的贡献。

paras.en: "Canada has an imbalanced system which feeds the central population and government at the expense of the outlying producing provinces such as Alberta," said Cory Morgan, founder of a pro-separation organization called Pathway to Independence.
paras.zh: “加拿大的体系不平衡，为中央人口和政府提供食物，而牺牲了艾伯塔省等边远生产省份的利益，”支持分离组织“独立之路”的创始人科里·摩根说。

paras.en: Canadian sovereignty under pressure from within and without
paras.zh: 加拿大主权面临内外压力

paras.en: Carney, who grew up in Alberta, has spent much of the past week campaigning for the "stay" campaign, appealing to national pride and urging supporters to vote to provide as resounding a result as possible — even in what might not be a close race.
paras.zh: 卡尼在艾伯塔省长大，过去一周的大部分时间都在为“留欧”运动奔走，呼吁民族自豪感，并敦促支持者投票，以提供尽可能响亮的结果——即使是在可能不是势均力敌的竞选中。

paras.en: The renowned economist and central banker often argued that the separatist cause might be guilty of overlooking matters more significant than dollars and drilling permits.
paras.zh: 这位著名的经济学家和央行行长经常辩称，分裂主义的原因可能是忽视了比美元和钻探许可更重要的问题。

paras.en: "Canada is not a transaction between provinces. It's not about gross and net, gives and gets," he said at an event in Red Deer on Friday.
paras.zh: “加拿大不是各省之间的交易。这不是总额和净额、给予和得到的问题，”他周五在红鹿市的一次活动中表示。

paras.en: Although polls in French-speaking Quebec suggest that enthusiasm for independence — typically a minority cause — is lower than usual during Carney's premiership, the issue is never very far from the political debate. The success of the separatist Parti Quebecois in local elections this month served as a reminder of this.
paras.zh: 尽管魁北克法语区的民意调查显示，在卡尼担任总理期间，对独立的热情（通常是少数派的原因）低于平常，但这个问题从来没有远离政治辩论。分裂主义魁北克党本月在地方选举中取得的成功提醒人们这一点。

paras.en: Carney is also trying to maintain national unity amid pressure from Canada's nearest neighbor and biggest trade partner.
paras.zh: 在加拿大最近邻国和最大贸易伙伴的压力下，卡尼还试图维持国家团结。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump is conducting characteristically combative trade talks with Canada that have seemed in danger of breaking down in recent months.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普正在与加拿大进行典型的好斗贸易谈判，近几个月来谈判似乎面临破裂的危险。

paras.en: When at his most agitated, Trump has even called for Canada to become the "51st state" of the US. He has also tried to rename bodies of water like Lake Ontario.
paras.zh: 特朗普最激动的时候，甚至呼吁加拿大成为美国的“第51个州”。他还尝试重新命名安大略湖等水体。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Benny Gantz drops out of Israel’s election race

paras.en: Benny Gantz, a former Israeli army chief and defence minister, has withdrawn from Israel’s election race after polls showed his party falling short of the threshold for entering parliament.
paras.zh: 以色列前陆军参谋长兼国防部长本尼·甘茨退出以色列竞选，因为民调显示他的政党未能达到进入议会的门槛。

paras.en: The leader of the Blue and White (Kahol Lavan) party announced on Monday he will not run in the October 27 polls, saying he will “continue to work for unity”.
paras.zh: 蓝白党领袖卡霍尔·拉万 (Kahol Lavan) 周一宣布，他不会参加 10 月 27 日的选举，并表示他将“继续为团结而努力”。

paras.en: The 67-year-old is expected to hold a news conference later on Monday.
paras.zh: 这位 67 岁的老人预计将于周一晚些时候召开新闻发布会。

paras.en: Opinion polls in the lead-up to next week’s vote had consistently shown Gantz’s party hovering below the 3.25 percent threshold needed to enter the 120-seat Knesset, or Israel’s parliament.
paras.zh: 下周投票前的民意调查一直显示甘茨所在的政党徘徊在进入拥有 120 个席位的以色列议会所需的 3.25% 门槛以下。

paras.en: A former main opposition leader, Gantz sat in a national unity government with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from 2020 to 2021.
paras.zh: 作为前主要反对派领导人，甘茨在 2020 年至 2021 年期间与总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡一起组成了民族团结政府。

paras.en: He also joined Netanyahu’s war cabinet that was formed to oversee Israel’s genocidal war against Palestinians in the Gaza Strip after the Hamas-led attacks in southern Israel on October 7, 2023. Gantz quit the emergency cabinet in early June 2024, saying Netanyahu “is preventing us from advancing toward true victory”.
paras.zh: 他还加入了内塔尼亚胡战时内阁，该内阁的成立是为了监督以色列在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的以色列南部袭击后对加沙地带巴勒斯坦人进行的种族灭绝战争。甘茨于 2024 年 6 月上旬退出紧急内阁，称内塔尼亚胡“正在阻止我们走向真正的胜利”。

paras.en: Reporting from Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera’s Nour Odeh said Gantz’s election withdrawal announcement “was not really expected”, but added that many would see it as being “in line with how he’s conducted himself” after entering politics in 2018.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台记者努尔·奥德在被占领的约旦河西岸拉马拉报道称，甘茨退出选举的声明“并不是真正预料到的”，但他补充说，许多人会认为这“符合他在 2018 年进入政坛后的行事方式”。

paras.en: “This is a man who entered into unity governments with leaders – especially Netanyahu – that he expressly opposed,” said Odeh.
paras.zh: 奥德说：“这个人与他明确反对的领导人——尤其是内塔尼亚胡——组成了联合政府。”

paras.en: Gantz’s message for unity is narrow, Odeh added, as it referred to “a unity government of Zionist parties, so no Palestinian Israeli parties, no non-Zionist parties in the government, even if that means bringing in Netanyahu again”.
paras.zh: 奥德补充说，甘茨关于团结的信息是狭隘的，因为它提到“犹太复国主义政党的联合政府，因此政府中没有巴勒斯坦以色列政党，没有非犹太复国主义政党，即使这意味着再次引入内塔尼亚胡”。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s Likud party and the far-right coalition it leads is locked in a tight race with a self-styled Zionist opposition alliance heading into the election, according to recent polling, although neither side appears on track to win a parliamentary majority.
paras.zh: 根据最近的民意调查，内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团及其领导的极右翼联盟在选举中与自封的犹太复国主义反对派联盟陷入了激烈的竞争，尽管双方似乎都没有赢得议会多数席位。

paras.en: Two Arab-led electoral lists representing the Palestinian citizens of Israel, who make up about 20 percent of the population, are projected to win 13 seats and could be critical to any post-election coalition – but both main blocs have ruled out forming a government with them.
paras.zh: 代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民（约占以色列人口 20%）的两份由阿拉伯人主导的选举名单预计将赢得 13 个席位，对任何选举后的联盟都可能至关重要 — — 但两个主要集团都排除了与他们组建政府的可能性。

paras.en: Opposition leaders, including Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot, who is seen as a potential prime minister candidate, welcomed Gantz’s decision as “correct” and “responsible”.
paras.zh: 反对派领导人，包括被视为潜在总理候选人的亚沙尔党领导人加迪·艾森科特，对甘茨的决定表示欢迎，认为这是“正确的”和“负责任的”。

paras.en: Alon Pinkas, a former Israeli ambassador and consul general in New York, told Al Jazeera Gantz’s exit from the race does not change the playing field as he was not going to have a major impact on the election.
paras.zh: 前以色列大使兼驻纽约总领事阿隆·平卡斯 (Alon Pinkas) 告诉半岛电视台，甘茨退出竞选不会改变竞争环境，因为他不会对选举产生重大影响。

paras.en: “Electorally, his departure from the political system is completely irrelevant and inconsequential,” he said. “In terms of the politics, it is also inconsequential,” adding that Gantz had lost “a lot of his aura” when he “overstayed his welcome in the Netanyahu government”.
paras.zh: “从选举角度来看，他脱离政治体系是完全无关紧要的，”他说。 “就政治而言，这也是无关紧要的”，并补充说，当甘茨“在内塔尼亚胡政府中呆得太久”时，他已经失去了“很多光环”。

articles.title: Netanyahu’s new security doctrine: Regional strategy or election ploy?

paras.en: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has unveiled an updated national security doctrine and displayed a map of rival regional alignments, signalling a security approach that prioritises preemptive military action, the expansion of buffer zones, and the pursuit of new regional partnerships.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡公布了更新的国家安全学说，并展示了敌对区域联盟地图，表明其安全方针优先考虑先发制人的军事行动、扩大缓冲区和寻求新的区域伙伴关系。

paras.en: The document was developed with the assistance of Israel’s National Security Council and published by the Prime Minister’s Office on Sunday, just nine days before Israel’s parliamentary elections that could spell the end of Netanyahu’s time in office. It outlines a formal policy of preventing perceived threats through military action rather than containment – a policy that has already been seen in action over the past few years, as Israel pursues multiple wars and attacks on its neighbours.
paras.zh: 该文件是在以色列国家安全委员会的协助下制定的，并于周日由总理办公室发布，距离以色列议会选举仅九天，这可能意味着内塔尼亚胡任期的结束。它概述了一项通过军事行动而不是遏制来防止感知到的威胁的正式政策 — — 随着以色列对邻国发动多场战争和袭击，这一政策在过去几年中已经在实施。

paras.en: The timing of the map’s release carries particular political significance, with Netanyahu fighting to retain power amid criticism of his conduct in power, the ongoing corruption trial he faces and his handling of the October 7, 2023, attacks, as well as the wars that followed.
paras.zh: 该地图的发布时机具有特殊的政治意义，因为内塔尼亚胡在其执政行为、他面临的持续腐败审判以及他对 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击以及随后的战争的处理受到批评的情况下，正在努力保住权力。

paras.en: As the October 27 election day draws closer, Netanyahu is attempting to bolster his credentials as Israel’s ‘Mr Security’, hoping to get the votes of Israelis who may not like some of his other policies or behaviour, but still view him as the most likely leader to defend the country.
paras.zh: 随着10月27日选举日的临近，内塔尼亚胡正试图增强他作为以色列“安全先生”的信誉，希望获得以色列人的选票，这些人可能不喜欢他的其他一些政策或行为，但仍然认为他是最有可能保卫国家的领导人。

paras.en: Netanyahu, who did get the endorsement of US President Donald Trump on Sunday, said during the briefing that Israel could face the possibility of a far less supportive administration in Washington in two years, after the end of the Trump presidency.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡周日确实得到了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的支持，他在新闻发布会上表示，在特朗普总统任期结束后的两年内，以色列可能面临华盛顿政府支持性大大减弱的可能性。

paras.en: “In two years, a president… who is extremely hostile to Israel could come to power [in the United States],” Netanyahu warned.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡警告说：“两年后，一位对以色列极度敌视的总统可能会（在美国）上台。”

paras.en: He therefore argued that Israel must “expand our network of alliances and develop capabilities that make us a valuable asset” to other countries as a way of protecting itself if US policy towards it changed.
paras.zh: 因此，他认为，如果美国对以色列的政策发生变化，以色列必须“扩大我们的联盟网络并发展使我们成为其他国家宝贵资产的能力”，以此作为保护自己的一种方式。

paras.en: The comments, according to analysts, suggest that Netanyahu is seeking to portray his leadership as essential to navigating both Israel’s regional military challenges and its diplomatic isolation, all while keeping a fearful electorate reassured.
paras.zh: 分析人士称，这些言论表明，内塔尼亚胡试图将他的领导力描绘成应对以色列的地区军事挑战和外交孤立的关键，同时让恐惧的选民放心。

paras.en: Mohanad Hage Ali, deputy director for research at the Malcolm H Kerr Carnegie Middle East Center, explained that the strategic presentation centred on competing regional blocs and buffer zones.
paras.zh: 马尔科姆·H·科尔·卡内基中东中心研究副主任莫哈纳德·哈格·阿里解释说，战略演示的重点是竞争性的区域集团和缓冲区。

paras.en: That framework “incubates and nurtures existential fears, which would lead Israeli voters to feel the need for a decisive leader”, Hage Ali noted.
paras.zh: 哈格·阿里指出，这一框架“孕育和培育了存在主义恐惧，这将导致以色列选民感到需要一位果断的领导人”。

paras.en: In his assessment, Netanyahu stands to benefit from the Israeli public’s fear of regional threats by presenting himself as a familiar leader capable of managing them, making him “the devil you know”, as the analyst put it, to voters reluctant to embrace political change at a sensitive time.
paras.zh: 在他的评估中，内塔尼亚胡将从以色列公众对地区威胁的恐惧中受益，因为他将自己呈现为一位熟悉的、有能力管理地区威胁的领导人，正如分析人士所说，对于不愿在敏感时刻接受政治变革的选民来说，他是“你知道的魔鬼”。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s political opponents have been quick to push back against that narrative.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的政治对手很快就反驳了这种说法。

paras.en: Gadi Eisenkot, one of the prime minister’s main challengers in the upcoming election, said that the published doctrine was “two hollow pages, full of slogans that have nothing to do with a security concept”.
paras.zh: 加迪·艾森科特是即将举行的选举中总理的主要挑战者之一，他表示，公布的学说是“两页空心的纸，充满了与安全概念无关的口号”。

paras.en: Another, former Prime Minister Yair Lapid, described the document as “superficial”.
paras.zh: 另一位前总理亚伊尔·拉皮德 (Yair Lapid) 称该文件“肤浅”。

paras.en: The map displayed during Netanyahu’s briefing was originally published in May by Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung, a German political foundation. It divides the Middle East and parts of Africa into competing blocs, highlighting the region’s complex network of alliances and rivalries.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡通报会期间展示的地图最初由德国政治基金会弗里德里希·艾伯特基金会于 5 月出版。它将中东和非洲部分地区划分为相互竞争的集团，凸显了该地区复杂的联盟和竞争网络。

paras.en: Those networks include states, unrecognised entities and non-state actors.
paras.zh: 这些网络包括国家、未经认可的实体和非国家行为者。

paras.en: The map identifies an Israel-United Arab Emirates alignment, described as the “Hexagon Alliance”, alongside a separate grouping of Egypt, Turkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia – the latter three of which signed the Mecca mutual defence pact in August – labelled the “Sunni Diamond Alliance”. It also depicts Iran and its regional allies as a separate axis.
paras.zh: 该地图确定了以色列和阿拉伯联合酋长国的结盟，被称为“六角联盟”，以及埃及、土耳其、巴基斯坦和沙特阿拉伯的单独组织——后三个国家在八月签署了麦加共同防御协议——被称为“逊尼派钻石联盟”。它还将伊朗及其地区盟友描绘成一个单独的轴心。

paras.en: The map serves to illustrate the issues outlined in the published security doctrine, presenting a region where Israel faces multiple threats, the alliance that Israel is seeking to cultivate across the wider region, and the perceived need for “buffer zones” – the occupation of territory in other countries.
paras.zh: 该地图旨在说明已发布的安全理论中概述的问题，展示了以色列面临多重威胁的地区、以色列寻求在更广泛地区建立的联盟，以及对​​“缓冲区”的必要性——占领其他国家的领土。

paras.en: Israel’s existing illegal occupation of territory in Gaza and southern Lebanon illustrates the potential consequences of expanding the buffer zone approach.
paras.zh: 以色列目前对加沙和黎巴嫩南部领土的非法占领说明了扩大缓冲区做法的潜在后果。

paras.en: Hage Ali warned that continuing to pursue an approach built around expanding military control could lead to “more conflict and more ethnic cleansing” under the guise of security buffers.
paras.zh: 哈格·阿里警告说，继续推行围绕扩大军事控制的做法可能会导致以安全缓冲为幌子的“更多冲突和更多种族清洗”。

paras.en: A striking element of the map displayed by Netanyahu is its explicit designation of non-state actors as friendly entities.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡展示的地图的一个引人注目的元素是其明确将非国家行为体指定为友好实体。

paras.en: The map highlights territories controlled by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces in Sudan and Khalifa Haftar’s self-styled Libyan National Army within an alignment deemed cooperative to Israel and the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 该地图突出显示了苏丹准军事快速支援部队和哈利法·哈夫塔尔自封的利比亚国民军控制的领土，其联盟被认为与以色列和阿拉伯联合酋长国合作。

paras.en: Israel views these actors as pragmatic partners or at least cooperative entities in a broader strategic grid, Hage Ali explained. However, the public association of these groups with Israel threatens to damage their domestic standing across the Arab world.
paras.zh: 哈格·阿里解释说，以色列将这些参与者视为务实的合作伙伴，或者至少是更广泛的战略网格中的合作实体。然而，这些团体与以色列的公开联系可能会损害他们在阿拉伯世界的国内地位。

paras.en: That reflects Netanyahu’s immediate priorities, where “what Israelis think matters more than the reputation of your allies and the viability of these alliances”, Hage Ali added.
paras.zh: 哈格·阿里补充说，这反映了内塔尼亚胡的当务之急，“以色列人的想法比盟友的声誉和这些联盟的生存能力更重要”。

paras.en: The portrayal of the Middle East as a region divided into competing alliances also carries risks for Netanyahu’s broader diplomatic ambitions.
paras.zh: 将中东描绘成一个分裂为相互竞争的联盟的地区也给内塔尼亚胡更广泛的外交野心带来了风险。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Netanyahu proposed a “hexagon of alliances”, envisaging cooperation between Israel, India, Greece, Cyprus and unnamed Arab, African and Asian partners, against what he described as “radical” regional alliances.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，内塔尼亚胡提出了“六边形联盟”，设想以色列、印度、希腊、塞浦路斯以及未透露姓名的阿拉伯、非洲和亚洲伙伴之间进行合作，反对他所说的“激进”区域联盟。

paras.en: The proposed grouping has not been established as a formal alliance, and commentators in Israel and the international press have described the project as a branding exercise rather than a binding military pact, noting that countries like India prioritise non-alignment and pragmatic trade over ideologically rigid blocs.
paras.zh: 拟议的组织尚未建立为正式联盟，以色列和国际媒体的评论员将该项目描述为一次品牌宣传活动，而不是具有约束力的军事条约，并指出印度等国家优先考虑不结盟和务实贸易，而不是意识形态僵化的集团。

paras.en: For Tehran and its regional partners, the map also offers potent political leverage.
paras.zh: 对于德黑兰及其区域合作伙伴来说，该地图还提供了强大的政治影响力。

paras.en: Hage Ali emphasised that the visual layout “will certainly help their propaganda machine”, providing Hezbollah and other Iranian allies with evidence to reinforce the narrative that Israel seeks to expand and dominate the region.
paras.zh: 哈格·阿里强调，视觉布局“肯定会帮助他们的宣传机器”，为真主党和其他伊朗盟友提供证据，以强化以色列寻求扩张和主宰该地区的叙述。

articles.title: Ex-OpenAI employee accused of planting device has Saudi backing: Prosecutor

paras.en: An ex-OpenAI engineer accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company appears to have received considerable support from the Saudi government, United States prosecutors have said in a court filing.
paras.zh: 美国检察官在一份法庭文件中表示，一名前 OpenAI 工程师被指控在该人工智能公司的高管会议室安装录音设备，该工程师似乎得到了沙特政府的大力支持。

paras.en: Federal prosecutors allege that the defendant, Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, was in frequent communication with an unnamed member of the Saudi royal family and that a Saudi military official paid for a one-way plane ticket for Alfozan’s wife and young son to return to Saudi Arabia after his arrest, according to the court document, made public late on Sunday.
paras.zh: 根据周日晚间公布的法庭文件，联邦检察官称，35 岁的被告阿卜杜拉赫曼·阿尔福赞 (Abdulrahman Alfozan) 与一名未透露姓名的沙特王室成员经常联系，一名沙特军官为阿尔福赞的妻子和年幼的儿子在被捕后支付了一张返回沙特阿拉伯的单程机票。

paras.en: Prosecutors made those allegations as they asked a federal judge to keep Alfozan in US custody to await trial, arguing he is a flight risk. Alfozan, a Saudi national and lawful permanent resident in the US, is scheduled to appear in federal court in San Francisco later on Monday.
paras.zh: 检察官在要求联邦法官将阿尔福赞拘留在美国等待审判时提出了这些指控，称他有潜逃风险。阿尔福赞是沙特国民，也是美国的合法永久居民，定于周一晚些时候在旧金山联邦法院出庭。

paras.en: The case has highlighted security challenges around sensitive AI research as companies and governments compete fiercely for an edge in the transformational technology.
paras.zh: 该案件突显了敏感人工智能研究面临的安全挑战，因为公司和政府正在激烈竞争变革性技术的优势。

paras.en: “The defendant went to significant lengths to create customized, encrypted recording devices to secretly record highly sensitive meetings involving senior OpenAI personnel and executives, high-level business counterparts, and government officials, all while communicating with individuals of significance in Saudi Arabia and pursuing opportunities in — and making plans to travel to — Saudi Arabia,” prosecutors wrote in a detention memo.
paras.zh: 检察官在一份拘留备忘录中写道：“被告不遗余力地制作定制的加密录音设备，秘密记录涉及 OpenAI 高级人员和高管、高层商业同行和政府官员的高度敏感会议，同时与沙特阿拉伯的重要人物进行沟通，寻求在沙特阿拉伯的机会并制定前往沙特阿拉伯的计划。”

paras.en: The Saudi government media office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A lawyer for Alfozan did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 沙特政府媒体办公室没有立即回应置评请求。阿福赞的律师没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: The lawyer, William Pernik, previously asked for Alfozan to be released from custody, subject to conditions including location monitoring and surrendering his passport, and said Alfozan had spent the last 15 years in the US and had applied to become a citizen.
paras.zh: 律师威廉·佩尔尼克(William Pernik)此前曾要求释放阿尔福赞，但条件包括位置监控和交出护照，并表示阿尔福赞过去15年一直在美国度过，并已申请成为美国公民。

paras.en: The lawyer said a planned trip by Alfozan to Saudi Arabia this month was booked before he was under investigation and was for “family and immigration reasons”, according to a court filing.
paras.zh: 根据一份法庭文件，该律师表示，阿尔福赞本月计划前往沙特阿拉伯的旅行是在接受调查之前预订的，是出于“家庭和移民原因”。

paras.en: US prosecutors charged Alfozan last week with using an electronic device to intercept oral communications. Alfozan plugged a recording device into the back of a television in an executive conference room at one of OpenAI’s San Francisco buildings, according to a criminal complaint.
paras.zh: 美国检察官上周指控阿尔福赞使用电子设备拦截口头通信。根据一份刑事起诉书，阿尔福赞将录音设备插入 OpenAI 位于旧金山的一栋大楼的行政会议室的电视机背面。

paras.en: Meetings involving government officials took place in the conference room around the time the device was installed, according to the prosecutors’ detention memo.
paras.zh: 根据检察官的拘留备忘录，在该设备安装前后，涉及政府官员的会议在会议室举行。

paras.en: Prosecutors said the investigation remains active and additional charges could be brought against Alfozan.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，调查仍在进行中，可能会对阿尔福赞提出更多指控。

paras.en: A member of the Saudi royal family sought to recruit Alfozan for an AI-focused role in Saudi Arabia, writing in one message, “Saudi needs you more then [sic] the US!” Alfozan replied, “100,” according to messages cited by prosecutors.
paras.zh: 沙特王室的一名成员试图招募阿尔福赞在沙特阿拉伯担任以人工智能为重点的职位，他在一条消息中写道：“沙特比[原文如此]美国更需要你！”根据检察官引用的信息，阿尔福赞回答说：“100”。

paras.en: Before his arrest, Alfozan was scheduled to fly to Riyadh during a planned two-month parental leave. His wife told investigators that she and their son planned to move permanently to Saudi Arabia and that Alfozan eventually intended to join them, according to prosecutors.
paras.zh: 在被捕之前，阿尔福赞原计划在两个月的育儿假期间飞往利雅得。据检察官称，他的妻子告诉调查人员，她和儿子计划永久移居沙特阿拉伯，而阿尔福赞最终打算加入他们的行列。

paras.en: In an Arabic-language interview on the Identity Capital podcast last month, Alfozan said that he visits Saudi Arabia three or four times a year, follows developments there and advises or mentors Saudi startups.
paras.zh: 阿尔福赞上个月在 Identity Capital 播客上接受阿拉伯语采访时表示，他每年访问沙特阿拉伯三到四次，跟踪那里的发展情况，并为沙特初创企业提供建议或指导。

paras.en: He said meeting Prince Mohammed bin Salman, then deputy crown prince, during a 2016 gathering with young Saudi tech workers in Silicon Valley persuaded him to learn at a top tech company before bringing those skills back home.
paras.zh: 他说，2016 年在硅谷与年轻的沙特科技工人聚会时，他遇到了时任副王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼亲王，说服他在将这些技能带回国内之前先在一家顶级科技公司学习。

paras.en: While Alfozan was working at Facebook, he and other Saudis in Silicon Valley formed a consulting initiative that linked Saudi public- and private-sector organisations with expertise in big data, the internet of things and machine learning.
paras.zh: 当阿尔福赞在 Facebook 工作时，他和硅谷的其他沙特人发起了一项咨询计划，将沙特公共和私营部门组织与大数据、物联网和机器学习方面的专业知识联系起来。

paras.en: OpenAI previously said it discovered the device on September 30 and referred the matter to the FBI.
paras.zh: OpenAI 此前表示，它于 9 月 30 日发现了该设备，并将此事提交给 FBI。

paras.en: Al Jazeera has reached out to the Saudi embassy for comment.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台已联系沙特大使馆征求评论。

articles.title: Ukraine and Russia exchange strikes, as relations between Trump and Zelenskyy sour
articles.author: Charles Maynes

paras.en: Ukraine and Russia exchange strikes, as relations between Trump and Zelenskyy sour
paras.zh: 特朗普和泽连斯基关系恶化，乌克兰和俄罗斯相互攻击

paras.en: Ukraine carried out a massive drone strikes on Russia, which launched deadly attacks on its smaller neighbor over the weekend.
paras.zh: 乌克兰对俄罗斯进行了大规模无人机袭击，俄罗斯在周末对其较小的邻国发动了致命袭击。

paras.en: At least one person is dead and more than a dozen injured from a major Ukrainian drone strike on Russia's former imperial capital, St. Petersburg.
paras.zh: 乌克兰无人机对俄罗斯前帝国首都圣彼得堡发动大规模袭击，造成至少一人死亡、十几人受伤。

paras.en: The attack happened on a weekend that also saw Russian missile strikes against Ukraine kill at least 11 people. The continued fighting is happening as President Trump argues the best way to end the war is to relieve pressure on Russia. In a moment, we'll speak with a lawmaker who disagrees, Democratic representative Don Beyer. We begin with the news.
paras.zh: 这次袭击发生在周末，俄罗斯也对乌克兰发动导弹袭击，造成至少 11 人死亡。特朗普总统认为结束战争的最佳方式是减轻对俄罗斯的压力，战斗仍在继续。稍后，我们将与一位持不同意见的议员、民主党众议员唐·拜尔 (Don Beyer) 交谈。我们从新闻开始。

paras.en: MARTIN: Joining us is NPR's Charles Maynes in Moscow. Charles, good morning.
paras.zh: 马丁：美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 驻莫斯科的查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes) 也加入了我们的行列。查尔斯，早上好。

paras.en: CHARLES MAYNES, BYLINE: Morning, Michel.
paras.zh: 查尔斯·梅恩连线：早上好，米歇尔。

paras.en: MARTIN: Could you start with these attacks in St. Petersburg? What can you tell us?
paras.zh: 马丁：你能从圣彼得堡的这些袭击事件开始吗？你能告诉我们什么？

paras.en: MAYNES: According to Russia's regional governor, Ukrainian drones struck a range of strategic targets in and around St. Petersburg, including energy infrastructure. A key port oil terminal was hit. So was a refinery, causing large fires and massive plumes of black smoke along the skyline. It appears this was the largest attack on St. Petersburg since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in 2022. Exactly how many drones struck the city, we don't know, but Russia's defense ministry said it intercepted 1,000 drones over various regions of Russia that night.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：据俄罗斯州长称，乌克兰无人机袭击了圣彼得堡及其周边地区的一系列战略目标，包括能源基础设施。一个重要的港口石油码头遭到袭击。一家炼油厂也是如此，引发大火，天际线上冒出大量黑烟。这似乎是自2022年俄罗斯发动全面入侵以来对圣彼得堡最大规模的袭击。具体有多少架无人机袭击了这座城市，我们不得而知，但俄罗斯国防部表示，当晚在俄罗斯各地拦截了1000架无人机。

paras.en: MARTIN: How big of a deal are the strikes on oil facilities, given that President Trump has been demanding that Ukraine stop hitting those sites?
paras.zh: 马丁：考虑到特朗普总统一直要求乌克兰停止袭击石油设施，袭击这些设施有多大？

paras.en: MAYNES: Well, Trump, you know, seems to be trying to protect Russian oil facilities, following a deal he cut with President Vladimir Putin to import Russian diesel, a move Trump hopes will bring down the price of gas for U.S. voters ahead of midterm elections. So in that sense, the news of Ukraine striking energy facilities in St. Petersburg Sunday is unlikely to please Trump, who's already called previous strikes, including one against Moscow last week, a disgrace, even as Russia has continued its own strikes on Ukraine. But it's part of a recent pattern we've seen from Trump, lashing out at Ukraine and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in particular.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：特朗普，你知道，在与总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成进口俄罗斯柴油的协议后，特朗普似乎试图保护俄罗斯的石油设施，特朗普希望此举将在中期选举前降低美国选民的天然气价格。因此，从这个意义上说，乌克兰周日袭击圣彼得堡能源设施的消息不太可能让特朗普满意，他已经称之前的袭击，包括上周针对莫斯科的袭击，是一种耻辱，尽管俄罗斯仍在继续对乌克兰进行袭击。但这是我们从特朗普身上看到的最近模式的一部分，他猛烈抨击乌克兰，特别是总统泽连斯基。

paras.en: MARTIN: Talk more about that tension between Trump and Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 马丁：更多地谈谈特朗普和泽连斯基之间的紧张关系。

paras.en: MAYNES: Well, Trump accuses Zelenskyy of carrying out these attacks to drive fuel prices up in the U.S., although economists will say that the rise in prices is mostly a result of Trump's war in Iran. Trump has since called for new leadership in Ukraine, saying Zelenskyy, not Russian president Vladimir Putin - who launched this war, after all - is the real obstacle to peace. And so to Ukrainians and their supporters, it feels - and not for the first time - that Trump is aligning the U.S. with Moscow against Kyiv.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：特朗普指责泽伦斯基发动这些袭击是为了推高美国的燃油价格，尽管经济学家会说油价上涨主要是特朗普在伊朗发动战争的结果。此后，特朗普呼吁乌克兰建立新的领导层，称泽连斯基，而不是俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京——毕竟是发动这场战争的——才是和平的真正障碍。因此，对于乌克兰人和他们的支持者来说，特朗普正在与莫斯科结盟对抗基辅，这已经不是第一次了。

paras.en: MARTIN: What has Zelenskyy been saying about this?
paras.zh: 马丁：泽连斯基对此有何评论？

paras.en: MAYNES: He's tried to tread lightly, but he was asked directly what the U.S. supporting Russia would mean for Ukraine's future. Here's this response on NBC's "Meet The Press With Kristen Welker."
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：他试图谨慎行事，但有人直接问他美国支持俄罗斯对乌克兰的未来意味着什么。以下是 NBC 在“与克里斯汀·韦尔克会见媒体”节目中的回应。

paras.en: (SOUNDBITE OF TV SHOW, "MEET THE PRESS WITH KRISTEN WELKER")
paras.zh: （电视节目原声片段，“与克里斯汀·韦尔克一起与媒体见面”）

paras.en: PRESIDENT VOLODYMYR ZELENSKYY: But if United States will support Putin, I mean, it's unbelievable. It's tragedy. It's historic mistake and big tragedy.
paras.zh: 总统沃洛德米尔·泽连斯基：但如果美国支持普京，我的意思是，这是令人难以置信的。这是悲剧。这是历史性错误，也是大悲剧。

paras.en: MARTIN: So, Charles, what's your sense of what happens next?
paras.zh: 马丁：那么，查尔斯，你对接下来发生的事情有何看法？

paras.en: MAYNES: Well, I think it depends on how much more political capital Trump is willing to bet on better ties with Russia. On Friday, he exempted Russia from a congressionally approved sanctions package. This legislation Trump himself signed into law to honor his late friend, the Senator Lindsey Graham, that would have placed steep tariffs on Russian energy sales and increased sanctions on senior Kremlin officials, including President Putin. Trump has justified the waiver, saying the legislation wasn't in the national interest right now and later argued that more sanctions would only drive Russia away from a peace deal. But the decision just crystalized how Trump's claims - you know, he's a mediator in this conflict - are growing untenable. We heard Zelenskyy call this dealmaking with Putin a historic mistake. Well, the Kremlin's White House envoy, Kirill Dmitriev - he called it truly historic.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯：嗯，我认为这取决于特朗普愿意在与俄罗斯建立更好的关系上投入多少政治资本。周五，他将俄罗斯排除在国会批准的制裁方案之外。特朗普亲自签署这项立法，以纪念他已故的朋友、参议员林赛·格雷厄姆，该法案将对俄罗斯能源销售征收高额关税，并加大对包括普京总统在内的克里姆林宫高级官员的制裁。特朗普为豁免辩护，称该立法目前不符合国家利益，后来又辩称，更多制裁只会迫使俄罗斯放弃和平协议。但这一决定恰恰体现了特朗普的主张——你知道，他是这场冲突的调解人——是如何变得站不住脚的。我们听到泽伦斯基称与普京的这次交易是一个历史性错误。克里姆林宫的白宫特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫（Kirill Dmitriev）称其为真正的历史性事件。

paras.en: MARTIN: That is NPR's Charles Maynes in Moscow. Charles, thank you.
paras.zh: 马丁：这是 NPR 驻莫斯科的查尔斯·梅恩斯。查尔斯，谢谢你。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of NPR transcripts may vary. Transcript text may be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio on npr.org may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 文字记录的准确性和可用性可能有所不同。转录文本可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。 npr.org 上的音频可能会在其原始广播或发布后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
paras.zh: 2026 年中期选举可能是有记录以来最昂贵的一次。并且，马克龙谴责抗议活动

paras.en: The 2026 midterm elections are set to become the most expensive on record. More than $15 billion has been raised to influence the outcome and control of Congress.
paras.zh: 2026 年中期选举将成为有记录以来最昂贵的一次。已筹集超过 150 亿美元来影响国会的结果和控制权。

paras.en: - 🎧 Democratic nominees in House and Senate races are raking in incredible amounts of donations, even though the Democratic Party remains unpopular, NPR's Stephen Fowler says. Republicans are also unpopular, largely due to issues like the war in Iran, gas prices and the economy. A few megadonors, such as Elon Musk, are donating money to super PACs to try to push voters to elect Republicans. In the 13 competitive races highlighted in the Cook Political Report, Republicans are being outraised by a 5-to-1 margin. Both parties are spending heavily, indicating that Democrats might have a chance to win in several locations. Currently, 75% of planned ad buys are in toss-up races or those leaning Republican.
paras.zh: - NPR 的史蒂芬·福勒 (Stephen Fowler) 表示，尽管民主党仍然不受欢迎，但众议院和参议院竞选中的民主党提名人却获得了令人难以置信的巨额捐款。共和党人也不受欢迎，这主要是由于伊朗战争、天然气价格和经济等问题。埃隆·马斯克等一些巨额捐助者正在向超级政治行动委员会捐款，试图推动选民选举共和党人。在库克政治报告中重点介绍的 13 场竞争性竞选中，共和党以 5 比 1 的优势获胜。两党都投入巨资，这表明民主党可能有机会在多个地点获胜。目前，75% 的广告购买计划是在两败俱伤的竞选中或倾向共和党的竞选中进行的。

paras.en: - ➡️ Some of the most competitive congressional races might not be called until days after Election Day. Here's why.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 一些竞争最激烈的国会竞选可能要到选举日几天后才会揭晓。原因如下。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: At least one person died and more than a dozen were injured in a major Ukrainian drone strike yesterday on Saint Petersburg, Russia's former imperial capital. The attack targeted strategic sites, including a key port oil terminal. Over the weekend, Russian missile strikes in Ukraine killed at least 11 people. This conflict continues as President Trump says that relieving pressure on Russia is the best way to end the war.
paras.zh: 昨天，乌克兰无人机对俄罗斯前帝国首都圣彼得堡发动大规模袭击，造成至少一人死亡、十几人受伤。这次袭击的目标是战略地点，包括一个重要的港口石油码头。周末，俄罗斯导弹袭击乌克兰，造成至少 11 人死亡。特朗普总统表示，减轻对俄罗斯的压力是结束战争的最佳方式，这场冲突仍在继续。

paras.en: - 🎧 The recent attack on Saint Petersburg appears to mark the largest one on the city since Russia's 2022 invasion, NPR's Charles Maynes tells Up First. While it's unclear how many drones struck the city, Russia's Defense Ministry reported intercepting 1,000 drones across various regions that night. Trump seems to be working to protect Russian oil facilities after cutting a deal with President Vladimir Putin to import Russian diesel. The move was aimed at lowering gas prices for U.S. voters before the midterm elections. Trump has called previous Ukrainian strikes a "disgrace," even as Russia continues to strike Ukraine, Maynes says. He adds that the president blames President Volodymyr Zelenskyy for attacks that allegedly raise U.S. fuel prices, despite economists attributing the price increase mainly to Trump's war in Iran.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes) 告诉 Up First，最近对圣彼得堡的袭击似乎是自俄罗斯 2022 年入侵以来该城市发生的最大规模的袭击。虽然尚不清楚有多少架无人机袭击了这座城市，但俄罗斯国防部报告称，当晚在不同地区拦截了 1,000 架无人机。在与总统普京达成进口俄罗斯柴油的协议后，特朗普似乎正在努力保护俄罗斯石油设施。此举旨在在中期选举前降低美国选民的汽油价格。梅恩斯说，特朗普称之前的乌克兰袭击是“耻辱”，尽管俄罗斯仍在继续袭击乌克兰。他补充说，总统指责弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基总统发动了据称抬高美国燃油价格的袭击事件，尽管经济学家将油价上涨主要归因于特朗普在伊朗的战争。

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron denounced violence over the weekend that he says has overshadowed largely peaceful protests across the country. The unrest began as a student protest for better conditions and has expanded to include public-sector workers protesting high energy prices, the rising cost of living and social inequality. The Interior Ministry reported about 2,300 arrests and nearly 1,000 injured police officers.
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙(Emmanuel Macron)谴责了周末的暴力事件，他说暴力事件给全国各地的和平抗议活动蒙上了阴影。骚乱始于学生要求改善条件的抗议活动，后来扩大到公共部门工作人员抗议高能源价格、生活成本上升和社会不平等。内政部报告称，约有 2,300 名警察被捕，近 1,000 名警察受伤。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Eleanor Beardsley, who was in the streets of Paris yesterday, witnessed burned bikes, shattered glass and graffiti on looted stores saying things like "tax the rich." She spoke with 23-year-old Sarah Berlia, who says she believes these actions come from a frustrated generation facing dwindling rights and opportunities. Beardsley says the protest culture in France often attracts "troublemakers," but the scale of current events is massive. The protests have had political implications, as France is six months away from a presidential election. Far-left candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon has joined the protesters, while far-right leader Marine Le Pen, who is leading in the polls, has condemned the violence and the government.
paras.zh: - 🎧 美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley) 昨天在巴黎街头目睹了自行车被烧毁、玻璃破碎，商店被抢劫的涂鸦，上面写着“向富人征税”之类的字样。她与 23 岁的莎拉·伯利亚 (Sarah Berlia) 进行了交谈，后者表示，她相信这些行为来自面临权利和机会日益减少的沮丧一代。比尔兹利表示，法国的抗议文化经常吸引“麻烦制造者”，但当前事件的规模却很大。抗议活动产生了政治影响，因为法国距离总统选举还有六个月。极左翼候选人让-吕克·梅朗雄也加入了抗议者行列，而民意调查中领先的极右翼领导人马琳·勒庞则谴责了暴力事件和政府。

paras.en: Living Better is a special series about what it takes to stay healthy in America.
paras.zh: 《生活得更好》是一个关于如何在美国保持健康的特别系列。

paras.en: Saunas are gaining renewed attention in the wellness world for their potential to improve mental health. This trend reflects the growing interest in the broader wellness movement and social connection, especially post-pandemic. While scientists understand how saunas affect the cardiovascular system, they are just beginning to explore their impact on mental health. Here's what they know so far.
paras.zh: 桑拿因其改善心理健康的潜力而在健康界重新受到关注。这一趋势反映了人们对更广泛的健康运动和社会联系日益增长的兴趣，尤其是在大流行之后。虽然科学家了解桑拿如何影响心血管系统，但他们才刚刚开始探索桑拿对心理健康的影响。这是他们到目前为止所知道的。

paras.en: - 🥵 When our skin detects heat, it sends signals to a primitive brain area that prompts our body to cool down. This pathway also influences mood and pleasure, which is associated with depression.
paras.zh: - 🥵 当我们的皮肤检测到热量时，它会向原始大脑区域发送信号，促使我们的身体降温。该通路还会影响与抑郁症相关的情绪和愉悦感。

paras.en: - 🥵 Heat triggers an anti-inflammatory response similar to the effects of exercise, which is known to help with depression and other mental health issues.
paras.zh: - 🥵 热量会引发类似于运动效果的抗炎反应，众所周知，这有助于缓解抑郁症和其他心理健康问题。

paras.en: - 🥵 Heating people up can act like a "thermoregulatory workout," helping their bodies cool down more efficiently over time.
paras.zh: - 🥵 给人们加热可以起到“体温调节锻炼”的作用，帮助他们的身体随着时间的推移更有效地降温。

paras.en: - Noah Adams, a writer and broadcaster who hosted All Things Considered for 18 years, has died. He was 84 years old.
paras.zh: - 诺亚·亚当斯 (Noah Adams) 去世，他是一位作家兼广播员，主持《All Things Thought》长达 18 年。他已经84岁了。

paras.en: - Trump announced over the weekend that he plans to close and renovate the East Potomac Golf Links course in Washington, D.C. The golf course is already at the center of a legal battle.
paras.zh: - 特朗普周末宣布，他计划关闭并翻新华盛顿特区的东波托马克高尔夫球场。该高尔夫球场已经成为一场法律诉讼的焦点。

paras.en: - An Air Force service member died Saturday after a rappelling accident during a pregame ceremony at the Alamodome ahead of the University of Texas at San Antonio's football game against Navy. (via Texas Public Radio)
paras.zh: - 周六，德克萨斯大学圣安东尼奥分校与海军队进行橄榄球比赛之前，在阿拉莫圆顶举行的赛前仪式上，一名空军军人因绳降事故身亡。 （来自德克萨斯州公共广播电台）

articles.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理表示议员被车严重受伤“并非意外”

paras.en: MELBOURNE, Australia — A car hit an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The driver was arrested.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚墨尔本——澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 表示，周一，一辆汽车撞上了一名澳大利亚联邦独立议员，导致她重伤，这显然是一次蓄意袭击。司机被捕。

paras.en: Helen Haines, 65, was struck by a Toyota Land Cruiser SUV outside her electoral district office mid afternoon in the city of Wangaratta in Victoria state, a police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，下午三点左右，65 岁的海伦·海恩斯 (Helen Haines) 在维多利亚州旺加拉塔市的选区办公室外被一辆丰田陆地巡洋舰 SUV 撞倒。

paras.en: Albanese said the national counterterrorism team, incorporating police and intelligence agencies, was investigating.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯表示，由警察和情报机构组成的国家反恐小组正在进行调查。

paras.en: "This wasn't an accident. There was a deliberate act, it would appear. We don't know what the motivation is," Albanese told Australian Broadcasting Corp.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯告诉澳大利亚广播公司：“这不是意外。这似乎是一次故意行为。我们不知道动机是什么。”

paras.en: The 43-year-old driver was arrested at the scene by a passerby. He will be interviewed in relation to the incident, police said.
paras.zh: 43岁的司机在现场被路人逮捕。警方表示，他将就该事件接受采访。

paras.en: "A knife was located by police and seized from inside the Toyota," police said.
paras.zh: 警方表示：“警方在丰田车内找到了一把刀，并缴获了一把刀。”

paras.en: "At this stage, police are investigating as to whether this was an intentional act," police added.
paras.zh: 警方补充说：“现阶段，警方正在调查这是否是故意行为。”

paras.en: Haines, who was first elected to the Parliament in 2019, was taken to a hospital with critical injuries, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，2019 年首次当选议员的海恩斯因伤势严重被送往医院。

paras.en: The episode has renewed safety concerns for Australian lawmakers, in a country where politicians have historically been highly accessible to the public and usually go about their business without security officers present. But public incitement against officials is growing.
paras.zh: 这一事件再次引发了澳大利亚立法者的安全担忧，在这个国家，政客历来很容易与公众接触，而且通常在没有安全官员在场的情况下开展工作。但针对官员的公开煽动正在增加。

paras.en: Australian Federal Police Commissioner Krissy Barrett said in 2025 that threats against parliamentarians had doubled over the past three years. Police data showed more than 1,000 such threats against politicians in the 2025-2026 financial year, Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke said Monday.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚联邦警察局长 Krissy Barrett 在 2025 年表示，针对议员的威胁在过去三年中增加了一倍。内政部长托尼·伯克周一表示，警方数据显示，2025-2026 财年针对政客的此类威胁超过 1000 起。

paras.en: Albanese told the ABC it was "unfortunate" that an increasingly polarized political climate had already led to security changes for Australia's lawmakers.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯告诉澳大利亚广播公司，日益两极分化的政治气候已经导致澳大利亚立法者的安全变化，这是“不幸的”。

paras.en: "I think there has been a rise in temperature and there has been too much shouting, not enough discourse, not enough polite conversation and disagreement," he said Monday. There was "no question" that social media played a part, Albanese added.
paras.zh: 他周一表示：“我认为气氛有所上升，并且有太多的叫喊、没有足够的讨论、没有足够的礼貌对话和分歧。”阿尔巴尼斯补充说，“毫无疑问”社交媒体发挥了作用。

paras.en: In Britain, murders of politicians have prompted bolstered security. Labour lawmaker Jo Cox was shot and stabbed in 2016 by a far-right extremist, and Conservative David Amess was stabbed in 2021 by an attacker inspired by the Islamic State group.
paras.zh: 在英国，政客被谋杀促使安全措施得到加强。工党议员乔·考克斯 (Jo Cox) 于 2016 年被一名极右翼极端分子开枪刺伤，保守党议员戴维·艾姆斯 (David Amess) 于 2021 年被一名受伊斯兰国组织启发的袭击者刺伤。

paras.en: In July, the former politician and reality TV contestant Ann Widdecombe was found slain with a hammer at her home. A man has been charged with murder and terrorism-related offenses.
paras.zh: 7 月，前政治家兼真人秀选手安·维德科姆 (Ann Widdecombe) 在家中被发现被锤子杀害。一名男子被指控犯有谋杀和恐怖主义相关罪行。

articles.title: 'Coming out coach' charges women hundreds for support navigating late in life lesbian transitions

paras.en: After decades of marriage and motherhood, some middle-aged women are spending hundreds of dollars to join online lesbian support groups led by a "coming out coach" to guide them through the process of coming out late in life, according to a New York Times report.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，在经历了几十年的婚姻和母亲身份后，一些中年女性花费数百美元加入由“出柜教练”领导的在线女同性恋支持小组，指导她们完成晚年出柜的过程。

paras.en: Coming out coach Anne-Marie Zanzal charges $400 for a private online membership designed to help "late-blooming" women, some of whom are still married to their longtime husbands, navigate what she calls "sexual identity transitions."
paras.zh: 出柜教练安妮·玛丽·赞扎尔 (Anne-Marie Zanzal) 收取 400 美元的私人在线会员资格，旨在帮助“晚熟”女性（其中一些仍与结婚多年的丈夫）度过她所说的“性身份转变”。

paras.en: "She helped me see that leaving my marriage wasn’t selfish. It was honest. And my kids are better for it," a testimonial from Zanzal’s website reads.
paras.zh: 赞扎尔网站上的一份感言写道：“她让我明白，离开婚姻并不自私。这是诚实的。我的孩子们也因此变得更好。”

paras.en: Zanzal also offers a separate 16-week program called "This Authentic Life," which includes live group coaching, individual coaching and access to her "Authentically Us" online community.
paras.zh: Zanzal 还提供了一个名为“This Authentic Life”的单独的为期 16 周的计划，其中包括现场团体辅导、个人辅导以及访问她的“Authentically Us”在线社区。

paras.en: According to Zanzal’s website, the program helps LGBTQ+ women unpack heavy questions regarding their sexuality alongside others navigating similar experiences.
paras.zh: 根据 Zanzal 的网站，该计划帮助 LGBTQ+ 女性与其他有类似经历的女性一起解决有关她们性取向的重大问题。

paras.en: "It is not too late, and you are not too late. Come as you are, and let us walk this part of the road together," Zanzal’s website reads.
paras.zh: 赞扎尔的网站上写道：“现在还不算太晚，你也不算太晚。来吧，让我们一起走这一段路。”

paras.en: "We were looking for women who came to this the way we did, later in life and carrying a whole history, who would never ask us to explain any of it."
paras.zh: “我们正在寻找像我们一样在后来的生活中走上这一步并拥有完整历史的女性，她们永远不会要求我们解释任何事情。”

paras.en: Zanzal, who holds a master's degree in divinity from Yale Divinity School, began her "coming out coaching" business in 2018. She came out at age 52 after being married to a man for nearly 30 years and raising four children with him.
paras.zh: 拥有耶鲁大学神学院神学硕士学位的赞扎尔于2018年开始了她的“出柜教练”事业。她在与一名男子结婚近30年并抚养了四个孩子后，于52岁时出柜。

paras.en: "I help women come home to themselves — with clarity, self-kindness, and community — so they can live authentically without abandoning the lives and relationships that matter to them," Zanzal writes on her coaching site.
paras.zh: 赞扎尔在她的辅导网站上写道：“我帮助女性回归自我——清晰、友善和社区——这样她们就可以真实地生活，而不会放弃对她们来说重要的生活和人际关系。”

paras.en: "That is why I built this work. Not because I have a degree in it — though I do … But because I lived it, in the dark, for a very long time."
paras.zh: “这就是我创作这件作品的原因。不是因为我拥有这方面的学位——尽管我有……而是因为我在黑暗中生活了很长一段时间。”

paras.en: During the support meetings, women share personal updates with the group and their coming-out coach. One woman, for example, discussed preparing to tell her son that she was a lesbian over a beer, according to a profile of Zanzal's business published in the Times on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 在支持会议期间，女性与团队及其出柜教练分享个人最新动态。例如，根据《泰晤士报》周三发表的赞扎尔公司简介，一名妇女在喝啤酒时讨论准备告诉儿子她是女同性恋。

paras.en: In an interview with the outlet, one of Zanzal’s clients named Shelly said she worried that coming out to her family would upend her "perfectly good" dynamic.
paras.zh: 在接受媒体采访时，赞扎尔的一位名叫雪莉的客户表示，她担心向家人出柜会破坏她“完美”的动态。

paras.en: Shelly said Zanzal helped her understand that any unhappiness her children felt about her sexuality transition was "likely to fade with time and be only a part of their story," whereas, her own pain could be permanent if she continued to conceal her identity.
paras.zh: 雪莉说，赞扎尔帮助她明白，她的孩子们对她的性转变感到的任何不快乐“可能会随着时间的推移而消失，只是他们故事的一部分”，而如果她继续隐瞒自己的身份，她自己的痛苦可能会是永久性的。

paras.en: Podcast host Ben Ferguson told Fox News Digital he found the messages being sent to women through this coaching service "outrageous."
paras.zh: 播客主持人本·弗格森告诉福克斯数字新闻，他发现通过这项辅导服务向女性发送的信息“令人震惊”。

paras.en: "What’s especially outrageous is the suggestion that a mother’s unhappiness is permanent, but her children’s pain will somehow just fade away," Ferguson said in a statement.
paras.zh: 弗格森在一份声明中说：“特别令人愤慨的是，有人认为母亲的不幸是永久性的，但孩子们的痛苦会以某种方式消失。”

paras.en: "Children aren’t disposable characters in their parents’ journey of self-discovery. Marriage involves commitment, and parenting requires sacrifice," he added.
paras.zh: “在父母的自我发现之旅中，孩子并不是可随意使用的角色。婚姻需要承诺，养育孩子需要牺牲，”他补充道。

paras.en: Ferguson argued that the business model — which includes $150 one-hour "clarity calls" with a coming out coach and $77 self-paced courses, including the "Maybe I am Not Straight Course" — is "deeply disturbing" and appears to monetize women’s personal struggles.
paras.zh: 弗格森认为，这种商业模式——其中包括 150 美元一小时的“澄清电话”，由即将出柜的教练提供，以及 77 美元的自定进度课程，其中包括“也许我的课程不正直”——“令人深感不安”，而且似乎是在利用女性的个人挣扎来赚钱。

paras.en: "This isn’t about being gay or straight," he said. "It’s about charging people hundreds of dollars to navigate decisions that could tear their families apart, with seemingly zero accountability for the damage left behind. That’s not compassion or empowerment. That’s opportunism disguised as counseling."
paras.zh: “这与同性恋或异性恋无关，”他说。 “这是向人们收取数百美元的费用，让他们做出可能导致家庭破裂的决定，而对留下的损害的责任似乎为零。这不是同情心或赋权。这是伪装成咨询的机会主义。”
