paras.en: Democratic strategist Kaivan Shroff offered a different perspective, arguing that Zanzal’s "community-driven" coming-out coaching reflects a broader cultural shift in how people seek support.
paras.zh: 民主党策略师凯万·史洛夫 (Kaivan Shroff) 提出了不同的观点，他认为赞扎尔的“社区驱动”的出柜辅导反映了人们寻求支持方式上更广泛的文化转变。

paras.en: "There is so much more freedom and language around sexuality and what makes a modern relationship that it isn’t surprising older women are looking at that and realizing they never had space to ask some of these deep questions of themselves," he told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 他告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“关于性和现代关系的要素有更多的自由和语言，老年女性正在关注这一点并意识到她们从来没有空间问自己一些深刻的问题，这并不奇怪。”

paras.en: Just 1% of LGBTQ+ women come out at 50 or older, according to a 2024 Gallup survey, and the number of teenage girls identifying as lesbian or bisexual has plunged in the last four years, a new study reveals.
paras.zh: 根据盖洛普 2024 年的一项调查，只有 1% 的 LGBTQ+ 女性在 50 岁或以上出柜，而一项新研究显示，在过去四年中，被认定为女同性恋或双性恋的少女数量大幅下降。

paras.en: Zanzal did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's request for comment.
paras.zh: 赞扎尔没有立即回应福克斯新闻数字媒体的置评请求。

articles.title: Selena Gomez warns fans after vaping habit leaves her with permanent consequence

paras.en: Selena Gomez kicked her nicotine habit, but she's still living with the consequences.
paras.zh: 赛琳娜·戈麦斯戒掉了尼古丁的习惯，但她仍然承受着后果。

paras.en: Gomez, 34, explained her own nicotine habit left her voice forever changed in a warning given to fans.
paras.zh: 34 岁的戈麦斯在向粉丝发出的警告中解释说，她自己的尼古丁习惯导致她的声音永远改变。

paras.en: "I'm not going to be able to change my voice," she said in a video uploaded to her Instagram Story. "I vaped nicotine, a lot."
paras.zh: “我无法改变我的声音，”她在上传到 Instagram Story 的视频中说道。 “我吸了很多尼古丁。”

paras.en: The "Only Murders in the Building" star made it clear that her vaping days came at a cost. Gomez urged fans to take her experience as a warning, particularly those considering trying vaping for the first time.
paras.zh: 这位《大楼里唯一的谋杀案》明星明确表示，她吸电子烟的日子是有代价的。戈麦斯敦促粉丝们将她的经历作为一个警告，特别是那些考虑第一次尝试电子烟的人。

paras.en: "Everyone knows – that's somewhat vaped – nicotine is so hard to quit," she said. "And I think I just wanted to say, if you're going through it, or if you are even trying to vape, it's just not worth it."
paras.zh: “每个人都知道——这有点像电子烟——尼古丁很难戒掉，”她说。 “我想我只是想说，如果你正在经历这一切，或者如果你甚至想尝试吸电子烟，那就不值得。”

paras.en: "And it's changed my voice," Gomez added. "So, if you guys don't like listening to my voice that's totally understandable I don't mind, just don't listen to it. Just don't listen."
paras.zh: “它改变了我的声音，”戈麦斯补充道。 “所以，如果你们不喜欢听我的声音，这是完全可以理解的，我不介意，只是不听而已。就是不听。”

paras.en: While Gomez acknowledged that her voice might never sound the same, she made it clear that she was focusing on the positive. The singer celebrated her decision to stop vaping and offered a message of encouragement to fans who were fighting to break free from their own difficult habits.
paras.zh: 虽然戈麦斯承认她的声音听起来可能永远不会一样，但她明确表示她专注于积极的一面。这位歌手庆祝了她停止吸电子烟的决定，并向那些努力摆脱自己的困难习惯的粉丝们发出了鼓励的信息。

paras.en: "But I am really excited because I stopped, and I just hope we can keep it up. It's really hard, but I know if you are going through something you can get through it too. It sucks."
paras.zh: “但我真的很兴奋，因为我停下来了，我只希望我们能坚持下去。这真的很难，但我知道如果你正在经历一些事情，你也可以克服它。这很糟糕。”

paras.en: Gomez's candid confession came after years of speaking openly about her health struggles and the physical challenges she's faced in the spotlight.
paras.zh: 戈麦斯在多年公开谈论自己的健康问题和在聚光灯下面临的身体挑战后，坦诚地承认了这一点。

paras.en: In 2014, the former Disney star entered a mental health facility shortly after she was diagnosed with lupus and later revealed she had been diagnosed with bipolar disorder.
paras.zh: 2014年，这位前迪士尼明星在被诊断出患有狼疮后不久就进入了精神病院，后来透露她被诊断出患有双相情感障碍。

paras.en: "My lupus, my kidney transplant, chemotherapy, having a mental illness, going through very public heartbreaks – these were all things that honestly should have taken me down," the actress explained in a 2021 interview with Elle magazine. "Every time I went through something, I was like, ‘What else? What else am I going to have to deal with?'"
paras.zh: 这位女演员在 2021 年接受《Elle》杂志采访时解释道：“我的狼疮、肾移植、化疗、精神疾病、经历过公开的心碎——这些都应该让我沮丧。” “每次我经历一些事情时，我都会想，‘还有什么？我还要处理什么？’”

paras.en: The former Disney Channel star has made a habit of sharing deeply personal experiences with fans, using her platform to discuss everything from her physical health to her mental health.
paras.zh: 这位前迪士尼频道明星养成了与粉丝分享深刻的个人经历的习惯，利用她的平台讨论从身体健康到心理健康的一切。

paras.en: Gomez released the documentary "My Mind & Me" in 2022. The film chronicled six years of the actress' life, career and mental health struggles.
paras.zh: 戈麦斯于 2022 年推出了纪录片《My Mind & Me》。该片记录了这位女演员六年的生活、职业和心理健康斗争。

paras.en: The "Wizards of Waverly Place" star has also included her mental health work in her business ventures.
paras.zh: 这位《奇才奇才》的明星还将她的心理健康工作纳入了她的商业事业中。

paras.en: In 2020, she launched Rare Beauty to "create a safe, welcoming space in beauty – and beyond," according to the brand's mission statement.
paras.zh: 2020 年，她推出了 Rare Beauty，根据该品牌的使命宣言，“创造一个安全、温馨的美容空间以及其他空间”。

paras.en: The brand includes the Rare Impact Fund, which raises money for mental health services.
paras.zh: 该品牌包括稀有影响力基金，该基金为心理健康服务筹集资金。

articles.title: BBC calls France protests 'mostly peaceful' as footage shows rioters torching cars, battling police

paras.en: BBC "News at Ten" host Jane Hill introduced a Sunday report detailing widespread riots across France, where thousands were arrested and nearly 1,000 law enforcement and emergency personnel were injured, before the network's Paris correspondent described the demonstrations as "mostly peaceful" while footage showed burning cars, looted businesses and violent clashes with police.
paras.zh: BBC“十点新闻”主持人简·希尔周日介绍了一份详细报道，详细介绍了法国各地发生的广泛骚乱，数千人被捕，近千名执法和紧急救援人员受伤，随后该电视台驻巴黎记者称示威活动“大部分是和平的”，而视频显示汽车被烧毁、企业被抢劫以及与警察的暴力冲突。

paras.en: Hill outlined the scale of the destruction before introducing Paris correspondent James Waterhouse's report on the nationwide unrest.
paras.zh: 希尔在介绍巴黎记者詹姆斯·沃特豪斯关于全国骚乱的报道之前概述了破坏的规模。

paras.en: "Across the country, nearly a thousand police officers and firefighters were injured. The Interior Ministry says nearly 2,400 people were arrested," Hill said.
paras.zh: “全国各地有近千名警察和消防员受伤。内政部称近 2,400 人被捕，”希尔说。

paras.en: Despite the figures, Waterhouse characterized the demonstrations as largely peaceful while reporting on the approximately half-million people who gathered across France to protest rising living costs and deteriorating public services.
paras.zh: 尽管有这些数字，沃特豪斯将示威活动描述为基本上是和平的，同时报道了法国各地大约五十万人聚集在一起抗议生活成本上涨和公共服务恶化的情况。

paras.en: "In Paris and beyond, half a million people had filled cities across France to protest over the future of their country. They were mostly peaceful, but as we saw in the capital, in the wings were those who wanted to take advantage of the disorder," Waterhouse said.
paras.zh: 沃特豪斯说：“在巴黎及其他地区，有五十万人涌入法国各地城市，抗议国家的未来。他们大多是和平的，但正如我们在首都看到的那样，有些人想利用骚乱。”

paras.en: The BBC defended its coverage in a statement to Fox News Digital, maintaining that its reporting accurately reflected the scale of the unrest while distinguishing between peaceful demonstrators and those responsible for the violence.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司在给福克斯新闻数字频道的一份声明中为其报道进行了辩护，坚称其报道准确反映了骚乱的规模，同时区分了和平示威者和暴力肇事者。

paras.en: "No one watching, reading or listening to BBC News coverage of the France protests and riots can be in any doubt as to what was happening – there is coverage of the fires, the looting and violence," the spokesperson said. "James Waterhouse and the team of reporters in France over the weekend gave broader context to the protests and riots – making the point that as well as the destructive scenes, several hundred thousand people were on the streets in peaceful protest, and those carrying out the violence and looting were a small fraction of that number."
paras.zh: 这位发言人表示：“观看、阅读或收听英国广播公司新闻对法国抗议和骚乱的报道的人不会对正在发生的事情有任何疑问——其中有关于火灾、抢劫和暴力的报道。” “周末，詹姆斯·沃特豪斯和法国记者团队对抗议和骚乱提供了更广泛的背景，指出除了破坏性场景外，还有数十万人走上街头进行和平抗议，而实施暴力和抢劫的人只占这一数字的一小部分。”

paras.en: The White House responded to Fox News Digital's request for comment on the escalating violence in France, a key U.S. ally, by pointing to two Truth Social posts from President Donald Trump addressing the unrest.
paras.zh: 白宫回应福克斯新闻数字频道就美国主要盟友法国不断升级的暴力事件发表评论的请求，引用了唐纳德·特朗普总统针对骚乱发表的两篇《真相社会》帖子。

paras.en: In his Sunday post, Trump blamed immigration for the violence and urged French authorities to close the country's borders.
paras.zh: 特朗普在周日的帖子中指责移民造成了暴力事件，并敦促法国当局关闭该国边境。

paras.en: "France is burning! The immigration of people from an entirely different world, people with hatred in their hearts, has shattered that once great country," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“法国正在燃烧！来自完全不同世界的人们、心中充满仇恨的人们的移民已经粉碎了这个曾经伟大的国家。”

paras.en: The president doubled down on his immigration concerns in a Monday morning post, calling for immediate border restrictions.
paras.zh: 总统在周一早上的一篇文章中强调了他对移民的担忧，呼吁立即实施边境限制。

paras.en: "The migrants have taken over France. They must CLOSE THE BORDERS, FAST! President DJT."
paras.zh: “移民已经占领了法国。他们必须快速关闭边界！DJT 总统。”

paras.en: The BBC's footage showed masked rioters clashing with police, setting vehicles ablaze and ransacking businesses, including a wine shop and an electric bicycle store. Waterhouse acknowledged that the destruction was being attributed to individuals exploiting the larger demonstrations.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司的镜头显示，蒙面暴徒与警察发生冲突，纵火焚烧车辆并洗劫商店，包括一家葡萄酒商店和一家电动自行车商店。沃特豪斯承认，造成破坏的原因是个人利用了更大规模的示威活动。

paras.en: "The shops that have been hit have been completely gutted. Like this wine shop has been looted from top to bottom," Waterhouse said.
paras.zh: 沃特豪斯说：“遭到袭击的商店已被彻底摧毁。就像这家酒店从上到下被洗劫一空一样。”

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron condemned the violence during a televised national address Sunday, distinguishing between demonstrators with legitimate grievances and those responsible for widespread destruction.
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙周日在全国电视讲话中谴责了暴力事件，区分了怀有正当不满的示威者和造成广泛破坏的人。

paras.en: "Nothing justifies it, nothing explains it, nothing excuses it. Tonight, we all feel anger and shame," Macron said.
paras.zh: “没有任何理由可以证明这一点，没有任何解释，没有任何借口。今晚，我们都感到愤怒和羞耻，”马克龙说。

paras.en: The violence prompted French Interior Minister Laurent Nunez to offer his resignation Monday, which Macron rejected. Nunez acknowledged that police had lost control in several major cities as the government considered additional security.
paras.zh: 暴力事件促使法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯周一提出辞职，但遭到马克龙拒绝。努涅斯承认，由于政府考虑加强安全措施，警方在几个主要城市失去了控制。

paras.en: According to a report Monday by Agence France-Presse, more than 2,500 people have been arrested, nearly 1,000 security personnel have been injured and at least 3,000 businesses were affected by the unrest. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu called for localized curfews to restore public order.
paras.zh: 据法新社周一报道，骚乱已造成超过 2,500 人被捕，近 1,000 名安全人员受伤，至少 3,000 家企业受到影响。总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努呼吁实施局部宵禁以恢复公共秩序。

paras.en: Fox News Digital reported that rioters also set fire to the historic Limoges Town Hall, built in 1883, causing extensive damage to the landmark.
paras.zh: 福克斯数字新闻报道称，骚乱者还纵火焚烧了建于 1883 年的历史悠久的利摩日市政厅，对这座地标建筑造成了广泛破坏。

paras.en: Waterhouse maintained that the violence was largely the work of individuals exploiting the demonstrations rather than those who had gathered to protest rising living costs and deteriorating public services.
paras.zh: 沃特豪斯坚称，暴力事件主要是利用示威活动的个人所为，而不是那些聚集在一起抗议生活成本上涨和公共服务恶化的人。

paras.en: "Few believe this was at the hands of the genuine protesters, but down to an opportunistic minority who came in and sought to rob and cause carnage," Waterhouse said.
paras.zh: 沃特豪斯说：“很少有人相信这是真正的抗议者所为，但实际上是少数机会主义分子进来并试图抢劫和造成屠杀。”

articles.title: Israeli police detain 10 people in rare raid against West Bank settlers
articles.author: Emma Graham-Harrison in Jerusalem

paras.en: Israeli police have detained 10 people in a rare raid against settlers, after a weekend of extreme violence in the occupied West Bank including an attack on US photojournalist Heidi Levine, which she described as an “attempted lynching”.
paras.zh: 以色列警方在对定居者的罕见突袭中拘留了10人，此前周末，被占领的约旦河西岸发生了极端暴力事件，其中包括对美国摄影记者海蒂·莱文的袭击，她称这是“企图私刑”。

paras.en: She was knocked down, kicked and beaten by a group of masked Israeli men as she covered the olive harvest in a Palestinian village on Friday. The militants broke four vertebrae and a rip, ripped open her finger so it required surgery and left her with lacerations across her body.
paras.zh: 周五，当她在巴勒斯坦村庄报道橄榄收获时，遭到一群蒙面以色列男子的殴打、殴打和殴打。武装分子折断了四块椎骨并撕裂了她的手指，因此需要进行手术，并在她的身上留下了撕裂伤。

paras.en: “I was practically, basically lynched by a gang of Jewish settlers in the area of Ramallah,” Levine said, in an interview with the BBC from her hospital bed on Monday.
paras.zh: “在拉马拉地区，我几乎是被一群犹太定居者用私刑处死的，”莱文周一在病床上接受 BBC 采访时说道。

paras.en: The day after that assault, Israeli militants armed with sticks and iron bars attacked a group of European diplomats and Palestinians harvesting olives outside the town of Taybeh, assaulting a visiting French mayor, smashing the window of an official car, and causing severe injuries to a young Palestinian man.
paras.zh: 袭击发生后的第二天，以色列武装分子手持棍棒和铁棍袭击了一群欧洲外交官和在泰贝镇外采摘橄榄的巴勒斯坦人，袭击了来访的法国市长，砸碎了一辆公务车的车窗，并造成一名巴勒斯坦年轻人重伤。

paras.en: The Israeli prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, questioned the accounts of Israeli militant violence, ignoring extensive video and witness evidence.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡对以色列武装暴力的描述提出质疑，无视大量视频和目击证据。

paras.en: He referenced an “alleged attack” on Levine, whose severe injuries were visible in interviews from her hospital bed, and “unproven allegations” the diplomats had been targeted by militants.
paras.zh: 他提到了对莱文的“涉嫌袭击”，在医院病床上接受采访时可以看到莱文的严重受伤，以及“未经证实的指控”，这些外交官是武装分子的目标。

paras.en: The attacks and his response drew a furious international reaction, including from the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, the US ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee – generally considered a staunch ally of the current Israeli government – European nations and the editor of the Washington Post, Matt Murray.
paras.zh: 这些袭击和他的回应引起了国际社会的强烈反应，其中包括美国国务卿马可·卢比奥、美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比（普遍被认为是以色列现政府的坚定盟友）、欧洲国家以及《华盛顿邮报》编辑马特·默里。

paras.en: On Monday morning Israeli police released footage of a rare raid on settlers, and said they had detained 10 people connected with the attacks on foreigners and construction of an illegal outpost.
paras.zh: 周一早上，以色列警方公布了一次罕见的针对定居者的突袭行动，并表示他们拘留了 10 名与袭击外国人和建造非法前哨基地有关的人。

paras.en: Hours later a court extended the detention of six men connected with the attacks on foreigners, to between three and four days.
paras.zh: 几小时后，法院将与袭击外国人有关的六名男子的拘留期限延长至三到四天。

paras.en: There has been little response to extreme violence against Palestinians across the West Bank, and Levine said the global focus on her attack highlighted extreme double standards.
paras.zh: 莱文表示，全球对她的袭击事件的关注凸显了极端的双重标准。

paras.en: “People are dealing with this, undergoing attacks, losing property, losing family members, being injured all across the West Bank and nothing is being done,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“西岸各地的人们都在应对这一问题，遭受袭击、失去财产、失去家人、受伤，但我们却没有采取任何行动。”

paras.en: Israelis target Palestinians with near total impunity in the occupied West Bank, where arrests are unusual, indictments rare and convictions even more unusual.
paras.zh: 在被占领的约旦河西岸，以色列人针对巴勒斯坦人的攻击几乎完全不受惩罚，逮捕行为不寻常，起诉很少见，定罪更是不寻常。

paras.en: Israeli human rights group Yesh Din has documented 561 incidents of settler and soldier violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank over three weeks since 27 September. That is an average of more than 26 each day.
paras.zh: 自 9 月 27 日以来的三周内，以色列人权组织 Yesh Din 记录了 561 起定居者和士兵在被占领的约旦河西岸针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力事件。平均每天超过 26 个。

paras.en: “It is telling that it took attacks on foreign nationals to prompt a significant response from Israeli authorities,” said the group’s executive director, Ziv Stahl. “Palestinians have endured years of systematic settler violence, with 94% of investigations into cases of settler violence against Palestinians closed without indictments.
paras.zh: 该组织执行董事齐夫·斯塔尔 (Ziv Stahl) 表示：“值得注意的是，针对外国人的袭击才促使以色列当局做出重大反应。” “巴勒斯坦人多年来一直遭受系统性的定居者暴力，对定居者针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力案件的调查中有 94% 在没有起诉的情况下结束。

paras.en: Levine said her body armour and helmet had prevented even more serious injuries, and she considered herself “lucky” given the ferocity of the attack. Netanyahu’s attempt to cast doubt on the attack felt like a “a big slap on my face”, she added.
paras.zh: 莱文说，她的防弹衣和头盔避免了更严重的伤害，考虑到袭击的凶猛程度，她认为自己“很幸运”。她补充说，内塔尼亚胡试图对这次袭击提出质疑，感觉就像是“打在我脸上的一记重耳光”。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s statements, apparently undermined by security forces arrests days later, were widely seen as an attempt to court far-right voters inside Israel, as the country heads into the final days of an election campaign.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的声明显然被安全部队几天后的逮捕行动所破坏，人们普遍认为，随着以色列竞选活动进入最后几天，内塔尼亚胡的声明试图讨好以色列境内的极右翼选民。

paras.en: His coalition partners include extremist settlers, who support the campaign of violence that has driven thousands of Palestinians from their homes and land in the occupied West Bank over the last three years.
paras.zh: 他的联盟伙伴包括极端主义定居者，他们支持暴力运动，在过去三年里，暴力运动迫使数千名巴勒斯坦人离开被占领的约旦河西岸的家园和土地。

paras.en: Haaretz reported on Monday that political pressure was preventing the army from confronting “Jewish terrorism” in the West Bank, even when the targets were foreigners including diplomats and journalists.
paras.zh: 《国土报》周一报道称，政治压力阻止军队在西岸对抗“犹太恐怖主义”，即使目标是包括外交官和记者在内的外国人。

paras.en: Commanders are reluctant to challenge settler leaders, or take action against Israeli civilians and soldiers who attack Palestinians, Israeli defence officials told the paper.
paras.zh: 以色列国防官员告诉该报，指挥官不愿意挑战定居者领导人，也不愿意对袭击巴勒斯坦人的以色列平民和士兵采取行动。

paras.en: Formal investigations and disciplinary procedures are limited and undermined by unofficial but clear messages of support from top commanders, the report said.
paras.zh: 报告称，正式调查和纪律程序受到高层指挥官非正式但明确的支持信息的限制和破坏。

paras.en: It cited the response to an attack on a CNN crew in March. Central Command chief Maj Gen Avi Bluth suspended the battalion responsible from operational duty and announced disciplinary action against soldiers involved.
paras.zh: 它引用了对 CNN 工作人员 3 月份袭击事件的回应。中央司令部司令阿维·布鲁斯少将暂停了负责该营的作战任务，并宣布对涉事士兵采取纪律处分。

paras.en: Later that night, the brigade commander came to a base where the soldiers were staying to express his support and join them in prayer, Haaretz said.
paras.zh: 据《国土报》报道，当晚晚些时候，旅长来到士兵们居住的一个基地，表达他的支持并与他们一起祈祷。

articles.title: France imposes partial curfews in several cities, including parts of Paris
articles.author: Jon Henley in Paris

paras.en: Partial curfews have been issued for a number of French cities, including parts of Paris, after the government admitted police had “lost control” during violent weekend protests around the country.
paras.zh: 在政府承认警察在周末全国各地的暴力抗议活动中“失去控制”后，包括巴黎部分地区在内的许多法国城市实施了部分宵禁。

paras.en: Sébastien Lecornu, the French prime minister, said after an emergency cabinet meeting on Monday he was “fully resolved to restore public order” and had called for “local and partial” curfews if needed. There was “no question” of imposing a full curfew on entire cities, he said.
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努在周一召开紧急内阁会议后表示，他“完全决心恢复公共秩序”，并呼吁在必要时实施“局部和部分”宵禁。他说，“毫无疑问”对整个城市实施全面宵禁。

paras.en: His office later announced partial curfews from 8pm to 6am on Monday and Tuesday nights in four northern cities, including Lille.
paras.zh: 他的办公室随后宣布，包括里尔在内的四个北部城市周一和周二晚上 8 点至早上 6 点实施部分宵禁。

paras.en: Police also imposed a curfew from 11pm Monday until 6am on Tuesday on two locations in Paris: Place de la République, where rioting took place on Saturday; and the shopping neighbourhood of Les Halles, which has been subject to looting.
paras.zh: 警方还在巴黎的两个地点实施宵禁，从周一晚上 11 点到周二早上 6 点：周六发生骚乱的共和广场；以及遭受抢劫的 Les Halles 购物区。

paras.en: A statement from police said the orders banned gatherings and demonstrations and prohibited anyone from entering or remaining in the two designated areas.
paras.zh: 警方的一份声明称，该命令禁止集会和示威，并禁止任何人进入或留在这两个指定区域。

paras.en: France’s second city, Marseille, earlier announced independently that it had banned all gatherings and demonstrations on Monday. French unions, meanwhile, called for a new round of strikes and rallies on 5 November.
paras.zh: 法国第二大城市马赛早些时候独立宣布，周一禁止所有集会和示威活动。与此同时，法国工会呼吁在 11 月 5 日举行新一轮罢工和集会。

paras.en: Lecornu told reporters that if declaring a state of emergency was deemed necessary “we could do so”, but added that at this stage partial curfews seemed “more appropriate”.
paras.zh: 莱科尔努告诉记者，如果认为有必要宣布紧急状态，“我们可以这样做”，但他补充说，现阶段部分宵禁似乎“更合适”。

paras.en: Lecornu’s comments came after France’s interior minister conceded that police had “lost control” in some cities during Saturday’s protests and the president, Emmanuel Macron, demanded a full security review and “new operational methods” to end the rioting.
paras.zh: 勒科尔努发表此番言论之前，法国内政部长承认警方在周六的抗议活动中在一些城市“失去了控制”，而总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙则要求进行全面的安全审查和“新的行动方法”来结束骚乱。

paras.en: Laurent Nuñez said on Monday there had been a “lack of anticipation” in preparations for the protests and acknowledged that police numbers had sometimes been inadequate to deal with rioters and looters on the fringes of the demonstrations.
paras.zh: 洛朗·努涅斯周一表示，抗议活动的准备工作“缺乏预期”，并承认警察人数有时不足以应对示威活动边缘的骚乱者和抢劫者。

paras.en: Nuñez said intelligence had suggested there would be 200,000 demonstrators around the country. In the event, there were more than 500,000 and peaceful protests were hijacked, morphing into one of France’s most violent days of unrest in recent years.
paras.zh: 努涅斯表示，情报显示全国将有20万示威者。结果，参与人数超过 50 万人，和平抗议活动被劫持，演变成法国近年来最暴力的骚乱之一。

paras.en: He said he had tendered his resignation to Macron because he felt “responsible for everything that happened”. Macron refused it, demanding instead that Nuñez “take all necessary steps to ensure transparency over planning and intelligence failures”.
paras.zh: 他表示，他向马克龙递交了辞呈，因为他觉得“对发生的一切负有责任”。马克龙拒绝了这一要求，而是要求努涅斯“采取一切必要措施，确保计划和情报失误的透明度”。

paras.en: The protests follow weeks of demonstrations by high school students that have been marred by sometimes violent clashes with police, rocking the country six months before a crunch presidential election and amid mounting economic pressures.
paras.zh: 抗议活动之前，高中生举行了数周的示威活动，有时与警察发生暴力冲突，在紧要的总统选举前六个月和经济压力不断加大的情况下，震动了整个国家。

paras.en: Public buildings including a town hall were attacked and set ablaze and an estimated 2,000 shops were ransacked and looted, authorities have said. Nearly 2,400 people – 70% of them adults – were arrested and almost 1,000 police and gendarmes injured.
paras.zh: 当局表示，包括市政厅在内的公共建筑遭到袭击并被纵火，估计有 2,000 家商店遭到洗劫和抢劫。近 2,400 人（其中 70% 是成年人）被捕，近 1,000 名警察和宪兵受伤。

paras.en: France’s digital minister, Anne Le Henanff, urged online resale platforms to remove listings for “stolen items” and summoned representatives of companies including Vinted and eBay. According to the commerce ministry, representatives of Amazon, Leboncoin, Meta and TikTok were also invited.
paras.zh: 法国数字部长 Anne Le Henanff 敦促在线转售平台删除“被盗物品”的列表，并召集了 Vinted 和 eBay 等公司的代表。据商务部称，亚马逊、Leboncoin、Meta 和 TikTok 的代表也受邀参加。

paras.en: Nuñez said 60,000 police and other security forces had been deployed around the country, but acknowledged it had not been enough to control determined, organised groups of violent rioters in major cities including Paris, Marseille and Lyon.
paras.zh: 努涅斯表示，已在全国各地部署了6万名警察和其他安全部队，但承认这还不足以控制巴黎、马赛和里昂等主要城市有决心、有组织的暴力骚乱团体。

paras.en: “You couldn’t look shopkeepers in the eye after hundreds of shops had been looted and say we hadn’t lost control,” the minister told French radio, but added that the responsibility of “rioters, looters and ultra-left militants” should not be glossed over.
paras.zh: 这位部长对法国电台表示：“在数百家商店被抢劫后，你不能直视店主的眼睛并说我们没有失去控制。”但他补充说，“骚乱者、抢劫者和极左武装分子”的责任不应被掩盖。

paras.en: The justice minister, Gérald Darmanin, also said intelligence failings had left the state vulnerable. “There’s no good policing without good intelligence,” he said, adding that many of those arrested had police records and “about 80%” were being prosecuted.
paras.zh: 司法部长杰拉尔德·达尔马宁 (Gérald Darmanin) 也表示，情报失误使国家变得脆弱。他说：“没有良好的情报就没有好的治安。”他补充说，许多被捕者都有警方记录，“大约 80%”正在被起诉。

paras.en: Macron’s office said in a statement on Monday that besides reviewing the security shortcomings, Nuñez had been tasked with “promptly implementing new operational methods for security forces to use on the ground in combating rioters”.
paras.zh: 马克龙办公室周一在一份声明中表示，除了审查安全缺陷外，努涅斯的任务还包括“迅速实施新的行动方法，供安全部队在实地打击骚乱者”。

paras.en: Rioting and looting continued on Sunday. The mayor of Paris, Emmanuel Grégoire, said on Monday that about 30 shops had been targeted in the capital the previous day, with a further 350 people arrested overnight.
paras.zh: 周日，骚乱和抢劫仍在继续。巴黎市长埃马纽埃尔·格雷瓜尔 (Emmanuel Grégoire) 周一表示，前一天，首都约 30 家商店遭到袭击，连夜又有 350 人被捕。

paras.en: “Maintaining public order is the responsibility of the state. It is the state that was at fault this weekend,” Grégoire said. “We have a social movement that is spreading, and no political prospect for a constructive way out. So the protests will continue.”
paras.zh: “维持公共秩序是国家的责任。这个周末是国家出了错，”格雷瓜尔说。 “我们的社会运动正在蔓延，但没有建设性出路的政治前景。因此抗议活动将继续下去。”

paras.en: Marseille’s mayor, Benoît Payan, said not just democracy but “the very foundations of the Republic” had been undermined. Describing the situation as “almost insurrectional”, he said the government’s stance amounted to “petty political manoeuvring”.
paras.zh: 马赛市长伯努瓦·帕扬表示，不仅民主，而且“共和国的根基”都受到了破坏。他将这种情况描述为“几乎是叛乱”，并表示政府的立场相当于“小小的政治动作”。

paras.en: On Monday, protesters blocked entrances to the Louvre Museum in support of the nationwide high school student protest movement and to denounce “police repression”. The museum could not open as scheduled because of the protest.
paras.zh: 周一，抗议者封锁了卢浮宫博物馆的入口，以支持全国高中生抗议运动并谴责“警察镇压”。由于抗议活动，博物馆无法如期开放。

paras.en: A leaflet displayed outside the museum read: “We are proud to announce that we are blocking the world’s largest museum.”
paras.zh: 博物馆外张贴的传单上写着：“我们很自豪地宣布，我们正在封锁世界上最大的博物馆。”

paras.en: In a televised address on Sunday, Macron criticised the “unbridled” violence and said local authorities would be able to ban some demonstrations in the coming days, but stopped short of drastic measures such as declaring a state of emergency or curfew.
paras.zh: 在周日的电视讲话中，马克龙批评了“肆无忌惮”的暴力行为，并表示地方当局将能够在未来几天禁止一些示威活动，但没有采取宣布紧急状态或宵禁等严厉措施。

paras.en: Saturday’s protests, by students, teachers, parents, unions and workers, focused on the high cost of living, an issue that also prompted demonstrations in several other European countries including Italy, Belgium and Albania over the weekend.
paras.zh: 周六由学生、教师、家长、工会和工人发起的抗议活动主要集中在高昂的生活成本上，这个问题也引发了意大利、比利时和阿尔巴尼亚等其他几个欧洲国家周末的示威活动。

articles.title: French authorities announce partial curfews as PM blames ‘ultra-left’ for exploiting protests – Europe live
articles.author: Nadeem Badshah (now); Lucy Campbell, Jakub Krupa and Martin Belam (earlier)

paras.en: French authorities announce curfew for some parts of Paris and other cities
paras.zh: 法国当局宣布对巴黎部分地区和其他城市实行宵禁

paras.en: French authorities have issued an overnight curfew, which will come into effect from 11pm until 6am local time, for Place de la Republique and the streets around Les Halles inParis, according to Libération and France24.
paras.zh: 据 Libération 和 France24 报道，法国当局已对巴黎共和广场和 Les Halles 周围的街道实施夜间宵禁，宵禁时间为当地时间晚上 11 点至凌晨 6 点。

paras.en: The measure will apply to three categories of people: unaccompanied minors, people wearing personal protective equipment, and those concealing their faces.
paras.zh: 该措施将适用于三类人：无人陪伴的未成年人、佩戴个人防护装备的人以及遮住脸部的人。

paras.en: Authorities had earlier issued the country’s first curfew to run for two days starting on Monday in the northern city of Lille and surrounding cities of Douai, Wattignies and Denain, France24 reported citing prime minister Sébastien Lecornu’s office.
paras.zh: 据 France24 援引总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努 (Sébastien Lecornu) 办公室的报道，当局早些时候发布了该国首次宵禁，从周一开始，在北部城市里尔及其周边城市杜埃、瓦蒂尼和德南实施两天。

paras.en: Here is the decree from the Paris police prefecture on the curfew which will be from 11 pm until 6am.
paras.zh: 以下是巴黎警察局关于宵禁的法令，宵禁时间为晚上 11 点至凌晨 6 点。

paras.en: “The central median of the Place de la République” and “an area [...] delimited by the following squares and streets within it: Place Maurice-Quentin; Rue Berger from Place Maurice-Quentin to the corner of Boulevard Sébastopol; the section of Passage des Lingères that leads onto Rue Berger; Boulevard Sébastopol from the corner of Rue Berger to the corner of Allée André-Breton; Allée André-Breton.”
paras.zh: “共和国广场的中央中线”和“由其中的以下广场和街道界定的区域：莫里斯-昆汀广场；从莫里斯-昆汀广场到塞瓦斯托波尔大道拐角处的伯杰街；通向伯杰街的林格雷斯通道部分；从伯杰街拐角到安德烈-布列塔尼大道拐角处的塞巴斯托波尔大道；安德烈-布列塔尼大街。”

paras.en: The prefecture clarifies that “residents who can prove, by any means, that their residence is located within the aforementioned areas, workers [...], members of the public emergency services, and shopkeepers are not subject to” the decree.
paras.zh: 该县澄清说，“能够以任何方式证明其住所位于上述地区的居民、工人、公共紧急服务人员和店主不受该法令的约束”。

paras.en: Demonstrations will also be prohibited from 8pm to 6am in other parts of the capital, such as Bastille, Châtelet, or near places of power like the Elysée, Matignon, the National Assembly and the Senate.
paras.zh: 晚上 8 点至凌晨 6 点，首都其他地区也将被禁止举行示威活动，例如巴士底狱、沙特莱，或爱丽舍宫、马蒂尼翁、国民议会和参议院等权力场所附近。

paras.en: Eric Ciotti, the mayor of the southern French city of Nice, has also issued a curfew “to protect the people of Nice” starting from Monday evening 9pm local time to 6am. The curfew will remain in effect each night until Sunday, and will only apply to minors, he said.
paras.zh: 法国南部城市尼斯市长埃里克·西奥蒂也宣布从当地时间周一晚上 9 点到凌晨 6 点实行宵禁，“以保护尼斯人民”。他说，宵禁将每晚持续到周日，并且仅适用于未成年人。

paras.en: According to Libération, only certain areas of the city are affected: the city center, Old Nice, the Trachel district, and the Gare du Sud (southern train station).
paras.zh: 据《解放报》报道，只有城市的某些区域受到影响：市中心、旧尼斯、Trachel 区和 Gare du Sud（南火车站）。

paras.en: French authorities announce curfew for some parts of Paris and other cities
paras.zh: 法国当局宣布对巴黎部分地区和其他城市实行宵禁

paras.en: French authorities have issued an overnight curfew, which will come into effect from 11pm until 6am local time, for Place de la Republique and the streets around Les Halles inParis, according to Libération and France24.
paras.zh: 据 Libération 和 France24 报道，法国当局已对巴黎共和广场和 Les Halles 周围的街道实施夜间宵禁，宵禁时间为当地时间晚上 11 点至凌晨 6 点。

paras.en: The measure will apply to three categories of people: unaccompanied minors, people wearing personal protective equipment, and those concealing their faces.
paras.zh: 该措施将适用于三类人：无人陪伴的未成年人、佩戴个人防护装备的人以及遮住脸部的人。

paras.en: Authorities had earlier issued the country’s first curfew to run for two days starting on Monday in the northern city of Lille and surrounding cities of Douai, Wattignies and Denain, France24 reported citing prime minister Sébastien Lecornu’s office.
paras.zh: 据 France24 援引总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努 (Sébastien Lecornu) 办公室的报道，当局早些时候发布了该国首次宵禁，从周一开始，在北部城市里尔及其周边城市杜埃、瓦蒂尼和德南实施两天。

paras.en: The prefect of the Nord department has issued an order imposing a curfew for minors starting at 8 p.m. local time in certain areas of the cities of Lille, Douai, Wattignies, and Denain.
paras.zh: 北部省长已发布命令，从晚上 8 点开始对未成年人实施宵禁。里尔、杜埃、瓦蒂尼和德南等城市部分地区的当地时间。

paras.en: “These orders are issued in close collaboration with the mayors concerned,” the prefecture said.
paras.zh: 该县表示：“这些命令是与有关市长密切合作发布的。”

paras.en: The Prime Minister’s office stated the measure is in effect for Monday and Tuesday nights, from 8pm to 6 am, Liberation reported.
paras.zh: 据《解放报》报道，总理办公室表示，该措施将于周一和周二晚上 8 点至凌晨 6 点生效。

paras.en: In Coulaines, a town of 8,000 inhabitants near Le Mans, the mayor, Christophe Rouillon, also announced on Facebook that he would be implementing a curfew “in the evening for minors who go out alone ,” starting at 11 p.m. on Monday.
paras.zh: 在勒芒附近有 8000 名居民的 Coulaines 小镇，市长 Christophe Rouillon 也在 Facebook 上宣布，他将从晚上 11 点开始“对单独外出的未成年人”实行宵禁。周一。

paras.en: The right-wing mayor of a town in Maine-et-Loire has decided to fly the flags at the town hall at half-mast and remove the portrait of Emmanuel Macron following the demonstrations in France.
paras.zh: 法国示威活动结束后，缅因-卢瓦尔省一个小镇的右翼市长决定在市政厅下半旗志哀，并移除埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的肖像。

paras.en: “I condemn in the strongest possible terms the violence and damage committed by those who flout our laws, vandalise our towns, and show contempt for the values of the Republic,” Frédéric Mortier, the mayor of Longué-Jumelles, said.
paras.zh: 隆格-朱梅勒市市长弗雷德里克·莫蒂埃表示：“我以最强烈的措辞谴责那些藐视我们的法律、破坏我们的城镇并蔑视共和国价值观的人所犯下的暴力和破坏行为。”

paras.en: “France cannot accept that some refuse common rules, reject the requirements of integration and challenge the authority of the State,” he continued.
paras.zh: “法国不能接受一些人拒绝共同规则、拒绝一体化要求并挑战国家权威，”他继续说道。

paras.en: The mayor added that he had also decided “to take down the portrait of the President of the Republic in the town hall”, explaining that the attitude of the head of state “in the face of this situation is unworthy of the gravity of the events and the expectations of our fellow citizens”.
paras.zh: 市长补充说，他还决定“取下市政厅里共和国总统的肖像”，并解释说，国家元首“面对这种情况的态度不符合事件的严重性和我们同胞的期望”。

paras.en: France protests escalate with riots, looting and 2,400 arrests - podcast
paras.zh: 法国抗议活动升级，骚乱、抢劫和 2,400 人被捕 - 播客

paras.en: Last weekend there were mass protests across France, with more than half a million people estimated to have been involved. The unrest included rioting, looting and violent clashes with outnumbered police in cities including Paris, Marseille and Limoges. The interior minister conceded that police “lost control” in some cities, while President Emmanuel Macron demanded a full security review.
paras.zh: 上周末，法国各地爆发大规模抗议活动，估计有超过五十万人参与其中。骚乱包括巴黎、马赛和利摩日等城市的骚乱、抢劫以及与人数不足的警察的暴力冲突。内政部长承认警方在一些城市“失去了控制”，而总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙则要求进行全面的安全审查。

paras.en: For today’s instalment of The Latest podcast, Lucy Hough speaks to the Guardian’s Europe correspondent, Jon Henley:
paras.zh: 在今天的最新播客中，露西·霍夫 (Lucy Hough) 接受了《卫报》欧洲记者乔恩·亨利 (Jon Henley) 的采访：

paras.en: François Gatel, Minister for Territorial Collectivities, told the National Assembly there will be “the mobilisation of an exceptional fund to support the reconstruction of public facilities.”
paras.zh: 领土集体部长弗朗索瓦·加特尔告诉国民议会，将“调动一笔特殊资金来支持公共设施的重建”。

paras.en: He added it will be “a one-stop shop to support disaster-stricken communities” to coordinate and facilitate the process. The minister also promised regulatory “flexibilities” to ease the work.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这将是“支持受灾社区的一站式服务”，以协调和促进这一进程。该部长还承诺监管“灵活性”以缓解工作压力。

paras.en: Four police officers were injured and a police station was vandalised in the Garenne district of La Roche-sur-Yon by “around sixty individuals dressed in black and wearing balaclavas” who fired fireworks and other projectiles, Liberation reported.
paras.zh: 据《解放报》报道，永河畔拉罗什 Garenne 区的一个警察局遭到“约 60 名身着黑衣、头戴巴拉克拉瓦的人”发射烟花和其他投射物的破坏，造成四名警察受伤。

paras.en: ‘It looks like a war zone’: France reels as looting continues for second night
paras.zh: “它看起来像一个战区”：法国因抢劫连续第二天晚上而陷入困境

paras.en: Just before 1am on Monday morning, two motorbikes carrying one passenger each stopped at a traffic light on a backstreet near rue de Rivoli,one of central Paris’s busiest shopping streets.
paras.zh: 周一凌晨 1 点前，两辆摩托车各载有一名乘客，在巴黎市中心最繁忙的购物街之一里沃利街附近的一条后街的红绿灯前停下。

paras.en: “You’ve got to go where there are a lot of people, where they’ve done the shop windows,” said one motorbike rider to another. Minutes later 10 other men, their faces covered with ski balaclavas, came down the street on foot pursued by a police van.
paras.zh: “你必须去人多的地方，他们已经把商店橱窗装饰好了，”一名摩托车骑手对另一名骑手说道。几分钟后，另外 10 名脸上戴着滑雪帽的男子步行来到街上，遭到一辆警车的追赶。

paras.en: Soon after Emmanuel Macron’stelevised speech on Sunday night telling the nation it was “unbearable to see our streets ransacked”, groups of men looted shops in central Paris for hours for a second night running. Dozens of people attempted to smash windows near Les Halles shopping centre and grab goods. Others broke into an electrical shop in Belleville in the north of the city.
paras.zh: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙周日晚上发表电视讲话告诉全国“我们的街道被洗劫令人难以忍受”后不久，成群结队的男子连续第二个晚上抢劫巴黎市中心的商店几个小时。数十人试图砸碎 Les Halles 购物中心附近的窗户并抢夺物品。其他人闯入该市北部贝尔维尔的一家电器店。

paras.en: “Men were battering shop windows, trying to break in, then they were chased by police,” said a 73-year-old woman near Les Halles.
paras.zh: “男人们敲打商店窗户，试图闯入，然后被警察追赶，”Les Halles 附近的一名 73 岁妇女说。

paras.en: “There were different groups running everywhere with police chasing on foot or by car, and at the same time, some people were setting bins and bikes alight. The groups breaking into shops aren’t hostile to passersby so you’d see local residents walking down the street on their way home late at night, and masked teenagers running past in the other direction carrying looted goods. It’s so strange – it’s like two different universes in parallel worlds.”
paras.zh: “到处都是不同的人群，警察步行或开车追赶，同时，一些人在焚烧垃圾箱和自行车。闯入商店的人群对路人并没有敌意，所以你会看到当地居民在深夜回家的路上走在街上，蒙面青少年带着抢来的物品从另一个方向跑过去。这太奇怪了——就像平行世界中的两个不同宇宙。”

paras.en: “It says a lot about society – it shows we have neglected our education system and that we’re living in a consumer society where all we say to our young people is: ‘buy, buy, buy’. In this type of extreme capitalism, some people don’t have enough money to buy all of this and so they attack.”
paras.zh: “这说明了很多关于社会的问题——它表明我们忽视了我们的教育体系，我们生活在一个消费社会，我们对年轻人说的就是：‘买，买，买’。在这种极端的资本主义中，有些人没有足够的钱来购买所有这些，所以他们发起攻击。”

paras.en: Macron begins Gulf trip aimed at securing petrol, diesel supplies
paras.zh: 马克龙开始海湾之行，旨在确保汽油、柴油供应

paras.en: Meanwhile, as France was busy cleaning up its streets, the country’s president Emmanuel Macron – who last night delivered an address to the nation on the events – arrived in Kuwait for a Gulf trip aimed at securing additional petrol and diesel supplies to bring down pump prices, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据路透社报道，法国正忙于清理街道，该国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙（昨晚就这一事件向全国发表讲话）抵达科威特，开始海湾之行，旨在确保额外的汽油和柴油供应，以降低汽油价格。

paras.en: During the trip, he is also visiting the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 访问期间，他还访问了阿拉伯联合酋长国。

articles.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders

paras.en: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult, Paul Mackenzie, has been found guilty of murdering 191 people, all but one of them children.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚末日邪教领袖保罗·麦肯齐 (Paul Mackenzie) 被判谋杀 191 人，其中除一名儿童外，均被判有罪。

paras.en: Mackenzie ordered members of his cult to starve their children to death so they could "meet Jesus".
paras.zh: 麦肯齐命令他的邪教成员将他们的孩子饿死，这样他们就可以“遇见耶稣”。

paras.en: His doctrine said that education was forbidden and modern medicine was "evil".
paras.zh: 他的学说认为教育是被禁止的，现代医学是“邪恶的”。

paras.en: Twenty-eight other leaders of his cult were also convicted of murder. They had all pleaded not guilty, repeatedly insisting that nobody was forced to die.
paras.zh: 他的邪教的其他 28 名领导人也被判犯有谋杀罪。他们都表示不认罪，并一再坚称没有人被迫死亡。

paras.en: Warning: This article contains details which some people might find distressing.
paras.zh: 警告：本文包含一些可能会让某些人感到痛苦的细节。

paras.en: Delivering her eight-hour judgement in the port city of Mombasa, Justice Diana Mochache said Mackenzie's followers believed he was "Jesus's mouthpiece".
paras.zh: 戴安娜·莫哈切法官在港口城市蒙巴萨进行了八个小时的判决，她说麦肯齐的追随者相信他是“耶稣的代言人”。

paras.en: One of his co-accused said Mackenzie had told his followers that anyone who "resisted the directive to fast must be forced to go to heaven through kicks and blows".
paras.zh: 他的一名同案被告表示，麦肯齐告诉他的追随者，任何“抵制禁食指令的人都必须被迫通过拳打脚踢进入天堂”。

paras.en: Burials inside the forest where the cult was based were called "weddings". Those who died "were celebrated as having wedded with Jesus", the judge said.
paras.zh: 邪教所在地森林内的埋葬被称为“婚礼”。法官说，那些死去的人“被庆祝为与耶稣结婚”。

paras.en: One witness stated that a pregnant woman had been barred from nursing her new-born baby, who died 12 days later. "She was instructed to fast to death and follow her children," the witness said.
paras.zh: 一名目击者称，一名孕妇被禁止哺乳她刚出生的婴儿，婴儿在 12 天后死亡。 “她被指示禁食至死并跟随她的孩子，”目击者说。

paras.en: Mackenzie's former head of security, Enos Amanya Ngala, was initially accused but then entered a plea deal and became a witness for the prosecution.
paras.zh: 麦肯齐的前安全主管伊诺斯·阿马尼亚·恩加拉最初受到指控，但后来达成认罪协议并成为检方的证人。

paras.en: Mackenzie and other leaders of the cult also face a raft of other legal cases, including for terrorism, radicalisation and denying education to children.
paras.zh: 麦肯齐和该邪教的其他领导人还面临大量其他法律案件，包括恐怖主义、激进化和剥夺儿童教育等案件。

paras.en: But this is the first time the pastor has faced a verdict on the most serious charges of murder. He is due to be sentenced on 6 November.
paras.zh: 但这是这位牧师第一次面临最严重的谋杀指控的判决。他将于 11 月 6 日被判刑。

paras.en: He was arrested in 2023, after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves in Shakahola forest near the Kenyan coast, where Mackenzie had led his followers from across the country.
paras.zh: 2023 年，麦肯齐带领来自全国各地的追随者在肯尼亚海岸附近的沙卡霍拉森林的浅坟中发现了 400 多具尸体，随后他被捕。

paras.en: Stephen Mwiti, 48, said he lost all six of his children to the cult. His former wife was one of those convicted of murder alongside Mackenzie.
paras.zh: 48 岁的史蒂芬·姆维蒂 (Stephen Mwiti) 说，他的六个孩子都因邪教而丧生。他的前妻是与麦肯齐一起被判犯有谋杀罪的人之一。

paras.en: "I'm a happy man, that all persons have been convicted," he told the BBC outside court.
paras.zh: “我很高兴，所有的人都被定罪了，”他在法庭外告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: "All six of my children died in Shakahola forest," Mwiti said ahead of the verdict, visibly emotional holding a photograph of his family. "I only found and buried the remains of my son Samuel."
paras.zh: “我的六个孩子都死在了沙卡霍拉森林里，”姆维蒂在判决前说道，他手里拿着一张家人的照片，显然情绪激动。 “我只找到并埋葬了我儿子塞缪尔的遗体。”

paras.en: Seventeen men were hired from the nearby town for the horrifying task of digging up the shallow graves. Some were paid just $8 (Â£6) a day.
paras.zh: 从附近的城镇雇佣了十七名男子来执行挖掘浅坟墓的可怕任务。有些人每天的工资仅为 8 美元（6 英镑）。

paras.en: "Every grave we found had at least three bodies," James, one of the gravediggers, told the BBC. "Some of the remains were of children as young as a few weeks old."
paras.zh: “我们发现的每个坟墓都至少有三具尸体，”掘墓人之一詹姆斯告诉英国广播公司。 “一些遗骸是只有几周大的儿童。”

paras.en: "We once found 12 bodies of children in a line inside a grave. It was massive, the bodies were arranged like clothes. One on top of another."
paras.zh: “我们曾经在一个坟墓里发现了 12 具儿童尸体，排成一排。坟墓很大，尸体像衣服一样排列。一具叠在另一具上面。”

paras.en: Gravediggers described some of the bodies of children as having had their "hands and legs tied and bodies wrapped in bedsheets".
paras.zh: 掘墓者称，一些儿童的尸体“手脚被绑住，身体裹着床单”。

paras.en: Although many of Mackenzie's followers were from elsewhere in Kenya, some of the remains are of people who were familiar to the community because the people in the cult would often go to nearby Shakahola town for supplies and to fetch water from the River Galana which flows through the town.
paras.zh: 尽管麦肯齐的许多追随者来自肯尼亚其他地方，但其中一些遗骸是该社区熟悉的人，因为该邪教的成员经常前往附近的沙卡霍拉镇获取物资，并从流经该镇的加拉纳河取水。

paras.en: "We would sometimes carry people on our motorbikes into the forest," said Salim Karisa, another gravedigger. "But it was so planned and secretive that nobody could tell what was happening inside."
paras.zh: “我们有时会用摩托车载人进入森林，”另一位掘墓人萨利姆·卡里萨 (Salim Karisa) 说。 “但它是如此计划和秘密，以至于没有人知道里面发生了什么。”

paras.en: Mackenzie established Good News International Ministries in 2003. Over the next 16 years, the church grew in popularity to draw thousands of followers in the church's branches across Kenya.
paras.zh: 麦肯齐于 2003 年成立了好消息国际事工。在接下来的 16 年里，该教会越来越受欢迎，在肯尼亚各地的分会中吸引了数千名追随者。

paras.en: His church ran a television station called Times TV which would broadcast his sermons from his church in Malindi.
paras.zh: 他的教堂经营着一家名为“时代电视台”的电视台，该电视台会在马林迪的教堂播放他的布道。

paras.en: His End Days sermons included conspiracy theories that described education as "evil", healthcare as "against the doctrine" and digital identity cards as "the mark of the devil".
paras.zh: 他的末日布道包括阴谋论，将教育描述为“邪恶”，将医疗保健描述为“违反教义”，将数字身份证描述为“魔鬼的印记”。

paras.en: Mackenzie's son, Dan Paul Mackenzie, said he worked as a cameraperson in the church. "The children would sit at the back, adults in the middle, and everyone would sing worship songs all morning."
paras.zh: 麦肯齐的儿子丹·保罗·麦肯齐说，他在教堂担任摄影师。 “孩子们坐在后面，大人坐在中间，整个早上每个人都会唱敬拜歌曲。”

paras.en: The self-proclaimed pastor would start his fiery sermons at noon, some of which included "casting out demons".
paras.zh: 这位自称牧师的人会在中午开始他激烈的布道，其中一些内容包括“赶鬼”。

paras.en: The main church shut down in 2019 and Paul Mackenzie moved to Shakahola forest, encouraging his devotees to follow him.
paras.zh: 主教堂于 2019 年关闭，保罗·麦肯齐 (Paul Mackenzie) 搬到了沙卡霍拉 (Shakahola) 森林，鼓励他的信徒跟随他。

paras.en: Peter Shukrani, 23, says his mother relocated to Shakahola with him at the time. He started going to Mackenzie's church when he was eight years old and described him as his "spiritual father", adding that he would "never say a bad word about him".
paras.zh: 23 岁的彼得·舒克拉尼 (Peter Shukrani) 说，他的母亲当时和他一起搬到了沙卡霍拉 (Shakahola)。他八岁时开始去麦肯齐的教堂，并将麦肯齐描述为自己的“精神之父”，并补充说他“永远不会说他的坏话”。

paras.en: When in the forest, Shukrani fell ill and his condition deteriorated because medication was banned.
paras.zh: 在森林里时，舒克拉尼生病了，而且由于药物被禁止，他的病情恶化了。

paras.en: "My mother would throw away all the medicine I was supposed to take because she believe that only God could heal me," Shukrani said.
paras.zh: “我母亲会扔掉我应该服用的所有药物，因为她相信只有上帝才能治愈我，”舒克拉尼说。

paras.en: The community was described as mud houses scattered across the vast forest. "We lived a quiet normal life, fasting for a few days then having a small meal," Shukrani said.
paras.zh: 该社区被描述为分散在广阔森林中的泥屋。 “我们过着平静的正常生活，禁食几天，然后吃一点饭，”舒克拉尼说。

paras.en: By March 2023 when the first remains were discovered by local herders, hundreds of people had died. "We would carry someone out of the forest but they were so frail that they would die in our arms," explained Salim Karisa, one of the gravediggers.
paras.zh: 到 2023 年 3 月，当地牧民发现第一批遗骸时，已有数百人死亡。掘墓人之一萨利姆·卡里萨（Salim Karisa）解释说：“我们会把某人带出森林，但他们太虚弱了，以至于会死在我们怀里。”

paras.en: Shukrani was one of the men rescued from the forest.
paras.zh: 舒克拉尼是从森林中获救的人之一。

paras.en: He was ill and bed-ridden for weeks until that point, but his condition worsened because his mother would throw away all the medication he needed to recover.
paras.zh: 在那之前，他已经病了几周，卧床不起，但他的病情恶化了，因为他的母亲会扔掉他康复所需的所有药物。

paras.en: "My mother believed Pastor Mackenzie's doctrine that medicine was evil," Shukrani said.
paras.zh: “我母亲相信麦肯齐牧师的教义，即医学是邪恶的，”舒克拉尼说。

paras.en: "I would have died if I wasn't rescued from Shakahola forest."
paras.zh: “如果我没有被从沙卡霍拉森林救出来，我就会死掉。”

paras.en: Many of the bodies are still unidentified owing to their advanced state of decomposition.
paras.zh: 由于高度腐烂，许多尸体仍无法辨认。

paras.en: In the court documents, several are referred to as "unknown male child" and identified by the location of their grave and date of their discovery.
paras.zh: 在法庭文件中，其中几人被称为“身份不明的男孩”，并通过他们的坟墓位置和发现日期来识别身份。

paras.en: Despite the suffering endured by Mackenzie's followers, men, women and children who died due to starvation, strangulation and even being bludgeoned to death, as well as his own suffering, Shukrani believes Mackenzie was "a good person who cares for me".
paras.zh: 尽管麦肯齐的追随者、男人、女人和儿童因饥饿、勒死甚至被殴打而遭受痛苦，舒克拉尼也相信麦肯齐是“一个关心我的好人”。

paras.en: "Mackenzie didn't force anyone to fast. People made those choices by themselves because of their beliefs," Shukrani said before the verdict was announced.
paras.zh: “麦肯齐没有强迫任何人禁食。人们因为自己的信仰而做出了这些选择，”舒克拉尼在判决宣布前说道。

paras.en: "I still love him and he is still my pastor."
paras.zh: “我仍然爱他，他仍然是我的牧师。”

paras.en: In contrast Dan Mackenzie believed his father should be found guilty of murder.
paras.zh: 相比之下，丹·麦肯齐认为他的父亲应该被判犯有谋杀罪。

paras.en: "He was the leader, he was someone who they were looking [up to]. So he is a murderer of mass killing," also speaking before the verdict.
paras.zh: “他是领导者，他是他们所仰望的人。所以他是大规模屠杀的凶手，”也在判决前说道。

articles.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre 'in 30 to 60 seconds'

paras.en: The fire that killed four members of the Canadian military and injured dozens of others on Saturday spread with alarming speed, accounts suggest.
paras.zh: 据报道，周六大火蔓延速度惊人，造成四名加拿大军人死亡，数十人受伤。

paras.en: It broke out in a grassy training area at a base in the province of Alberta and spread rapidly due to strong winds.
paras.zh: 疫情在阿尔伯塔省一处基地的草地训练区爆发，并因强风而迅速蔓延。

paras.en: "The fire was 1km (0.6 miles) away when the wind shifted," said Maj-Gen Wade Rutland, commander of the 1st Canadian Division of the Canadian Armed Forces. "It is not normal for a fire to move a kilometre in 30 to 60 seconds."
paras.zh: 加拿大武装部队加拿大第一师指挥官韦德·拉特兰少将表示：“当风向改变时，火势距离我们有 1 公里（0.6 英里）。” “火在 30 到 60 秒内蔓延一公里是不正常的。”

paras.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney described it as "one of the worst tragedies for the forces on Canadian soil in peacetime". Officials have ruled out the possibility of "any terrorist activity".
paras.zh: 总理马克·卡尼称这是“和平时期加拿大领土上军队最严重的悲剧之一”。官员们排除了“任何恐怖活动”的可能性。

paras.en: Speaking in the House of Commons on Monday, Carney said the fire was "driven by ferocious winds".
paras.zh: 卡尼周一在下议院发表讲话时表示，火灾是“由狂风驱动的”。

paras.en: "The fire jumped nearly a kilometer less than a minute to where the soldiers were gathered," he said, adding that the cause of the fire was not yet known.
paras.zh: 他说：“不到一分钟，火势就蔓延了近一公里，到达士兵聚集的地方。”他补充说，起火原因尚不清楚。

paras.en: Carney said the injuries occurred "in the space of a few minutes".
paras.zh: 卡尼说，受伤发生在“几分钟之内”。

paras.en: The blaze began at about 16:00 (22:00 GMT) on Saturday at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, one of the country's busiest military training bases.
paras.zh: 火灾于周六 16:00（格林威治标准时间 22:00）左右在加拿大温赖特军事基地发生，该基地是加拿大最繁忙的军事训练基地之一。

paras.en: The BBC has confirmed that Sgt Morgan Wong, Pte Shaun Farrell, Pte Aidan Goulding and Pte Hayden Lykkemark have died.
paras.zh: BBC 已证实摩根·黄中士、肖恩·法雷尔上尉、艾丹·古尔丁上尉和海登·莱克马克上尉已经死亡。

paras.en: Of the 39 injured people receiving care in hospital, at least 19 are in a critical condition.
paras.zh: 39名伤者正在医院接受治疗，其中至少19人情况危急。

paras.en: Warren Thirsk, an emergency department doctor at the Royal Alexandra Hospital, told Canadian broadcaster CBC that the number of patients involved in the incident had "completely overwhelmed" healthcare facilities in Wainwright.
paras.zh: 皇家亚历山德拉医院急诊科医生沃伦·瑟斯克（Warren Thirsk）告诉加拿大广播公司 CBC，参与这起事件的患者数量已经“完全压垮”了温赖特的医疗设施。

paras.en: Tributes are being paid to the servicemen who died.
paras.zh: 人们向死去的军人表示哀悼。

paras.en: Patricia Farrell, the mother of Shaun Farrell, wrote on Facebook that it was "with heavy hearts that we share the news that our son, Shaun Farrell, has passed away to be with our Heavenly Father".
paras.zh: 肖恩·法雷尔的母亲帕特里夏·法雷尔在脸书上写道，“我们怀着沉重的心情分享我们的儿子肖恩·法雷尔去世的消息，与我们的天父在一起”。

paras.en: Wong received a tribute from the Loyal Edmonton Regiment, of which he was part. The regiment was "deeply saddened", it wrote in a Facebook post of its own. It sent "heartfelt condolences to [the group's] families, friends, and fellow soldiers".
paras.zh: 黄受到了忠诚埃德蒙顿军团的致敬，他也是该军团的一员。该团在自己的脸书帖子中写道，该团“深感悲痛”。它“向[该组织的]家人、朋友和战友表示衷心的哀悼”。

paras.en: The mother of Goulding, Sonia Monk, said her late son was an exceptional athlete and a natural leader. "He was always the guy who kept everybody's spirits up," she told CBC. "He really was the light of my life."
paras.zh: 古尔丁的母亲索尼娅·蒙克 (Sonia Monk) 表示，她已故的儿子是一位杰出的运动员和天生的领导者。 “他总是那个让每个人都精神振奋的人，”她告诉加拿大广播公司。 “他确实是我生命中的光。”

paras.en: Canadian PM Carney said on Monday that Goulding was known as "a generous and deeply loyal friend".
paras.zh: 加拿大总理卡尼周一表示，古尔丁被称为“一位慷慨且忠诚的朋友”。

paras.en: Lykkemark, Carney said, "was known for his gift for lightening a hard day, his quick wit - he dreamed of a career in law enforcement".
paras.zh: 卡尼说，莱克马克“以减轻辛苦一天的天赋和机智而闻名——他梦想从事执法工作”。

paras.en: "These were sons, brothers, partners, friends, young men with bright futures who chose to serve our country and who died in that cause," Carney said.
paras.zh: 卡尼说：“这些人是儿子、兄弟、合作伙伴、朋友、前途光明的年轻人，他们选择为我们的国家服务，并为此献身。”

paras.en: In recounting Saturday's events, Rutland told reporters that members of the infantry had been conducting "high-intensity combat training with live munitions" at a grenade range and attack range.
paras.zh: 在讲述周六的事件时，拉特兰告诉记者，步兵成员一直在手榴弹靶场和攻击靶场进行“高强度实弹战斗训练”。

paras.en: He told reporters that officials knew about the fire on the base for several hours, but it was decided that training "could carry on for a certain amount of time".
paras.zh: 他告诉记者，官员们在几个小时前就知道基地发生火灾，但决定训练“可以持续一段时间”。

paras.en: "I spoke to my commander last night, and he said within 30 seconds to a minute they saw no fire, and then there was a fire right on top of them," Rutland said.
paras.zh: 拉特兰说：“昨晚我和我的指挥官谈过，他说在 30 秒到一分钟内他们没有看到火，然后他们的头顶上就着火了。”

paras.en: Rutland said it was not yet known what exactly caused the fire.
paras.zh: 拉特兰表示，目前尚不清楚火灾的具体原因。

paras.en: Some witnesses had said they had heard explosions, fuelling speculation that oil and gas infrastructure may have been hit and sparked the fire. But Rutland said authorities "do not believe this [incident] to be a result of any oil and gas infrastructure".
paras.zh: 一些目击者表示，他们听到了爆炸声，这加剧了人们对石油和天然气基础设施可能遭到袭击并引发火灾的猜测。但拉特兰表示，当局“不认为这起事件是任何石油和天然气基础设施造成的”。

paras.en: The Canadian Armed Forces has said that "while the incident remains under investigation, at this time, there are no indications that it was the result of any terrorist activity".
paras.zh: 加拿大武装部队表示，“虽然该事件仍在调查中，但目前没有迹象表明这是任何恐怖活动的结果”。

paras.en: Forecasters had issued a wind warning on Saturday for large parts of Alberta, predicting wind gusts of up to 90km/h (66mph), Canadian broadcaster CBS said.
paras.zh: 加拿大广播公司哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 表示，预报员周六对阿尔伯塔省大部分地区发出了风力警告，预计阵风速度将高达 90 公里/小时（66 英里/小时）。

paras.en: According to Rutland, the investigation may take at least a month.
paras.zh: 拉特兰表示，调查可能至少需要一个月的时间。

paras.en: Wainwright, about 130 miles east of Edmonton, Alberta's capital, is one of the main bases used by the Canadian military for live-fire training exercises, and it houses troops from Canada and allied countries.
paras.zh: 温赖特位于阿尔伯塔省首府埃德蒙顿以东约130英里处，是加拿大军队进行实弹训练演习的主要基地之一，驻扎着来自加拿大及其盟国的部队。

paras.en: About 690 military personnel and 300 civilian workers are on site on a typical day.
paras.zh: 通常一天约有 690 名军事人员和 300 名文职人员在现场。

articles.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC

paras.en: Ukrainians have died because Kyiv is still not receiving reliable US warnings of incoming Russian attacks, according to a key adviser to President Volodymyr Zelensky.
paras.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基的一位重要顾问表示，乌克兰人死亡是因为基辅仍未收到美国关于俄罗斯袭击的可靠警告。

paras.en: Serhii "Flash" Beskrestnov told the BBC that lives had been lost because there had not been time to warn citizens about ballistic missile strikes, saying: "It's dangerous... I think it's really very bad... People [have] already died."
paras.zh: Serhii “Flash” Beskrestnov 告诉 BBC，由于没有时间就弹道导弹袭击向公民发出警告，造成了人员伤亡，他说：“这很危险……我认为这真的非常糟糕……人们已经死亡。”

paras.en: The adviser also said restrictions to Ukraine's use of the Starlink internet network were ongoing.
paras.zh: 该顾问还表示，对乌克兰使用星链互联网网络的限制仍在继续。

paras.en: The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing with Ukraine.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，与乌克兰的情报共享没有变化。

paras.en: Ukraine first reported an interruption to US intelligence sharing last week, as a row with the Trump administrations over its controversial deal to import Russian oil sent relations to new lows.
paras.zh: 乌克兰上周首次报告美国情报共享中断，原因是与特朗普政府就其有争议的进口俄罗斯石油协议发生争执，导致两国关系跌至新低。

paras.en: Despite the denials from Washington, many in Kyiv suspect the issues are not a coincidence.
paras.zh: 尽管华盛顿予以否认，但基辅的许多人怀疑这些问题并非巧合。

paras.en: On Monday morning, Zelensky wrote on social media: "Overnight two ballistic missile attacks were reported on the capital, one without warning, the second with only minimal time to take shelter."
paras.zh: 周一早上，泽连斯基在社交媒体上写道：“据报道，首都一夜之间发生了两起弹道导弹袭击，其中一次没有任何警告，第二次只在最短的时间内进行了躲避。”

paras.en: Hours earlier, an interview the president did with NBC was published, in which he said intelligence sharing had been restored after a three-day pause.
paras.zh: 几个小时前，总统接受美国全国广播公司 (NBC) 的采访发表，他在采访中表示，情报共享在暂停三天后已恢复。

paras.en: "We are very thankful for this," he said. "Only [the] United States has this unique intelligence to tell our side when Russia uses ballistic missiles."
paras.zh: “我们对此非常感激，”他说。 “只有美国拥有这种独特的情报，可以在俄罗斯使用弹道导弹时告诉我方。”

paras.en: But Beskrestnov told the BBC that American intelligence continued to be incomplete and inconsistent, and that the US had failed to provide a clear explanation for the issue.
paras.zh: 但别斯克雷斯诺夫告诉BBC，美国情报仍然不完整且不一致，美国未能就这一问题提供明确的解释。

paras.en: "This looks very strange," he said. "Sometimes we receive this information before the attack, another time we [do] not."
paras.zh: “这看起来很奇怪，”他说。 “有时我们会在袭击发生前收到这些信息，有时则不会。”

paras.en: He continued: "And for example, last night we received it, but... one minute before the attack."
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“例如，昨晚我们收到了它，但是……袭击发生前一分钟。”

paras.en: However, he said other collaboration with US continues, adding: "Intelligence data keeps flowing, and the issue is solely with the air raid alert component."
paras.zh: 不过，他表示与美国的其他合作仍在继续，并补充道：“情报数据不断流动，问题仅在于空袭警报部分。”

paras.en: Beskrestnov also said the US had given no clarity about who was responsible for the ongoing restrictions to the Starlink internet network and its military service Starshield, which Kyiv uses to provide connectivity for drones, helicopters and military communications.
paras.zh: 贝斯克雷斯诺夫还表示，美国没有明确说明是谁对星链互联网网络及其军事服务星盾的持续限制负责，基辅利用该服务为无人机、直升机和军事通信提供连接。

paras.en: Last week, Starshield restricted the speed at which mobile units could move while staying connected to the network to 100mph (160km/h).
paras.zh: 上周，Starshield 将移动设备在保持网络连接的情况下移动的速度限制为 100 英里/小时（160 公里/小时）。

paras.en: This has limited Ukraine's ability to shoot down incoming drones or to launch mid-range drone attacks into Russian-occupied areas.
paras.zh: 这限制了乌克兰击落来袭无人机或向俄罗斯占领地区发动中程无人机攻击的能力。

paras.en: Starlink owner Elon Musk said last week that the US government ultimately controls access to Starshield, which was designed for the Pentagon, suggesting it may therefore be behind the restrictions. Trump has denied involvement.
paras.zh: 星链所有者埃隆·马斯克上周表示，美国政府最终控制着为五角大楼设计的星盾的访问权，这表明美国政府可能是这些限制的幕后黑手。特朗普否认参与其中。

paras.en: Beskrestnov said he thought both issues occurring at the same time was "probably" a deliberate move to put pressure on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 贝斯克雷斯诺夫表示，他认为这两个问题同时发生“可能”是故意向乌克兰施压。

paras.en: He told BBC News: "It's probably the United States trying to say [to] us, 'let's have the conversation, negotiation with Russia, you should find the compromise'."
paras.zh: 他告诉英国广播公司新闻：“这可能是美国试图对我们说，‘让我们与俄罗斯进行对话、谈判，你应该找到妥协方案’。”

paras.en: Beskrestnov also said Ukraine had its own radar data to provide some limited warning of incoming attacks, but was urgently looking into using alternative communication systems.
paras.zh: 贝斯克雷斯诺夫还表示，乌克兰拥有自己的雷达数据，可以对即将到来的攻击提供一些有限的警告，但正在紧急考虑使用替代通信系统。

paras.en: He added: "Now we understand that something begins to happen with Starlink, and we're not sure what will be the next step.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“现在我们了解到星链开始发生一些事情，但我们不确定下一步会发生什么。

paras.en: "We understand that we should be prepared for some problems in future. And now we're thinking about an alternative for Starlink, not only for air defence, for communication between our forces, between our staff, for civilians also, because we don't know what we should expect in future regarding Starlink."
paras.zh: “我们明白，我们应该为未来的一些问题做好准备。现在我们正在考虑星链的替代方案，不仅用于防空，还用于我们部队之间、我们的工作人员之间以及平民之间的通信，因为我们不知道未来对星链应该有什么期望。”

paras.en: Earlier on Monday, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there had not been a "pause" to intelligence sharing.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，情报共享并未“暂停”。

paras.en: "I don't know where [Zelensky is] getting these things or why he's saying these things to the press," he told reporters on Monday.
paras.zh: “我不知道（泽伦斯基）从哪里得到这些东西，也不知道他为什么向媒体说这些东西，”他周一告诉记者。

paras.en: Rubio said he could not comment on the incident, adding: "I know a few nights ago there was a software problem involving their early warning system."
paras.zh: 卢比奥表示，他无法对这一事件发表评论，并补充道：“我知道几天前晚上，他们的预警系统出现了软件问题。”

paras.en: The BBC has contacted Starlink for a response.
paras.zh: BBC 已联系 Starlink 寻求回应。

paras.en: A White House official said there were no changes to intelligence sharing operations between the US and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 一名白宫官员表示，美国和乌克兰之间的情报共享行动没有变化。

paras.en: The official spoke on background to discuss intelligence matters. Trump is focused on ending the war, the official said, and added that the US has provided more aid to Ukraine than any other country.
paras.zh: 这位官员在背景发言中讨论了情报问题。这位官员表示，特朗普的重点是结束战争，并补充说美国向乌克兰提供的援助比任何其他国家都多。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

(MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.

Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).

“We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.

EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: SEMA’s FutureTech Studio Returns with ADAS Sessions and More
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The FutureTech Studio will return to the 2026 SEMA Show with more than 20 vehicles and a three-day education program highlighting technologies changing how automotive aftermarket products are designed, developed and brought to market. Topics include advanced powertrains and fuels, artificial intelligence, automated driving technologies and emerging product-development tools.

Located in Central Hall, booth no. 24401, FutureTech Studio will feature vehicles showcasing alternative fuels and EV powertrains, a FutureTech Live Education Stage offering 21 30-minute microlearning sessions across three days and product displays demonstrating solutions to help manufacturers get products to market faster.

“FutureTech Studio is designed to show industry professionals both where automotive technology stands today and where it’s headed, helping attendees evaluate emerging solutions, understand their business implications and identify opportunities to remain competitive,” said Jim Moore, vice president of OEM and product development for SEMA. “Attendees can expect a connected, hands-on environment where they can see technologies up close, talk with experts and experience how innovations are shaping the industry’s future.”

articles.title: INDASA, Save the Rhino International Join Forces
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: INDASA announced it has partnered with Save the Rhino International, a UK-registered charity working to safeguard rhino species and their landscapes. The partnership brings together two organizations connected by a shared symbol: the rhino.

For INDASA, the Rhyno has represented strength, resilience and performance for decades. For Save the Rhino International, the vision is a future where all five rhino species thrive in the wild. The idea is straightforward: the symbol that has represented INDASA for decades should also help protect the species behind it.

At the center of the initiative are INDASA’s Rhynogrip and Rhynostick White Line, both in 150mm and in 125mm. Throughout the campaign, these products will feature bespoke packaging designed to reflect INDASA’s commitment to the partnership with Save the Rhino International and to carry the conservation message to markets around the world.

The special-edition packaging becomes a visible platform for the conservation cause, placing it in the hands of the professionals who use these products every day. Every package sold also contributes directly to rhino conservation, creating a clear connection between a professional-use product and a global environmental cause.

Through its products, packaging, digital communication and international network, INDASA aims to raise awareness of rhino conservation beyond traditional environmental audiences, reaching the body shops and distributors where the cause has never been addressed before.

Save the Rhino International works in partnership with conservation organizations, governments and local communities to conserve rhinos and their landscapes. These collaborations bring together knowledge, expertise and resources to support evidence-based conservation, address the challenges facing rhino populations and secure their long-term recovery.

Through this partnership, INDASA is contributing to those ongoing projects and giving the conservation message a route into an industry outside the organization’s usual reach. The campaign gives industry professionals a way into the cause: by acquiring the products they already use in their surface preparation activities, they contribute to conservation efforts, creating a direct connection between product, people and purpose.

Running for one year, the campaign connects every package sold with a direct contribution to Save the Rhino International’s conservation work. For every campaign box sold, INDASA will donate €0.03 directly to the organization.

The campaign identity captures the connection at the heart of the partnership. “By The Rhyno” represents the means: the strength and reach of INDASA’s own symbol, put behind the cause. “For the Rhino” represents the purpose: raising awareness and supporting the conservation of rhinos and their natural habitats.

The donation matters. So does the attention it brings: rhinos placed in front of professionals who would otherwise never come across the cause, and the reminder that a routine purchase can be part of protecting a species.

articles.title: Takata airbag recall: NHTSA says status of 9% unconfirmed
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) says it “cannot confirm the status” of the remaining 9% of more than 67 million recalled Takata airbags, or whether they remain on U.S. roads.
NHTSA told Repairer Driven News that according to its latest 2024 completion-rate estimates, 91% of the affected airbags had been replaced or were otherwise accounted for.

The Takata airbag inflator recall is the largest safety recall in automotive history and spans worldwide. Issues first came to light in 2008. Vehicles across more than 30 brands are equipped with the airbags, according to NHTSA.
NHTSA says the airbags have killed 28 people and caused at least 400 injuries in the U.S. It linked the 28th death to an incident that occurred in Alabama involving a Honda vehicle.

“NHTSA cannot confirm the status of the remaining 9% or if they remain on U.S. roads,” a NHTSA spokesperson told Repairer Driven News. “NHTSA encourages everyone to check for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or by downloading our SaferCar app. Anyone with an open Takata recall should follow any manufacturer warnings and call their vehicle’s dealership immediately to schedule a free repair.”

The chart below shows the net percentage of airbags remaining for replacement for priority groups 1–12. “Net” refers to the percent remaining from the total airbags count, according to NHTSA. NHTSA includes these groups because vehicle manufacturers have submitted verifiable underlying data.

The chart above specifies the percentage of dispositioned airbags, as approved by NHTSA, including stolen and scrapped vehicles and those exported from the U.S. jurisdiction, according to NHTSA. It also includes vehicles with aftermarket modifications, degraded to the point that the recall remedy cannot be completed, and those to which owners have been nonresponsive to or have affirmatively refused the recall remedy outreach.

The data in this chart begins in 2022 when NHTSA added several reporting categories: nonresponsive, affirmative refusal, aftermarket modification, and vehicle degradation. NHTSA must receive a request before a vehicle manufacturer can submit to these categories. NHTSA notes that not all vehicle manufacturers have been approved for or have requested inclusion in the categories.

Takata, a bankrupt parts supplier, was responsible for manufacturing airbag canisters in defective airbag inflators that can explode and spray sharp metal fragments toward the driver and passengers, comparable to shrapnel from an exploding grenade, which has caused severe injuries and deaths.

According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), propellant in the inflators breaks down after long-term exposure to high temperature fluctuations and humidity. This can cause the propellant to burn too quickly, creating too much pressure and leading to explosions.

As of Aug. 21, Honda says it has voluntarily removed over 535,000 inflators from salvage yards, and the effort continues. The OEM says it has also asked major online auction sites to prohibit and stop any sales of the affected airbags.
A separate group of defective Takata airbags was recalled in late 2019. According to NHTSA, unlike the airbag inflators in the larger Takata recalls, this recall involves non-azide driver inflators.
According to the latest Carfax data, 4.7 million vehicles equipped with recalled Takata airbags remain in the U.S.
Carfax says the number of vehicles on the road with the Takata airbags has dropped 20% from 6 million in 2024.

“Many automakers are working to find owners of vehicles that still have Takata airbags and finally get those airbags replaced,” Carfax states in its September recall tracker report. “Some are even sending teams out across the country to locate affected owners and provide help.

“Despite the drop in affected vehicles, nearly 5 million still need those Takata airbags replaced, and as they get older, they’re more likely to continue to change hands, which makes tracking down the owners more difficult. And some of those vehicles even have ‘do not drive’ orders.”

articles.title: CCC announces its acquisition by GTCR, Elliott
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings announced Thursday that a consortium of private investment firms, led by GTCR and including Elliott Investment Management, will acquire it in an all-cash transaction with an enterprise value of $6.1 billion.
Until the transaction closes, CCC will remain publicly traded and continue operating as an independent company, according to a CCC press release.

“The transaction is not subject to a financing condition,” the release states. “Upon completion of the transaction, CCC will become a privately held company, and its common stock will no longer be listed on the Nasdaq.”
Githesh Ramamurthy, CCC’s chairman and CEO, says Thursday’s announcement “follows a thorough review of strategic options with assistance from our financial and legal advisors.”

The release states that CCC’s Board of Directors approved the transaction, which is expected to close in Q1 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including the receipt of required regulatory approvals and CCC stockholder approval.

“Our Board of Directors is confident this transaction recognizes the strength of the business our team has built while delivering immediate and premium cash value to our stockholders,” said Ramamurthy.

Under the terms of a definitive agreement, CCC stockholders will receive $7.75 in cash for each share of CCC common stock, representing a premium of 44% to CCC’s unaffected closing stock price on July 9, 2026, and a premium of 59% to the 30-day average price as of July 9, 2026.

A press release announcing the acquisition notes that July 9 was the last trading day before media speculation of CCC’s potential sale. At the time, Reuters reported that CCC was “exploring a sale of the company, according to three people familiar with the matter.”
The article stated: “The Chicago-based company has hired Morgan Stanley to advise on a sale process and has reached out to prospective buyers, including private equity firms, the sources said.”
In August, Seeking Alpha, Bloomberg News, and Reuters reported that private equity firms and Copart were reportedly interested in buying CCC.
At the time Repairer Driven News reached out to CCC for comment on the reported interest. A company spokesperson responded, “CCC doesn’t comment on rumors and speculation.”
Now, Ramamurthy says that with the experience and resources GTCR and Elliot provide, CCC will continue to build on its momentum and extend its leadership.

“Throughout CCC’s history, we have helped customers navigate growing complexity and achieve better outcomes through technology and innovation,” he said. “Together, we will accelerate the AI and agentic capabilities our customers want from us, expand the network at the center of our platform, and continue to develop and build our world-class team. I am deeply grateful to our employees for their dedication and commitment to our customers, and I am excited for all that we will accomplish together in this next chapter.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: He shared similar commentary to a Facebook post by CCC announcing the sale.

A Reuters article published after the CCC announcement noted that “earlier this year, the company faced investor concerns over slowing growth, softer claims volumes and a slower-than-expected rollout of some newer software products, which had weighed on its share price.” Meanwhile, the acquiring firms have expressed confidence in CCC’s underlying business and its opportunities for future growth, particularly through artificial intelligence.

When Repairer Driven News asked CCC for comment on its reasoning for the acquisition, CCC reiterated that its Board of Directors approved the transaction and said it “delivers immediate and certain value to shareholders at a significant premium to the unaffected share price.”

“CCC remains a strong business,” a CCC spokesperson said. “Our Board of Directors is confident this transaction recognizes the strength of the business our team has built while delivering immediate and premium cash value to our stockholders. Beyond today’s announcement and related SEC filings, we do not have additional information to share at this time.”
CCC went public in 2021 after announcing its owners at the time, and a Dragoneer Investment Group spinoff had agreed to a merger and subsequent listing of shares on the New York Stock Exchange.

Private equity firm Advent, which owned the majority of CCC at the time, would continue to hold most of the shares once CCC went public. Reuters previously reported that Advent “fully exited its investment in 2025 through a series of secondary share offerings, including the sale of its remaining stake in November.”

On Thursday, Mark Anderson, GTCR media and telecommunications managing director and head of technology, said the PE firm has followed CCC for years and believes it’s “uniquely positioned to support their customers as they increasingly adopt AI solutions to improve decision-making and efficiency across the claims and repair lifecycle.”

“We look forward to partnering with Githesh and the talented CCC team to support continued investment in product innovation and AI capabilities, expand the company’s offerings and build long-term value,” he said. “Our focus will be on helping CCC deliver better outcomes for its customers while supporting CCC’s next phase of growth.”

David Kerko, Elliott’s head of global private equity, added: “We have [a] strong belief in CCC’s position as the trusted third party at the center of the automotive insurance and repair industry. CCC’s role within the large ecosystem of insurers, repair facilities, automakers and parts suppliers creates strong data advantages and network benefits for their more than 35,000 customers. We believe these advantages make CCC a highly durable franchise in vertical software – which AI will only make more valuable as CCC delivers the next generation of capabilities to its customers.”

paras.en: CCC will report its Q3 earnings on Oct. 29 without a conference call and webcast “in light of the pending transaction,” according to the release.

Morgan Stanley & Co. is serving as financial advisor in the transaction. Kirkland & Ellis is serving as legal counsel, and Joele Frank, with Wilkinson Brimmer Katcher, is serving as strategic communications advisor to CCC.

J.P. Morgan is serving as lead financial advisor to GTCR and lead arranger of committed financing for the transaction. Citi is also serving as financial advisor and participating in the committed financing. Simpson, Thacher & Bartlett is serving as GTCR’s legal counsel. Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher and Debevoise & Plimpton are serving as Elliott’s legal counsel.
