articles.title: A Monumental 18th-Century Portrait of a Young Polynesian Man—a 'Supreme Work of Art'—Visits the U.S. for the First Time

paras.en: More than 250 years ago, a young Pacific Islander named Mai made a splash when he arrived in England. He became “a sensation, a star of the press, the darling of the intelligentsia [and] the subject of poems, books, musical plays,” as Hampton Sides wrote in an adapted Smithsonian magazine excerpt of The Exotic: Intrigue and Cultural Ruin in the Age of Imperialism. Joshua Reynolds, a leading portraitist of the day, immortalized Mai’s visit in a massive portrait measuring nearly eight feet tall.
paras.zh: 250多年前，一位名叫Mai的年轻太平洋岛民在抵达英格兰时引起了轰动。汉普顿·赛德斯（ Hampton Sides ）在改编自史密森尼学会的杂志《异国情调：帝国主义时代的阴谋和文化废墟》（ The Exotic: Intrigue and Cultural Ruin in the Age of Imperialism ）的摘录中写道，他成为“轰动一时、新闻界的明星、知识分子的宠儿[和]诗歌、书籍、音乐剧的主题”。当时领先的肖像画家约书亚·雷诺兹（ Joshua Reynolds ）在一幅近8英尺高的大型肖像画中将迈的访问永垂不朽。

paras.en: Now, for the first time, the painting has made its way across the Atlantic. It’s on view now at the Getty Museum in Los Angeles, giving art aficionados in America a chance to witness one of Britain’s most significant early portraits of a person of color.
paras.zh: 现在，这幅画首次横跨大西洋。它现在在洛杉矶的盖蒂博物馆展出，让美国的艺术爱好者有机会见证英国最重要的早期有色人种肖像之一。

paras.en: Mai, also known as Ma‘i or Omai, was a Polynesian man from the island of Raiatea in the South Pacific. After a childhood of hardship, Mai decided to join British explorer James Cook’s second Pacific expedition, aboard the HMS Adventure—a companion ship to the HMS Resolution—under Captain Tobias Furneaux.
paras.zh: Mai ，也被称为Ma 'i或Omai ，是来自南太平洋Raiatea岛的波利尼西亚人。经过童年的艰辛， Mai决定加入英国探险家詹姆斯·库克的第二次太平洋探险队，登上HMS冒险号，这是HMS决议号的伴侣船，由Tobias Furneaux船长率领。

paras.en: After the two ships became separated in a storm in October 1773, Furneaux opted to return to England. When the Adventure sailed into Portsmouth on July 14, 1774, Mai became the first Polynesian to visit Britain.
paras.zh: 1773年10月，两艘船在风暴中分开后， Furneaux选择返回英格兰。当冒险号于1774年7月14日驶入朴茨茅斯时，迈成为第一个访问英国的波利尼西亚人。

paras.en: Joseph Banks, a botanist who had accompanied Cook on his first voyage, became Mai’s patron and chaperone. Over the next two years, Mai became a celebrity of sorts, visiting aristocratic estates, attending concerts and dinner parties, riding horses, hunting and exploring the English countryside. Many Britons assumed he was a Polynesian royal—a misconception Mai did little to correct.
paras.zh: 伴随库克第一次航行的植物学家约瑟夫·班克斯（ Joseph Banks ）成为了麦的赞助人和监护人。在接下来的两年里， Mai成为各种各样的名人，参观贵族庄园，参加音乐会和晚宴，骑马，狩猎和探索英国乡村。许多英国人认为他是波利尼西亚王室成员--这是一个误解， Mai几乎没有纠正。

paras.en: Reynolds is believed to have painted Mai sometime around 1776. He “modeled Mai on ancient Roman senators and military leaders, dressing him in robes reminiscent of Tahitian tapa cloth but with a Roman flair,” Saar Shahar, an English scholar at the University of Southern California, writes for the Conversation. Reynolds depicted the young man barefoot, with a white turban atop his head and intricate tattoos covering his hands.
Mai departed England in 1776 aboard the Resolution and settled on the South Pacific island of Huahine, where he is believed to have died of a virus just a few years later.

The artist evidently loved the portrait so much that he kept it in his studio until he died. From there, it passed into the hands of Frederick Howard, 5th Earl of Carlisle, whose family held onto it for roughly 200 years.

In 2001, Irish business magnate and art collector John Magnier reportedly purchased it for $12.4 million. To keep the painting from being sold abroad, the British government imposed an export ban on the portrait in 2022.

The National Portrait Gallery in London tried to raise enough money to buy the painting outright. But, in 2023, the institution ultimately teamed up with the J. Paul Getty Trust to complete the purchase, with each contributing half of the roughly $62 million price tag.

Nicholas Cullinan, then the director of the National Portrait Gallery, told the New York Times’ Alex Marshall at the time that the portrait is a “supreme work of art” that will likely inspire important conversations about European colonialism.

This year, Davide Gasparotto, senior curator of paintings at the Getty, echoed that sentiment, telling the Los Angeles Times’ Anthony Solorzano that the painting doubles as “an anthropological artifact.”
“It talks about this incredibly important moment of encounter of cultures, sometimes difficult, problematic,” he added.
The unusual joint ownership arrangement for Portrait of Mai means that the painting will travel back and forth between Britain and the United States periodically.

The portrait arrived in California for the first time in July. Conservators from the Getty and Britain's National Portrait Gallery spent weeks studying the painting, ultimately discovering several places where Reynolds had reworked the composition using multiple colors and layers of paint.

“[Reynolds] is notoriously someone that never is satisfied with what he’s done,” Sally Higgs, a conservator for the National Portrait Gallery, told the Los Angeles Times. “And you can really see that in this painting that he just can’t stop—it’s never finished.”

The painting will remain on view at the Getty until March 2027, when the museum is scheduled to close for renovations. It will be transferred to the Getty Villa and will return to the museum in time for the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.
“Joshua Reynolds’ Portrait of Mai and 18th-Century Portraiture” is on view at the Getty Museum in Los Angeles through March 14, 2027.

articles.title: This Ancient Animal Looked Like a Platypus-Otter Hybrid. It's Providing Clues About the Origins of Mammalian Suckling and Swallowing

paras.en: Some 165 million years ago, a predator that looked like a strange mishmash of a platypus and river otter roamed what’s now China. And surprisingly, the now-extinct “chimera” already had certain throat features that define today’s living mammals—even though it wasn’t a true mammal.
paras.zh: 大约1.65亿年前，一种看起来像鸭嘴兽和水獭的奇怪混合物的捕食者漫游在现在的中国。令人惊讶的是，现已灭绝的“嵌合体”已经具有某些喉咙特征，这些特征定义了今天的活哺乳动物，尽管它不是真正的哺乳动物。

paras.en: A well-preserved fossil of the odd creature reveals it could suckle its mother’s milk, researchers report in a study published October 7 in the journal Nature. The specimen represents a previously unknown genus and species, and it’s the earliest known example of a semi-aquatic mammal-like animal.
paras.zh: 研究人员在10月7日发表在《自然》杂志上的一项研究中报告说，保存完好的这种奇怪生物的化石显示，它可以吮吸母乳。该标本代表了一个以前未知的属和物种，它是已知的最早的半水生哺乳动物样动物的例子。

paras.en: “It’s a fascinating specimen,” says Jessica Theodor, a paleontologist at the University of Calgary in Canada who wasn’t involved in the study, to NPR’s Ari Daniel. “The whole setup looks more like what we see in modern mammals.”
paras.zh: “这是一个迷人的标本，”加拿大卡尔加里大学的古生物学家杰西卡·西奥多（ Jessica Theodor ）对NPR的阿里·丹尼尔（ Ari Daniel ）说，她没有参与这项研究。“整个设置看起来更像我们在现代哺乳动物身上看到的。”

paras.en: Scientists discovered the fossil roughly a decade ago in a northern part of China called Inner Mongolia. The animal is estimated to have been around 16 to 20 inches long and weighed roughly 2 to 4.5 pounds. It was a docodont, a member of an extinct group of close relatives to mammals dating back to the Mesozoic Era, some 66 million to 252 million years ago. Researchers named its genus Megacauda in reference to its wide tail and its species sungei in honor of paleontologist Sun Ge.
paras.zh: 大约十年前，科学家在中国北部内蒙古发现了这种化石。据估计，这只动物长约16至20英寸，重约2至4.5磅。这是一种牙形动物，是哺乳动物近亲灭绝群体的成员，可以追溯到中生代，大约6600万至2.52亿年前。研究人员将其巨尾鲸属命名为巨尾鲸，以纪念其宽大的尾巴和其物种Sungei ，以纪念古生物学家孙戈。

paras.en: Digital reconstructions based on CT scans revealed M. sungei had a shockingly modern throat structure. The sharp-toothed creature had small bony projections on the roof of the mouth, which, in modern mammals like humans, support the soft palate. This tissue structure separates the oral cavity from the throat, allowing suckling, swallowing and breathing. What’s more, the researchers found hyoid bones in the throat, which anchor certain muscles and help today’s mammals swallow without the aid of gravity.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The structures suggest M. sungei could chew bits of food and swallow one morsel at a time, rather than shaking its head to jiggle large hunks of food down its throat like a crocodile, according to a statement. Scientists suspect that this evolutionary adaptation allowed mammal species to develop a variety of diets and become carnivores, insectivores, omnivores or herbivores.
paras.zh: 根据一份声明，这些结构表明， M. sungei可以咀嚼食物并一次吞下一口，而不是像鳄鱼一样摇头晃动大块食物。科学家们怀疑，这种进化适应使哺乳动物物种能够发展各种饮食，成为食肉动物、食虫动物、杂食动物或食草动物。

paras.en: The findings also hint that a young animal could suckle its mom’s milk without the liquid entering its nose, a trait that “literally defined our biology,” study co-author Zhe-Xi Luo, a paleontologist at the University of Chicago, tells NPR. “That’s why our group is called mammals. We’re named after the mammary glands,” or milk-producing structures.
paras.zh: 研究结果还暗示，一只年轻的动物可以在不让液体进入鼻子的情况下吮吸母乳，这项特性“从字面上定义了我们的生物学” ，芝加哥大学的古生物学家Zhe-Xi Luo告诉NPR。“这就是为什么我们的团队被称为哺乳动物。我们以乳腺或产奶结构命名。

paras.en: “Neonatal suckling behavior was previously thought of as being a hallmark of advanced mammals,” Sue Hand, a vertebrate paleontologist at the University of New South Wales in Australia who didn’t participate in the study, tells Live Science’s Chris Simms. “But it now appears to have evolved well before then, in the common ancestor of docodontans and mammals at least 165 million years ago.”
paras.zh: “新生儿哺乳行为以前被认为是高级哺乳动物的标志，”澳大利亚新南威尔士大学的脊椎动物古生物学家Sue Hand没有参与这项研究，他告诉Live Science的Chris Simms。“但现在看来，至少在1.65亿年前，牙本质动物和哺乳动物的共同祖先早就已经进化了。”

paras.en: The animal may have navigated its watery environment by using its front legs to paddle, swishing its tail in a wave-like motion and using its hind legs to steer. The fossil represents the earliest evidence of a mammal conducting a partially aquatic lifestyle, study co-author Thomas Martin, a paleontologist at the University of Bonn in Germany, says in a separate statement. The findings suggest that swimming evolved early in the mammal lineage, Luo tells the Australian Broadcasting Corporation’s Peter de Kruijff.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: More broadly, M. sungei sheds light on how early mammal relatives experienced their ecosystems while living alongside dinosaurs.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说， M. sungei揭示了早期哺乳动物亲属在与恐龙生活在一起时如何体验其生态系统。

paras.en: It’s “cool to see that this sister lineage to today’s mammals had evolved an aquatic lifestyle, which is something we have seen multiple times across the mammalian family tree, including in the platypus,” says Oliver Griffith, an evolutionary biologist at Macquarie University in Australia who wasn’t involved in the study, to New Scientist’s James Woodford.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚麦考瑞大学（ Macquarie University ）的进化生物学家奥利弗·格里菲斯（ Oliver Griffith ）对《新科学家》（ New Scientist ）杂志的詹姆斯·伍德福德（ James Woodford ）说： “很高兴看到今天哺乳动物的这个姊妹谱系进化出了一种水生生活方式，这是我们在哺乳动物家谱中多次看到的，包括在鸭嘴兽中。”

articles.title: Small Dogs Tend to Live Longer Than Big Dogs. Scientists Say They Might Finally Know Why—and It Goes to the Molecular Level

paras.en: A Great Dane is lucky to see its 10th birthday, while a Chihuahua might live to celebrate its 20th. But exactly why smaller dogs tend to live longer than their larger counterparts has long been a mystery.
paras.zh: 大丹犬很幸运能看到它的10岁生日，而吉娃娃可能活着庆祝它的20岁生日。但是，为什么体型较小的狗往往比体型较大的狗活得更长，长期以来一直是个谜。

paras.en: Now, new research suggests the differences may stem, in part, from what’s happening at the molecular level. A study published October 8 in the journal Science suggests big dogs’ cells age faster because of changes that allow potentially harmful “jumping genes” to move around their genomes, or complete sets of genetic instructions.
paras.zh: 现在，新的研究表明，这种差异可能部分源于分子水平上发生的事情。10月8日发表在《科学》杂志上的一项研究表明，大狗的细胞衰老更快，因为它们的变化允许潜在有害的“跳跃基因”在基因组中移动，或者完成一套遗传指令。

paras.en: The work is “fascinating,” Borbála Turcsán, an animal behavior researcher at Eötvös Loránd University in Hungary who was not involved with the study, tells Nature’s Heidi Ledford. “It provides a molecular background for something we also observe at a behavioral level.”
paras.zh: 匈牙利Eötvös Loránd大学的动物行为研究员Borbála Turcsán没有参与这项研究，他告诉自然界的Heidi Ledford ，这项工作“令人着迷”。“它为我们在行为层面观察到的东西提供了分子背景。”

paras.en: Researchers behind the new study used data from the Dog Aging Project, a citizen science initiative in which participating dog owners and their veterinarians regularly share information about their pup’s health, behavior, environment and physical activity. Founded in 2014, the project has since enrolled roughly 55,000 canine companions of various breeds.
paras.zh: 这项新研究背后的研究人员使用了狗老化项目的数据，这是一项公民科学计划，参与的狗主人和他们的兽医定期分享有关幼犬健康、行为、环境和身体活动的信息。该项目成立于2014年，迄今已招募了大约55,000只不同品种的犬类伴侣。

paras.en: Scientists analyzed the DNA of 894 pet dogs spanning diverse breeds and body sizes. More specifically, they looked at methyl groups, or chemical tags on DNA that scientists often use as biological markers of aging. Methyl groups are part of the epigenome, chemical changes that regulate gene activity—controlling which genes are turned on or off—without affecting the underlying genetic code. Factors like diet, exercise, stress and pollutants can alter the epigenome.
paras.zh: 科学家分析了894只宠物狗的DNA ，这些狗的品种和体型各不相同。更具体地说，他们研究了科学家经常用作衰老生物标志物的DNA上的甲基或化学标签。甲基是表观基因组的一部分，表观基因组是调节基因活性的化学变化，在不影响底层遗传密码的情况下控制哪些基因被打开或关闭。饮食、运动、压力和污染物等因素会改变表观基因组。

paras.en: They also looked at detailed demographic and genetic information. Using correlations between DNA methylation patterns and chronological age, they developed a molecular clock that could predict a dog’s age with a median error of less than one year based on its epigenome.
paras.zh: 他们还查看了详细的人口统计和遗传信息。利用DNA甲基化模式与实际年龄之间的相关性，他们开发了一种分子钟，可以根据表观基因组预测狗的年龄，中位误差小于一年。

paras.en: Analyses revealed that larger dogs tend to accumulate epigenetic changes associated with aging more quickly than small dogs, and that male dogs also tend to accrue these modifications faster than female dogs, even if they were neutered at a young age. In other words, both big dogs and male dogs showed signs of accelerated molecular aging. The study also found that dogs whose biological age was older than their chronological age were at greater risk of early death.
paras.zh: 分析显示，与小型犬相比，大型犬倾向于更快地积累与衰老相关的表观遗传变化，而雄性犬也倾向于比雌性犬更快地积累这些修饰，即使它们在年轻时被绝育。换句话说，大型犬和雄性犬都表现出加速分子老化的迹象。该研究还发现，生物学年龄大于实际年龄的狗有更大的早期死亡风险。

paras.en: Did you know? World’s tallest and shortest dogs
paras.zh: 你知道吗？世界上最高和最矮的狗

paras.en: In 2025, the world’s tallest dog, a 3-foot-3 Great Dane named Reggie, and the world’s shortest dog, a 3.6-inch-tall Chihuahua named Pearl, met up for an adorable playdate.
paras.zh: 2025年，世界上最高的狗，一只3英尺3英寸的大丹犬名叫雷吉，世界上最矮的狗，一只3.6英寸高的吉娃娃名叫珍珠，相遇在一个可爱的玩耍约会。

paras.en: In large dogs, this faster molecular aging trajectory seems to be related to “jumping genes,” also known as transposable elements, or DNA sequences that can move from one location in a genome to another. These rogue sequences can interfere with normal gene function, leading to a variety of health problems, as well as inflammation and aging.
paras.zh: 在大型犬中，这种更快的分子老化轨迹似乎与“跳跃基因”有关，也称为转座因子，或可以从基因组中的一个位置移动到另一个位置的DNA序列。这些流氓序列会干扰正常的基因功能，导致各种健康问题，以及炎症和衰老。

paras.en: Methyl groups help keep jumping genes in place. The study suggests that large dogs tend to lose these methyl groups more rapidly as they age, which might make it easier for jumping genes to hop around and disrupt gene function.
paras.zh: 甲基有助于保持基因的跳跃。该研究表明，随着年龄的增长，大型犬倾向于更快地失去这些甲基，这可能使跳跃基因更容易跳跃并破坏基因功能。

paras.en: “Large dogs show a faster-moving DNA methylation aging signature in blood, and that this acceleration is especially strong in parts of the genome that normally help keep ‘jumping genes’ quiet,” study co-author Noah Snyder-Mackler, a genomicist at Arizona State University, tells Reuters’ Marta Serafinko. In such canines, “methylation at those regions appears to erode more quickly with age, as if the genome is losing some of the tape or clamps that keep these mobile elements suppressed.”
paras.zh: 研究合著者、亚利桑那州立大学基因组学家诺亚·斯奈德-麦克勒（ Noah Snyder-Mackler ）告诉路透社的Marta Serafinko ： “大型犬在血液中表现出更快的DNA甲基化老化特征，这种加速在通常有助于保持‘跳跃基因’安静的基因组部分尤其强大。”在这些犬科动物中， “这些区域的甲基化似乎随着年龄的增长而更快地侵蚀，就好像基因组正在失去一些保持这些可移动元件被抑制的胶带或钳子。”

paras.en: Humans may have inadvertently sent big dogs down their accelerated molecular aging path, Snyder-Mackler adds. By breeding dogs to grow and reach their large adult sizes quickly, we may have unknowingly shortened their life spans.
paras.zh: Snyder-Mackler补充说，人类可能无意中将大型犬送上了加速分子衰老的道路。通过饲养狗快速生长并迅速达到大型成年犬，我们可能在不知不觉中缩短了它们的寿命。

paras.en: “Their bodies have to make this trade-off between really rapid growth and maintenance of that, versus investment in the immune system and integrity of the organism,” Snyder-Mackler tells Live Science’s R.J. Mackenzie, adding that, for now, this is just a hypothesis.
paras.zh: Snyder-Mackler告诉Live Science的R.J. Mackenzie ， “他们的身体必须在真正的快速生长和维持之间做出权衡，而不是对免疫系统和生物完整性的投资，”他补充说，就目前而言，这只是一个假设。

paras.en: In male dogs, meanwhile, the study suggests epigenetic changes on the X sex chromosome might be driving their accelerated molecular aging. Male dogs typically have one copy of the X chromosome, while female dogs usually have two—and the researchers think the extra copy might help female dogs stave off some of these aging-related epigenetic changes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在雄性狗中，该研究表明X性染色体上的表观遗传变化可能推动了它们加速的分子老化。雄性狗通常有一个X染色体拷贝，而雌性狗通常有两个，研究人员认为额外的拷贝可能有助于雌性狗避免这些与衰老相关的表观遗传变化。

paras.en: “This was an unexpected result,” study co-author Brianah McCoy, a biologist now at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill who conducted the research at Arizona State University, says in a statement. “It challenges some of our assumptions about how the X chromosome is regulated and highlights the complexity of epigenetic aging.”
paras.zh: “这是一个意想不到的结果，”该研究的共同作者，现任北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校的生物学家，在亚利桑那州立大学进行这项研究的Brianah McCoy在一份声明中说。“它挑战了我们关于X染色体如何调节的一些假设，并突出了表观遗传衰老的复杂性。”

paras.en: The molecular aging differences between males and females appear to be distinct from the aging-related differences between big dogs and small dogs, so Snyder-Mackler considers it “a separate biology that needs follow-up, rather than the same mechanism in disguise,” he tells Reuters.
paras.zh: 他告诉路透社，雄性和雌性之间的分子衰老差异似乎与大型犬和小型犬之间与衰老相关的差异不同，因此Snyder-Mackler认为这是“需要随访的单独生物学，而不是伪装的相同机制”。

paras.en: Additionally, while the study finds an association between DNA methylation patterns and longevity in dogs, it doesn’t establish whether or how these patterns contribute to aging. Researchers hope to use this paper as a jumping-off point to learn more about the relationship between DNA methylation and aging in canines.
paras.zh: 此外，虽然该研究发现狗的DNA甲基化模式与长寿之间存在关联，但并未确定这些模式是否或如何导致衰老。研究人员希望利用这篇论文作为起点，更多地了解犬类DNA甲基化与衰老之间的关系。

paras.en: Moving forward, the findings might one day lead to developments that could help extend the life spans of larger dogs. There “may be processes we can measure, follow over time and potentially modify before disease appears,” Snyder-Mackler tells Reuters. However, even if scientists find a way to slow down molecular aging, it wouldn’t be a cure-all. Large dogs would still face breed-specific risks that might affect their longevity, Snyder-Mackler notes.
paras.zh: 展望未来，这些发现可能有一天会导致有助于延长大型犬寿命的发展。Snyder-Mackler告诉路透社， “在疾病出现之前，我们可以测量、跟踪并可能进行修改的过程。”然而，即使科学家找到了减缓分子衰老的方法，也不是万灵药。斯奈德-麦克勒指出，大型犬仍将面临可能影响其寿命的特定品种风险。

paras.en: Longer term, the research could even have implications for human aging. In the meantime, however, methylation changes are probably more like wrinkles—evidence that someone is getting older, but not an underlying cause of aging.
paras.zh: 从长远来看，这项研究甚至可能对人类衰老产生影响。然而，与此同时，甲基化变化可能更像是皱纹-证明某人正在变老，但不是衰老的根本原因。

paras.en: “Wrinkles are certainly diagnostic of aging,” Trey Ideker, a biologist at the University of Oxford in England who was not involved with the study, tells Nature. “There’s a big business in curing wrinkles. But is that going to cure aging? Probably not.”
paras.zh: “皱纹当然可以诊断衰老，”英国牛津大学的生物学家Trey Ideker告诉《自然》杂志，他没有参与这项研究。“治疗皱纹是一项大生意。但这能治愈衰老吗？可能不会。”

articles.title: Magnesium May Not Reach Your Brain, Despite Supplement Label Promises
articles.author: Adam Obr

paras.en: Most of us probably don’t think about how much magnesium we’re consuming, but our bodies couldn’t function without it. We each typically contain about 25 grams of magnesium, more than half of which is stockpiled in bones. The rest is distributed in cells throughout the body, taking part in hundreds of essential chemical reactions, including building DNA and proteins and sending signals within our nervous systems and between our brains and the rest of our bodies.
paras.zh: 我们大多数人可能不会考虑我们消耗了多少镁，但如果没有它，我们的身体就无法运作。我们每个人通常含有约 25 克镁，其中一半以上储存在骨骼中。其余的分布在全身的细胞中，参与数百种重要的化学反应，包括构建 DNA 和蛋白质，以及在我们的神经系统内以及我们的大脑和身体其他部位之间发送信号。

paras.en: But just because our cells—and especially our neurons—need magnesium doesn't mean that extra magnesium will make them function any better. Not only that, but ingesting more of the element doesn’t mean it’s reaching your brain or really any specific part of your body.
paras.zh: 但仅仅因为我们的细胞——尤其是我们的神经元——需要镁并不意味着额外的镁会让它们发挥更好的功能。不仅如此，摄入更多的元素并不意味着它会到达您的大脑或身体的任何特定部位。

paras.en: In supplement pills, magnesium isn’t just on its own but part of a compound usually called a “magnesium salt.” This must dissolve to release Mg²⁺, the ionic version that our bodies use. How much of this actually gets into your system—versus gets excreted—depends on a variety of factors including the dose, your stomach contents, and how much magnesium is already in your body. In other words, the higher the dose, the less magnesium gets absorbed.
paras.zh: 在补充剂药丸中，镁不仅是其本身，而且是通常称为“镁盐”的化合物的一部分。它必须溶解以释放 Mg²⁺，这是我们身体使用的离子版本。其中有多少实际上进入您的系统（与排出体外）取决于多种因素，包括剂量、您的胃内容物以及您体内已有的镁含量。换句话说，剂量越高，吸收的镁就越少。

paras.en: That’s all if the supplement dissolves in the first place. Magnesium oxide, which is usually the basis of the cheapest pills offered, doesn’t break down all that easily. In reality, magnesium oxide supplements mostly act as laxatives, drawing water into the intestines to flush out the excess salt.
paras.zh: 如果补充剂一开始就溶解了，这就是全部。氧化镁通常是最便宜的药丸的基础，它不会轻易分解。实际上，氧化镁补充剂主要起到泻药的作用，将水吸入肠道以冲走多余的盐。

paras.en: This is where the marketing comes in. There are other types of magnesium compounds that do dissolve better. Magnesium citrate, for example, has been shown to have the highest bioavailability in laboratory tests. Despite the fact that all these salts still break down in the intestine, some supplement labels also claim that their specific chemical blend targets the magnesium directly to certain parts of your body, like your muscles or your brain.
paras.zh: 这就是市场营销的用武之地。还有其他类型的镁化合物溶解性更好。例如，在实验室测试中，柠檬酸镁已被证明具有最高的生物利用度。尽管所有这些盐仍然在肠道中分解，但一些补充剂标签还声称，它们的特定化学混合物将镁直接靶向身体的某些部位，如肌肉或大脑。

paras.en: These claims are often based on experiments using rodents, and the animals are typically supplied with magnesium long-term at higher doses than found in a pill. One study in rats found that a salt called magnesium L-threonate increased the amount of magnesium in the brain and improved some manifestations of learning and memory. This is the basis of some of the more overzealous marketing in the supplement world, which proclaims that this special salt will take the magnesium right to your brain.
paras.zh: 这些说法通常基于使用啮齿动物的实验，并且通常以高于药丸中发现的剂量长期向动物提供镁。一项针对大鼠的研究发现，一种名为L-苏氨酸镁的盐增加了大脑中的镁含量，并改善了学习和记忆的一些表现。这是补充剂世界中一些过度热情的营销的基础，它宣称这种特殊的盐会把镁带到你的大脑中。

paras.en: There are some human studies, but that’s not really what they say. A few small randomized trials reporting improvements in some cognitive tests or sleep have been conducted—but there are several important caveats. Some studies tested a mixture of substances, lasted for only a few weeks, or analyzed a very limited number of outcomes. Many of these studies can also not be considered independent, because they were funded by supplement manufacturers or led by their staff.
paras.zh: 有一些人类研究，但事实并非如此。一些小型随机试验报告了一些认知测试或睡眠的改善，但有几个重要的警告。一些研究测试了多种物质的混合物，只持续了几周，或者分析了非常有限的结果。其中许多研究也不能被认为是独立的，因为它们是由补充剂制造商资助或由其员工领导的。

paras.en: Moreover, the studies—for extremely understandable reasons—didn't measure magnesium content in the brain. So maybe a little more sneaks into your gray matter, but based on the scientific understanding of how these salts are processed, in all likelihood, a brain-focused magnesium supplement is still just an expensive laxative.
paras.zh: 此外，由于极其可理解的原因，这些研究并未测量大脑中的镁含量。因此，也许更多地潜入你的灰质，但基于对这些盐如何加工的科学理解，以大脑为中心的镁补充剂很可能仍然只是一种昂贵的泻药。

paras.en: This story originally appeared on WIRED Czech Republic and Slovakia and has been translated from Czech.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初出现在WIRED捷克共和国和斯洛伐克，并已从捷克翻译。

articles.title: Climate Change Has It In for the World’s Best Surfing
articles.author: Damian Carrington

paras.en: This story originally appeared on The Guardian and is part of the Climate Desk collaboration.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初出现在《卫报》上，是气候台合作的一部分。

paras.en: The climate crisis is coming for some of the world’s greatest surf breaks, submerging some as sea level rises and wiping out others as classic breaks get crushed against coastal developments.
paras.zh: 世界上一些最大的冲浪胜地即将面临气候危机，随着海平面上升，一些冲浪胜地被淹没，而随着沿海开发的破坏，经典的冲浪胜地被淹没，另一些冲浪胜地也被淹没。

paras.en: Analysis of dozens of famous waves in World Surfing Reserves (WSR) found that more than three-quarters were at high risk because of changing tide levels, hardened shorelines, and shifting sands.
paras.zh: 对世界冲浪保护区（ WSR ）数十个著名浪潮的分析发现，由于潮位变化、海岸线变硬和沙流，超过四分之三的人处于高风险之中。

paras.en: The impacts matter not only to the surfers catching the waves but also to the communities that depend on the multibillion-dollar surf economy, often located in places with little else.
paras.zh: 这些影响不仅对冲浪者来说很重要，而且对依赖数十亿美元冲浪经济的社区也很重要，这些社区通常位于没有其他东西的地方。

paras.en: The waves rated at most risk in the study include the “bombing barrels” of Croyde Beach in North Devon, UK; the point breaks at Noosa in Australia and Oriente Salvaje, El Salvador; and Santa Cruz reefs of California such as Sewer Peak and Wind and Sea.
paras.zh: 研究中风险最大的海浪包括英国北德文郡克罗伊德海滩的“轰炸桶” ；澳大利亚的努萨和萨尔瓦多的东萨尔瓦多；以及加利福尼亚州的圣克鲁斯珊瑚礁，如下水道峰和风和海。

paras.en: The best surfing waves are created by intricate combinations of seafloor shape, swell direction, and tide. “Surf breaks are incredibly unique oceanographic phenomena—a confluence of all these factors that fit together just right to make the wave happen—and so those processes are really sensitive,” said Dan Reineman, an associate professor at California State University Channel Islands and a coauthor of the study.
paras.zh: 最好的冲浪波是由海底形状、膨胀方向和潮汐的复杂组合创造的。加利福尼亚州立大学海峡群岛分校副教授、该研究的合著者Dan Reineman说： “冲浪休息是非常独特的海洋现象--所有这些因素恰好结合在一起，使浪潮发生，因此这些过程非常敏感。”

paras.en: Global heating is pushing up sea level and changing rainfall patterns that affect sediment movement, which can upset the delicate balance and destroy the wave. However, the researchers said the expert local knowledge of surfers could be tapped to help protect the waves.
paras.zh: 全球变暖正在推高海平面并改变影响沉积物运动的降雨模式，这可能会破坏微妙的平衡并破坏波浪。然而，研究人员表示，可以利用冲浪者对当地的专业知识来帮助保护海浪。

paras.en: Trent Hodges, a coauthor of the study and a senior programs manager at Save the Waves Coalition, which launched the WSR program in 2009, said: “Climate change will impact surf breaks all over the world in different ways, depending on their unique geographies. We learned directly from the local surfers how they are seeing their waves change. It’s a canary in the coal mine too—when a wave changes, that often means the beach is changing, and everybody enjoys the beach.”
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、拯救波浪联盟 (Save the Waves Coalition) 的高级项目经理特伦特·霍奇斯 (Trent Hodges) 表示：“气候变化将以不同的方式影响世界各地的冲浪点，具体取决于其独特的地理位置。我们直接从当地冲浪者那里了解了他们如何看待波浪的变化。这也是煤矿里的金丝雀——当波浪变化时，通常意味着海滩正在变化，每个人都可以享受其中的乐趣。”海滩。”

paras.en: The study, published in the journal Climatic Change, concludes: “Climate change and coastal management both have significant negative implications for the future viability of multiple surf breaks of global significance and, therefore, the myriad distinct local communities, cultures and economies they support.”
paras.zh: 这项发表在《气候变化》杂志上的研究得出的结论是：“气候变化和沿海管理都对具有全球意义的多个冲浪点的未来生存能力产生重大负面影响，因此也对它们所支持的无数独特的当地社区、文化和经济产生重大负面影响。”

paras.en: Almost 200 local experts analyzed 57 surf breaks in all but two of the 13 WSRs, spread across eight countries. The researchers said thousands of other surf waves around the world faced similar peril.
paras.zh: 近200名当地专家分析了分布在八个国家/地区的13个WSR中除两个之外的所有57个冲浪点。研究人员表示，世界各地成千上万的其他冲浪浪潮也面临着类似的危险。

paras.en: A key finding was that where coastlines were more natural, they could adapt better to the changes brought by the climate crisis, by shifting inland and relocating sediments. Development such as sea walls, jetties, and groynes made the beaches and waves less resilient, Reineman said.
paras.zh: 一个关键的发现是，在海岸线更自然的地方，它们可以通过转移内陆和转移沉积物，更好地适应气候危机带来的变化。Reineman说，海堤、码头和groynes等开发项目使海滩和海浪的弹性降低。

paras.en: Adam Hall, a cofounder of the North Devon WSR, was one of the local surfers who contributed to the study. He said: “North Devon is so special. We have Saunton Sands, a world-renowned longboarding wave with really long, mellow rides, and the UK’s best beach break at Croyde. We’ve got left- and right-hand point breaks and a sheltered spot for when it gets too windy and too big. Whatever you want to do, we’ve got it.”
paras.zh: 北德文郡 WSR 的联合创始人 Adam Hall 是参与这项研究的当地冲浪者之一。他说：“北德文郡非常特别。我们有桑顿沙滩 (Saunton Sands)，这是世界著名的长板冲浪胜地，具有真正漫长而柔和的滑道，还有英国最好的克罗伊德 (Croyde) 海滩休息点。我们有左手和右手休息点，以及在风势太大或太大时避风的地方。无论您想做什么，我们都能满足。”

paras.en: He said surfing was very important for the local economy, and not just in summer. “Surfers will come throughout the year. They fill up the pubs, restaurants, and car parks when the swells are good in January, February, and March, where if you go to any other tourist destination that doesn’t have surf, they’re dead on their knees.”
paras.zh: 他说，冲浪对当地经济非常重要，不仅仅是在夏天。“冲浪者全年都会来。当1月、2月和3月天气晴朗时，他们会挤满酒吧、餐厅和停车场，如果你去任何其他没有冲浪的旅游目的地，他们就会跪倒在地。”

articles.title: Valerion VisionMaster Max 4K Projector Review: Looks Great, Sounds OK
articles.author: Chris Haslam

paras.en: Valerion’s VisionMaster Kickstarter campaign raised more than $8 million in 2024, making it the most-funded campaign on the platform that year. After spending the past few weeks with the flagship VisionMaster Max, I’m confident there are plenty of satisfied backers.
paras.zh: Valerion 的 VisionMaster Kickstarter 活动在 2024 年筹集了超过 800 万美元，成为当年该平台上资金最多的活动。在过去几周使用旗舰产品 VisionMaster Max 后，我相信有很多满意的支持者。

paras.en: At $3,999, it costs far more than excellent point-and-play rivals, such as the Nebula X1 (9/10 WIRED Recommends), but considerably less than native 4K home-theater projectors from brands like Sony and JVC. That leaves the Max straddling two very different camps.
paras.zh: 它的售价为3,999 $ ，远远高于Nebula X1 （ 9/10有线推荐）等优秀的点播竞争对手，但远低于索尼和JVC等品牌的原生4K家庭影院投影仪。这使得Max跨越了两个截然不同的阵营。

paras.en: Its compact design, built-in Google TV, and automated setup suggest the classification of a premium lifestyle projector, while optical zoom, vertical lens shift, a mechanical iris, and sophisticated black-level processing point toward something far more capable. It’s easy to use and almost too pretty to ceiling-mount, but arguably too sophisticated to spend its life propped up on a side table. So the question remains: Who is the VisionMaster Max actually for?
paras.zh: 其紧凑的设计、内置的Google TV和自动设置建议对高端生活方式投影仪进行分类，而光学变焦、垂直镜头移位、机械虹膜和复杂的黑色处理则指向更强大的功能。它易于使用，几乎太漂亮了，无法安装在天花板上，但可以说太复杂了，无法在边桌上度过余生。所以问题仍然存在： VisionMaster Max实际上是为谁设计的？

paras.en: The 16.5-pound VisionMaster Max is simple to get up and running. Google TV grants instant access to many streaming services, while auto-keystone and autofocus make positioning a frictionless process. (However, because keystone correction digitally reshapes the image, when used heavily, it can reduce resolution—but that's true for all devices with the feature.) Optical zoom, with a 0.9 to 1.5:1 throw ratio, lets you resize the picture without moving the projector. There's also vertical lens shift, which moves the image up or down without needing to resort to digital correction. All of this means that if you’ve got a blank wall and five minutes, you can stream Emily in Paris on a 90-inch screen in no time.
paras.zh: 16.5 磅重的 VisionMaster Max 易于安装和运行。 Google TV 允许即时访问许多流媒体服务，而自动梯形校正和自动对焦使定位过程变得毫无摩擦。 （但是，由于梯形校正以数字方式重塑图像，因此大量使用时，可能会降低分辨率，但对于所有具有该功能的设备都是如此。）光学变焦具有 0.9 至 1.5:1 的投射比，让您无需移动投影仪即可调整图片大小。还有垂直镜头移位，可以向上或向下移动图像，而无需诉诸数字校正。所有这一切意味着，如果您有一堵空白墙，只需五分钟，您就可以立即在 90 英寸的屏幕上直播《艾米丽在巴黎》。

articles.title: Orlando Jones: Papa Legba finally offers answers to 'AHS 13'

paras.en: NEW YORK, Oct. 18 (UPI) -- American Gods and Sleepy Hollow alum Orlando Jones says he was happy to learn his American Horror Story 13 character Papa Legba, gatekeeper to the underworld, would be the one to finally answer some of the show's biggest questions in Episode 10.
paras.zh: 纽约，10 月 18 日（合众国际社）——《美国众神》和《断头谷》的演员奥兰多·琼斯表示，他很高兴得知《美国恐怖故事 13》中的角色 Papa Legba（黑社会的看门人）将在第 10 集中最终回答剧中一些最大的问题。

paras.en: This weekend's installment saw Papa Legba revealing to a coven of witches -- played by Angela Bassett, Jessica Lange, Sarah Paulson, Emma Roberts and Billie Lourd -- that Satan bet God long ago that if the devil could survive 100 years in a human body, he would be given Heaven, Earth and Hell to rule.
paras.zh: 在本周末的剧集中，爸爸雷格巴向由安吉拉·贝塞特、杰西卡·兰格、莎拉·保尔森、艾玛·罗伯茨和比莉·洛德饰演的一群女巫透露，撒旦很久以前就跟上帝打赌，如果魔鬼能在人体内存活 100 年，他就会被赐予天堂、地球和地狱来统治。

paras.en: Now that he is 97, the devil and his minions are wreaking havoc, trying to eliminate anyone, including the witches, who might keep him from achieving his goal.
paras.zh: 现在他已经 97 岁了，魔鬼和他的爪牙正在肆意破坏，试图消灭任何可能阻止他实现目标的人，包括女巫。

paras.en: "I laughed because everybody kept saying, 'I don't know what the hell's going on,'" Jones, 58, told UPI in a recent Zoom interview.
paras.zh: “我笑了，因为每个人都在说，‘我不知道到底发生了什么，’”58 岁的琼斯在最近的 Zoom 采访中告诉合众国际社。

paras.en: "I was like, 'I know exactly what's going on.' It was fun. I think a lot of it was a relief. But a fun character and exciting and crazily and wonderfully written by Ryan [Murphy] and Charlie [Carver] and the guys."
paras.zh: “我当时想，‘我完全知道发生了什么事。’很有趣。我认为这在很大程度上是一种解脱。但这是一个有趣的角色，由瑞恩（墨菲）和查理（卡弗）和其他人写得令人兴奋、疯狂和精彩。”

paras.en: The role was previously played in Seasons 3 and 8 by Lance Reddick, who died in 2023 at the age of 60.
paras.zh: 该角色之前由兰斯·雷迪克在第 3 季和第 8 季中扮演，他于 2023 年去世，享年 60 岁。

paras.en: "Taking over the role from a close friend of mine was a crazy, emotional roller coaster at the same time," Jones said.
paras.zh: 琼斯说：“从我的一位密友手中接过这个角色，就像坐过山车一样疯狂、情绪激动。”

paras.en: "Lance was so calm and still and I loved that," Jones added, noting Papa is in a different place emotionally in Season 13.
paras.zh: “兰斯非常平静，我很喜欢这一点，”琼斯补充道，并指出爸爸在第 13 季中的情感状态有所不同。

paras.en: "This guy's agitated. This guy is pissed. He is fit to be tied from the start. Somebody's missing from Hell. I didn't know they were gone. There's apparently a loophole."
paras.zh: “这家伙很激动。这家伙很生气。他从一开始就适合被绑起来。有人从地狱失踪了。我不知道他们已经走了。显然有漏洞。”

paras.en: Most of Jones' scenes place Papa Legba in the middle of a mansion powerfully explaining to the witches the rules of lost magic.
paras.zh: 琼斯的大部分场景都将雷格巴老爹置于宅邸中央，有力地向女巫们解释失落魔法的规则。

paras.en: Despite the fact that he has tons of lines and is surrounded by famous actresses, Jones said he didn't feel like he was under tremendous pressure.
paras.zh: 尽管台词很多，而且周围都是著名女演员，琼斯说他并不觉得自己承受着巨大的压力。

paras.en: "No, no. Angela and I did Fences together years ago. So, there's a familiarity there," he said.
paras.zh: “不，不。安吉拉和我几年前一起拍过《栅栏》。所以，那里有一种熟悉感，”他说。

paras.en: "Sarah, I hadn't worked with, but, obviously, I am a massive fan of hers and, to be completely honest, little me, King Kong fan me, completely agrees with Kong that if you were going to chase someone around New York and tear the whole damn city up, Jessica Lange is the right choice [to do that for]. I concur. She's wonderful and lovely."
paras.zh: “莎拉，我没有和她合作过，但是，显然，我是她的超级粉丝，说实话，小我，金刚粉丝，完全同意金刚的观点，如果你要在纽约追一个人，撕毁整个该死的城市，杰西卡·兰格是正确的选择。我同意。她很棒，很可爱。”

paras.en: Jones credited the artists who designed his costumes, hair and makeup for helping him breathe life into the character.
paras.zh: 琼斯称赞设计他的服装、发型和化妆的艺术家帮助他为这个角色注入了生命。

paras.en: "From the hat pushed way down on my head to the dreadlocks to the layered necklaces and the nails, the teeth, the red eyes, it allows me to really sink into him," Jones said.
paras.zh: “从低垂在我头上的帽子，到辫子，再到层叠的项链、指甲、牙齿、红眼睛，这让我真正融入了他，”琼斯说。

paras.en: "I was so in love with it that I would stay in the whole get-up all day."
paras.zh: “我非常喜欢它，所以我会整天穿着整套衣服。”

articles.title: Sen. Schiff says suspicious envelope addressed to office intercepted

paras.en: Oct. 18 (UPI) -- Sen. Adam Schiff announced Sunday that at least one envelope containing "a suspicious substance" was mailed to his offices in California amid a surge in similar mailings targeting elected officials of both parties.
paras.zh: 10 月 18 日（UPI）——参议员亚当·希夫周日宣布，至少有一个含有“可疑物质”的信封被邮寄到他在加利福尼亚州的办公室，而针对两党民选官员的类似邮件激增。

paras.en: The Democratic senator from California said he was notified that at least one such letter addressed to one of his offices was intercepted by U.S. Capitol Police and the Senate Sergeant at Arms.
paras.zh: 这位来自加利福尼亚州的民主党参议员表示，他接到通知，美国国会警察和参议院武装警官截获了至少一封写给他的办公室的此类信件。

paras.en: "This attempt to intimidate elected officials and our staff will not succeed," he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“这种恐吓民选官员和我们工作人员的企图不会成功。”

paras.en: "We instead condemn these threats as antithetical to the values of our nation, recommit to our work and thank the law enforcement and postal officials who are helping keep our teams safe."
paras.zh: “相反，我们谴责这些威胁与我们国家的价值观相悖，重新致力于我们的工作，并感谢帮助保障我们团队安全的执法人员和邮政官员。”

paras.en: A number of elected officials have reported being targeted by suspicious mail since Tuesday, when Louisiana Secretary of State Nancy Landry and the Oklahoma State Election Board reported receiving envelopes containing a suspicious white powder. Ohio Secretary of State Frank laRosa said Wednesday that U.S. Postal Service investigators intercepted a similar letter intended for his office.
paras.zh: 自周二以来，一些民选官员报告成为可疑邮件的目标，当时路易斯安那州国务卿南希·兰德里和俄克拉荷马州选举委员会报告称收到了含有可疑白色粉末的信封。俄亥俄州国务卿弗兰克·拉罗萨周三表示，美国邮政局调查人员截获了一封寄给他办公室的类似信件。

paras.en: Dozens of members of Congress have been the targets of such letters, including Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas, Susan Collins of Maine, Mike Rounds of South Dakota and Pete Ricketts of Nebraska and Rep. Gil Cisneros, who late last week posted a picture of a white-gloved hand holding an envelope with his name and address handwritten on it to social media.
paras.zh: 数十名国会议员成为此类信件的目标，其中包括德克萨斯州参议员特德·克鲁兹、缅因州参议员苏珊·柯林斯、南达科他州参议员迈克·朗兹、内布拉斯加州议员皮特·里基茨以及众议员吉尔·西斯内罗斯。上周晚些时候，西斯内罗斯在社交媒体上发布了一张戴着白手套的手拿着一个信封的照片，信封上手写着他的名字和地址。

paras.en: The mailings, which come just weeks before the Nov. 3 midterm elections, are being investigated by multiple federal agencies.
paras.zh: 这些邮件是在 11 月 3 日中期选举前几周发出的，多个联邦机构正在对这些邮件进行调查。

paras.en: Schiff, in his statement, described the mailings as "a disturbing pattern of lawmakers being targeted across party and geography."
paras.zh: 希夫在声明中将这些邮件描述为“跨党派和跨地域的立法者成为攻击目标的令人不安的模式”。

articles.title: Bomb threat forces Tel Aviv-to-Vienna flight to land in Bulgaria

paras.en: Oct. 19 (UPI) -- An Airbus A320 flying from Tel Aviv to Vienna was diverted to Sofia for an emergency landing Sunday night following a reported bomb threat, Bulgarian officials said.
paras.zh: 10 月 19 日（合众国际社）——保加利亚官员称，周日晚间，一架从特拉维夫飞往维也纳的空客 A320 飞机因接到炸弹威胁报告而紧急迫降索非亚。

paras.en: The flight with six crew members and 51 passengers aboard was diverted to the Bulgarian capital after the crew reported receiving a bomb threat while the aircraft was near the border with Romania, Bulgaria's Ministry of Transport and Communications said in a statement.
paras.zh: 保加利亚交通和通讯部在一份声明中表示，这架载有 6 名机组人员和 51 名乘客的航班在机组人员报告飞机靠近罗马尼亚边境时收到炸弹威胁后，已改道飞往保加利亚首都。

paras.en: A Bulgarian Air Force fighter jet was scrambled in response and escorted the passenger plane to Vasil Levski Sofia Airport, it said.
paras.zh: 报道称，保加利亚空军一架战斗机紧急紧急升空，护送客机飞往瓦西里列夫斯基索非亚机场。

paras.en: "A response team has been established, and the relevant authorities have begun an investigation," according to the ministry statement. "The passengers have disembarked from the aircraft."
paras.zh: 该部声明称，“已成立反应小组，有关部门已开始调查”。 “乘客们已经下飞机了。”

paras.en: The Ministry of Defense said the bomb threat was reported at 9:17 p.m. local time while the aircraft was in Bulgarian airspace, and scrambling of MiG-29 fighter jets was carried out in coordination with NATO's Combined Air Operations Center in Torrejón, Spain.
paras.zh: 国防部表示，炸弹威胁是在晚上 9 点 17 分接到的。当地时间，当飞机在保加利亚领空时，米格 29 战斗机的紧急升空是与位于西班牙托雷洪的北约联合空中作战中心协调进行的。

paras.en: Austrian Airlines confirmed that the plane landed safely.
paras.zh: 奥地利航空证实飞机安全着陆。

paras.en: The aircraft had departed on schedule at 7:04 p.m. local time, but deviated from its planned route and began heading for Sofia about two hours later, with it landing safely in Bulgaria at 9:42 p.m. local time. The entire flight lasted 2 hours and 38 minutes.
paras.zh: 飞机于晚上 7 点 04 分准时起飞。当地时间晚上9点42分，飞机偏离了计划航线，开始飞往索非亚，并于晚上9点42分安全降落在保加利亚。当地时间。整个飞行持续了2小时38分钟。

paras.en: Austrian Airlines spokeswoman Anita Kiefer said the passengers were evacuated and the aircraft was searched.
paras.zh: 奥地利航空发言人安妮塔·基弗表示，乘客已被疏散，飞机也已接受搜查。

paras.en: "Following the inspection of the aircraft, passengers will be rebooked on alternative flights as quickly as possible," Kiefer said in a statement.
paras.zh: 基弗在一份声明中表示：“检查完飞机后，我们将尽快为乘客重新预订替代航班。”

paras.en: "The safety of our passengers and crews is always our highest priority."
paras.zh: “乘客和机组人员的安全始终是我们的首要任务。”

paras.en: The incident is at least the third bomb threat involving flights to or from Tel Aviv in less than a week, with two Delta Air Lines flights receiving bomb threats on Oct. 13. One flight arrived from New York City and was searched at Ben Gurion Airport, while the other was held and inspected at JFK Airport before being cleared to depart for Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 这起事件至少是不到一周内发生的第三起涉及往返特拉维夫航班的炸弹威胁，达美航空的两架航班于 10 月 13 日收到炸弹威胁。其中一架航班从纽约市起飞，在本古里安机场接受搜查，另一架航班在肯尼迪机场被扣留并接受检查，然后获准飞往特拉维夫。

articles.title: BMI Opens Coral Gables Office, Expanding Its Presence in Miami Area
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: BMI now has a physical presence in the Miami area, in Coral Gables, Florida, where the performing rights organization opened its newest office on Miracle Mile on Thursday (Oct. 15). With the company’s new location in the Miami-Dade County, BMI aims to strengthen its commitment to serving music creators throughout South Florida, Puerto Rico and Latin America.
paras.zh: BMI 目前在佛罗里达州科勒尔盖布尔斯的迈阿密地区设有实体办事处，该表演权组织于周四（10 月 15 日）在 Miracle Mile 开设了最新的办事处。随着公司在迈阿密戴德县设立新址，BMI 旨在加强其为南佛罗里达州、波多黎各和拉丁美洲的音乐创作者提供服务的承诺。

paras.en: An opening-day celebration featured a live performance by Zulia. Billboard co-chief content officer Leila Cobo introduced the Latin pop singer-songwriter and spoke on the impact of Latin music at the ribbon-cutting ceremony for BMI’s Coral Gables site.
paras.zh: 开幕日庆祝活动以 Zulia 的现场表演为特色。 Billboard 联合首席内容官 Leila Cobo 在 BMI 科勒尔盖布尔斯网站剪彩仪式上介绍了这位拉丁流行歌手兼词曲作家，并谈到了拉丁音乐的影响。

paras.en: “We think it’s a great place to welcome our amazing songwriters, composers, producers, and publishers, not just those here in the Miami area but from all over the country and the world,” Mike O’Neill, BMI’s chief executive officer, said at the event. “It’s what BMI is all about. We invest in our company, and we invest in our creative community, who we are so honored to serve. Welcome to your new BMI home in Miami.”
paras.zh: BMI 首席执行官迈克·奥尼尔 (Mike O’Neill) 在活动中表示：“我们认为这是一个欢迎我们出色的歌曲作者、作曲家、制作人和出版商的好地方，不仅是迈阿密地区的歌曲作者、作曲家、制作人和出版商，还有来自全国各地和世界各地的人们。” “这就是 BMI 的意义所在。我们投资于我们的公司，投资于我们的创意社区，我们很荣幸为他们服务。欢迎来到 BMI 在迈阿密的新家。”

paras.en: “Latin music is having a moment unlike anything we’ve seen. It’s not crossing over anymore, it’s leading. Miami is a creative epicenter, and we’re going to keep building on the musical foundation that is Miami,” said Mike Steinberg, chief revenue and creative officer of BMI.
paras.zh: BMI 首席营收兼创意官迈克·斯坦伯格 (Mike Steinberg) 表示：“拉丁音乐正迎来前所未有的时刻。它不再是跨界，而是领先。迈阿密是一个创意中心，我们将继续在迈阿密的音乐基础上继续发展。”

paras.en: “BMI’s commitment to Latin music didn’t begin with its global explosion. We’ve stood alongside its creators for generations,” added Jesús González, BMI’s vice president of creative, Latin. “Our decision to call Coral Gables home was intentional. We didn’t simply want an office. We wanted a home. A place where creators connect, ideas become songs, and the next generation finds opportunity.”
paras.zh: “BMI 对拉丁音乐的承诺并非始于其在全球的爆发。我们几代人都与它的创作者站在一起，”BMI 拉丁创意副总裁 Jesús González 补充道。 “我们决定把科勒尔盖布尔斯称为家是有意的。我们不只是想要一间办公室。我们想要一个家。一个创作者相互交流、想法变成歌曲、下一代找到机会的地方。”

paras.en: BMI, which represents the public performance rights in more than 25 million musical works by more than 1.5 million songwriters, composers and music publishers, has its headquarters in New York City. The organization also has offices in Los Angeles, Nashville, Atlanta, Austin and Washington, D.C., and an international location in London, U.K.
paras.zh: BMI 代表超过 150 万歌曲作者、作曲家和音乐出版商的超过 2500 万首音乐作品的公开表演权，总部位于纽约市。该组织还在洛杉矶、纳什维尔、亚特兰大、奥斯汀和华盛顿特区设有办事处，并在英国伦敦设有国际办事处。

articles.title: Universal Music Publishing Group Promotes Maree Hamblion to EVP of A&R and Creative in AUNZ
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Universal Music Publishing Group has promoted Maree Hamblion to executive vice president, A&R and creative, Australia and New Zealand. She will lead the publisher’s creative and talent-development strategy across the region from Sydney.
paras.zh: 环球音乐出版集团已晋升 Maree Hamblion 为澳大利亚和新西兰 A&R 和创意执行副总裁。她将在悉尼领导出版商在整个地区的创意和人才发展战略。

paras.en: UMPG managing director for the U.K. and head of global A&R David Gray, to whom Hamblion reports, announced the move Monday (Oct. 19). It follows her signing of Tones and I, the ARIA Award-winning singer-songwriter-producer. UMPG did not disclose the terms of the deal. Tones and I’s “Dance Monkey” was a top 10 hit on the Billboard Hot 100, peaking at No. 4, and in January 2020 it made her the No. 1 act on the Hot 100 Songwriters chart. Warner Chappell had signed her in 2019 to administer her compositions worldwide outside Australia and New Zealand.
paras.zh: Hamblion 的下属 UMPG 英国董事总经理兼全球 A&R 负责人 David Gray 于周一（10 月 19 日）宣布了这一举措。此前，她还与荣获 ARIA 奖的创作型歌手兼制作人 Tones and I 签约。 UMPG 没有透露交易条款。 Tones 和 I 的《Dance Monkey》在 Billboard Hot 100 中名列前十，最高排名第四，并在 2020 年 1 月使她成为 Hot 100 歌曲作者排行榜上的第一名。华纳·查佩尔 (Warner Chappell) 于 2019 年与她签约，负责管理她在澳大利亚和新西兰以外的全球范围内的作品。

paras.en: “Australia and New Zealand have always produced extraordinary music and some of the world’s most distinctive songwriters and artists,” Gray said. UMPG chairman/CEO Jody Gerson said Hamblion “understands that developing songwriters and artists locally also means creating opportunities for them globally.” Hamblion said songwriters “are at the heart of everything we do.”
paras.zh: “澳大利亚和新西兰一直产生非凡的音乐以及一些世界上最独特的歌曲作者和艺术家，”格雷说。 UMPG 董事长兼首席执行官乔迪·格尔森 (Jody Gerson) 表示 Hamblion“明白，在本地培养歌曲作者和艺术家也意味着为他们在全球范围内创造机会。”汉布利恩表示歌曲作者“是我们所做一切的核心”。

paras.en: Her expanded remit includes local facilities. UMPG will add a dedicated writing room and content space alongside its existing LVL 4 recording studio.
paras.zh: 她的职责范围扩大到包括当地设施。 UMPG 将在其现有的 LVL 4 录音室旁边增加一个专用的写作室和内容空间。

paras.en: Hamblion joined UMPG’s Australia and New Zealand office in 2024 as senior vice president, A&R. Her signings there include Benny Morrell, Matthew Ifield, Esha Tewari, Rupert Bullard, Ownlife and Lach Bostock. She has also set up joint ventures with Peach Publishing, THIS IS NOISE, Apple Street Music and Artist Labs, the last of which has signed Midnight Til Morning, Lane Pittman and Lime Cordiale.
paras.zh: Hamblion 于 2024 年加入 UMPG 澳大利亚和新西兰办事处，担任 A&R 高级副总裁。她在那里签约的球员包括本尼·莫雷尔、马修·伊菲尔德、埃莎·特瓦里、鲁珀特·布拉德、Ownlife 和拉赫·博斯托克。她还与 Peach Publishing、THIS IS NOISE、Apple Street Music 和 Artist Labs 成立了合资企业，其中最后一家已签约 Midnight Til Morning、Lane Pittman 和 Lime Cordiale。

paras.en: Before UMPG, she spent more than a decade at Sony/ATV, later Sony Music Publishing. Sony promoted her to senior vice president, international A&R in 2021, and her signings there included Sarah Aarons, Alex Hope and Jawsh 685. She began her career at EMI Music Publishing’s Sydney office in 1995 and spent more than 17 years there. Her work at EMI included Savage Garden, PNAU and The Veronicas.
paras.zh: 在进入 UMPG 之前，她在 Sony/ATV（后来的 Sony Music Publishing）工作了十多年。索尼于 2021 年将她提升为国际 A&R 高级副总裁，她在那里签约的成员包括 Sarah Aarons、Alex Hope 和 Jawsh 685。她于 1995 年在 EMI 音乐出版公司悉尼办事处开始了自己的职业生涯，并在那里工作了 17 年多。她在 EMI 的作品包括 Savage Garden、PNAU 和 The Veronicas。

articles.title: ONEFOUR Team Up With Penrith Chamber Orchestra for World-Premiere ‘Made Men’ Show
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Western Sydney drill group ONEFOUR will go home to Penrith for a world-premiere show with the 25-piece Penrith Chamber Orchestra. Made Men runs Jan. 22 and 23, 2027, in the Concert Hall at The Joan, presented by Penrith Performing & Visual Arts and Sydney Festival.
paras.zh: 西悉尼演练团体 ONEFOUR 将回到彭里斯的家乡，与 25 人组成的彭里斯室内乐团一起进行世界首演。 Made Men 将于 2027 年 1 月 22 日至 23 日在 The Joan 音乐厅举行，由 Penrith Performing & Visual Arts 和 Sydney Festival 主办。

paras.en: The production reimagines ONEFOUR’s catalog over two nights. They will be backed by young classical musicians from across the region who have trained through the Penrith Conservatorium. Tickets go on sale Thursday (Oct. 22) at 9 a.m. local time, and Sydney Festival’s discounted-ticket initiative will cover a limited number of premium seats.
paras.zh: 制作团队花了两个晚上重新构思了 ONEFOUR 的目录。他们将得到来自该地区经过彭里斯音乐学院培训的年轻古典音乐家的支持。门票于当地时间周四（10 月 22 日）上午 9 点开始发售，悉尼艺术节的折扣门票计划将覆盖数量有限的高级座位。

paras.en: “This is a Western Sydney story, told in Western Sydney, for the people who live here,” Penrith Performing & Visual Arts CEO and artistic director Toby Chapman said in a statement. He framed the project as a celebration of the region’s range, from contemporary rap to classical strings.
paras.zh: “这是一个西悉尼的故事，在西悉尼为居住在这里的人们讲述，”彭里斯表演与视觉艺术首席执行官兼艺术总监托比·查普曼在一份声明中说。他将该项目定义为对该地区从当代说唱到古典弦乐等各种音乐的庆祝。

paras.en: ONEFOUR come from Mount Druitt and are widely credited with putting Australian drill on the map. Their debut album, Look at Me Now, came out June 13, 2025, with guests including Headie One, The Kid Laroi and Mabel. The group’s publicist says it reached No. 2 on the ARIA albums chart and that the group has more than 400 million streams.
paras.zh: ONEFOUR 来自 Mount Druitt，因使澳大利亚钻探闻名于世而受到广泛赞誉。他们的首张专辑《Look at Me Now》于 2025 年 6 月 13 日发行，嘉宾包括 Headie One、The Kid Laroi 和 Mabel。该乐队的公关人员表示，该乐队在 ARIA 专辑排行榜上排名第二，并且该乐队拥有超过 4 亿的播放量。

paras.en: Their 2020 EP Against All Odds reached No. 7 on the ARIA albums chart. It also gave its name to the Netflix documentary ONEFOUR: Against All Odds, which premiered at SXSW Sydney in October 2023. The film chronicles their rise alongside the canceled shows and police scrutiny that shadowed it. The group’s first headline Sydney show came only in September 2025, at City Recital Hall.
paras.zh: 他们的 2020 年 EP Against All Odds 在 ARIA 专辑排行榜上排名第七。 Netflix 纪录片《ONEFOUR：Against All Odds》也以它的名字命名，该片于 2023 年 10 月在悉尼 SXSW 首映。这部电影记录了他们的崛起以及节目取消和警方审查的阴影。该乐队于 2025 年 9 月在城市演奏厅首次在悉尼举行了大型演出。

paras.en: Made Men is the second recent Western Sydney booking for Sydney Festival’s partnership with Penrith Performing & Visual Arts. It also fits a wider push by local arts bodies to pair hip-hop acts with classical ensembles.
paras.zh: Made Men 是悉尼艺术节与彭里斯表演与视觉艺术中心 (Penrith Performing & Visual Arts) 合作举办的西悉尼近期第二个预订活动。它还符合当地艺术机构将嘻哈表演与古典合奏相结合的更广泛推动。

articles.title: Six Key Points That Explain ‘You Can See Everything’
articles.author: Steven Zeitchik

paras.en: [Spoilers galore! But come on, you want them.]
paras.zh: 【剧透多多！但来吧，你想要它们。]

paras.en: You’ve gone out and watched You Can See Everything, joining the nearly 2 million people this weekend who drank in the Nathan Fielder–Lance Oppenheim investigation into the mad psyche of Elizabeth Holmes. You gasped in the theater, you turned to a friend or new friend unable to believe what you just saw, you found yourself still marveling at the moments in the parking lot and restaurant, you texted your other friends both annoyed and superior they haven’t seen it yet. Go pick up your phone right now, another friend has just written back “yeah, I need to see it” while you shake your head at their deprivatory laziness.
paras.zh: 你已经出去观看了《你可以看到一切》，加入了本周末近 200 万人的行列，观看了内森·菲尔德-兰斯·奥本海姆对伊丽莎白·福尔摩斯疯狂心理的调查。你在剧院里喘着粗气，你转向朋友或新朋友，无法相信你刚刚看到的一切，你发现自己仍然对停车场和餐厅里的时刻感到惊叹，你给其他朋友发短信，既恼火又优越，他们还没有看到它。现在就拿起你的手机，另一位朋友刚刚回信说“是的，我需要看看”，而你则对他们剥夺性的懒惰摇头。

paras.en: But even after all that discussing, all that plumbing, you still have questions about what “Fieldenheim” have created. We all have questions. Heck, Fielder himself still has questions. “I am still struggling to this day to understand what I went through,” the filmmaker told an New York Film Festival audience last month and said he and Oppenheim disagreed over nearly everything that was happening between Holmes and her husband Billy Evans.
paras.zh: 但即使在进行了所有的讨论、所有的管道之后，你仍然对“菲尔登海姆”创造了什么有疑问。我们都有疑问。哎呀，菲尔德本人仍然有疑问。这位电影制片人上个月对纽约电影节的观众说：“直到今天，我仍在努力理解我所经历的事情。”他说，他和奥本海姆在福尔摩斯和她的丈夫比利·埃文斯之间发生的几乎所有事情上都存在分歧。

paras.en: But there are some verifiable facts, no matter how Holmes and Evans have an, er, postmodern take on the truth. Here are six key points you’re likely curious about, unpacked to sate your twitchy curiosity.
paras.zh: 但无论福尔摩斯和埃文斯如何以，呃，后现代的方式看待真相，都有一些可验证的事实。以下是您可能好奇的六个关键点，为满足您的好奇心而展开。

paras.en: So how did this thing even happen? How was Holmes convinced to do it? Here’s how it went down…it actually began with A24.
paras.zh: 那么这件事是怎么发生的呢？福尔摩斯是如何被说服去做这件事的？事情是这样的……实际上是从 A24 开始的。

paras.en: The company met with Holmes after she called them looking for exposure (lest you think she was just minding her own business when Hollywood came along. Hey, at least she has taste). “It was to have people see who she is,” Evans recently said. But the parties couldn’t come to an agreement, and the project seemed dead.
paras.zh: 在霍姆斯打电话寻求曝光后，该公司与他们会面了（免得你认为好莱坞出现时她只是在管自己的事。嘿，至少她有品味）。 “这是为了让人们了解她是谁，”埃文斯最近说道。但双方未能达成协议，该项目似乎已经胎死腹中。

paras.en: Then some weirdness (kismet? No, weirdness.) Fieldenheim were — wait for it — at the Magic Castle together when Oppenheim was visiting LA from NYC. During an improv bit someone from the audience called out Holmes’ name. “Hey, that reminds me, I heard A24 is mulling a Holmes movie!,” Oppenheim said to Fielder when the show ended. Shortly after, Fielder placed a call to A24 offices in NY, and the pair were on the case. Or, at least, on some weirdness they thought could probably never be a movie.
paras.zh: 然后发生了一些奇怪的事情（天运？不，奇怪的事情。）当奥本海姆从纽约访问洛杉矶时，菲尔登海姆 - 等等 - 一起在魔术城堡。在即兴表演中，观众中有人喊出了福尔摩斯的名字。 “嘿，这让我想起了，我听说 A24 正在考虑拍一部福尔摩斯电影！”节目结束时奥本海姆对菲尔德说。不久之后，菲尔德给 A24 位于纽约的办公室打电话，两人正在处理此案。或者，至少，出于某种奇怪的原因，他们认为可能永远不会成为一部电影。

paras.en: So who are the two A24 execs who met with filmmakers and Holmes-Evans, as the movie reconstructs? The studio isn’t saying, but one thing that is worth knowing: the person who ran docs for the studio and helped guide the project earlier on is…no longer there. Yes, she was not at the company to see everything. That would be Emily Osborne, laid off last year as A24 shelved its doc division. She’s still an executive producer on the film though; the legacy runs deep.
paras.zh: 那么，根据电影的重构，与电影制片人和福尔摩斯-埃文斯会面的两位 A24 高管是谁？工作室没有明说，但有一件事值得了解：为工作室管理文档并早期帮助指导项目的人……已经不存在了。是的，她并没有在公司看到一切。那就是艾米丽·奥斯本 (Emily Osborne)，她去年因 A24 搁置其文档部门而被解雇。不过，她仍然是这部电影的执行制片人。遗产根深蒂固。

paras.en: By the way, like all good wannabe lawyers, you may have watched the whole handwring about whether the Holmes-Evans unit could get paid and thought: isn’t there a law against that — against a convicted criminal profiting from their crime? There is. Or there was — the Son of Sam Law. But California struck it down a number of years back, so had Evans and Holmes opted for payment, it likely would have been fine even for Holmes to get paid directly. The money could have funded more blood-testing machines!
paras.zh: 顺便说一句，像所有想成为律师的优秀律师一样，您可能已经看到了关于霍姆斯-埃文斯部门能否获得报酬的整个令人沮丧的情况，并思考：难道没有法律禁止这样做吗——禁止被定罪的罪犯从他们的犯罪中获利？有。或者还有——山姆·劳的儿子。但加州几年前就取消了这一规定，因此，如果埃文斯和霍姆斯选择付款，即使霍姆斯直接获得付款也可能没问题。这笔钱本来可以资助更多的血液检测机器！

paras.en: Does the Alleged Rape Incident Explain Everything?
paras.zh: 涉嫌强奸事件能解释一切吗？

paras.en: It comes and goes so fast you have to lean in to make sure you heard it. Did Holmes’ father say, unequivocally, that everything changed for his daughter when she was raped? It seems like that kind of trauma could indeed make someone dramatically pull back, hide behind a false persona so thick even they’ve lost track of what’s underneath
paras.zh: 它来得快去得也快，你必须靠过去才能确保你听到了。福尔摩斯的父亲是否明确表示，当他的女儿被强奸时，一切都改变了？似乎这种创伤确实会让一个人戏剧性地退缩，隐藏在一个如此厚重的虚假角色后面，甚至他们已经忘记了下面的东西

paras.en: So is Holmes a rape victim? Yes, she has alleged she is — and that it changed everything. Back at her trial in 2022 she spoke tearfully about an incident when she was at Stanford in the fall of 2003, at 19.
paras.zh: 那么福尔摩斯是强奸受害者吗？是的，她声称自己是这样的——而且这改变了一切。回到 2022 年的审判时，她泪流满面地讲述了 2003 年秋天 19 岁时在斯坦福大学发生的一件事情。

paras.en: The alleged incident, she said, sent her on a work-constantly, my-startup-must-succeed-at-all-costs path (she founded Theranos and dropped out of college later that academic year).
paras.zh: 她说，这起事件让她走上了一条“不断工作、不惜一切代价创业必须成功”的道路（她创立了 Theranos，并在该学年晚些时候从大学退学）。

paras.en: What do public records say about the event? The Santa Clara County sheriff’s office had gotten a call late one October night that a student named Elizabeth Holmes was reporting an on-campus sexual assault, at a frat house. Deputies were dispatched, according to a document NPR obtained as part of a California Public Records request. We don’t know where the investigation went from there.
paras.zh: 公共记录对这一事件有何评价？ 10 月的一个深夜，圣克拉拉县治安官办公室接到电话，称一名名叫伊丽莎白·霍姆斯 (Elizabeth Holmes) 的学生正在报告一所兄弟会宿舍内发生的校园性侵犯事件。根据美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 根据加州公共记录请求获得的一份文件，派出了代表。我们不知道调查从那里开始。

paras.en: Holmes also alleged that Sunny Balwani — her former boyfriend and Theranos COO who was convicted of fraud and is currently incarcerated too — sexually abused her. Balwani has denied the allegations.
paras.zh: 霍姆斯还声称，她的前男友、Theranos 首席运营官桑尼·巴尔瓦尼 (Sunny Balwani) 曾对她进行性虐待，后者被判犯有欺诈罪，目前也被监禁。巴尔瓦尼否认了这些指控。

paras.en: Those details certainly contextualize Holmes’ behavior; whether they excuse it is up to you. But no such context exists for Billy. Which brings us to…
paras.zh: 这些细节确实反映了福尔摩斯的行为。他们是否原谅这取决于你。但对比利来说，不存在这样的背景。这让我们……

paras.en: Who the Hell is Billy Evans and Is He an AI Who Came Into Existence with a “Design Me an Evil Trust Fund-Bro Stereotype” Prompt?
paras.zh: 比利·埃文斯到底是谁？他是一个带着“为我设计一个邪恶的信托基金——兄弟刻板印象”提示而诞生的人工智能吗？

paras.en: No. Maybe. Probably not. We don’t know in great detail what Evans’ source of wealth is in the film — just that he has one, and this makes him uber-credible because he doesn’t need anything from Holmes. (“What does she have to gain from me?” as he says in the film.) Or so he’d like us to believe, like Larry David and his whole unattractive-spouse bit.
paras.zh: 不，也许吧。可能不会。我们不知道电影中埃文斯的财富来源是什么——只是他有一个，这让他变得超级可信，因为他不需要福尔摩斯的任何东西。 （正如他在影片中所说，“她能从我身上得到什么？”）或者说他希望我们相信这一点，就像拉里·大卫和他那毫无吸引力的配偶那样。

paras.en: Here’s something to know about Evans: the Evans Hotel Group that his grandparents founded some 70+ years ago (The Lodge Terry Pines, the Bahia Resort Hotel, and the Catamaran Resort are its three properties) has gotten into plenty of hot water with local groups in Southern California. Citizens’ orgs said an expansion of the Bahia, for instance, took away access to the public Mission Bay. Which gives Evans and Holmes frolicking on an endless expanse of beach at their Del Mar rental an added pungency. The family also sued some unions in San Diego because they didn’t like how said unions were trying to stop the expansion. The suit was dismissed.
paras.zh: 关于埃文斯，有一些需要了解的事情：他的祖父母在大约 70 多年前创立的埃文斯酒店集团（特里松树旅馆、巴伊亚度假酒店和双体船度假村是其三处房产）与南加州的当地团体发生了很多争执。例如，公民组织表示，巴伊亚的扩建剥夺了通往公共使命湾的通道。这让埃文斯和福尔摩斯在德尔马出租屋一望无际的海滩上嬉戏，增添了一丝刺激感。该家族还起诉了圣地亚哥的一些工会，因为他们不喜欢工会试图阻止扩张的方式。诉讼被驳回。

paras.en: But hey, Evans is in biotech now. Yes, the new blood-testing company talked about in the 2023 section of the film was indeed founded the next year. It’s called Haemanthus — like Theranos, but with extra Haman — and Evans is the CEO. The company actually is working with a legit technique known as Raman spectroscopy but only seem to have one patent. Blood-testing from the people who brought you and/or defended Theranos, what could go wrong?
paras.zh: 但是，嘿，埃文斯现在从事生物技术行业。是的，影片中2023年部分谈到的新血液检测公司确实是在第二年成立的。它被称为 Haemanthus——类似于 Theranos，但多了 Haman——埃文斯是首席执行官。该公司实际上正在使用一种称为拉曼光谱的合法技术，但似乎只有一项专利。带来你和/或捍卫希拉洛斯的人的血液测试，可能会出现什么问题？

paras.en: Amanda, I’m Going to Take You By Surprise and Make You Realize
paras.zh: 阿曼达，我会让你感到惊讶并让你意识到

paras.en: You know that scene where we first see Seyfried, when she’s sitting there on the couch watching the Holmes footage at the start of the third act and you almost blink in disbelief? “Wait…who…could it…is it?” Well, that happened in real time — that’s the first meeting she and Fielder actually had. In fact so realtime there were no plans to have Seyfried come in and play Holmes in those reconstructions we later see. Fieldenheim just wanted her to react to what happened and maybe provide some talking-head clarity on the arguments they were having. Little did even they know what it would become — a rehearsal for the eventual Rehearsal.
paras.zh: 你知道我们第一次看到塞弗里德的那个场景，当她坐在沙发上观看第三幕开始时福尔摩斯的镜头时，你几乎难以置信地眨着眼睛？ “等等……谁……难道是……是吗？”嗯，这是实时发生的——这是她和菲尔德第一次见面。事实上，如此实时，我们并没有计划让塞弗里德在我们后来看到的重建中扮演福尔摩斯。菲尔登海姆只是想让她对所发生的事情做出反应，或许还能对他们的争论提供一些清晰的谈话。他们甚至都不知道这会变成什么——为最终的排练而进行的排练。

paras.en: N.B. That farm Fielder visits Seyfried where the animals are fed (and fart). That’s an animal rescue that the actress and Thomas Sadoski founded and live in in upstate New York with their two kids. It’s a pretty rad place — a 501(c)(3) nonprofit on which they’ve saved and housed elderly or endangered ducks, goats, donkeys, cats, chickens and horses, funding the place themselves. They thus don’t take donations, but Seyfried has done work for at least one animal-rights group that is public facing, the anti-kill shelter Best Friends Society. If you donate money, we imagine you’d actually save a living being, unlike whatever time you’re not saving using a Theranos device.
paras.zh: 注意：那个农场菲尔德参观了塞弗里德，在那里给动物喂食（和放屁）。这是这位女演员和托马斯·萨多斯基 (Thomas Sadoski) 与两个孩子在纽约州北部创立并居住的动物救援组织。这是一个相当棒的地方——一个 501(c)(3) 非营利组织，他们拯救并安置了老年或濒临灭绝的鸭子、山羊、驴、猫、鸡和马，并自己出资建造这个地方。因此，他们不接受捐款，但塞弗里德至少为一个面向公众的动物权利组织——反杀戮庇护所最好的朋友协会——做过工作。如果您捐款，我们想象您实际上会拯救一个生命，这与您使用 Theranos 设备时不节省的时间不同。

paras.en: Anyway, Seyfried and Sadoski announced a split after that footage was shot. Hopefully she got to heal there too.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，塞弗里德和萨多斯基在这段视频拍摄后宣布分手。希望她也能在那里痊愈。

paras.en: Besides some pretty chill movies, A24 excels at spinning off memes. Hereditary memes, Uncut Gems memes, memes contrasting its movies with Costco hot dogs. The company thought — we all thought — they had a good one with that close-up two-shot of Fielder and Holmes on the couch. It had already been repurposed so many times.
paras.zh: 除了一些非常酷的电影外，A24 还擅长衍生梗。遗传模因、未切割宝石模因、将其电影与 Costco 热狗进行对比的模因。公司认为——我们都认为——他们拍了一个很好的镜头，拍摄了菲尔德和福尔摩斯坐在沙发上的特写两张照片。它已经被改变了很多次用途。

paras.en: But when the final history of our era is written and the one true artifact remains, that artifact will, of course, be a meme of the egg scene. So banal; so revealing. There is no one way to whisk eggs. But Evans thinks there is, and he is about to joystick Holmes into doing it that way.
paras.zh: 但是，当我们这个时代的最终历史被书写并且一件真正的神器仍然存在时，该神器当然将成为鸡蛋场景的模因。如此平庸；如此暴露。没有一种方法可以搅拌鸡蛋。但埃文斯认为是有的，他准备操纵福尔摩斯这样做。

paras.en: The SNL sketches are coming; so are the Oscar bits. An omelet station will never be the same again.
paras.zh: SNL 草图即将推出；奥斯卡金像奖也是如此。煎蛋卷站将不再一样。

paras.en: Federal Prison Camp Bryan, where Holmes is being held, already comes off as a mysterious place in the film, doesn’t it? (We still have vending-machine questions.) But you don’t know the half of it. The place has incarcerated a true motley crew of inmates — Epstein associate Ghislaine Maxwell is currently there, former Real Housewife star Jen Shah just got out of there in August, and Jenna Ryan, the Texas realtor and convicted Jan. 6 rioter who’s had some seriously wild things to say as she tried to become a right-wing influencer, was released from there last winter. When’s the doc of that place?
paras.zh: 关押福尔摩斯的布莱恩联邦监狱营在电影中已经显得很神秘，不是吗？ （我们仍然有自动售货机的问题。）但你只知道其中的一半。这个地方关押着一群真正的杂种囚犯——爱泼斯坦的同事吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦尔(Ghislaine Maxwell)目前就在那里，前《真正的家庭主妇》明星珍·沙阿(Jen Shah)8月份刚刚从那里出来，德克萨斯州房地产经纪人、1月6日被定罪的骚乱者珍娜·瑞恩(Jenna Ryan)去年冬天从那里释放，她在试图成为右翼影响者时曾说过一些非常疯狂的话。那个地方的医生什么时候有？

paras.en: The women’s prison is a very low-security facility (one reason Maxwell’s transfer there as a sex offender provoked outrage) and generally holds people with sentences shorter than five years. The facility, about 100 miles outside Houston, has fewer staff than other federal facilities because the inmates are not generally considered violent risks. Family and anyone else approved by the inmate can visit every Saturday and/or Sunday. The prison sits in a residential neighborhood of craftsman-esque homes and singing mockingbirds, and the grounds have even been reported by neighbors as almost seeming like a park. (You may have gotten that vibe from the last scene.)
paras.zh: 女子监狱是一个安全性非常低的设施（麦克斯韦作为性犯罪者被转移到那里引起公愤的原因之一），通常关押刑期不超过五年的人。该设施距离休斯顿约 100 英里，与其他联邦设施相比，工作人员较少，因为囚犯通常不被视为暴力风险。家人和囚犯批准的任何其他人可以每周六和/或周日探视。监狱坐落在一个住宅区，周围有工匠式的房屋和会唱歌的反舌鸟，邻居甚至报告说，监狱的场地几乎看起来像一个公园。 （你可能已经从最后一个场景中感受到了这种氛围。）

paras.en: Holmes, per her sentence, shouldn’t be out until 2034. But a judge ruled earlier this year that because she didn’t cause “substantial financial hardship” to victims she can get out some four years early, in 2030. Meanwhile a Theranos investor who was defrauded by Holmes says he was alerted by the Justice Department that, likely because of good behavior, Holmes is actually headed for a halfway house in Austin this very summer — giving her and Fieldenheim just enough time to plan a sequel for 2028.
paras.zh: 按照霍尔姆斯的判决，霍尔姆斯要到 2034 年才能出狱。但今年早些时候，一名法官裁定，由于她没有给受害者造成“严重的经济困难”，她可以提前大约四年，即 2030 年出狱。与此同时，一位被霍尔姆斯欺骗的 Theranos 投资者表示，司法部向他发出警报，霍尔姆斯实际上可能是因为表现良好，今年夏天将前往奥斯汀的一所中途宿舍，这样她和菲尔登海姆就有足够的时间计划在 2028 年拍摄续集。

articles.title: ‘Other Desert Cities’ Theater Review: Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Ed Harris and Allison Janney Fail to Make a Once-Timely Play Relevant Again
articles.author: Richard Lawson

paras.en: What if there was a second Ronald Reagan? It’s a troubling question, and one that playwright Jon Robin Baitz posed in his 2011 Pulitzer-finalist play Other Desert Cities. A classic coming-home family drama, Other Desert Cities was last on Broadway that same year, when its study of neocon order running headlong into its rotten, self-serving legacy was hot-button relevant. The play, largely set in 2004, opens with talk of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, before settling into its more allegorical story of the troubled liberal daughter of Palm Springs Republicans returning to the nest with the worst kind of Christmas gift under her arm: manuscripts of a damning, soon-to-be-published family memoir.
paras.zh: 如果有第二个罗纳德·里根怎么办？这是一个令人不安的问题，剧作家乔恩·罗宾·贝茨 (Jon Robin Baitz) 在其 2011 年入围普利策奖的戏剧《其他沙漠城市》中提出了这个问题。 《其他沙漠城市》是一部经典的回家家庭剧，同年最后一次在百老汇上演，当时它对新保守主义秩序的研究一头扎进了其腐烂、自私的遗产中，成为热门话题。该剧主要以 2004 年为背景，以伊拉克和阿富汗战争作为开头，然后开始讲述更具寓言性的故事：棕榈泉共和党人的自由派女儿陷入困境，腋下夹着最糟糕的圣诞礼物：一本即将出版的家庭回忆录的手稿。

paras.en: The Wyeths, Polly (Julia Louis-Dreyfus in her Broadway debut) and Lyman (Ed Harris), are grand poobahs of the conservative establishment, once close friends of the Reagans and other miserable people (Barry Goldwater is mentioned). Lyman, like dear old Dutch, was a low-tier movie star before Reagan gave him an ambassadorship. Polly, unlike Nancy, is Jewish and wrote a forgettable series of made-for-TV movies with her sister before higher purpose, and more money, came calling. Retired from showbiz and politics, the Wyeths enjoy their country club socializing and their well-appointed mid-century home but, it seems, not always the company of their children.
paras.zh: 惠氏夫妇、波莉（朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷福斯在百老汇首次亮相）和莱曼（艾德·哈里斯饰）是保守派的大佬，曾经是里根家族和其他悲惨人民（提到了巴里·戈德华特）的亲密朋友。莱曼，就像亲爱的老荷兰人一样，在里根授予他大使职位之前，他只是一名低级电影明星。与南希不同，波莉是犹太人，在更高的目标和更多的钱到来之前，她和姐姐一起创作了一系列令人难忘的电视电影。从演艺圈和政界退休后，怀斯夫妇享受乡村俱乐部的社交活动和设备齐全的中世纪住宅，但似乎并不总是有孩子的陪伴。

paras.en: Baby boy Trip (Joe Keery) is the caddish, porn-addicted creator of a People’s Court-esque reality show called Jury of Your Peers, the gag being that the jury is made up of faded icons and D-listers. Though no great pride of his parents’, Trip is close to them in the infantilized way of youngest children, and is far more apathetic to their increasingly creaky (and dangerous) politics than is his sister Brooke (Lily Rabe), a black sheep who long ago decamped to the East Coast, where a marriage crumbled and some months were spent in a psychiatric hospital.
paras.zh: 小男孩特里普（乔·基里饰演）是一个恶俗、沉迷于色情片的人，他制作了一个人民法院式的真人秀节目《同侪陪审团》，搞笑之处在于陪审团由褪色的偶像和 D 级明星组成。尽管特里普并没有为父母感到骄傲，但他以最小的孩子们幼稚的方式与他们亲近，并且对他们日益摇摇欲坠（且危险）的政治态度比他的妹妹布鲁克（莉莉·拉贝饰）更加冷漠，布鲁克是一只害群之马，很久以前逃到了东海岸，在那里婚姻破裂，并在精神病院度过了几个月。

paras.en: The American moment in which Brooke and her parents find themselves — just after George W. Bush’s second election victory — is a fraught one for such ideological divides within a family, the respective sides pushed further from one another as the nation dumbs itself with modern media and tilts into what could become another Vietnam. But more poignantly ailing the Wyeths, maybe, is the ghost of Polly and Lyman’s eldest son, Henry, who dropped out and burnt out before taking his own life following a Weather Underground-esque bombing that killed a security guard at an Army recruitment facility.
paras.zh: 就在乔治·W·布什第二次选举胜利之后，布鲁克和她的父母发现自己所处的美国时刻是一个令人担忧的时刻，因为一个家庭内部存在着这样的意识形态分歧，随着这个国家用现代媒体愚弄自己，并倾向于可能成为另一个越南，双方之间的分歧越来越大。但更让怀斯一家感到痛苦的或许是波莉和莱曼的长子亨利的鬼魂。亨利在一次类似地下气象报的爆炸事件中导致一名陆军征兵设施的保安身亡后，他辍学并在自杀前精疲力竭。

paras.en: That’s 30 years in the past, though, which is where the family has largely kept that pain, until Brooke announces that she’s written the book that will till the earth of their tragedy for all to see. Horrified parents thus turn on addled daughter, with aimless, amoral son caught in the middle.
paras.zh: 然而，那已经是 30 年前的事了，这家人在很大程度上一直保留着这种痛苦，直到布鲁克宣布她写了这本书，这本书将让所有人都看到他们的悲剧。惊恐万分的父母于是把矛头指向了精神错乱的女儿，而漫无目的、不道德的儿子则被夹在中间。

paras.en: Minus the specific details, this is a familiar set-up in the American theater; anyone weaned on the medium is well (and perhaps fondly) aware of the squabbling, big-gesture, family-secret genre. We just saw it in sterling form on Broadway recently, in two awards-bedecked plays from the same playwright: Brandon Jacobs-Jenkins’ companion-piece barn burners Appropriate and Purpose. It’s a hoary but still fecund form — I’m tempted to make the contention that almost every great playwright worth their salt must have their version of a juicy living-room brawl in their portfolio.
paras.zh: 除去具体细节，这是美国剧院中常见的设置；任何接触过这种媒体的人都清楚（或许还深情地）了解这种争吵、大动作、家庭秘密的类型。我们最近刚刚在百老汇看到了它的纯正形式，在同一位剧作家的两部获奖戏剧中：布兰登·雅各布斯-詹金斯的姊妹篇《谷仓燃烧器》《适当》和《目的》。这是一种古老但仍然丰富的形式——我很想提出这样的论点：几乎每一位称职的伟大剧作家的作品中都必须有他们版本的有趣的客厅争吵。

paras.en: When it first debuted, Other Desert Cities — the title referring to a sign on the highway approaching Palm Springs, but perhaps also alluding to places in faraway countries that were being bombed and invaded at the time of the story — was hailed as one of the greats of its kind. Theatergoers in the elated and relieved first blushes of the Obama age were hungry for plays that looked back at the terrible destruction and numbskullery of the Bush years, eager to sift through the rubble and find some piercing insight that might put all that horror in its proper context. And to have a laugh, too, now that dinosaurs like Polly and Lyman had been proven so terribly wrong.
paras.zh: 当它首次亮相时，《其他沙漠城市》——标题指的是接近棕榈泉的高速公路上的一个标志，但也许也暗指在故事发生时正在遭受轰炸和入侵的遥远国家的地方——被誉为同类中最伟大的作品之一。奥巴马时代的观众在兴高采烈、如释重负的第一眼红时，渴望看到能够回顾布什时代可怕的破坏和麻木的戏剧，渴望在废墟中筛选并找到一些敏锐的洞察力，可以将所有这些恐怖放在适当的背景下。现在，像波利和莱曼这样的恐龙已经被证明是大错特错了，也可以开怀大笑。

paras.en: I saw the play back then, and was rattled and moved and amused by it, just as so many others were. It was a pleasure to watch Stockard Channing as Polly, playing the dark inverse of her solid-liberal first lady character on The West Wing; to sit in the rumbling majesty of Stacy Keach as grizzly old teddy bear Lyman; to enjoy Judith Light wryly staggering around as Polly’s tenuously sober sister, Silda (played in this production by Allison Janney). And the cri de coeur of Baitz’s writing made its impact, too: His portrait of wealthy and once powerful right-wingers stranded on the wrong side of history felt like a smug and bitterly sad goodbye to an era, to an entire ethos over which we had just triumphed.
paras.zh: 我当时就看过这部剧，和很多人一样，被它惊吓、感动、好笑。很高兴看到斯托卡德·钱宁饰演波莉，在《白宫风云》中扮演坚定自由的第一夫人角色的黑暗反面。坐在史黛西·基奇 (Stacy Keach) 的隆隆威严中，扮演灰白的老泰迪熊莱曼 (Lyman)；朱迪思·莱特 (Judith Light) 饰演波莉 (Polly) 清醒的妹妹西尔达 (Silda)（在这部作品中由艾莉森·詹尼 (Allison Janney) 饰演），她苦笑着摇摇晃晃地走来走去。拜茨作品中的内心呐喊也产生了影响：他对富有且曾经强大的右翼分子的描绘，被困在历史的错误一边，感觉就像是对一个时代、对我们刚刚战胜的整个精神的自鸣得意和痛苦的悲伤告别。

paras.en: In hindsight, of course, that was an awfully presumptuous sentiment. Baitz could in no way have predicted what would come belching out of hell in the wake of Obama optimism, which makes much of Other Desert Cities seem like an ossified, naïve period piece. And yet there is still some pertinence to be mined; plenty of liberal kids are currently railing against the cold self-dealing of their rich, Trump-voting parents. At least, that’s the value that the producers of this new production at the Hudson Theatre might have seen in the text.
paras.zh: 当然，事后看来，这是一种非常自以为是的情绪。贝茨根本无法预测奥巴马的乐观主义会带来什么，这使得其他沙漠城市的大部分内容看起来像是一个僵化、天真的时代作品。然而，仍有一些相关性有待挖掘。许多自由派孩子目前正在抱怨他们富有的、投票特朗普的父母冷酷的自我交易。至少，这是哈德逊剧院这部新作品的制片人可能在文本中看到的价值。

paras.en: In order to really sell this political-meets-personal drama in the present day, they’d need a starry cast, and one has indeed been impressively assembled. The A-list ensemble has made Other Desert Cities one of the hottest tickets of the fall season; as proof of that, my audience was stacked with celebrities, there to either cheer on their peers or stew enviously in their success.
paras.zh: 为了在当今真正推销这部政治与个人相结合的戏剧，他们需要明星阵容，而其中的阵容确实令人印象深刻。一流的乐团使“其他沙漠城市”成为秋季最热门的门票之一；作为证明，我的听众中挤满了名人，他们要么为同龄人欢呼，要么羡慕他们的成功。

paras.en: The latter camp wasn’t given much reason to sulk, though. This Other Desert Cities, directed by John Benjamin Hickey, is wobbly from the start, off-rhythm and woefully imbalanced in its performances. The biggest draw here is no doubt Louis-Dreyfus, a TV comedy icon who has won 11 Emmys and a Mark Twain Prize. Sharp, nimble and unafraid of humor’s dark corners, Louis-Dreyfus is a legend for good reason. She has also proved an adept dramatic actress in two Nicole Holofcener films, Enough Said and You Hurt My Feelings, performances that should have garnered far more acclaim than they did. I don’t know anyone who loves the filmed arts who doesn’t also love Julia Louis-Dreyfus. Which is why it’s such a shame to report that she really doesn’t work here.
paras.zh: 不过，后一个阵营并没有太多理由生闷气。这部由约翰·本杰明·希基执导的《其他沙漠城市》从一开始就摇摇欲坠，节奏失调，表演严重不平衡。这里最吸引人的无疑是路易斯-德雷福斯，他是一位荣获 11 项艾美奖和一项马克·吐温奖的电视喜剧偶像。路易斯-德雷福斯敏锐、敏捷，不畏幽默的阴暗角落，成为传奇是有充分理由的。她还在妮可·哈洛芬瑟的两部电影《说得够多》和《你伤害了我的感情》中证明了自己是一位娴熟的戏剧演员，这些表演本应获得比他们更多的赞誉。我不知道有哪个热爱电影艺术的人不喜欢朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷福斯。这就是为什么报告她真的不在这里工作真是太遗憾了。

paras.en: Louis-Dreyfus leans too hard on the sitcom-y beats of Baitz’s early banter, which sets her up poorly for the towering drama to come. Polly is spoken about as the lion of the household, a force of nature who ruthlessly commands her family in a cute tennis skirt or boho, Saks-outing maxi dress. Louis-Dreyfus, though, communicates little of that power; she’s too airy and chipper, never giving us the sense that Polly is firmly planted in the bedrock of her world.
paras.zh: 路易斯-德雷福斯过于依赖贝茨早期戏谑的情景喜剧节奏，这让她为即将到来的精彩戏剧做好了准备。波莉被认为是家庭中的狮子，一种自然的力量，她穿着可爱的网球裙或波西米亚风格的萨克斯外出长裙，无情地命令她的家人。然而，路易-德雷福斯并没有传达出多少这种力量。她太轻快、活泼，从来没有让我们感觉到波莉牢牢植根于她的世界的基石中。

paras.en: While Louis-Dreyfus deftly lands a few killer lines, and does achingly register some of the sadder stretches, Channing’s moody gravitas is sorely missed, especially when Polly gets angry. Pinched and peppery worked really well for Louis-Dreyfus on Veep, but Polly’s rage is meant to be a deeper, more elemental threat, one amassed to conceal an ocean of pain and regret. We pick up little of that layered complexity in this performance.
paras.zh: 虽然路易斯-德雷福斯巧妙地说出了几句杀手锏，并且确实痛苦地记录了一些更悲伤的片段，但查宁喜怒无常的庄严却令人非常怀念，尤其是当波莉生气的时候。路易斯-德雷福斯在《副总统》中的紧张和辛辣效果非常好，但波莉的愤怒意味着一种更深层次、更基本的威胁，一种聚集起来掩盖痛苦和遗憾的海洋。我们在这次表演中几乎没有看到分层的复杂性。

paras.en: Harris, on the night I saw him at least, seems lost, failing to find the music in Lyman’s shift from supportive dad to titan indignantly defending his master-of-the-universe life choices. I found myself wondering if Harris was maybe going up on his lines a little; there were sudden breaks in tempo that suggested an actor grasping for the next measure. Perhaps to make up for Louis-Dreyfus’ flimsiness and Harris’ willowy presence, Rabe turns the melodrama knob up too high, churning the play’s second act into a sometimes illegible howl of despair. Janney, such a smooth pro on stage, tries to keep things grounded and in motion, but can’t really find her place in this out-of-sync ensemble.
paras.zh: 至少在我见到他的那天晚上，哈里斯似乎迷失了方向，在莱曼从支持他的父亲转变为愤怒地捍卫他宇宙大师的人生选择的巨人的过程中，他找不到音乐。我发现自己想知道哈里斯是否可能在他的台词上稍微提高了一点；节奏突然中断，表明演员正在抓紧下一步。也许是为了弥补路易斯-德雷福斯的脆弱和哈里斯的柔弱存在，拉贝把情节剧的旋钮调得太高，把该剧的第二幕搅成了有时难以辨认的绝望嚎叫。珍妮在舞台上是一位如此流畅的专业人士，她试图让一切扎根并保持运转，但无法真正在这个不同步的合奏中找到自己的位置。

paras.en: The best acting is done by Stranger Things star Keery, who credibly embodies a young man whose privilege and access have certainly made him cynical, but not yet entirely indecent. He is simply the spoiled, listless baby of a family whom he is too young to have known at their mightiest, before the postlapsarian retreat to the desert, buried child in tow. Keery nails the way that guys of a certain stripe tend to pivot between snark and sensitivity, punctuating real feelings with a joke or a nihilistic provocation. He understands the intended tone of Baitz’s rickety dynasty, the clan’s haughty but not entirely confident put-on that through even this, they — like a noble idea of old America itself — shall endure.
paras.zh: 最好的表演是由《怪奇物语》的主演基里完成的，他可信地体现了一个年轻人的特权和接触，这无疑让他变得愤世嫉俗，但还没有完全不雅。他只是一个被宠坏了、无精打采的孩子，他还太小，无法了解这个家庭在堕落后撤退到沙漠之前，把孩子埋葬在最强大的时期。基里指出了某些类型的人倾向于在尖刻和敏感之间摇摆的方式，用笑话或虚无主义的挑衅来强调真实的感受。他理解拜茨摇摇欲坠的王朝的意图，这个家族傲慢但并不完全自信，即使如此，他们——就像旧美国本身的崇高理念一样——将持续下去。

paras.en: Keery’s best moment comes at the start of act two, when he fizzily delivers a biting monologue about the banalities and anxieties of his existence. One hopes that this welcome clarity and energy will sustain through the rest of the play, but Hickey all too soon lets the tension sag.
paras.zh: 基里的最佳时刻出现在第二幕的开头，当时他气喘吁吁地发表了一段辛辣的独白，讲述了他存在的平庸和焦虑。人们希望这种令人欢迎的清晰度和活力能够贯穿整部剧的其余部分，但希基很快就让紧张气氛缓和下来。

paras.en: The entire back half of Other Desert Cities is meant to build to a grand reveal that bares a stark truth about the Wyeths’ hypocrisy, about the parents’ failure to live public principle in private, or the other way around. That shock is severely dampened by Hickey’s enervating pacing; there is nothing steady about the build here, the line graph of the production instead one of sudden lurches.
paras.zh: 《其他沙漠城市》的整个后半部分旨在打造一个盛大的揭秘，揭露惠氏夫妇的虚伪、父母私下未能遵守公共原则的赤裸裸真相，反之亦然。希基令人疲倦的步伐严重削弱了这种震惊。这里的构建没有什么稳定的，生产的线图而不是突然的倾斜。

paras.en: Only the lovely writing at the very end of the play — when one character in a pool of light reflects, years later, on what all of this led to — delivers a swell of heady emotion. Just about everything else in this expensively populated place is arid, overheated and woefully devoid of life.
paras.zh: 只有剧末可爱的文字——当一个角色在光池中反思多年后这一切所导致的结果——传递出一种令人陶醉的情感。在这个人口稠密的地方，几乎所有其他东西都干旱、过热，而且严重缺乏生命。

paras.en: Producers: Bad Robot Live, ATG Productions, Gavin Kalin Productions
paras.zh: 制作人：Bad Robot Live、ATG Productions、Gavin Kalin Productions
