Already, they don't have cooking gas to cook for themselves. And, you know, they told me they eat once a day. They have no fresh vegetables. So these are people who, you know, are not eating enough already.
paras.zh: SKAU：当我在一个提供热饭菜的分发点时，这是一个大锅，你会为每个带着锅走开的人分享一顿饭。而这些人是最脆弱的。这些人住在靠近前线的地方。他们告诉我，许多人在过去几周内流离失所。他们已经没有燃气可以自己做饭了。而且，你知道，他们告诉我他们每天吃一次。他们没有新鲜蔬菜。所以，你知道，这些人已经吃得不够了。

paras.en: And as we are now facing the winter, we are being forced to cut. You know, we are cutting almost half a million people off assistance in these next few weeks. It's not because the needs are down. It's also not because we are not able to bring in food. It's because the funding is no longer there.
paras.zh: 由于我们现在正面临冬天，我们被迫减产。你知道，在接下来的几周内，我们将削减近 50 万人的援助。这并不是因为需求下降。这也不是因为我们不能带食物进来。因为资金已经没有了。

paras.en: ROSE: What happened? Why is the funding falling short of the need?
paras.zh: 罗斯：发生了什么事？资金为何无法满足需求？

paras.en: SKAU: Well, it's because it's a massive operation. You know, we've been reaching 2 million people every month in an environment that is also relatively expensive. So it's a massive undertaking. But of course, this is not the time to turn away. If anything, this is the time to step up. We need to sustain this effort, sustain this emergency support so we can protect the gains that we made.
paras.zh: SKAU：嗯，因为这是一项大规模的行动。您知道，我们每个月都在一个相对昂贵的环境中接触 200 万人。所以这是一项艰巨的任务。但当然，现在还不是转身离开的时候。如果有的话，现在是挺身而出的时候了。我们需要维持这一努力，维持这种紧急支持，以便我们能够保护我们取得的成果。

paras.en: But also, we need to move beyond that, frankly. I mean, we need to now really make a push on early recovery, help people get some proper housing and shelter before the winter. Then on the food side, you know, we want commercial to come in. We want the markets to start working so that we can instead distribute cash. It's much cheaper, and it helps people - you know, they can choose for themselves. There is some dignity in that, and it would be the way to start some kind of domestic food system as well.
paras.zh: 但坦率地说，我们还需要超越这一点。我的意思是，我们现在需要真正推动早期恢复，帮助人们在冬天之前获得适当的住房和庇护所。然后在食品方面，你知道，我们希望商业介入。我们希望市场开始运转，这样我们就可以分发现金。它便宜得多，而且对人们有帮助——你知道，他们可以自己选择。这有一定的尊严，而且这也是启动某种国内食品系统的方式。

paras.en: ROSE: I want to ask you about the flow of goods and supplies into Gaza. There has been some reporting about the suspension of commercial shipments into the Gaza Strip in recent days. What is going on there?
paras.zh: 罗斯：我想问你有关进入加沙的货物和物资流动情况。最近几天有一些关于暂停向加沙地带商业运输的报道。那里发生了什么事？

paras.en: SKAU: Well, that's deeply concerning. There is some disagreement around taxation for commercial goods. And, you know, this is at a time when, if anything, we need to scale up. When we were there, there hadn't been any entry of commercial goods for five days. We now saw some commercial trucks moving. I hope that means that this has been resolved because what we really need is to expand the commercial and bring more fresh foods and vegetables.
paras.zh: SKAU：嗯，这非常令人担忧。关于商业商品的税收存在一些分歧。而且，你知道，现在正是我们需要扩大规模的时候。我们去的时候，已经五天没有任何商品进入了。我们现在看到一些商用卡车在移动。我希望这意味着这个问题已经得到解决，因为我们真正需要的是扩大商业规模并带来更多的新鲜食品和蔬菜。

paras.en: There's a lot of, you know, chocolates and chips coming in and Cokes. That's not really what's needed. And that's because there is bigger margin, I guess, on that and that you don't need a cold chain. But what we need is proper commercial goods coming in, food goods that - you know, the fresh foods, the fresh vegetables and fruits. That's what we need to diversify, but also to bring down the prices on the market so that people with the cash they have can get more.
paras.zh: 你知道，有很多巧克力、薯条和可乐。这并不是真正需要的。我想，那是因为这方面有更大的利润，而且你不需要冷链。但我们需要的是适当的商品进来，食品——你知道，新鲜食品、新鲜蔬菜和水果。这就是我们需要的多元化，同时也需要降低市场价格，以便拥有现金的人们可以获得更多。

paras.en: ROSE: Beyond funding, what else needs to happen to ensure that the necessary aid gets to the people who need it the most?
paras.zh: 罗斯：除了提供资金之外，还需要采取哪些措施来确保最需要的人获得必要的援助？

paras.en: SKAU: Well, I guess, I mean, clearly, there needs to be progress on the peace plan. But, you know, we don't need to wait with early recovery. The big issue there is the dual-use problems. We need UNICEF and other partners to be able to bring in what they need to restore water and sanitation facilities. We need to be able to get the learning material in so we can expand on those temporary learning centers that are there. And there is lots of garbage everywhere. So you can just imagine when the rains start hitting, it's going to be an absolute mess there.
paras.zh: 斯考：嗯，我想，我的意思是，显然，和平计划需要取得进展。但是，你知道，我们不需要等待早日康复。最大的问题是双重用途问题。我们需要联合国儿童基金会和其他合作伙伴提供恢复供水和卫生设施所需的资源。我们需要能够获取学习材料，以便我们可以扩展那里的临时学习中心。而且到处都有很多垃圾。所以你可以想象一下，当雨开始袭来时，那里将会变得一团糟。

paras.en: But on the food side, again, I mean, you know, us now moving into a period where we have to cut 500,000 - half a million people - off our assistance, this is going to cause additional pressure just as the winter hit. And so we need to avoid that. We need donors to step up with funding. But we, of course, also need international community to step up and push forward on the political tracks so there is a solution here. Three years into this, you know, life is at a standstill. They need some hope, and they need to be given the basics to start rebuilding their lives.
paras.zh: 但在食品方面，我的意思是，我们现在正进入一个必须削减 50 万（50 万人）援助的时期，这将在冬季来临之际造成额外的压力。所以我们需要避免这种情况。我们需要捐助者加大资金投入。但当然，我们也需要国际社会在政治轨道上加紧推动，以便找到解决方案。三年过去了，你知道，生活陷入了停滞。他们需要一些希望，需要获得开始重建生活的基础。

articles.title: Political rivals implicated under Pakistan's anti-terror law
articles.author: Betsy Joles

paras.en: Political rivals implicated under Pakistan's anti-terror law
paras.zh: 政治对手受到巴基斯坦反恐法的牵连

paras.en: Pakistan's political showdown continues as more opposition figures are implicated under Pakistan's anti-terror law.
paras.zh: 随着越来越多的反对派人士受到巴基斯坦反恐法的牵连，巴基斯坦的政治摊牌仍在继续。

paras.en: Pakistan's political showdown continues. The former leader of a fractious province that borders Afghanistan has officially been added to a major terrorism case, joining a long list of political figures implicated under anti-terrorism legislation. Betsy Joles has more on this from Islamabad.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦的政治摊牌仍在继续。与阿富汗接壤的一个脾气暴躁的省份的前领导人已正式被纳入一起重大恐怖主义案件，加入了受反恐立法牵连的一长串政治人物名单。贝特西·乔尔斯 (Betsy Joles) 在伊斯兰堡报道了更多相关内容。

paras.en: BETSY JOLES, BYLINE: Pakistan's Anti-Terrorism Act came into effect in 1997. At that time, sectarian and ethnic violence was raging in two of the country's most populous provinces. The anti-terrorism law provided a parallel legal system for speedier trials of those accused. Then came the U.S.-led war on terror. This is George W. Bush in 2001.
paras.zh: 贝西·乔尔斯连线：巴基斯坦的《反恐法》于 1997 年生效。当时，宗派和种族暴力在该国人口最多的两个省份肆虐。反恐法提供了一个平行的法律制度，以加快对被告的审判。随后美国领导的反恐战争爆发了。这是2001年的乔治·W·布什。

paras.en: GEORGE W BUSH: Our war on terror begins with al-Qaida, but it does not end there. It will not end until every terrorist group of global reach has been found, stopped and defeated.
paras.zh: 乔治·W·布什：我们的反恐战争始于基地组织，但并没有结束。直到每一个影响全球的恐怖组织都被找到、制止和击败为止，这场战争才会结束。

paras.en: JOLES: In the aftermath of 9/11, Pakistan's border belt became a base for militants regrouping after the U.S. invasion of Afghanistan. That gave rise to other insurgencies, like the Tehrik-e Taliban Pakistan, or Pakistan Taliban, in 2007. They'd go on to carry out attack after attack in Pakistan. Here's news of one particularly deadly attack at the Army Public School in Peshawar broadcast on Geo News.
paras.zh: 乔尔斯：9/11 事件发生后，巴基斯坦边境地区成为美国入侵阿富汗后武装分子重新集结的基地。这引发了其他叛乱组织，例如 2007 年的巴基斯坦塔利班运动（Tehrik-e Taliban）或巴基斯坦塔利班（Pakistan Taliban）。他们在巴基斯坦发动了一次又一次的袭击。以下是《地理新闻》播出的白沙瓦陆军公立学校发生的一次特别致命的袭击事件的新闻。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED REPORTER: (Non-English language spoken).
paras.zh: 身份不明的记者：（非英语语言）。

paras.en: JOLES: Anti-terrorism courts were one way to try militants. But by this time, anti-terrorism legislation had also been used in cases involving politicians. Nawaz Sharif, the brother of the current prime minister, faced charges under it in 2000, as did General Pervez Musharraf, who overthrew Sharif in a military coup a year earlier. Zoha Waseem, a researcher focused on policing in Pakistan, says it ties back to the law's wording.
paras.zh: 乔尔斯：反恐法庭是审判武装分子的一种方式。但此时，反恐立法也被用于涉及政客的案件。现任总理的兄弟纳瓦兹·谢里夫 (Nawaz Sharif) 于 2000 年面临该罪的指控，一年前在军事政变中推翻谢里夫的佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫 (Pervez Musharraf) 将军也面临同样的指控。专注于巴基斯坦治安问题的研究员佐哈·瓦西姆 (Zoha Waseem) 表示，这与法律的措辞有关。

paras.en: ZOHA WASEEM: Terrorism is very broadly defined, and that's been the case for a few decades now under this law.
paras.zh: 佐哈·瓦西姆：恐怖主义的定义非常广泛，根据这项法律，几十年来一直如此。

paras.en: JOLES: In the years since its inception, the law was amended several times to expand its definition and the powers it granted to law enforcement. These days, it could mean...
paras.zh: 乔尔斯：自该法颁布以来，该法已多次修订，以扩大其定义和赋予执法部门的权力。如今，这可能意味着...

paras.en: WASEEM: Anything from kidnapping for ransom, street crime, money laundering or supporting an organization that is considered to be banned.
paras.zh: WASEEM：从绑架勒索、街头犯罪、洗钱或支持被视为禁止的组织等任何行为。

paras.en: JOLES: The terrorism case that names Sohail Afridi, the former chief minister of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, now under emergency rule, relates to an attack on a state-run radio station. Supporters of former Prime Minister Imran Khan stormed the building and set it on fire after he was arrested in 2023. Footage from elsewhere in Pakistan that day shows Khan's supporters running through the street waving his party's flag as smoke billows around them.
paras.zh: 乔尔斯：目前处于紧急状态的开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省前首席部长索海尔·阿夫里迪的恐怖主义案件与对一家国营广播电台的袭击有关。前总理伊姆兰·汗 (Imran Khan) 于 2023 年被捕后，他的支持者冲进了这座建筑并将其纵火。当天从巴基斯坦其他地方拍摄的视频显示，汗的支持者在街上挥舞着政党旗帜，周围浓烟滚滚。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PERSON: (Shouting in non-English language).
paras.zh: 身份不明的人：（用非英语语言大喊）。

paras.en: JOLES: Khan himself is now facing terrorism charges, so are the leaders of a banned hard-line Islamist party. In recent years, Kashmiri, Pashtun and Baloch activists have been accused of terrorism too.
paras.zh: 乔尔斯：汗本人现在面临恐怖主义指控，被禁止的强硬伊斯兰政党的领导人也是如此。近年来，克什米尔、普什图和俾路支活动人士也被指控犯有恐怖主义行为。

paras.en: SHIREEN MAZARI: The problem is that you're trivializing the anti-terrorism law.
paras.zh: Shireen Mazari：问题在于你轻视了反恐法。

paras.en: JOLES: Shireen Mazari knows the gravity of this law well because her daughter, Imaan Mazari, and son-in-law, Hadi Ali Chattha, are currently being tried under it. They're lawyers and have been in prison since January - first, in a case related to their social media posts and now for charges that include spreading terror. Mazari is a former politician who has, herself, spent time in jail. But with her daughter's situation, she feels powerless.
paras.zh: 乔尔斯：Shireen Mazari 非常了解这项法律的严重性，因为她的女儿 Imaan Mazari 和女婿 Hadi Ali Chattha 目前正在根据该法律接受审判。他们是律师，自一月份以来一直在监狱中 - 首先是因为与他们的社交媒体帖子有关的案件，现在是因为包括散布恐怖在内的指控。马扎里是一名前政客，她本人也曾入狱。但面对女儿的处境，她却感到无能为力。

paras.en: JOLES: There's nothing you can do. For NPR News, I'm Betsy Joles in Islamabad.
paras.zh: 乔尔斯：你无能为力。我是 NPR 新闻的贝特西·乔尔斯 (Betsy Joles)，来自伊斯兰堡。

paras.en: (SOUNDBITE OF ENLUV AND PAUL GRANT'S "JUNGLE GYM")
paras.zh: （ENLUV 和保罗·格兰特的“丛林健身房”原声片段）

paras.zh: 摩根大通是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。 Motley Fool 持有并推荐摩根大通 (JPMorgan Chase)、塔吉特 (Target) 和 Visa 等公司。 Motley Fool 推荐第一资本金融公司 (Capital One Financial) 和优步科技 (Uber Technologies)。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。

articles.title: Arizona man accused of plotting mass casualty attack on religious site with 'cookbook' tied to OKC bombing

paras.en: An Arizona man who allegedly plotted a mass casualty attack on a Jewish or Muslim house of worship is being accused by prosecutors of possessing an infamous bomb-making manual linked to the Oklahoma City bomber.
paras.zh: 一名亚利桑那州男子涉嫌策划对犹太或穆斯林礼拜堂进行大规模伤亡袭击，目前被检察官指控拥有与俄克拉荷马城炸弹袭击者有关的臭名昭著的炸弹制造手册。

paras.en: Matthew Bjornholt, 27, faces a felony count of making a terrorist threat in connection with his alleged plot to attack a religious site.
paras.zh: 27 岁的马修·比约恩霍尔特 (Matthew Bjornholt) 因涉嫌密谋袭击宗教场所而面临制造恐怖威胁的重罪。

paras.en: Prosecutors in Maricopa County said Bjornholt laid out a chilling blueprint for violence that involved guns, explosives and an accomplice tasked with gunning down survivors.
paras.zh: 马里科帕县检察官表示，比约恩霍尔特制定了一份令人毛骨悚然的暴力蓝图，其中涉及枪支、爆炸物和一名负责枪杀幸存者的同谋。

paras.en: During an initial court appearance on Friday, prosecutor Stephen Garcia sought a $500,000 cash bond, calling Bjornholt an imminent danger to the community, according to FOX 10.
paras.zh: 据福克斯 10 台报道，在周五首次出庭时，检察官斯蒂芬·加西亚 (Stephen Garcia) 寻求 50 万美元的现金保证金，称比约恩霍尔特对社区构成迫在眉睫的危险。

paras.en: Bjornholt allegedly outlined detailed plans to attack a religious site, according to Garcia, who also claimed the suspect kept a copy of "The Anarchist Cookbook," a manual containing bomb-making instructions that has been linked to Oklahoma City bomber Timothy McVeigh.
paras.zh: 加西亚称，比约恩霍尔特据称概述了袭击宗教场所的详细计划，他还声称嫌疑人保留了一本《无政府主义食谱》，该手册包含炸弹制造说明，与俄克拉荷马城炸弹袭击者蒂莫西·麦克维有关。

paras.en: Garcia alleged that Bjornholt referred to the book as his "Bible."
paras.zh: 加西亚声称比约恩霍尔特将这本书称为他的“圣经”。

paras.en: The alleged plot included plans to detonate bombs before an accomplice of Bjornholt's would begin "picking off people" with firearms, according to prosecutors.
paras.zh: 检察官称，涉嫌的阴谋包括计划在比约恩霍尔特的同伙开始用枪支“杀人”之前引爆炸弹。

paras.en: Investigators later seized three guns and ammunition from Bjornholt’s home.
paras.zh: 调查人员后来从比约恩霍尔特的家中查获了三支枪和弹药。

paras.en: Bjornholt’s defense attorney, Chad Schell, pushed back against the allegations, claiming that the charges are based solely on unverified hearsay from a disgruntled former acquaintance, according to FOX 10.
paras.zh: 据福克斯 10 台报道，比约恩霍尔特的辩护律师查德·谢尔反驳了这些指控，称这些指控完全是基于一位心怀不满的前熟​​人的未经证实的传闻。

paras.en: Schell told the court that the tip came from a "homeless alcoholic" whom Bjornholt had briefly let crash on his couch before kicking him out late last month.
paras.zh: 谢尔告诉法庭，这个消息来自一名“无家可归的酒鬼”，比约恩霍尔特曾短暂地让他躺在沙发上，然后上个月末将他赶了出去。

paras.en: Schell said federal authorities had already investigated the claims weeks ago. Schell said the FBI executed a search warrant at Bjornholt’s home on Sept. 29 and that Bjornholt voluntarily provided investigators with his electronic devices and passwords.
paras.zh: 谢尔表示，联邦当局几周前就已经对这些说法进行了调查。谢尔表示，FBI 于 9 月 29 日对比约恩霍尔特的家执行了搜查令，比约恩霍尔特自愿向调查人员提供了他的电子设备和密码。

paras.en: According to Schell, federal investigators found no evidence of terrorism or bomb-making materials and did not pursue federal charges before county authorities took over the case a couple of weeks later.
paras.zh: 谢尔表示，联邦调查人员没有发现恐怖主义或炸弹制造材料的证据，并且在县当局几周后接手此案之前没有提出联邦指控。

paras.en: "There is no evidence he's a danger to the community. What is the evidence that he's a danger to the community? Some hearsay statements from some dude — that my client kicked out of his house two days before September 29," Schell told the court.
paras.zh: “没有证据表明他对社区构成危险。有什么证据表明他对社区构成危险？一些家伙的一些传闻——我的当事人在 9 月 29 日之前两天被赶出了家门，”谢尔告诉法庭。

paras.en: "Again, the FBI served a search warrant, got all of his electronic devices. He gave them access, gave him his passwords to those devices. They went through all of those electronic devices. They didn't see anything about terrorism. And FBI cut him loose," he continued.
paras.zh: “联邦调查局再次发出搜查令，拿到了他所有的电子设备。他给了他们访问权限，给了他这些设备的密码。他们检查了所有这些电子设备。他们没有看到任何有关恐怖主义的信息。然后联邦调查局就释放了他，”他继续说道。

paras.en: Schell also argued that the three seized guns were lawfully possessed, adding that Bjornholt's civil rights were restored after completing a previous sentence on a drug charge stemming from a closed first-degree murder case. According to Schell, the murder charge against Bjornholt was dropped because of a lack of evidence.
paras.zh: 谢尔还辩称，被查获的三把枪是合法拥有的，并补充说，比约恩霍尔特在完成对一级谋杀案中毒品指控的判决后，恢复了公民权利。谢尔表示，由于缺乏证据，对比约恩霍尔特的谋杀指控被撤销。

paras.en: The ammunition found inside the home, Schell said, was no more than standard magazine loads.
paras.zh: 谢尔说，在屋内发现的弹药不过是标准弹匣装弹量。

paras.en: Fox News Digital has reached out to the Maricopa County Attorney’s Office and FBI Phoenix for comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道已联系马里科帕县检察官办公室和联邦调查局凤凰城寻求评论。

paras.en: Despite prosecutors citing Bjornholt's criminal history in arguing for a larger bond, the judge said the state's preliminary evidence relied heavily on hearsay and set Bjornholt's bond at $100,000, according to FOX 10.
paras.zh: 据福克斯 10 台报道，尽管检察官援引比约恩霍尔特的犯罪记录来主张缴纳更多保释金，但法官表示，该州的初步证据严重依赖道听途说，并将比约恩霍尔特的保释金定为 10 万美元。

paras.en: The judge nevertheless found enough probable cause to move the case forward.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，法官还是找到了足够的可能理由来推动案件的进展。

paras.en: It remains unclear whether specific houses of worship were targeted in the alleged plot or whether there was a specific accomplice.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚该阴谋是否针对特定的礼拜堂，或者是否有特定的同谋。

paras.en: Bjornholt is scheduled to return to court on Oct. 22 for a status conference and then later for a preliminary hearing on Oct. 26.
paras.zh: 比约恩霍尔特计划于 10 月 22 日返回法庭参加情况会议，然后于 10 月 26 日举行初步听证会。

articles.title: NFC East nearing second straight winless week as Packers beat struggling Cowboys on 'Sunday Night Football'

paras.en: The Green Bay Packers’ win over the Dallas Cowboys, 23-13, on "Sunday Night Football" maintained a tale of two divisions in the NFC.
paras.zh: 绿湾包装工队在《周日橄榄球之夜》中以 23-13 战胜达拉斯牛仔队，延续了国联两分区的传奇。

paras.en: The NFC North is once again a very strong group to begin the 2026 season, and perhaps for the second straight week, the NFC East will be winless.
paras.zh: 国联北部队在 2026 赛季开始时再次成为一支非常强大的球队，也许国联东部队将连续第二周不胜。

paras.en: Last week, the Cowboys and Philadelphia Eagles both lost, while the New York Giants and Washington Commanders managed an overtime tie in wacky fashion.
paras.zh: 上周，牛仔队和费城老鹰队双双输球，而纽约巨人队和华盛顿指挥官队则在加时赛中以古怪的方式打成平手。

paras.en: After the Giants and Eagles lost in the 1 p.m. slate this Sunday, the Cowboys were routed at Lambeau Field by a Packers team that did much of the same against their divisional foe, the Chicago Bears.
paras.zh: 巨人队和老鹰队在下午 1 点输球后。本周日，牛仔队在朗博球场被包装工队击败，而包装工队也以同样的方式击败了他们的分区对手芝加哥熊队。

paras.en: That leaves the Commanders, sitting at the bottom of the division at 1-3-1, as the only team still able to pick up a victory, though it will be tough on the road against a red-hot San Francisco 49ers squad that remains unbeaten.
paras.zh: 这使得指挥官队以 1-3-1 的成绩位居分区垫底，成为唯一一支仍然能够取得胜利的球队，尽管他们在客场对阵保持不败的炙手可热的旧金山 49 人队将会很艰难。

paras.en: It’s too early to say this NFC East division has shades of 2020, when Washington won it at 7-9, but it’s been an interesting start to say the least. In recent seasons, one team usually breaks away from the pack and wins pretty comfortably, but each team has its own issues that need addressing at the moment.
paras.zh: 现在说 NFC 东区有 2020 年的影子还为时过早，当时华盛顿以 7-9 获胜，但至少可以说这是一个有趣的开始。最近几个赛季，一支球队通常会脱颖而出并轻松获胜，但每支球队目前都有自己需要解决的问题。

paras.en: For the Cowboys, it was the defense entering this game against the Packers. Tampa Bay Buccaneers rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels looked too comfortable in "Jerry’s World" in just his second career start, and first road game, in Week 5’s shocking win over Dallas. The Cowboys brought Mike Pettine out of retirement, hiring him as a senior defensive assistant to help out Christian Parker, the team’s defensive coordinator, get this group back on track.
paras.zh: 对于牛仔队来说，这是对阵包装工队这场比赛的防守。坦帕湾海盗队新秀四分卫贾隆·丹尼尔斯在“杰里的世界”中看起来太舒服了，这是他职业生涯的第二次首发，也是第一个客场比赛，在第五周令人震惊地战胜了达拉斯。牛仔队让迈克·佩廷（Mike Pettine）复出，聘请他作为高级防守助理，帮助球队防守协调员克里斯蒂安·帕克（Christian Parker）让球队重回正轨。

paras.en: A seasoned football mind might be what the Cowboys need in the long run, but it didn’t work tonight against the Packers.
paras.zh: 从长远来看，经验丰富的足球头脑可能是牛仔队所需要的，但在今晚对阵包装工队的比赛中，这并不起作用。

paras.en: It was an inauspicious start for the Packers through the first three weeks. In fact, Mike LaFleur’s seat was getting quite hot after a blowout loss at home to the Atlanta Falcons in Week 3.
paras.zh: 包装工队在前三周的开局并不顺利。事实上，在第三周主场惨败于亚特兰大猎鹰队之后，迈克·拉弗勒尔的座位变得相当热门。

paras.en: Since then, they’ve ripped off three straight wins, and a big reason is Jordan Love looking comfortable again in the pocket for Green Bay.
paras.zh: 从那时起，他们已经取得了三连胜，其中一个重要原因是乔丹·乐福在绿湾队中看起来再次感到舒服。

paras.en: The franchise man continues to build a strong rapport with his receivers, finishing 23-of-41 for 276 yards with a touchdown pass to Matthew Golden, who led the game with 104 yards on six grabs. And this comes after Love threw for 367 yards with two touchdowns in the 31-7 win last week.
paras.zh: 这位球队球员继续与他的接球手建立了牢固的融洽关系，41 投 23 中，取得 276 码，并传球达阵给马修·戈尔登 (Matthew Golden)，后者 6 次抢球，取得 104 码，领先全场。此前，乐福在上周以 31-7 获胜的比赛中传球 367 码并两次达阵。

paras.en: The Packers are simply buzzing now, which includes their defense continuing to take the ball away. They came into this game with nine on the year, and they added two more after picking off Dak Prescott twice.
paras.zh: 包装工队现在简直热闹非凡，其中包括他们的防守继续抢走球权。他们今年带着九场比赛进入这场比赛，在两次摘下达克·普雷斯科特后又增加了两场。

paras.en: Unlike the NFC East, the North, a division where every team finished above .500, have all gotten off to solid starts. The Packers and Bears are both 4-2 now after their wins on Sunday. The Minnesota Vikings, who remain undefeated at 5-0, and Detroit Lions, who are 3-2, are both on bye weeks.
paras.zh: 与 NFC 东部赛区不同，北部赛区的每支球队都取得了 0.500 以上的成绩，但都取得了良好的开局。周日获胜后，包装工队和熊队目前战绩均为 4 胜 2 负。明尼苏达维京人队以 5 胜 0 负的战绩保持不败，底特律雄狮队则以 3 胜 2 负的战绩进入轮空周。

paras.en: There’s so much football left to play, but the fact that the NFC East could go two weeks without a single team getting a win, while the NFC North can’t stop winning, goes to show the parody that makes the NFL so much fun each week.
paras.zh: 还有很多比赛要打，但 NFC 东区可能会连续两周没有一支球队获胜，而 NFC 北区则无法停止获胜，这一事实表明，NFL 每周都如此有趣。

paras.en: For teams in the East, though, it would be more fun if they could get a victory. But at this rate, with a slow division race, all three who played Sunday will hope Washington doesn't shock the football world on Monday night.
paras.zh: 不过对于东部球队来说，如果能取得一场胜利那就更有趣了。但按照这样的速度，随着分区赛的缓慢进行，周日参加比赛的三名球员都希望华盛顿不会在周一晚上震惊足球界。

articles.title: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier secures state arrest warrant for Raúl Castro

paras.en: Florida has obtained a state arrest warrant for former Cuban leader Raúl Castro on a no-bond charge of conspiracy to commit first-degree murder stemming from the 1996 Brothers to the Rescue shootdown, according to a warrant obtained by Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 据福克斯新闻数字频道获得的一份逮捕令，佛罗里达州已获得对古巴前领导人劳尔·卡斯特罗的州逮捕令，罪名是串谋实施一级谋杀，罪名是 1996 年“救援兄弟”被击落事件。

paras.en: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier, whose office reopened the state's investigation into Castro after he took office, is expected to announce the new arrest warrant alongside Gov. Ron DeSantis at a press conference Monday morning.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州总检察长詹姆斯·尤斯迈尔（James Uthmeier）的办公室在卡斯特罗上任后重新启动了该州对卡斯特罗的调查，预计将在周一上午的新闻发布会上与州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯一起宣布新的逮捕令。

paras.en: The no-bond warrant, issued in Miami-Dade County, directs law enforcement to immediately arrest Castro and says a judge found probable cause to believe he conspired to commit first-degree murder in connection with the deaths of four men aboard the unarmed civilian aircraft.
paras.zh: 迈阿密戴德县发出的不保释逮捕令指示执法部门立即逮捕卡斯特罗，并表示法官找到了可能的理由相信他与这架手无寸铁的民用飞机上四名男子的死亡密谋犯有一级谋杀罪。

paras.en: The warrant marks a new front in efforts to hold Castro accountable for the Feb. 24, 1996, attack, which has long reverberated through South Florida's Cuban-American community. Castro already faces a separate federal prosecution over the shootdown.
paras.zh: 该逮捕令标志着追究卡斯特罗对 1996 年 2 月 24 日袭击事件负责的努力的新战线，该袭击事件长期以来在南佛罗里达州的古巴裔美国人社区中引起反响。卡斯特罗已经因击落事件而面临单独的联邦起诉。

paras.en: "The investigation revealed evidence of a conspiracy to kill persons aboard BTTR aircraft. The deaths of Carlos Costa, Pablo Morales, Mario de la Peña, and Armando Alejandre Jr. were the object of that conspiracy," the warrant reads.
paras.zh: “调查发现了 BTTR 飞机上有人阴谋杀人的证据。卡洛斯·科斯塔、巴勃罗·莫拉莱斯、马里奥·德拉佩纳和小阿曼多·亚历杭德烈的死亡就是该阴谋的目标，”逮捕令中写道。

paras.en: According to the warrant, investigators allege that in 1996, the Castro regime's foreign intelligence service's plan to shoot down Brothers to the Rescue aircraft and kill their occupants traveled through the chain of command, with Raúl Castro and his brother, former Cuban leader Fidel Castro, as the final decision-makers.
paras.zh: 根据逮捕令，调查人员称，1996年，卡斯特罗政权的外国情报部门计划击落“兄弟救援”飞机并杀死机上人员，这一计划经过整个指挥系统，劳尔·卡斯特罗和他的兄弟、古巴前领导人菲德尔·卡斯特罗是最终决策者。

paras.en: "They have violated the airspace, the waters of the Republic. I made it clear that this had to be decentralized if we wanted it to do its job, and five generals were given the authority. I used to say: Try to shoot them down over our territory. But they would come into Havana and leave," Raúl Castro, now 95, said in a recorded statement months after the incident, recounting orders he gave to senior military leaders before the shootdown, according to the warrant.
paras.zh: “他们侵犯了共和国的领空和水域。我明确表示，如果我们想让它发挥作用，就必须将其权力下放，五名将军被授予了权力。我过去常常说：尝试在我们的领土上击落他们。但他们会进入哈瓦那并离开，”现年 95 岁的劳尔·卡斯特罗在事件发生几个月后的一份记录声明中说道，根据逮捕令，他回顾了他在击落前向高级军事领导人发出的命令。

paras.en: "Of course, with a missile shot like that, plane against plane, what comes down is a ball of fire, and it is going to fall on top of the city. So I said: Fine, shoot them down at sea when they show up, and those who have the authority are not to consult anyone," he added in his statement.
paras.zh: “当然，像这样的导弹，飞机对飞机发射，落下的是一个火球，它会落在城市的顶部。所以我说：好吧，当他们出现时，在海上击落他们，那些有权力的人不要咨询任何人，”他在声明中补充道。

paras.en: Brothers to the Rescue is a Miami-based organization that flew unarmed civilian aircraft to search for Cuban migrants stranded or lost at sea. By the mid-1990s, the group had also become involved in anti-Castro political activity, including dropping pro-democracy leaflets over Cuba.
paras.zh: 救援兄弟会是一个总部位于迈阿密的组织，该组织驾驶非武装民用飞机搜寻在海上滞留或失踪的古巴移民。到 20 世纪 90 年代中期，该组织还参与了反卡斯特罗的政治活动，包括在古巴上空散发支持民主的传单。

paras.en: The Cuban government has rejected the U.S. prosecution of Castro, maintaining that Brothers to the Rescue repeatedly violated Cuban airspace and that Cuba acted in defense of its sovereignty.
paras.zh: 古巴政府拒绝美国对卡斯特罗的起诉，坚称救援兄弟会多次侵犯古巴领空，古巴的行动是为了捍卫其主权。

paras.en: The warrant indicates that Florida authorities are seeking full extradition of Raúl Castro if he is arrested outside the Sunshine State, authorizing authorities to pursue his return to Florida to face the felony charge if he is arrested in another U.S. jurisdiction.
paras.zh: 逮捕令表明，如果劳尔·卡斯特罗在阳光州以外被捕，佛罗里达当局正在寻求将他完全引渡，如果他在美国其他司法管辖区被捕，授权当局将他送回佛罗里达接受重罪指控。

paras.en: The attorney general’s Office of Statewide Prosecution will assume jurisdiction over the multi-circuit criminal conspiracy case against Castro.
paras.zh: 总检察长的全州检察办公室将对针对卡斯特罗的多巡回刑事串谋案拥有管辖权。

articles.title: David Shoebridge responds to Jordon Steele-John’s explosive statement as Greens hold emergency meeting
articles.author: Josh Butler and Sarah Basford Canales

paras.en: Greens leader David Shoebridge has said it was his understanding Jordon Steele-John agreed to take leave from parliament while misconduct allegations against him are investigated, and that it’s “appropriate” that he does so, despite the Western Australian senator saying overnight that he was not on leave and had never agreed to stay away from parliament.
paras.zh: 绿党领袖大卫·舒布里奇(David Shoebridge)表示，据他了解，乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰(Jordon Steele-John)同意在对他的不当行为指控进行调查期间离开议会，而且他这样做是“适当的”，尽管这位西澳大利亚州参议员隔夜表示他没有休假，也从未同意离开议会。

paras.en: Steele-John released a lengthy, explosive statement on Sunday night claiming Shoebridge pressured him to take leave after complaints about his conduct were made public last week, and accused an internal faction within the Greens of playing “nasty political games”. He has denied any allegations of misconduct.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰周日晚上发表了一份冗长、爆炸性的声明，声称舒布里奇在上周对他的行为的投诉被公开后向他施压，要求他辞职，并指责绿党内部派系玩“肮脏的政治游戏”。他否认任何不当行为的指控。

paras.en: Shoebridge called an emergency federal party meeting on Monday morning following the 2400-word statement, which Steele-John also attended. It’s understood no decisions about the senator’s immediate future, including whether he would attend parliament this month, were taken. There will likely be further meetings this week to determine those decisions.
paras.zh: 在发表 2400 字的声明后，舒布里奇于周一上午召开了一次紧急联邦党会议，斯蒂尔-约翰也出席了会议。据了解，尚未就这位参议员的近期未来做出任何决定，包括他本月是否参加议会。本周可能还会举行进一步的会议来确定这些决定。

paras.en: The new Greens leader has not called a press conference or spoken publicly about the latest salvo from Steele-John since Sunday night, but instead released a short statement attributed to a spokesman following the meeting on Monday.
paras.zh: 自周日晚上以来，这位新任绿党领导人没有召开新闻发布会或公开谈论斯蒂尔-约翰的最新攻击，而是在周一的会议后发表了一份由发言人发表的简短声明。

paras.en: The statement said Shoebridge “firmly believes this matter must be resolved with a fair, timely and independent process as is being commissioned by the WA Greens, and he has worked to ensure this occurs.”
paras.zh: 声明称，舒布里奇“坚信此事必须按照西澳绿党的委托，通过公平、及时和独立的程序得到解决，他已努力确保这一点的实现。”

paras.en: “This process must include procedural fairness for all involved, with the key findings made public.”
paras.zh: “这个过程必须包括对所有参与者的程序公平性，并公开主要调查结果。”

paras.en: “Senator Shoebridge remains of the opinion that leave is appropriate under the circumstances and reiterates that this in no way prejudges any of the matters being referred to an inquiry commissioned by the WA Greens. It was the understanding of Senator Shoebridge that leave was agreed.”
paras.zh: “舒布里奇参议员仍然认为，在这种情况下，休假是适当的，并重申，这绝不会对西澳绿党委托调查的任何事项做出预先判断。舒布里奇参议员的理解是，同意休假。”

paras.en: That language differs from the first statement issued by Shoebridge, on the matter last Thursday, which said: “in the circumstances Senator Steele-John has requested leave from the party room and I have accepted it.”
paras.zh: 这种措辞与舒布里奇上周四就此事发表的第一份声明不同，该声明称：“在这种情况下，斯蒂尔-约翰参议员要求离开党室，我已经接受了。”

paras.en: Nine newspapers reported last week that seven party members had demanded an investigation into allegations Steel-John had acted inappropriately towards women between 2017 and 2025.
paras.zh: 九家报纸上周报道称，七名党员要求对 Steel-John 在 2017 年至 2025 年间对女性采取不当行为的指控进行调查。

paras.en: Steele-John, in his Sunday night statement, said he was not on leave, contrary to Shoebridge’s comments last week, and claimed he had been pressured by the leader to request leave on Thursday as Nine’s story was breaking.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰在周日晚上的声明中表示，与舒布里奇上周的言论相反，他并没有休假，并声称周四随着九号台的报道曝光，他受到了领导人的压力要求休假。

paras.en: “I feel that he used those meetings to repeatedly pressure me to say that I would take leave,” Steele-John said on Sunday.
paras.zh: “我觉得他利用这些会议反复向我施压，要求我休假，”斯蒂尔-约翰周日说道。

paras.en: The senator said “survivors of family violence are entitled to make decisions about their own lives and the Greens have always said so”.
paras.zh: 这位参议员表示，“家庭暴力的幸存者有权对自己的生活做出决定，绿党也一直这么说”。

paras.en: “It was a bad call from David. We’ve all made those in politics. So, to be clear, I am not on leave and did not agree to the inclusion of that line within David’s statement.”
paras.zh: “大卫的决定很糟糕。我们都曾在政治上做出过这样的决定。所以，需要明确的是，我并没有休假，也不同意将这句话纳入大卫的声明中。”

paras.en: The Western Australian Greens are expected to finalise the details of the independent investigation into the claims outlined in the letter by the end of the week.
paras.zh: 西澳大利亚绿党预计将在本周末之前敲定对信中概述的指控进行独立调查的细节。

paras.en: A separate referral has been made to the Independent Parliamentary Standards Commission.
paras.zh: 已单独提交给独立议会标准委员会。

articles.title: Minns accused of bypassing high court ruling with laws to allow NSW mine to increase coal production by 32%
articles.author: Lisa Cox and Penry Buckley

paras.en: The Minns government says it will introduce special legislation to allow a mine in the New South Wales Hunter Valley that was the subject of high court proceedings to increase its coal production by 32% per year.
paras.zh: 明斯州政府表示，将出台特别立法，允许新南威尔士州猎人谷的一座煤矿每年增加 32% 的煤炭产量，该矿场曾是高等法院诉讼的对象。

paras.en: The premier, Chris Minns, said the bill would authorise MACH Energy to increase the annual coal output at its Mount Pleasant coalmine by 4m tonnes to 16.5MT per year until 2032. He claimed it was necessary to save 400 jobs at the site before Christmas.
paras.zh: 州长 Chris Minns 表示，该法案将授权 MACH Energy 将其 Mount Pleasant 煤矿的煤炭年产量增加 400 万吨，达到 16.5 吨，直至 2032 年。他声称有必要在圣诞节前在该矿场挽救 400 个工作岗位。

paras.en: The move comes less than two weeks after the high court ruled that the approval of an expansion at the mine in Muswellbrook was invalid.
paras.zh: 不到两周前，高等法院裁定马斯韦尔布鲁克矿场扩建的批准无效。

paras.en: The company is currently permitted to mine up to 12.5MT under a separate modification that was approved in August. That approval extended the mine’s operating life to 2032 and increased the coal extraction rate by 2MT per year.
paras.zh: 根据 8 月份批准的一项单独修改，该公司目前获准开采最多 12.5 吨。该批准将该矿的运营寿命延长至 2032 年，并将煤炭开采量每年提高 2 吨。

paras.en: The government said the legislation would address “unique legal uncertainty arising from the high court’s judgment on 7 October 2026”.
paras.zh: 政府表示，该立法将解决“高等法院 2026 年 10 月 7 日判决所产生的独特法律不确定性”。

paras.en: “After discussions with the company, it’s become apparent that there are 400 jobs on the line that will go before Christmas without this intervention,” Minns said on Monday.
paras.zh: 明斯周一表示：“在与公司讨论后，很明显，如果没有这种干预，圣诞节前将有 400 个工作岗位面临失业。”

paras.en: He said if the bill passed, MACH Energy had agreed to a “jobs guarantee” to ensure that the current permanent workforce was retained until 2032.
paras.zh: 他表示，如果该法案获得通过，MACH Energy 将同意“就业保证”，以确保目前的长期劳动力保留到 2032 年。

paras.en: The NSW Greens climate spokesperson and environmental lawyer Sue Higginson said: “This is an incredible new low for the Minns Labor government, bypassing the planning process and the law as laid down by the high court of Australia.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州绿党气候发言人兼环境律师苏·希金森（Sue Higginson）表示：“对于明斯工党政府来说，这是令人难以置信的新低，绕过了澳大利亚高等法院制定的规划程序和法律。

paras.en: “One thing is clear, under Labor the coal mining giants are writing the laws, and they are laws that will cause significant unassessed climate pollution and hurt communities,” she said.
paras.zh: “有一点很清楚，在工党的领导下，煤炭开采巨头正在制定法律，这些法律将导致未经评估的严重气候污染并损害社区，”她说。

paras.en: Georgina Woods, from the Lock the Gate Alliance, accused the government of “cynical and dangerous political interference in the planning system and the courts to increase coal production and coal pollution”.
paras.zh: 来自“锁门联盟”的乔治娜·伍兹指责政府“对规划系统和法院进行愤世嫉俗和危险的政治干预，以增加煤炭产量和煤炭污染”。

paras.en: “Premier Minns is manufacturing a crisis to give special treatment to a coal company – there is no threat to jobs at Mount Pleasant, which already has approval to stay open for another six years,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“明斯州长正在制造一场危机，为一家煤炭公司提供特殊待遇——普莱森特山的就业不会受到威胁，该公司已经获准继续营业六年。”

paras.en: “We understand the importance of a safety net for mining communities and back measures that back workers, but this is not about workers. This is about corporate interests trumping the public interest.”
paras.zh: “我们了解采矿社区安全网和支持工人的措施的重要性，但这与工人无关。这是企业利益高于公共利益的问题。”

paras.en: Earlier this month, a majority of the high court found the Independent Planning Commission (IPC) failed to consider imposing conditions aimed at minimising emissions generated when the coal was burnt overseas – known as scope 3 emissions – to the greatest extent possible.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，高等法院的多数成员发现，独立计划委员会 (IPC) 未能考虑施加旨在最大程度地减少海外煤炭燃烧产生的排放（称为范围 3 排放）的条件。

paras.en: Minns said the bill, which will be introduced in the next sitting fortnight, would also include provisions to impose “restrictions” on these emissions that were similar to those in the commission’s recent approval of the state’s largest coal project – the Hunter Valley Operations extension.
paras.zh: 明斯表示，该法案将在接下来的两周内提出，其中还将包括对这些排放实施“限制”的条款，类似于该委员会最近批准的该州最大的煤炭项目——猎人谷运营扩建项目中的条款。

paras.en: “These are not easy decisions. They’re incredibly difficult, and I’ve agonised over this one in particular,” he said.
paras.zh: “这些都不是容易的决定。它们非常困难，我尤其为这个决定感到痛苦，”他说。

paras.en: “But the truth of the matter is, there’s some people who say that the only thing to worry about is industry and jobs in all and every circumstance.
paras.zh: “但事实是，有些人说唯一值得担心的是所有情况下的工业和就业。

paras.en: “And there are others who say you should only be worrying about the environment in any and all circumstances. And the truth in our economy and our community is that we have to do both.”
paras.zh: “还有其他人说，你应该在任何情况下都只担心环境。而我们的经济和社区的事实是，我们必须两者兼顾。”

paras.en: A MACH Energy spokesperson said the company welcomed the announcement, which they said would “deliver operational certainty for the Mount Pleasant mine”.
paras.zh: MACH Energy发言人表示，该公司对这一公告表示欢迎，称这将“为芒特普莱森特矿带来运营的确定性”。

paras.en: They claimed the expansion project that was the subject of the company’s unsuccessful high court appeal had been through “a rigorous and exhaustive assessment process over several years”.
paras.zh: 他们声称，该公司向高等法院上诉失败的扩建项目已经通过了“数年严格而详尽的评估程序”。

paras.en: “Since that time, the approval has been subject to numerous legal challenges by well-funded activist groups. This has created ongoing fear and uncertainty for local communities who rely on Mount Pleasant for employment, business and community support,” they said.
paras.zh: “从那时起，这一批准就受到了资金充足的活动团体的多次法律挑战。这给依赖芒特普莱森特提供就业、商业和社区支持的当地社区造成了持续的恐惧和不确定性，”他们说。

paras.en: The director of Johnson Legal, Elaine Johnson, who represented the Denman Aberdeen Muswellbrook Scone Healthy Environment Group (Dams Heg) in the high court proceedings said the government announcement “looks like legislative overreach”.
paras.zh: 在高等法院诉讼中代表 Denman Aberdeen Muswellbrook Scone 健康环境组织 (Dams Heg) 的约翰逊法律总监伊莱恩·约翰逊 (Elaine Johnson) 表示，政府的公告“看起来像是立法越权”。

paras.en: “The proposed changes to the law to allow an increase in production limits at one mine in NSW makes it look like laws are being written for individual mine owners against the public interest,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“拟议的法律修改允许提高新南威尔士州一座矿山的产量限制，这看起来像是为个人矿主制定的法律，违背了公共利益。”

paras.en: “The mine already has a modified approval allowing continued production until 2032. It’s unclear why it needs legislation to increase its production without going through the proper planning process.
paras.zh: “该矿已经获得了修改后的批准，允许继续生产到 2032 年。目前还不清楚为什么它需要立法来增加产量，而不经过适当的规划流程。

paras.en: “Communities engaged in good faith in the planning process. This community brought public interest litigation seeking to enforce the law of the land. They won. That decision needs to be respected.”
paras.zh: “社区真诚地参与了规划过程。这个社区提起了公共利益诉讼，寻求执行土地法。他们赢了。这一决定需要得到尊重。”

paras.en: Asked on Monday if the legislation undermined the high court’s decision, Minns said the government was “not seeking a full approval … just to keep pace with the current workforce and the current profile on the site”.
paras.zh: 周一被问及该立法是否破坏了高等法院的裁决时，明斯表示，政府“并不是寻求全面批准......只是为了跟上当前劳动力和网站当前形象的步伐”。

paras.en: He said Mount Pleasant was the state’s “last legacy mine” and rejected the idea that the legislation set a precedent to secure jobs at other mines.
paras.zh: 他表示，芒特普莱森特矿是该州“最后一个遗留矿场”，并拒绝认为该立法为确保其他矿场的就业树立了先例。

paras.en: “We don’t have other mines, certainly not at that scale, that are pending a high court decision or an appeal process.”
paras.zh: “我们没有其他矿山正在等待高等法院的裁决或上诉程序，当然规模也没有那么大。”

articles.title: Amelia Earhart researchers leave remote atoll empty-handed after ‘plane debris’ found to be a clump of trees
articles.author: Oliver Holmes in Bangkok

paras.en: A US expedition that voyaged to a remote Pacific island in the hope of solving the mystery of what happened to pioneering pilot Amelia Earhart has said an object they suspected to be her plane was a clump of washed-up trees.
paras.zh: 一支美国探险队前往太平洋一个偏远岛屿，希望解开先驱飞行员阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特的遭遇之谜，他们表示，他们怀疑是她的飞机的一个物体是一丛被冲毁的树木。

paras.en: “Unfortunately, we weren’t able to find that smoking gun,” said Steve Schultz of Purdue University, standing on the sand in front of a blue lagoon on the atoll of Nikumaroro, about halfway between Australia and Hawaii.
paras.zh: “不幸的是，我们没能找到确凿的证据，”普渡大学的史蒂夫·舒尔茨站在尼库马罗罗环礁上蓝色泻湖前的沙滩上说道，该环礁位于澳大利亚和夏威夷之间。

paras.en: Earhart and her navigator Fred Noonan vanished in 1937 during their attempt to circumnavigate the globe at the equator, leading to one of the largest air and sea searches in history. Nearly 90 years later, people are still looking, with Nikumaroro in the archipelago country of Kiribati emerging as a leading candidate for where they might have crash-landed.
paras.zh: 1937 年，埃尔哈特和她的领航员弗雷德·努南 (Fred Noonan) 在尝试绕赤道环球航行时失踪，导致了历史上最大规模的空中和海上搜索之一。近 90 年后，人们仍在寻找，基里巴斯群岛国家的 Nikumaroro 成为他们可能迫降的主要候选地点。

paras.en: Previous visits to the uninhabited atoll have found signs of a castaway camp, a 1930s-era woman’s shoe and other tantalising evidence attributed to the celebrity aviator, including glass from a cosmetics freckle cream jar.
paras.zh: 之前对这个无人居住的环礁的访问已经发现了漂流者营地的痕迹、一只 1930 年代的女鞋以及其他归因于这位名人飞行员的诱人证据，包括化妆品祛斑霜罐中的玻璃。

paras.en: The latest mission stemmed from 2020 satellite images showing an elongated, white object lying in the shallows of the island, near a sandy outcrop called the Taraia Peninsula.
paras.zh: 最新的任务源于 2020 年的卫星图像，显示一个细长的白色物体位于该岛的浅滩上，靠近称为塔拉亚半岛的沙质露头。

paras.en: Other longtime Earhart explorers quickly identified it as a fallen tree, but Richard Pettigrew, who heads the nonprofit Archaeological Legacy Institute, found other images, including aerial video showing what he suspected to be a metallic glint in the water.
paras.zh: 其他长期从事埃尔哈特探险的人很快就认出这是一棵倒下的树，但非营利性考古遗产研究所所长理查德·佩蒂格鲁发现了其他图像，包括航拍视频，显示他怀疑水中有金属闪光。

paras.en: After a multi-day voyage by ship and subsequent delays due to bad weather, the 17-person expedition managed to pass through the coral-encircled atoll and set up tents to conduct four days of research, including metal detecting. The crew was forced to sleep offshore, partly due to massive land-dwelling coconut crabs, known as “robber crabs” for their inquisitiveness when searching for food.
paras.zh: 经过多天的乘船航行以及随后因恶劣天气造成的延误后，这支由 17 人组成的探险队设法穿过珊瑚环绕的环礁并搭起帐篷，进行了四天的研究，包括金属探测。船员们被迫在海上过夜，部分原因是巨大的陆地椰子蟹，这些椰子蟹因寻找食物时的好奇心而被称为“强盗蟹”。

paras.en: By Monday, Purdue University confirmed in a statement that the “visual anomaly” was “likely a collection of large trees deposited along the peninsula’s sandspit”.
paras.zh: 周一，普渡大学在一份声明中证实，“视觉异常”“可能是沿着半岛沙嘴沉积的大树的集合”。

paras.en: It said the glint was part of a natural process. “The fragment’s reflective surface, long associated with the idea that the object was a metallic substance, was due to its carbonate veneer. Other items found by the team were similarly coated with a shiny concretized amalgam of coral sand.”
paras.zh: 它说闪光是自然过程的一部分。 “该碎片的反射表面长期以来一直与该物体是金属物质的想法联系在一起，这是由于其碳酸盐饰面。该团队发现的其他物品也同样涂有闪亮的珊瑚砂混凝土混合物。”

paras.en: The trip was partially sponsored by the university in Indiana, where Earhart once taught and mentored young female pilots, and which helped fund her modified Lockheed Electra 10-E, known as her “flying laboratory”.
paras.zh: 这次旅行得到了印第安纳州大学的部分赞助，埃尔哈特曾在那里教授和指导年轻的女飞行员，并为她改装的洛克希德·伊莱克特拉 10-E（被称为她的“飞行实验室”）提供了资金。

paras.en: “While we know this is disappointing to many, including us, this mission adds a new chapter in the quest to find the ultimate answer to the mystery of what happened to Earhart during her attempt to circumnavigate the globe nearly nine decades ago,” the university statement said.
paras.zh: 该大学的声明称：“虽然我们知道这让包括我们在内的许多人感到失望，但这次任务为寻找近九个十年前埃尔哈特试图环球航行时所发生的谜团的最终答案翻开了新的篇章。”

paras.en: The trip adds to a growing list of dismissed hypotheses, including that Earhart – who was the first woman to make a nonstop solo transatlantic flight – was captured by Japanese forces or that she survived and lived under an alias.
paras.zh: 这次旅行又增加了越来越多被驳回的假设，包括埃尔哈特——她是第一位进行不间断单人跨大西洋飞行的女性——被日本军队俘虏，或者她幸存下来并以化名生活。

articles.title: France's government under pressure after weekend of widespread violence

paras.en: France's Prime Minister SÃ©bastien Lecornu is holding a crisis cabinet meeting on Monday to assess a weekend of violence and looting across the country, in what were some of the worst scenes of public disorder in modern French history.
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努周一召开危机内阁会议，评估周末全国各地发生的暴力和抢劫事件，这是法国现代史上最严重的公共骚乱场面。

paras.en: On Saturday over half a million mainly peaceful protesters demonstrated against rising living costs and dwindling access to decent public services, including a good state education. But the protests turned nasty after groups of black-clad, masked activists and vandals appeared.
paras.zh: 周六，超过五十万主要是和平抗议者举行示威，抗议生活成本上涨和获得体面公共服务（包括良好的公立教育）的机会减少。但在一群身穿黑衣、蒙面的活动人士和破坏者出现后，抗议活动变得令人厌恶。

paras.en: An estimated 1,500 shops and businesses were looted and destroyed. Riot police fired tear gas and turned water cannon on crowds. They were seen hitting people with batons in several places. France's interior ministry said about 1,000 police officers were injured on Saturday, seven of them seriously.
paras.zh: 估计有 1,500 家商店和企业遭到抢劫和破坏。防暴警察向人群发射催泪瓦斯并向人群开水枪。人们在几个地方看到他们用警棍殴打人们。法国内政部表示，周六约有 1000 名警察受伤，其中 7 人伤势严重。

paras.en: There had been rumours in France that President Emmanuel Macron may introduce a temporary curfew in parts of the country, or even impose a state of emergency to help calm the febrile atmosphere. In the end, he used a televised address to the nation on Sunday to call for national unity and to try to assure the French public that the perpetrators of the violence would be punished.
paras.zh: 法国曾有传言称，总统马克龙可能会在该国部分地区实施临时宵禁，甚至实施紧急状态，以帮助平息狂热气氛。最后，他在周日向全国发表电视讲话，呼吁全国团结，并试图向法国公众保证，暴力肇事者将受到惩罚。

paras.en: Macron's speech has been roundly criticised on social media forums and by political opponents for lacking concrete detail.
paras.zh: 马克龙的讲话因缺乏具体细节而在社交媒体论坛和政治对手上遭到严厉批评。

paras.en: How will vandals and rioters now be brought to account?
paras.zh: 现在将如何追究破坏者和骚乱者的责任？

paras.en: How might France's towns and cities be better protected - especially since new mass demonstrations have been announced in a couple of weeks' time?
paras.zh: 法国的城镇如何才能得到更好的保护——尤其是在几周后宣布将举行新的大规模示威活动的情况下？

paras.en: Exactly how will destroyed businesses be compensated?
paras.zh: 被毁的企业究竟如何得到补偿？

paras.en: And when will a dialogue be established with students and teachers' bodies on the subject of education?
paras.zh: 何时与学生和教师团体就教育主题建立对话？

paras.en: On Sunday the Secretary General of the CGT union, Sophie Binet, accused Macron of failing to address students' concerns, the cost-of-living crisis or the dwindling quality of public services in France.
paras.zh: 周日，CGT 工会秘书长索菲·比奈指责马克龙未能解决法国学生的担忧、生活成本危机或公共服务质量下降的问题。

paras.en: He's apparently passed that baton to Prime Minister Lecornu. Yet he and his interior minister are charged by many in France with being woefully ill-prepared and under-policed ahead of Saturday's multiple, scheduled protests.
paras.zh: 他显然已经把接力棒交给了总理勒科尔努。然而，法国许多人指责他和他的内政部长在周六预定的多场抗议活动之前准备不足，警力不足。

paras.en: The president of France's lower house of parliament, YaÃ«l Braun-Pivet, says she wants to open an inquiry into exactly what happened this weekend and why.
paras.zh: 法国下议院议长雅尔·布劳恩-皮维表示，她希望对本周末到底发生了什么以及原因展开调查。

paras.en: "Things are dark in the city of light [a nickname for Paris]" was the graffiti I read daubed in red paint across a wall adjacent to a row of shattered shops in the French capital on Sunday night.
paras.zh: 周日晚上，我在法国首都一排破烂商店附近的墙上看到了用红色油漆涂抹的涂鸦，“光之城（巴黎的昵称）里一切都是黑暗的”。

paras.en: Macron is widely viewed here as a lame-duck president. He is on his way out. There's a hotly contested race under way to become his successor, with the vote scheduled in six months' time. The presidential candidate from the anti-immigration nationalist right (Marine Le Pen) and also the anti-capitalist left (Jean-Luc Melenchon) are vying to make headlines.
paras.zh: 马克龙在这里被广泛视为跛脚鸭总统。他正在出去的路上。他的继任者争夺战正在激烈进行，投票定于六个月后进行。来自反移民民族主义右翼（玛丽娜·勒庞）和反资本主义左翼（让-吕克·梅朗雄）的总统候选人正在争夺成为头条新闻。

paras.en: That is adding to current tensions in France - in politics as well as on the streets.
paras.zh: 这加剧了法国目前政治和街头的紧张局势。

paras.en: Parliament here is paralysed, deeply divided between three vying political blocks.
paras.zh: 这里的议会陷入瘫痪，三个相互竞争的政治派别深度分裂。

paras.en: Then there are France's financial woes too. Investors are leaning hard on this country to get its spiralling public debt under control. But the French government worries, if it cuts public services or welfare, yet more angry people will pour out onto the streets.
paras.zh: 此外，法国也面临着金融困境。投资者正大力指望这个国家控制其不断上升的公共债务。但法国政府担心，如果削减公共服务或福利，更多愤怒的人会涌上街头。

paras.en: What now, what next, is our country broken? You hear these questions a lot at the moment.
paras.zh: 现在怎么办，接下来怎么办，我们的国家已经崩溃了吗？你现在经常听到这些问题。

paras.en: People across France were shocked and troubled by Saturday's events. The images of tear-gassed towns, apparently unimpeded looters and burning public buildings have worried the nation.
paras.zh: 法国各地的人们对周六的事件感到震惊和不安。催泪瓦斯袭击的城镇、显然畅通无阻的抢劫者和燃烧的公共建筑的画面让全国感到担忧。

paras.en: Many passers-by I speak to express frustration that, while they worry about the future, their leading politicians seem, instead, to be passionately focused on finger-pointing; blaming one another for the volatility.
paras.zh: 与我交谈的许多路人都表达了沮丧，他们在担心未来的同时，他们的主要政客似乎却热衷于相互指责；互相指责对方造成波动。

paras.en: "While we worry for our safety, they use this situation as a pre-presidential election political football," teacher and father of three Edouard told me.
paras.zh: “虽然我们担心自己的安全，但他们却利用这种情况作为总统选举前的政治足球，”老师、三个孩子的父亲爱德华告诉我。

paras.en: Macron and his prime minister blamed Saturday's violent chaos on radical far left groups and delinquents; hard left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon alleged government "incompetence"; Marine Le Pen on the nationalist right, which likes to be seen as strong on law and order, posted a video seated in front of the French flag, giving a presidential-style address blaming the "Macronist administration that is out of steam, exhausted, and disoriented".
paras.zh: 马克龙和他的总理将周六的暴力混乱归咎于激进的极左团体和罪犯；极左翼领袖让-吕克·梅朗雄 (Jean-Luc Melenchon) 指责政府“无能”；民族主义右翼人士马琳·勒庞(Marine Le Pen)喜欢被视为在法律和秩序方面很强硬，她发布了一段坐在法国国旗前的视频，发表了总统式的讲话，指责“马克龙主义政府失去了动力、疲惫不堪、迷失方向”。

paras.en: For the next two weeks, the French authorities hope for a bit of a respite. Students start their half-term break as of Monday.
paras.zh: 在接下来的两周里，法国当局希望能得到一些喘息的机会。学生从周一开始期中休息。

paras.en: But on 5 November, a cross-section of trade unions, plus France's disparate "yellow jacket" (gilets jaunes) movement that staged demonstrations for over a year in 2018 - during Macron's first term as president - have announced huge protests.
paras.zh: 但在 11 月 5 日，各个工会组织以及法国不同的“黄背心”运动（在 2018 年马克龙第一任总统任期内举行了一年多的示威活动）宣布了大规模抗议活动。

articles.title: Anthropic says it will commit 5% of its shares to 'public benefit fund'

paras.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) giant Anthropic says it will commit 5% of its shares to a fund that will make donations for the "public good".
paras.zh: 人工智能 (AI) 巨头 Anthropic 表示，将把 5% 的股份投入一个基金，该基金将为“公共利益”捐款。

paras.en: The announcement comes as Anthropic lays the ground for a potential blockbuster stock market listing that could value the firm at more than $1tn (Â£750bn).
paras.zh: 这一消息发布之际，Anthropic 正在为潜在的重磅股票上市奠定基础，该公司的估值可能超过 1 万亿美元（7500 亿英镑）。

paras.en: The AI industry has come under intense scrutiny recently over safety concerns and fears about its impact on society and the economy. Anthropic reportedly said in its initial public offering (IPO) filing that AI could pose "catastrophic or existential risks to humanity".
paras.zh: 人工智能行业最近因安全问题以及对其对社会和经济影响的担忧而受到严格审查。据报道，Anthropic 在其首次公开募股（IPO）文件中表示，人工智能可能会给“人类带来灾难性或生存风险”。

paras.en: Anthropic said its proposed fund could support nonprofit organisations, and efforts to address AI's impact on the jobs market.
paras.zh: Anthropic 表示，其拟议的基金可以支持非营利组织，以及解决人工智能对就业市场影响的努力。

paras.en: None of the shares held by the the fund would be used for lobbying or political donations in the US or overseas, it added.
paras.zh: 它补充说，该基金持有的任何股份都不会用于在美国或海外进行游说或政治捐赠。

paras.en: Anthropic's Public Benefit Fund could also receive another 2% of the firm's shares at its board's discretion, the Claude developer said in a statement released on Sunday.
paras.zh: 克洛德开发商在周日发布的一份声明中表示，Anthropic 的公共福利基金还可以根据董事会的决定获得该公司另外 2% 的股份。

paras.en: Technology billionaire Elon Musk responded to the announcement on social media with: "I recommend giving the shares directly to the public." "This is what I will be doing," he added.
paras.zh: 科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克在社交媒体上回应了这一消息：“我建议直接向公众发放股票。” “这就是我要做的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Last week, Anthropic told prospective investors that its revenue surged by 45% to $16.8bn (Â£12.6bn) in the three months to the end of September.
paras.zh: 上周，Anthropic 告诉潜在投资者，截至 9 月底的三个月内，其收入猛增 45%，达到 168 亿美元（126 亿英镑）。

paras.en: In common with other AI firms, it is seeking to position itself as being able to generate huge profits despite spending billions on developing the technology and building infrastructure to power its models.
paras.zh: 与其他人工智能公司一样，尽管花费数十亿美元开发技术和建设基础设施来支持其模型，但它仍寻求将自己定位为能够产生巨额利润。

paras.en: Companies around the world, primarily technology firms, have cut thousands of jobs after investing in AI, with many pointing to higher efficiencies from its adoption.
paras.zh: 世界各地的公司，主要是科技公司，在投资人工智能后已经裁员数千人，许多人指出采用人工智能可以提高效率。

paras.en: Research by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) published in 2024 suggested that almost 40% of jobs around the world will be affected by AI, with that figure rising as high as â60% in advanced economies.
paras.zh: 国际货币基金组织 (IMF) 2024 年发布的研究表明，全球近 40% 的就业机会将受到人工智能的影响，而在发达经济体，这一数字高达 60%。

paras.en: In September, a researcher who quit Anthropic said people working on the technology were "genuinely frightened" about the speed of its advancements and what it could mean for humanity.
paras.zh: 今年 9 月，一位退出 Anthropic 的研究人员表示，从事这项技术的人们对其进步的速度以及它对人类的意义感到“真正害怕”。

paras.en: "I believe that if we don't slow down at the current rate of progress, there is a strong chance that we could all die in the immediate future," he said.
paras.zh: “我相信，如果我们不按照目前的进展速度放慢速度，我们很有可能在不久的将来都会死去，”他说。

paras.en: Jacob Coxon was speaking to the BBC after his resignation post on the dangers of AI went viral on a backdrop of growing safety concerns about the industry.
paras.zh: 雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 在接受 BBC 采访时表示，在人们对人工智能的安全担忧日益加剧的背景下，他关于人工智能危险的辞职帖子在网上疯传。

paras.en: The 27-year-old's former boss, Anthropic head Dario Amodei, had previously called for AI development to slow down - though some have questioned the motivations behind this.
paras.zh: 这位 27 岁的前任老板、人类学负责人达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 此前曾呼吁放慢人工智能的发展速度，尽管有些人质疑这背后的动机。

paras.en: The bosses of two rival AI firms, Sam Altman of OpenAI and Musk, have both said they agree with Amodei's proposal for industry-wide deceleration and regulation, as well as independent monitoring of AI model development.
paras.zh: OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 和 Musk 两家竞争对手人工智能公司的老板都表示，他们同意 Amodei 关于全行业减速和监管以及对人工智能模型开发进行独立监控的提议。

paras.en: Earlier this month, US President Donald Trump and the heads of major AI firms signed a "morally binding" document, making them responsible for ensuring the safety of their own technology.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和主要人工智能公司的负责人签署了一份“具有道德约束力”的文件，要求他们负责确保自己技术的安全。

paras.en: Trump has repeatedly rejected the idea of laws to control development of the technology despite a debate about the potential risks of AI and what it means for humanity.
paras.zh: 尽管关于人工智能的潜在风险及其对人类意味着什么存在争议，但特朗普一再拒绝通过法律来控制技术发展的想法。

paras.en: Since then, the president has named the director of national intelligence Jay Clayton as the head of a new taskforce on AI which, he said, will co-ordinate government engagement with consumers, companies and "religious organizations".
paras.zh: 此后，总统任命国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿（Jay Clayton）为新的人工智能特别工作组的负责人，他表示，该工作组将协调政府与消费者、公司和“宗教组织”的互动。

articles.title: Australian Greens senator denies claims of misconduct towards women

paras.en: An Australian Greens senator has denied allegations of inappropriate behaviour towards women and accused his party of "nasty political games", days after the claims emerged.
paras.zh: 一名澳大利亚绿党参议员否认了针对女性的不当行为的指控，并指责他的政党进行“令人讨厌的政治游戏”，几天后该指控出现。

paras.en: Last Thursday, Greens leader David Shoebridge said Senator Jordon Steele-John, 32, had taken leave from the party room after a letter from seven current and former members said he had been accused of "multiple allegations" of misconduct between 2017 and 2025.
paras.zh: 上周四，绿党领袖戴维·舒布里奇 (David Shoebridge) 表示，32 岁的参议员乔登·斯蒂尔·约翰 (Jordon Steele-John) 已从党室休假，此前七名现任和前任成员写信称，他被指控在 2017 年至 2025 年间犯有不当行为的“多项指控”。

paras.en: In an online post on Sunday, the senator denied the claims and said he was not on leave. On a sexual assault claim, he said police investigating the matter had closed the case and no charges were laid.
paras.zh: 这位参议员周日在网上发帖否认了这一说法，并表示他没有休假。关于性侵犯指控，他说调查此事的警方已结案，没有提出任何指控。

paras.en: An internal party probe has been launched into the allegations.
paras.zh: 党内调查已针对这些指控展开。

paras.en: Steele-John, who has cerebral palsy and uses a wheelchair, was first elected to the senate in Western Australia in November 2017.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰患有脑瘫并需要使用轮椅，他于 2017 年 11 月首次当选为西澳大利亚州参议员。

paras.en: In his letter responding to the claims, Steele-John said his nickname - "Feels on wheels" - initially referred to him being emotional when advocating for disability rights but had since taken on a "more sinister meaning" about his alleged mistreatment of women.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰在回应这些指控的信中表示，他的昵称“车轮上的感觉”最初是指他在倡导残疾人权利时情绪激动，但后来对他涉嫌虐待妇女的行为有了“更险恶的含义”。

paras.en: He accused Shoebridge of mishandling the matter and questioned the timing of the letter, saying "it is no coincidence" that the allegations were sent to the leader "the day after we agreed on the timeline for the next preselection" ahead of the next federal election.
paras.zh: 他指责舒布里奇处理此事不当，并质疑这封信的时间安排，称这些指控是在下一次联邦选举前“我们就下一次预选的时间表达成一致的第二天”发送给这位领导人的，“这并非巧合”。

paras.en: Days after the letter with the claims was sent to Shoebridge, local media reported that the party had created a 47-page dossier years earlier that listed a number of allegations against Steele-John and how to manage media coverage if they emerged.
paras.zh: 载有指控的信函被发送给舒布里奇几天后，当地媒体报道称，该党几年前就创建了一份 47 页的档案，其中列出了针对斯蒂尔-约翰的多项指控，以及如果这些指控出现，如何管理媒体报道。

paras.en: Steele-John said the dossier was made so that the media would not "bombard" the two women at the centre of those claims and that neither woman had made a complaint.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰表示，制作这份档案是为了让媒体不会“轰炸”这两名处于这些指控中心的女性，而且两名女性都没有提出投诉。

paras.en: He acknowledged the allegations against him would have "damaged" the public's trust in him and said he was "committed to rebuilding that by acting with as much transparency and accountability as I can".
paras.zh: 他承认针对他的指控将“损害”公众对他的信任，并表示他“致力于通过尽可能透明和负责任的行动来重建这种信任”。

paras.en: Shoebridge's office confirmed that the allegations had been referred to the Independent Parliamentary Standards Commission.
paras.zh: 舒布里奇的办公室证实，这些指控已提交给独立议会标准委员会。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Shoebridge said the leader still believed "leave is appropriate under the circumstances" and taking leave would not influence the internal party investigation.
paras.zh: Shoebridge的发言人表示，该领导人仍然认为“在这种情况下休假是适当的”，并且休假不会影响党内调查。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.

articles.title: GM, Ford active safety engineers to speak during SCRS OEM Summit at SEMA Show
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: At the SEMA Show next month, active safety engineers from General Motors and Ford will provide a look behind the engineering decisions that influence vehicle safety before, during, and after a collision.

They’ll speak during the second session of the Society of Collision Repair Specialists’ (SCRS) 2026 OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, titled “Engineering the Safety Benefit: From Requirements to Real-World Performance,” Thursday, Nov. 5, from 2–3 p.m.

It will follow an earlier session featuring National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Deputy Administrator Lee White from 12:30–1:30 p.m. White will examine vehicle safety priorities and the agency’s role in advancing safety on U.S. roadways.
To register for all three OEM Summit sessions, visit here.
An SCRS RDE Full Series Pass provides access to Tuesday and Wednesday RDE sessions, the IDEAS Collide Showcase, Thursday’s OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit, and the SCRS Afterparty.

“This second session will move from those broader safety objectives into the vehicle itself, examining how automakers translate requirements and safety goals into technologies designed to produce measurable real-world benefits,” an SCRS press release states. “The afternoon will then progress to the collision repair environment, exploring how those engineered capabilities are preserved and restored after a vehicle has been damaged.”

The second session will bring together engineers who are responsible for developing, evaluating, and measuring advanced vehicle safety systems. Attendees will learn about the engineering decisions that influence vehicle safety.

Panelists include Michael Carpenter, General Motors Active Safety and Global Vehicle Performance owner; Jameson Collins, General Motors Active Safety and staff product manager; and Jeremy Nelson, Ford Motor Co. ADAS application systems engineer.

Carpenter works within GM Global Product Safety, Systems, and Certification on ADAS technology and performance strategies, new technology development, implementation of regulatory and consumer metric requirements, ADAS field effectiveness and safety benefits, and industry collaboration on standards and test-method development.

Collins leads product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for GM’s Active Safety features, translating customer needs, competitive insights, and regulatory requirements into technologies intended to improve safety and the driving experience.

Nelson focuses on the development, release, integration, and servicing of advanced driver assistance system domain controllers. He supports vehicle production and development milestones while troubleshooting ADAS components and working across engineering, quality, and product development teams to ensure systems perform safely and as intended.

The discussion will be moderated by Jake Rodenroth, automotive industry executive, and will move beyond what ADAS features do to examine why they exist, how their intended performance is established, and how their effectiveness is evaluated. This will include what it means when a safety system is absent, disabled, damaged, or operating outside its intended parameters.

The release states: “That progression leads directly to a fundamental question for collision repair professionals: If a vehicle entered a collision with a measurable safety capability, how can the repairer know that capability has been restored?”

The panel will also explore ADAS feature development, real-world effectiveness, crash avoidance and mitigation, implications of inoperable systems, verification of safety performance, and the potential for system degradation.
The 2026 OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit is part of SCRS’ Repairer Driven Education (RDE) program at the SEMA Show.

“The Summit brings collision repair professionals together with automakers, engineers, regulators, and other subject-matter experts to examine emerging technologies and their implications for safe and complete vehicle repair,” the release states.

During the first session, White will present on the agency’s current vehicle and roadway safety priorities, emerging transportation technologies, data-driven research, and the federal government’s work with the industry to reduce fatalities and serious injuries, an SCRS release states.

Following White’s presentation, he will sit down with Aaron Schulenburg, SCRS executive director, for a one-on-one conversation exploring the intersection between federal safety objectives, automotive innovation, and the collision repair industry’s role in preserving vehicle safety throughout its service life.
NHTSA sits at the center of many discussions that impact the collision repair industry.

During a July Collision Industry Conference meeting, Schulenburg discussed NHTSA’s investigation into counterfeit airbags with Teena Bohi, an Automotive Anti-Counterfeiting Council (A2C2) Board member.

In April, NHTSA announced a ban on one type of counterfeit airbag part. Before the ban, it also issued an “urgent” industry alert specifically asking the auto repair industry to look for dangerous airbag inflators.
Repair procedures are impacted by NHTSA-mandated vehicle safety technology. This includes mandated backup cameras in all new vehicles under 10,000 pounds as of May 2018.
NHTSA also has a final rule that mandates automatic emergency braking (AEB) in pedestrian vehicles by September 2029.
However, NHTSA also announced it paused the rule to give the Trump administration time to review it following pushback and a lawsuit filed by the Alliance of Automotive Innovation (Auto Innovators).
Additional information about SCRS and RDE can be found at www.scrs.come/rde
For more information about SCRS or to join as a member, visit www.scrs.com, call 877-841-0660, or email [email protected]

articles.title: Class action lawsuit filed against CCC alleging consumer personal information misuse
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A class action lawsuit filed Oct. 8 in California against CCC Intelligent Solutions and CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings alleges that CCC stores personally identifiable information (PII) from collision repair estimates created in CCC ONE to inform its artificial intelligence products and analytics.

The PII in question includes customer names, home addresses, phone numbers, insurance claim numbers, vehicle identification numbers, license plate numbers, and vehicle mileage. CCC also stores photos of damaged vehicles, according to the suit.
Plaintiffs LaTrenda Zekenya Burries, Gloribel Lissbeth Garcia, and Katleen Saturné were all involved in vehicle collisions and sought repairs at California collision repair facilities.
The suit alleges intrusion upon seclusion, invasion of privacy under the California Constitution, unjust enrichment, and violation of California’s unfair competition law.

The Law Offices of Maro Burunsuzyan, on behalf of the plaintiffs, says the alleged harm is the loss of privacy and control over personal information, including the ability to decide whether it could be repurposed and commercially exploited, as well as being deprived of resulting economic value.

CCC allegedly combines stored PII with data across its network to build AI products and analytics that it licenses to other customers without notice, consent, or compensation to the consumers who own the information, according to the complaint.
When Repairer Driven News asked CCC for comment on the suit, CCC replied that it “doesn’t comment on pending litigation.”

“Its contract with insurers provides that ‘CCC may use data to train AI Services,'” the complaint states. “Its contract with repair facilities reserves to CCC the use of the facility’s data for CCC’s own ‘product improvement, and research and development,’ a use that ‘may continue after the expiration or termination of this agreement.’ CCC tells consumers none of this. No page of the estimate describes CCC’s retention, aggregation, or commercial use of the personal information, or gives the consumer any way to opt out of it, see it, or delete it.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The suit adds that a repair facility’s contract with CCC doesn’t equal consumers’ consent for CCC to collect and use their data.
“CCC’s own contract anticipates as much by requiring the repair facility to indemnify CCC ‘for failure to obtain the requisite authorizations,'” the suit states.

The agreements noted in the suit are CCC’s Repair Facility License Agreement, effective in 2018; form Independent Appraiser Master License Agreement, reflected in a product schedule executed in 2024; the Insurer MSA, CCC’s public Master Services Agreement for insurers, last updated Nov. 7, 2025; and CCC’s companion Data Processing Addendum (DPA), last updated Nov. 4, 2025.

According to the suit, the Repair Facility License Agreement “authorizes CCC to provide the repair ‘content’ to insurers whose direct repair programs the shop participates in, or with whom the shop configures CCC ONE UpdatePlus to share information, and separately authorizes CCC to provide the Content to CCC’s vendor, Flash of Genius, Inc. (d/b/a UpdatePromise) (“Flash”), granting the identified insurers, CCC, and that vendor ‘perpetual, royalty-free licenses to use the content.'”
The agreement also “forbids the repair facility itself to ‘compile estimate data for the purpose of creating a database,’ a use that CCC reserves to itself…”

The Appraiser License Agreement also forbids the appraiser to “‘compile estimate data for the purpose of creating a database'” and “‘aggregate or co-mingle data in the programs and/or services or provide reports or analysis based on data in the programs and/or services to anyone.'”

It notes as well that a section of the Insurer MSA, titled “License by Customer to CCC,” “contemplates the development or testing of artificial intelligence tools or models on Customer Data that has not been de-identified, subject only to the customer’s prior written approval, which the provision states CCC may accept by e-mail from a vice-president-level or higher employee of the customer.”
The plaintiffs contend that consumers aren’t parties or signatories to the aforementioned agreements despite CCC’s collection, movement, and licensing of their personal information.

“The Repair Facility License Agreement runs between CCC and a collision repair facility, the Appraiser License Agreement runs between CCC and an independent appraiser, and the Insurer MSA and DPA run between CCC and an insurer,” the suit states.

“The only authorization CCC obtains to take and use consumers’ personal information under these agreements is the business’s own promise: under the Repair Facility License Agreement, customer ‘represents and warrants that it has full right and authority to provide the authorization and licenses contained herein,’ and indemnifies CCC ‘for failure to obtain the requisite authorizations;’ and under the Appraiser License Agreement, customer ‘represents and warrants that it has the right to provide the data to CCC.'”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The suit also states that CCC has patented training AI models on identifiable consumer data and harvesting vehicle event data recorder information, including U.S. Patent No. 10,922,726; U.S. Patent No. 11,727,551; and U.S. Patent No. 9,500,545.

“Taken together, these patents describe CCC’s designs for systems that ingest, store, retrain on, and reuse identifiable consumer and vehicle data of the kinds that populate CCC ONE, including names, home addresses, VINs, license plates, policy and claim identifiers, and event-data-recorder data,” the suit states. “On information and belief, CCC has implemented these designs in the CCC ONE platform and in the artificial-intelligence products and analytics it licenses to insurers and other customers.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The proposed nationwide class includes more than 15 million U.S. vehicle owners or customers named on repair estimates that a U.S. collision repair facility prepared on CCC ONE in the four years before the complaint was filed. It also proposes a nationwide intrusion subclass and a California subclass.

Relief sought includes nominal and punitive damages, restitution and disgorgement of the value CCC obtained from consumers’ information, barring CCC from using consumer information for AI training or other purposes beyond the estimate without consent, and requiring CCC to delete consumer PII.

An injunction on behalf of the California subclass would require CCC to inform California consumers before or when their personal information is entered into CCC ONE at a collision repair facility of its identity, the categories of PII it collects, and the purposes of use for the PII. It would also require CCC to obtain consumer consent before using PII for any purpose beyond preparing or transmitting vehicle estimates or valuations.
CCC hadn’t filed a response to the suit in court as of Monday afternoon.

“Artificial intelligence is reshaping the economy, and the question of what these systems are built on has never mattered more,” said Maro Burunsuzyan, attorney for the plaintiffs and founder of the Law Offices of Maro Burunsuzyan, in a press release.

“The complaint alleges that, in CCC’s case, part of the answer is the personal information of ordinary people who simply needed a car repaired. Those drivers were never told, never asked, and never paid. This case is about restoring a basic principle: a company that wants to profit from your information should have to ask you first.”
